8960.title: Bodley's Unfortunate Fate
8960.description:
So we need to recover the rest of the medallion? Finding Bodley's going to be a bit of a headache. He went back to Blackrock Mountain to attempt to re-enter Blackrock Spire and never came back.

I'd suggest taking the goblin's ghost revealing device with you, as I fear the worst might have happened.
8960.completion:
I am so glad that you can see me. Finally someone to talk to!

Will you help us, <name>? Help to undo the wrong that we perpetrated and put things to right? If it's true that you already have the Top Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet, then I think I can point you in the right direction to acquire the other two parts, reunite them and put an end to all of this.

Oh, by the way, hello, my name is Bodley. Nice to meet you!

8961.title: Three Kings of Flame
8961.description:
In order to summon Lord Valthalak we're first going to need to gather the other two-thirds of the amulet. To do that we need to get a brazier and some special coals to burn in it.

There are three nobles of fire, Lord Incedius in Blackrock Depths, Pyroguard Emberseer in Blackrock Spire and The Duke of Cynders in Silithus, with what we need. Collect from each a piece of their remains, and then return to me with a Hallowed Brazier, which can be purchased from the Argent Dawn if you are honored by them.
8961.progress:
It was our folly... our doom that we took that last job. If only we hadn't inadvertently stolen Lord Valthalak's spirit, which was contained in the amulet; if only there weren't those in our mercenary group that had been so greedy and divided it up amongst themselves. I'd be alive today, maybe tossing back a beer, or tossing one of my kids into the air.

<name>, don't let the avarice of the ignoble in our old mercenary company be your doom as well.
8961.completion:
I'm impressed, <class>, but there's no time to lose. I will give you your next task, because you will still need to acquire a few more important components before we can proceed.

Speak to me again when you feel that you are ready for the challenge that lies ahead.

8962.title: Components of Importance
8962.description:
<class>, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.

Mor Grayhoof, our most prominent druid, had many close friends amongst the Cenarion Circle, some of which have fallen to the silithid. I need you to retrieve some Druidical Remains from the silithid that inhabit the environs of Hive'Regal in southeastern Silithus.
8962.progress: Have you returned already then, <class>, with what I sent you out to gather?
8962.completion:
A job well done, <name>. I will imbue the essence of the remains into the brazier.

Now all that is left is to go to the lower portion of Blackrock Spire, to the chamber where War Master Voone resides in Tazz'Alaor, and use the brazier to summon forth the corrupted spirit of my former cohort, Mor Grayhoof. He cannot rest until the amulet piece is taken from him.

8963.title: Components of Importance
8963.description:
<class>, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.

Isalien, our priestess, grew up in Winterspring at Starbreeze Village. I need you to gather a Starbreeze Village Relic from the Frostmaul giants of Frostwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, who are known for raiding to the north from time to time.
8963.progress: Have you returned already then, <class>, with what I sent you out to gather?
8963.completion:
A job well done, <name>. I will imbue the essence of the relic into the brazier.

Now all that is left is to go to the Shrine of Eldretharr in the east wing of Dire Maul, and use the brazier to summon forth the spirit of my former cohort, Isalien. Her spirit has been corrupted by her possession of the piece of Valthalak's amulet, and the portion of his soul within it.

8964.title: Components of Importance
8964.description:
<class>, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to summon the remains of my deceased, former comrades.

The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, were believers in the way of the Scarlet Crusade. They aspired to knighthood within that vile organization. Go to Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands and retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry from the praetorians there.
8964.progress: Have you returned already then, <class>, with what I sent you out to gather?
8964.completion:
A job well done, <name>. I will imbue the essence of the sword into the brazier.

Now all that is left is to get into The Crimson Throne inside The Scarlet Bastion at Stratholme, and use the brazier to summon forth the remains of my former cohorts, Jarien and Sothos. Their souls have been twisted further by their possession of Valthalak's amulet piece and his spirit within.

8965.title: Components of Importance
8965.description:
<class>, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.

An ogre necromancer that traveled with us, Kormok, delighted in summoning forth the souls of the banished dead of Purgation Isle, off the south coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Go there and retrieve some Soul Ashes of the Banished from their remains.
8965.progress: Have you returned already then, <class>, with what I sent you out to gather?
8965.completion:
A job well done, <name>. I will imbue the essence of the ashes into the brazier.

Now all that is left is to get into Scholomance, to Ras Frostwhisper's chamber, and use the brazier to summon forth the spirit of my former cohort, Kormok. The amulet piece, and Valthalak's spirit within, has corrupted him even further, and he will not rest until you forcibly take it from him.

8966.title: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
8966.description:
My friend, Mor Grayhoof, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.

Later, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by War Master Voone. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of Voone.
8966.progress: Then it is done? You have retrieved the left piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet and finally put to rest the spirit of my old companion, Mor Grayhoof?
8966.completion:
You have done a great thing, <name>. One spirit rests in peace, but there is still much work to be done before we can put all of this behind us.

Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.

8967.title: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
8967.description:
It became known to us in later days, as we were doing what we could ourselves to survive, that Isalien, a night elf priestess of our company, had gone to the night elvic ancestral city, now known as Dire Maul. From what we gathered, she went there both for personal reasons and also to unlock the secrets of the piece of the amulet that she had in her possession.

She didn't quite make it, though. Word got back to us that she was ambushed at the Shrine of Eldretharr by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces.
8967.progress: Surely you haven't already dealt with the salvation of Isalien's spirit and the retrieval of the left piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, <name>?
8967.completion:
Thank you, <name>, for putting Isalien's spirit to rest. Now, perhaps, she will find peace with her goddess. But, there is still a great deal of work ahead of us if we are to get out of this fine pickle we find ourselves in.

Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.

8968.title: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
8968.description:
The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, decided to join the Scarlet Crusade upon the disbanding of our mercenary company. They took the left piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet with them. Good riddance, I say, but we need that piece back.

From what we could gather, they were actually slain by Grand Crusader Dathrohan himself for failing the initiation rites inside his chamber in the Scarlet Bastion.

In any case, we... meaning you, are still going to need to retrieve that piece of the amulet.
8968.progress: Does this mean then, <class>, that you've already put the souls of those two fools to rest and retrieved the left piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet?
8968.completion:
I suppose it's for the best that the souls of those two have finally been put to rest, even if I didn't like them while they were alive. In any case, we have what we were after, and that is definitely a good thing!

Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.

8969.title: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
8969.description:
Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning.

Kormok was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, Scholomance.

But even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.
8969.progress: I commend you, <name>, if you have returned with the left piece of the amulet. If not, however, please take care of that as there is no time to waste, I assure you!
8969.completion:
Good work, <name>! Kormok wasn't all that bad for an ogre, at least not while he was still alive, so I hope he gets the rest that he deserves. But, there is more work ahead of us.

Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.

8970.title: I See Alcaz Island In Your Future...
8970.description:
As I was saying, <class>, in my living years I flirted with becoming a diviner. But, there really wasn't as much profit in it as you might imagine, mostly because it's dangerous and the reagents are rare and expensive. However, I do know enough to be able to pinpoint the final piece of the amulet, and the spirit of my former comrade along with it.

This is where you come in, <name>. I need you to go to Alcaz Island off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh and collect Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga that live there.
8970.progress: Bloodkelp, <name>, a big stack of it, that's what I need to power my divinatory spells. You're likely to need to take at least a couple of friends along with you to Alcaz Island to gather it up... those Strashaz are a nasty lot!
8970.completion:
To be honest, <name>, I'm surprised you made it back in one piece. Then again, I guess Alcaz Island is the least of your worries right now.

Ok, give me a moment here... divination isn't something that you can just snap your fingers and expect accurate answers from.

8977.title: Return to Deliana
8977.description:
It's been great working with you, <name>. Here is the finished product.

I hope it helps you in your current endeavors. And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word. I wouldn't mind having more customers!
8977.completion: Excellent! You've done well, <name>. I'm not sure I trust the goblin's craftsmanship, but I'm left with no other choice.

8978.title: Return to Mokvar
8978.description:
It's been great working with you, <name>. Here is the finished product.

I hope it helps you in your current endeavors. And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word. I wouldn't mind having more customers!
8978.completion: You've returned with the device! I'm impressed by your dedication, <name>. Excellent work.

8979.title: Fenstad's Hunch
8979.description:
I believe I know the cause of this recent behavior. Have you smelled the new fragrance on the wind, over the stink of the canals? The new colognes and perfumes that have come into fashion?

Our thinking has been clouded by some foul alchemy.

There is only one way to be sure - bring a bottle of cologne and perfume to my friend, Apothecary Zinge. The Royal Apothecary Society will find the truth.

I will reimburse you for their purchase when you return.
8979.completion:
Another one of Fenstad's obsessions, I see. Does he think that the Royal Apothecary Society has nothing better to do than to perform his little investigations?

Very well, I will humor him once again.

8980.title: Zinge's Assessment
8980.description:
This is unexpected. It looks like Fenstad might be on to something after all. I found traces of substances used in mind control potions.

It isn't unheard of for perfumes to have some of this, but a few of the ingredients I detected... This is serious alchemy, along the abilities of a member of the Royal Apothecary Society.
8980.completion:
So, I was right. We must waste no time. We must determine the source of these tainted fragrances.

Here, to repay you for the purchase of the cologne and perfume.

8981.title: Gift Giving
8981.progress: Have you come to deliver a present of love and adoration to your favorite leader? Horde Gift Collection
8981.completion:
Wonderful! Wonderful! I will add this to the pile of other gifts.

I didn't expect so many! You must truly love your leaders.

Now, let me just add one more to the count...

8982.title: Tracing the Source
8982.description: We must find who the supplier is. I noticed Apothecary Katrina with a bottle of the perfume tucked in her pack. She told me that she purchased it from Norman, the innkeeper.
8982.completion:
Ah yes, I just recently received stock of the perfume and cologne. I don't know how long I can keep it on the shelves - seems like no one can get enough of it.

If you ask me, I don't see what the big deal is.

8983.title: Tracing the Source
8983.description:
Something's wrong with my product? Well, I've never seen so many people wanting something so badly.

I bought my supply from a merchant named Mara Rennick. She's new in town.

She mentioned she had some goods she had to deliver to the tailor in the Mage Quarter.
8983.completion:
I'm afraid I sold my entire supply of perfume and cologne to Norman, the innkeeper. If you'd like some, you should speak with him - assuming he has any left.

You shouldn't waste any time, though. I think you'll find the cologne irresistible.

8984.title: The Source Revealed
8984.description:
Look, the actions of a rogue apothecary are not my concern. If he's undermining our efforts, then let me be the first to point you in the right direction

If he's innocent, then he's got nothing to hide, right?

I purchased the goods from Apothecary Staffron Lerent. He's working in a secluded area past Ravenholdt Manor in the hills over Hillsbrad. To be honest with you, I thought he was a little odd.
8984.completion:
Yes, I made those fragrances. Wonderful smell, isn't it? Irresistible.

Once the warriors of Alliance and Horde alike are smitten with these feelings of love, they will be powerless to stop the rise of the Shadow Council.

They will be weakened, unprepared. As they worry for their loved ones, they will lose their edge.

The solution was so simple. Why did it take me so long to come upon it? The weakness of all is through the heart. And there is nothing you can do to stop the inevitable.

8985.title: More Components of Importance
8985.description:
<class>, listen closely. Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.

Isalien, our priestess, grew up in Winterspring at Starbreeze Village. I need you to gather a Starbreeze Village Relic from the Frostmaul giants of Frostwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, who are known for raiding to the north from time to time.
8985.progress: Have you returned already then, <class>, with what I sent you out to gather?
8985.completion:
A job well done, <name>. I will imbue the essence of the relic into the brazier.

Now all that is left is to go to the Shrine of Eldretharr in the east wing of Dire Maul, and use the brazier to summon forth the spirit of my former cohort, Isalien. Her spirit has been corrupted by her possession of the piece of Valthalak's amulet, and the portion of his soul within it.

Oh, by the way, I had some leftover bloodkelp from your trip to Alcaz Isle, so I made it into some potions for you. Take your pick!

8989.completion:
Thank you for helping Mor Grayhoof, <name>. Another spirit rests in peace, and we now have the reassembled amulet! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.

In order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.

8990.title: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
8990.description:
It became known to us in later days, as we were doing what we could ourselves to survive, that Isalien, a night elf priestess of our company, had gone to the night elvic ancestral city, now known as Dire Maul. From what we gathered, she went there both for personal reasons and also to unlock the secrets of the piece of the amulet that she had in her possession.

She didn't quite make it, though. Word got back to us that she was ambushed at the Shrine of Eldretharr by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces.
8990.progress: Surely you haven't already dealt with the salvation of Isalien's spirit and the retrieval of the right piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, <name>? Be sure to recombine the pieces of the amulet before handing it to me.
8990.completion:
Thank you, <name>, for putting Isalien's spirit to rest. Now, perhaps, she will find peace with her goddess. And, we have the reassembled amulet, as well! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.

In order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.

8991.title: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
8991.description:
The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, decided to join the Scarlet Crusade upon the disbanding of our mercenary company. They took the right piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet with them. Good riddance, I say, but we need that piece back.

From what we could gather, they were actually slain by Grand Crusader Dathrohan himself for failing the initiation rites inside his chamber in the Scarlet Bastion.

In any case, we... meaning you, are still going to need to retrieve that piece of the amulet.
8991.progress: Does this mean then, <class>, that you've already put the souls of those two fools to rest and recombined the pieces of Lord Valthalak's amulet?
8991.completion:
I suppose it's for the best that the souls of those two have finally been put to rest, even if I didn't like them while they were alive. In any case, we have what we were after, and now the amulet is reassembled! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.

In order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.

8992.title: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
8992.description:
Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning next.

Kormok was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, Scholomance.

But even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.
8992.progress: I commend you, <name>, if you have returned with the completed amulet. If not, however, please take care of that as there is no time to waste, I assure you!
8992.completion:
Good work, <name>! Kormok wasn't all that bad for an ogre, at least not while he was still alive, so I hope he gets the rest that he deserves. And now we have the completed amulet! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.

In order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.

8993.title: Gift Giving
8993.progress: Have you come to deliver a present of love and adoration to your favorite leader? Alliance Gift Collection
8993.completion:
Wonderful! Wonderful! I will add this to the pile of other gifts.

I didn't expect so many! You must truly love your leaders.

Now, let me just add one more to the count...

8994.title: Final Preparations
8994.description:
We're nearly there, <class>. All that is left is to retrieve a few more components so that I can attune the brazier and enable it to beckon forth Lord Valthalak.

To begin I must ask you to journey forth into Blackrock Spire and slay the orcs therein. They wear bracers that contain trace metals that I will need, so I'll need more than a few to extract the right amount out of them. Then, to complete the imbuing process, you'll need to bring me a Flask of Supreme Power.

Good luck, <name>!
8994.progress: We've come a long way, <name>, and I just wanted to say that no matter what happens, thank you! You've put yourself in mortal danger to try to help the surviving members of our mercenary company, The Veiled Blade, and as far as I'm concerned, you're one of us now.
8994.completion:
That's it then. I'll extract the metal from the bracers and imbue the brazier with these final components. Then it will be ready for you to summon Lord Valthalak, and finally return his spirit amulet to him.

You've come quite a distance, <name>, don't falter now that the end is in sight!

8995.title: Mea Culpa, Lord Valthalak
8995.description:
All is now ready, <name>.

When alive, Lord Valthalak used to inhabit what is now The Beast's chamber. Go there and use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Lord Valthalak. It will reincorporate him, so he'll have to be killed again. I'd take care of The Beast first, and be sure take enough friends along to survive the upper portion of Blackrock Spire.

Once you've dispatched Valthalak, use the amulet on his corpse. With his spirit reunified, he'll likely want his amulet back, as well.

Good luck!
8995.completion:
How fortunate for you that I know you're not part of the original group that stole this from me.

I'll take back what is mine now, mortal! Give the amulet to me!

8996.title: Return to Bodley
8996.description:
I will ignore your impertinence this time, <class>, because you have done a noble thing today; returning the rest of my stolen spirit to me. Despite your obviously weak nature, <race>, you have shown courage where those that stole from me did not, and probably never could!

Return to them, before I change my mind and slay you where you stand. Go back and tell them that they are safe... for now.
8996.progress:
<name>, you're back and still alive! Well, at least that makes one of us.

You're going to have to tell me all about it!
8996.completion:
He really said all of that? Wow, I can't believe he's going to call off the spectral assassins and stalkers, even if he did hint at causing my living companions further harm in the future.

This is a great day, <name>! You've accomplished what few ever could, and absolved us, at least in part, of some of our past sins.

Thank you! As a sign of appreciation, I'd like to give you this. You can use it to summon forth spirits at the same haunted locations that you already have, and a few others, too.

8997.title: Back to the Beginning
8997.description:
I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire.

Go, before I start to cry. Go back to Deliana in Ironforge and tell her what's happened.
8997.completion:
I am very happy to see you return to me safely, <name>. You look well, if not a bit worse for the wear.

Come, tell me of all that has transpired.

8998.title: Back to the Beginning
8998.description:
I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire.

Go, before I start to cry. Go back to Mokvar in Orgrimmar and tell him what's happened.
8998.completion:
I am pleased to see that you have survived, <name>. You look well, if not a bit more seasoned.

Come, tell me of all that has transpired.

8999.title: Saving the Best for Last
8999.description:
That's an amazing story, <name>! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.

As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
8999.progress: As per our deal, are you ready to hand over your Wildheart pieces in exchange for your new Feralheart Cowl and Vest?
8999.completion:
I'm going to miss you, <name>. I owe you such a debt of gratitude; I think I'll never be able to repay it.

I hope that you enjoy your new head and chest armor, and that it protects you for a long time to come.

9007.description:
A truly amazing story, <name>! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.

As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.

9007.completion:
I will truly miss you, <name>. There is a debt that I owe you, which I may never be able to repay.

Enjoy your new head and chest armor. May it protect you for a long time to come, and help you to achieve even greater honor!

9015.title: The Challenge
9015.description:
Heed me well, <name>. For the banner to work in the desired way, you will need to step into the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths. Allow yourself to be sentenced by High Justice Grimstone and place the banner firmly on the ground in a sign of defiance.

Your victim will not be able to restrain himself and shall enter the fray filled with a desire to fight you. Once you obtain that which you seek, go back to Anthion.
9015.completion: You've recovered part of the medallion, <name>?

9016.title: Anthion's Parting Words
9016.description:
Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.

I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
9016.progress: You've returned and I see in your eyes that you've much to tell me, <name>. Let us take care of your reward first.
9016.completion:
This curse was bestowed upon us but for a mere medallion. Lord Valthalak certainly knows how to hold a grudge.

We'll endeavor to find the remaining pieces - hopefully before I meet an untimely demise. But before that, let us see about your reward.

9023.title: The Perfect Poison
9023.description:
My brother and I run the poison operations out of the manor Ravenholdt.

Lord Ravenholdt tasked me to track down a new and extremely effective poison compound that can be crafted from the venom sacs of the inhabitants of Zul'Gurub and the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.

There are two particularly venomous beasts residing in those blasted ruins that possess what it is that we might be looking for, <class>. Bring me a venom sac from the beasts Kurinnaxx and Venoxis and we would be eternally grateful.
9023.progress: This ain't no smash and grab job, <name>. You're gonna need to bring friends.
9023.completion: Ravenholdt thanks you, hero! Take your pick!

9024.title: Aristan's Hunch
9024.description:
I've got it! Have you smelled the new fragrance on the wind? The new colognes and perfumes that have come into fashion? Our guards wouldn't neglect their duties so easily.

That is, unless their thinking has been clouded by some foul alchemy.

There is only one way to be sure - bring a bottle of cologne and perfume to Morgan Pestle, and tell him my suspicions. I will reimburse you for their purchase when you return.
9024.progress: Something I can help you with?
9024.completion:
I understand Aristan's concerns, but I really think he's overreacting. Let young men and women do what they will. I think Aristan has forgotten what it means to be young and in love.

But it would be better not to tell him that. We'll humor him.

9025.title: Morgan's Discovery
9025.description:
Well, I'll be. It looks like Aristan might be on to something after all. I found traces of substances used in love potions and insidious mind-altering draughts.

It isn't unheard of for perfumes to have some of them, but a few of the ingredients I detected... Smells funny.
9025.completion:
While I thought this would be the case, finding out that my suspicions were correct is still unsettling. We must carefully consider our next move.

Here, to repay you for the purchase of the cologne and perfume.

9026.title: Tracing the Source
9026.description: We've got to find the source. I've seen a lot more people than usual - guards included - going in and out of The Gilded Rose. Talk to Allison. If she's selling them, she can tell you where they came from.
9026.completion:
Oh yes, I just got the perfume and cologne in stock recently. It's been selling so well, I don't know how long I can keep it on the shelves.

If you ask me, it's kind of boring. Everyone smelling the same? It smells great, but still.

9027.title: Tracing the Source
9027.description:
Something funny about the cologne? It's possible. I've never seen so many people after one product like this.

Look, if there's something wrong with it, I want to know, too. I bought my supply from a merchant named Evert Sorisam. He's new in town.

He mentioned he had some goods he was going to deliver to The Finest Thread.
9027.completion:
Yes, of course. Those fragrances are the hottest items this season. You must be the fifth or sixth person this hour to inquire about them.

I'm afraid my supplies are all sold out. If you'd like some, you should speak with Allison, the innkeeper of The Gilded Rose.

You shouldn't waste any time, though. I think you'll find the perfume will be irresistible.

9028.title: The Source Revealed
9028.description:
What, treason? No, no. I assure you, my intentions are completely harmless. Is it so wrong to help those who wish to ease the painful ritual of courtship? Come now, that is no crime.

And to prove that I mean no harm, I will even tell you my source. They were shipped to me by a Staffron Lerent, an apothecary of some sort. I never spoke with him. Our goblin middle man said that he worked in the foothills over Hillsbrad past that mysterious Ravenholdt Manor. I wish you luck in finding him.
9028.completion:
Yes, I made those fragrances. Wonderful smell, isn't it? Irresistible.

Once the warriors of Alliance and Horde alike are smitten with these feelings of love, they will be powerless to stop the rise of the Shadow Council.

They will be weakened, unprepared. As they worry for their loved ones, they will lose their edge.

The solution was so simple. Why did it take me so long to come upon it? The weakness of all is through the heart. And there is nothing you can do to stop the inevitable.

9029.title: A Bubbling Cauldron
9029.completion: A pleasant smell wafts up from the cauldron.

9032.title: Bodleys Unfortunate Fate
9032.description:
The medallion contained Valthalaks soul? Its no surprise it was guarded by such a powerful curse.

Locating Bodley presents a bit of a problem. Last time I heard of him, he was preparing to venture back into Blackrock Spire. He was never heard of again.

Seek him out in Blackrock Mountain, though Im afraid to say hes probably dead by now. I suggest taking the goblins device with you, friend.
9032.completion:
I am so glad that you can see me. Finally someone to talk to!

Will you help us, <name>? Help to undo the wrong that we perpetrated and put things to right? If its true that you already have the Top Piece of Lord Valthalaks Amulet, then I think I can point you in the right direction to acquire the other two parts, reunite them and put an end to all of this.

Oh, by the way, hello, my name is Bodley. Nice to meet you!

9033.title: Echoes of War
9033.description:
Five years since the last war...

Tens of thousands of lives were lost and for what? The threat was never fully extinguished.

And so the Lich King stirs once more... His yes-man, Kel'Thuzad, amassing for another attack upon our lands.

We will not allow it! Prove your dedication. Prove that you are willing to risk life and limb to stop this madness and the combined might of the Dawn and the Crusade will be at your beck and call.

Enter Naxxramas and destroy the Scourge within...
9033.progress: Duty, honor, dedication... What do these words mean to you?
9033.completion: A job well done! You will be rewarded via the services of the men and women at Light's Hope.

9051.title: Toxic Test
9051.description:
The toxin you helped me create is for a special purpose. The great devilsaurs of the crater make it dangerous to hunt and difficult for me to survive. Even if I possessed the necessary strength, killing a devilsaur simply allows another to move into its territory.

Take this poisoned barb and stab it deep into a living devilsaur. The toxin should pacify the creature, though I do not know how quickly...
9051.progress: Were you able to pacify the great beast?
9051.completion:
Thank you, <name>. You are brave and wise.

Tell me, how did the devilsaur react to the toxin?

9052.title: Bloodpetal Poison
9052.description:
I would ask you to help me create a toxin of sorts, to pacify a great creature living here in the crater. It is not deadly, and only the keen eyes of a <class> can hope to collect the ingredients.

You can find the bloodcap mushrooms growing within the bloodpetal sprouts all across the crater. Gorishi stings are from the insects inside and around the Slithering Scar, located in the southern part of the crater.
9052.completion:
The ingredients at last!

With the Un'Goro soil I have collected, the toxin is easily concocted...

9053.title: A Better Ingredient
9053.description:
It is as I feared -- the toxin is simply too weak for such a powerful creature.

If we are to create a toxin of high enough potency, you must venture to the bottom of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, unlock the secrets of the altar and recover a putrid vine from the guardian there. The temple is dangerous, and it would behoove you to bring friends.

Return to me when this is done.
9053.completion:
At last, the toxin can be created in full. I dare not require you to inflict it upon the creature again, as I have asked too much already.

You have my thanks and respect. May you be well in your travels, <name>.

9054.title: Cryptstalker Tunic
9054.description:
I have discovered a use for the carapace of the crypt fiend. I am able to fashion an extremely light and very deadly set of armor by combining the fragments with some of the desecrated magical armors lost in Naxxramas.

Bring me the items I require and I shall fashion for you a suit of armor the likes of which has never before been seen in our world!
9054.progress: Do you have the items I asked for, <class>?

9085.title: Shadows of Doom
9085.description:
After you bring down the defenses of the Scourge summoning circles that have appeared in the zones under attack, you will be able to confront the acolytes who protect them.

In truth, these are not men. They are shadows, some of the Lich King's most frightening creatures. They can be revealed using the necrotic runes they carry, and then destroyed with magic or strength of arms.

9086.description:
Many heroes fell in the last war and many continue to perish at the hands of the Scourge to this day. From the corpses of the fallen, the armor is stripped and taken back to Naxxramas to be used for unknown purposes.

Recover the desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps and supply to me the other material components I require and I will craft Dreamwalker armor.

9095.title: Frostfire Robe
9095.description:
As a Watcher, I was allowed access to many of Medivh's personal effects. Among those items, I found the tomes most enlightening. While the majority of the books were filled with - to put it bluntly - tripe, there were some gems. One of those tomes documented the creation of a set of armor fit for an archmage: Frostfire.

<Angela points to her head.>

It's all in here and I am willing to share the fruits of that knowledge with you as long as you are able to provide me with the necessary materials.
9095.progress: With the proper materials and reagents, I am able to reform the mythical Frostfire armor.
9095.completion: Do not forget that power left unchecked is as destructive as power left unused, <class>. Use discretion when donning Frostfire.

9097.title: Frostfire Circlet
9097.description:
As a Watcher, I was allowed access to many of Medivh's personal effects. Among those items, I found the tomes most enlightening. While the majority of the books were filled with - to put it bluntly - tripe, there were some gems. One of those tomes documented the creation of a set of armor fit for an archmage: Frostfire.

<Angela points to her head.>

It's all in here and I am willing to share the fruits of that knowledge with you as long as you are able to provide me with the necessary materials.
9097.progress: With the proper materials and reagents, I am able to reform the mythical Frostfire armor.
9097.completion: Do not forget that power left unchecked is as destructive as power left unused, <class>. Use discretion when donning Frostfire.

9103.title: Plagueheart Robe
9103.description:
I make no pretenses, maggot. The darkness Plagueheart items hold could very well destroy the both of us. That is why the price is so high. If I'm going to die, it's going to be as a rich man.

And I don't give an ounce of gnoll spit how you die, only that you do as I ask. Bring me what I require and we will both benefit - or die; but I've already explained this...
9103.progress: The prodigal rodent returns! Have you what I require?
9103.completion:
Do you see? Do you now understand the power? Purification... What fools...

<Mataus shakes his head disapprovingly.>

Now take it and get out of my sight.

9111.title: Robe of Faith
9111.description:
<Father Montoy makes some strange gestures in the air in front of you.>

Blessed $Gboy:girl, have you found the vestments of the fallen? The poor souls whose last breaths were taken on the field of battle - stripped of everything including their dignity.

Bring me the desecrated remnants of the departed along with reagents of purification and you shall know faith.
9111.progress: Have you brought me the reagents, child?
9111.completion: The vestments are ready, <name>. Smite those that would harm our world in your righteous fire.

9118.progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
9118.completion: Exellent <name> ! , you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Bindings of Faith.

9120.title: The Fall of Kel'Thuzad
9120.description:
The phylactery is all that remains of the master of Naxxramas. Your better judgment dictates that you destroy the phylactery, preventing the lich from ever reforming. Thankfully, you seldom listen to that internal voice of reason.

Someone at Light's Hope will pay you hugely for this artifact. Who cares if Kel'Thuzad regenerates to full power?
9120.progress: BLESSED LIGHT! What foulness do you hold, child?
9120.completion:
In all my days of living I would never have expected to see this...

<Father Montoy appears to be salivating.>

Oh yes, you will be rewarded dear child. You will be greatly rewarded. Give it here. Now!

9121.title: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
9121.description:
In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.

We have devised a way to gain entry via arcane cloaking - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is somewhat lacking, <name>, the price will be high. You may decline and choose to return when you are revered or exalted for a discount.
9121.progress: None have entered Naxxramas and lived to tell the tale.
9121.completion: You will feel a slight tingle, <name>. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you will be able to enter Naxxramas by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.

9122.title: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
9122.description:
In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.

We have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. With that said, the cloaking is costly. Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is admirable, we are willing to incur some of those costs.
9122.progress: None have entered Naxxramas and lived to tell the tale.
9122.completion: You will feel a slight tingle, <name>. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you will be able to enter Naxxramas by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.

9123.title: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
9123.description:
In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.

We have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. With that said, the cloaking is costly; however, your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is unwavering! We will waive all cost associations.
9123.progress: None have entered Naxxramas and lived to tell the tale.
9123.completion: You will feel a slight tingle, <name>. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you will be able to enter Naxxramas by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.

9124.title: Cryptstalker Armor Doesn't Make Itself...
9124.description:
How would you like to earn yourself one of these shiny coins?

<Leopold holds up an insignia of the Crusade.>

I've got a little problem that you might be able to help me with, <name>. You see, I make Cryptstalker armor for those daft enough to venture into Naxxramas. While they supply me with the core material requirements for the armor, I always run out of the crypt fiend parts. Bring me back a bundle of parts and I'll pay you with an insignia - usable at the quartermaster.
9124.completion: Ah, that'll do nicely, <name>. Remember, I'm always acceptINg more parts. For every bundle you brINg me, I'll reward you with an INsignia.

9125.title: Crypt Fiend Parts
9125.progress: You did an exemplary job on the first bundle, <name>. If you have more, I will take them now. For every bundle that you turn in, I will reward you with another insignia. Crypt Fiend Parts(30)
9125.completion: Most excellent, <name>! These will definitely come to good use.

9126.title: Bonescythe Digs
9126.description:
Don Julio's Bonescythe armor pattern requires bone fragments - a lot of bone fragments. While those crazy enough to venture into Naxxramas provide me with enough of the core materials to make the armor, I'm always looking for more Scourge bone fragments.

So what do you think? Interested in getting your hands dirty and destroying some Scourge at the same time? It's a win-win situation.
9126.progress: I can direct you to skeleton infested locales, <class>.
9126.completion:
You work fast, <name>. Fast like a fox... Say, have I ever told you about the time I was IN a barber shop quartet?

RemINd me to tell you that story one of these days.

9127.title: Bone Fragments
9127.progress: A man in my line of work can never have too many bone fragments, <name>. Whenever you have a surplus of fragments, bring them to me and I'll reward you with another insignia. Bone Fragments(30)
9127.completion: My dream of becoming a full-time dancer at the Gadgetzan disco is soon to become a reality! Keep up the good work, <name>.

9128.title: The Elemental Equation
9128.description:
Greetings, adventurer! Are you interested in some work? I pay those under my employ with insignias. These insignias can be used at the Quartermaster to purchase items of power.

All I need you to do is bring me as many core of elements as you can carry. The more the better!

You'll find them on elementals of varying shapes and sizes that exist across our world.
9128.progress: I can only steer you in the right direction, <name>.
9128.completion: A job well done, <name>! As promised, the INsignia is yours. Just remember, there's more WHERE that came from...

9129.title: Core of Elements
9129.progress:
Truth be told, I use the cores to create Frostfire armor. It is the armor used by the mages battling in Naxxramas. Without you and others like you, we would most definitely be losing this war.

With that said, bring me more cores and I shall grant you more insignias. Core of Elements(30)
9129.completion: You perform a great service for us, <name>. Well done!

9131.title: Binding the Dreadnaught
9131.description:
Have you ever seen Dreadnaught armor, <class>? No, of course you haven't. You're still a boy - a tyke. Let me tell you, it is glorious.

You're probably asking yourself what any of this has to do with you, right? I'll tell you what, scrub; I need Dark Iron scraps and I'm willing to pay to get my hands on as many as possible.

I need the scraps to put together sets of Dreadnaught for our champions. Bring me scraps and get paid.
9131.progress:
<Korfax growls at you.>

What do you want? Directions? I can provide those...
9131.completion: This will do, for now. If you get more, you know WHERE to fINd me.

9132.title: Dark Iron Scraps
9132.progress: For every armful of the scraps, I'll give you an insignia - the more the better. Now get out of my sight before I split you in two! Dark Iron Scraps(30)
9132.completion: That's all you brought me? Maybe you didn't hear me the first time. I need MORE!

9136.title: Savage Flora
9136.description:
I make a special type of armor for the brave heroes that enter Naxxramas known as Dreamwalker. They are able to provide me with most of the materials I require but I am always looking for those able to retrieve savage fronds from the flora of our world.

You may think of this job as beneath you, but without the fronds, the armor could not be made.

I am also in a unique position to pay you with an insignia of your choice as both the Dawn and the Crusade supply me with funds.
9136.progress: I have intimate knowledge of the flora in our world. Do you require direction?
9136.completion:
I am much obliged, <name>.

<Rayne bows.>

Please remember that I am always accepting fronds.

9137.title: Savage Fronds
9137.progress:
For every bundle of fronds that you deliver to me, I will pay you with your choice of an insignia of the Dawn or the Crusade.

Insignias may be turned in to the Quartermaster for various rewards. Savage Frond(30)
9137.completion: Thank you, <name>. Your work is vital to the success of our campaign against the Scourge.

9141.title: They Call Me "The Rooster"
9141.description:
You want a writ? What? Do you expect me to hand you a highly sought after work order just for showing up? I think not, scrub. Crafters from around the world bid for jobs here at the front lines.

If you want a work order, you'll have to show me that you're willing to bleed for the cause. Bring me a valor token and we'll talk.

And there's only one way to get your grubby little scrub mitts on those - get to killin'.
9141.progress:
<Commander Metz chews on his cigar.>

What is it? I'm a busy man.
9141.completion: Alright, here's how it works: For every valor token that you turn in, I'll give you another writ. You complete the order on that writ and deliver the order to Packmaster Stonebruiser. Got it? Good. Now get out of here.

9142.title: Craftsman's Writ
9142.description: You know the drill, kid. One valor token gets you a craftsman's writ.
9142.completion: You earned this, scrub. Now, don't cry about your orders. Fill 'em or destroy 'em.

9153.title: Under the Shadow
9153.description:
The floating necropolises of the Scourge plague the lands of Horde and Alliance alike. Tanaris, the Blasted Lands, Winterspring and the Burning Steppes are blanketed in the shadows of the flying fortresses.

Only through our combined efforts will they be turned away.

The necropolises are supported by magical circles at various points in the invaded areas. We have determined that destroying the mindless hordes that surround these circles will destroy their defenses.
9153.progress: It will take time to prevail against this threat. How have you fared, <name>?
9153.completion:
You've done well, <name>. Through these incremental defeats, we shall prevail against this renewed Scourge threat.

Rest and recover, but then you must head out to the front again, lest we lose the ground we have gained today.

To aid you in your further battles, we will make some of our special items available to you in trade for more necrotic runes.

9154.title: Light's Hope Chapel
9154.description: The Scourge have returned in greater numbers than we have seen before. The Argent Dawn is recruiting all willing and capable men and women to defend our lands.

9165.title: Writ of Safe Passage
9165.description:
Without the help of adventurers, my caravan would have never made it! Scourge were coming out of the woodwork to try and stop us from getting here.

<Guard Didier wipes his brow.>

Now we need to wait here for Field Marshal Chambers to arrive. He'll sign your writ of safe passage to take back to Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel.

And <name>, watch what you say around Chambers. He's the 'bite off your head and spit down your wind pipe' type of guy - except that he'll actually do it...
9165.completion:
<Dispatch Commander Metz takes the writ and signs it.>

Excellent work, <name>. Outstanding even! Take this as a token of our appreciation. No pun intended, scrub.

9178.title: Craftsman's Writ - Dense Weightstone
9178.description:
The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.

Work Order BS-091:

120 Dense Weightstones.

All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.

-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
9178.completion: Yep, these will come in handy for the infantry's bashin' weapons.

9179.title: Craftsman's Writ - Imperial Plate Chest
9179.description:
The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.

-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
9179.completion: More armor for the troops! Fantastic, <name>!

9181.completion: These should go well with the dense weightstones we're stockpiling.

9182.title: Craftsman's Writ - Huge Thorium Battleaxe

All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.

-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
9182.completion: These aren't as huge as I expected. Regardless, a deal is a deal.

9183.title: Craftsman's Writ - Radiant Circlet
9183.description:
The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.

Work Order BS-80:

3 Radiant Circlets.

All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.

-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
9183.completion: I still can't believe Metz expects our troops to wear this low-quality garbage to protect against the freezing attacks of the Scourge.

9184.title: Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Headband
9184.description:
The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.

Work Order LW-971:

All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.

-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn

9185.title: Craftsman's Writ - Rugged Armor Kit
9185.description:
The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.

Work Order LW-448:

25 Rugged Armor Kits.

All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.

-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
9185.completion: The rugged armor kits have many uses, <name>. They aren't JUST for slapping on certain armor pieces for added protection. Like this one here, I'm going to use it as teapot cozy.

9186.title: Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Belt
9186.description:
The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.

Work Order LW-736:

All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

These will definitely help alleviate some of the whining.

You shouldn't have! No really, you shouldn't have. I don't know what Metz is thinking, but nobody is going to be wearing these robes into Naxxramas.

Bah, another pile of junk I'll have to get transferred to the front lines and another berating I'll have to take from Chambers.

Why are you smiling? What's so funny? Listen, mister, a gnomish battle chicken is a very important unit and not to be taken lightly - EVER. We send these in to areas that might be heavily plagued or infested and they clean up any plagued insects or carrion maggots that might still be fluttering about. Everybody knows that robots are immune to the plague.

I bet you don't feel so smart now, do you? Big dummy...

9208.title: The Savage Guard - Arcanum of Protection
9208.description:
Zanza can create many ancient troll enchantments with proper components! Have you heard of the Savage Guard? No, of course you haven't. Your mind is addled with the inferior elven magic.

Bring me an arcanum of elven creation so that I may destroy the aberration. Do this and the Savage Guard will be yours.
9208.completion:
The worthless magic in these enchantments fuels my anger. My anger gives me strength.

Bring me more and you shall receive another Savage Guard.

9211.title: The Ice Guard
9211.description:
Ah, the Ice Guard. It is a thin sheen of protective magic that covers certain pieces of equipment. Those that do battle with creatures of frost and ice will gain increased protection from their attacks by using the Ice Guard.

As with all things the Wrathcaster creates, there is a price - a price that I will not lower, regardless of how much you whimper. Interested?
9211.progress: If it were not for these Argent Dawn guards, you would be a stain upon this floor.
9211.completion:
<Mataus pockets the gold.>

Enjoy the repair costs, <race>. Naxxramas is 'unkind' to the uninitiated.

9213.title: The Shadow Guard
9213.description:
A creation of genius! Much like the Ice Guard, the Shadow Guard employs a thin sheen of protective magic that covers certain pieces of equipment. And like the Ice Guard, the Shadow Guard is going to cost you a good amount of money.

<Mataus holds his hand out and rubs his fingers together.>

Interested?
9213.progress:
<Mataus yawns.>

Be gone, insect, lest you have something for me.
9213.completion:
<Mataus stuffs the gold into his robe.>

What are you still standing around for, <race>? Our business is done.

9221.completion: Good day, <name>. It was a pleasure doing business with you.

9228.completion: Good day, <name>. It was a pleasure doing business with you.

9229.title: The Fate of Ramaladni
9229.description:
Ramaladni was a warrior of the Brotherhood - a pupil of Highlord Mograine before the Dawn even existed! When news of Mograine's death reached him, hatred and anger took over.

Understand this, <name>, when rage and retribution take the reins, a man ceases to be a man. The man personifies the emotions that control him instead. And so it would be that Ramaladni, the spirit of retribution, would enter Naxxramas to exact vengeance... and never return.

Enter Naxxramas and find what became of Ramaladni.
9229.completion:
It is his ring! But it is destroyed. No other evidence of Ramaladni was found?

<Korfax grimaces.>

This does not bode well for Ramaladni. The ring, however... it might be salvageable.

9230.title: Ramaladni's Icy Grasp
9230.description: Fixing this band may prove to be quite challenging, <name>. You see, it was made from the very runes that form inside Scourge structures - like Naxxramas. Additional materials are also required but your main concern should be getting those frozen runes. Bring me what I need and I will restore the ring to its former glory.
9230.progress: Frozen runes could probably be found inside Naxxramas.
9230.completion: Ramaladni himself couldn't have done better! Here is the ring, as promised.

9232.title: The Only Song I Know...
9232.description:
You fancy yourself a hero of the Dawn, eh? I've seen our greatest soldiers get rolled over by Kel'Thuzad's plebes! How well could someone so clueless possibly fare in Naxxramas?

<Wilhelm sighs.>

Bah, what choice do I got? You're the best I can do; I may as well help you.

Omarion left me with one recipe. It's the only song I know... I can make a few variations of these pants; you just gotta supply the materials.
9232.progress: You haven't run into Omarion, have you?
9232.completion:
<Wilhelm wipes the sweat from his brow.>

That's some hard work! Enjoy the pants, <class>. At least you'll die in a clean pair now.

9233.title: Omarion's Handbook
9233.description:
Wilhelm,

If you are reading this, I have perished - finally. I want you to know that my dying thoughts revolved around you and your ineptitude when it comes to tradeskills. Unfortunately, the bearer of this handbook is in even worse shape than you in regards to crafting.

About the book: These are the rest of my recipes. Make the bearer of this book whatever they request. I'm sure you will charge a hefty fee for your services because you are, after all, a bastard.

In Disdain,

Omarion
9233.progress:
Is that what I think it is?

<Wilhelm appears to be drooling.>
9233.completion:
He musta really been off his rocker when he wrote this! Omarion and I - we were thick as thieves!

Anyhow, this certainly opens up some new possibilities, <name>. I am now able to craft more items - for a small fee and material charges, of course.

9234.completion: Here is your order, <name>. Delivered as promised!

9247.title: The Keeper's Call
9247.description:
<name>,

In times past you have served the interests of the Argent Dawn, always to the best of your abilities. Now, once again, we sound the clarion call in our time of greatest need.

<name>, please report to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands if you are willing to aid us once more.

9248.title: A Humble Offering
9248.description: Ishnu-alah, <race>. Show me proof of the demise of a Lord of the Abyssal Council and I shall reward you with an item that should aid you in your battles against the Qiraji.
9248.progress: Fandu-dath-belore? Oh, pardon me, <name>. I did not recognize you. Have you the scepter?
9248.completion:
Ande'thoras-ethil. It means; 'May your troubles be diminished,' in my native tongue.

Wear the band proudly and in good health, <name>.

9250.title: Frame of Atiesh
9250.description:
With the frame formed, Atiesh is nearly whole. Only the head and base of the staff are now missing. There is also a minor issue regarding the staff being a conduit for Sargeras's evil.

Find someone that can assist you in locating the remaining pieces and exorcising the evil from the staff.
9250.completion:
The archmages have died.

Do not mourn their passing, <name>. All such things are fated. Just as you holding the staff of the Guardian was fated...

9251.title: Atiesh, the Befouled Greatstaff
9251.description:
You question why you are still alive. After all, you have in your possession an item of great evil. The answer is not clear, <name>. I only do as I must.

Kel'Thuzad sits atop his throne in Naxxramas, plotting... He seeks that which you hold and holds that which you seek.

As for the base of the staff; the dwarf, Brann Bronzebeard, held it when he entered Ahn'Qiraj. He has left Ahn'Qiraj but the base of Atiesh remains.

Should you succeed in recovering the pieces, return them to me.
9251.progress: In its current form, the staff is far too dangerous to be in the hands of a mortal.
9251.completion: There is a being within... a being not of this world.

9257.title: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
9257.description:
This final task will be the most difficult of all, <name>. You have faced and defeated both an Old God and the Lich King's General, but now you must face the hand of Sargeras.

Take the staff to Stratholme. It is there that you will find a piece of consecrated earth: ground where the greatest knights of Lordaeron were murdered. Place the befouled staff upon the holy ground and prepare for an entity of immense power to break from within... Defeat the demonic being that controls the staff and return to me.
9257.completion: The magnitude of this accomplishment must not be understated, <name>. You have done what most would have thought to be impossible. Alas, it was fated. The staff has made its choice.

9259.title: Traitor to the Bloodsail
9259.progress:
That mangy dog, Revilgaz, has offered to pardon any former Bloodsails willing to turn on their cap'n! That bilge sucker asked me to go an' off me ole' mates and to bring back their bandannas as proof.

I don't have it in me heart to do that, nor will I ask ye to. Bring me some silk cloth and red dye and I'll make suitable replicas. I'll tell the Baron you went turncoat, but be warned... the Bloodsails are not gonna like it! Silk Cloth(40)Red Dye(4)
9259.completion:
Let us observe a minute of silence for our fallen mates, <name>.

<The Bloodsail Traitor grins at you and winks.>

Being a traitor is one thing, murdering yer own buckos... that'd be just downright despicable, aye!

9260.title: Investigate the Scourge of Stormwind
9260.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Stormwind from these accursed invaders? There are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you. Go!
9260.progress: Have you investigated the invasion yet? There's no time for dawdling!
9260.completion: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... they must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane. The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.

9263.title: Investigate the Scourge of Orgrimmar
9263.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Orgrimmar from these accursed invaders? There are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you. Go!
9263.progress: Have you investigated the invasion yet? There's no time for dawdling!
9263.completion: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... they must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane. The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.

9264.title: Investigate the Scourge of Thunder Bluff

9265.title: Investigate the Scourge of the Undercity
9265.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend the Undercity from these accursed invaders? There are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane. The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.

9266.title: Making Amends
9266.progress:
You must've done something really bad to us or our friends, <name>. At any rate, I'm here to offer you a way to get our good graces back.

As you know, Winterspring is quite cold. With so many of us goblins coming from other cities, we could use a hand keeping warm. Bring me some runecloth and coal and I'll put in the good word for ya. Be warned though, our enemies are not going to take kindly to your helping us. Runecloth(40)Coal(4)
9266.completion: Thank you, <name>. You're on a quick path to redeeming yourself with our fair town.

9267.title: Mending Old Wounds
9267.progress:
You'd better think twice before setting foot in Ratchet, <name>! Word's been getting around of your dirty deeds.

You're in luck though, a ship just arrived with many wounded from an encounter with the Bloodsail Buccaneers. This is your chance to prove you're not a complete scoundrel. Lend us a hand by bringing linen cloth for bandages and empty vials for potions. Linen Cloth(40)Empty Vial(4)
9267.completion: I'm happy you're seeing the error of your ways, <name>. Keep the supplies coming; we're not going to forget about you so easily, mister!

9268.title: War at Sea
9268.progress: You seek to befriend the goblins of Tanaris once again, <name>? We're in need of materials for sails and guns to fight off our old enemies, the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Bring me mageweave and strong flux and we'll be on our way to pardoning your trespasses. Mageweave Cloth(40)Strong Flux(4)
9268.completion: Keep it coming, <name>. Us goblins don't forget that easily!

9269.title: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
9269.description:
This final task will be the most difficult of all, <name>. You have faced and defeated both an Old God and the Lich King's General, but now you must face the hand of Sargeras.

Take the staff to Stratholme. It is there that you will find a piece of consecrated earth: ground where the greatest knights of Lordaeron were murdered. Place the befouled staff upon the holy ground and prepare for an entity of immense power to break from within... Defeat the demonic being that controls the staff and return to me.
9269.completion: The magnitude of this accomplishment must not be understated, <name>. You have done what most would have thought to be impossible. Alas, it was fated. The staff has made its choice.

9270.title: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
9270.description:

9272.title: Dressing the Part
9272.completion:
Yarrr... if ye be keen on enjoying the company of us experienced sea dogs, you'd best belay dressing like a blaggard! Here, put on something proper 'fore I keelhaul yer hide.

These'll fit ye better than they ever fit that old dog, Red-Eyed Ben. Lost him in a devil of a storm at sea.

Wear 'em with pride, mate!

9292.title: Cracked Necrotic Crystal
9292.description: On the corpse of the fallen abomination, you discover a cracked crystal, slowly pulsing with necrotic energy.
9292.completion:
Hm, you took this from the corpse of one of the invading abominations?

We have received word about the necropolis base camps that are being summoned by the Scourge. I suspect they wanted to create one inside Stormwind. It is good that they were unseccessful.

9295.title: Letter from the Front
9295.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...

9299.title: Note from the Front
9299.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
9299.progress: Yes? What do you have there?

9300.title: Page from the Front
9300.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...

9301.title: Envelope from the Front
9301.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
9301.progress: Yes? What do you have there?

9302.title: Missive from the Front
9302.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...

9304.title: Document from the Front
9304.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
9304.progress: Yes? What do you have there?

9310.title: Faint Necrotic Crystal
9310.description: On the corpse of the fallen wight, you find a crystal that is faintly radiating necrotic energy.

9317.title: Consecrated Sharpening Stones
9317.progress: If you bring me eight necrotic runes from the Scourge invaders, I can give you a consecrated sharpening stone. It should be of great help in your battle against the minions of the Lich King. Necrotic Rune(8)
9317.completion: Thank you, <name>. Here are your consecrated sharpening stones. Use them prudently.

9318.title: Blessed Wizard Oil
9318.progress: In exchange for the necrotic runes of the Scourge invaders, the Argent Dawn will give you one vial of blessed wizard oil. Necrotic Rune(8)
9318.completion: I hope that you will find these items useful in future battles.

9319.title: A Light in Dark Places
9319.description:
We are not the only ones who celebrate this holiday, <name>. All creatures, all cultures, are touched by the flame. Even in the darkest places, the fires are being lit.

If you wish to see them for yourself, travel into the depths. Seek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, among the ogres of Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I will await your return.
9319.completion:
Your essence sings with the energy of the flames you found, <name>. The fire you encountered is potent, and with the right knowledge, its power can be harnessed...

Ah! Here we are. May this light your path, no matter where you tread.

9320.title: Major Mana Potion
9320.progress: In addition to our other supplies, we also have a number of major mana potions you may find useful. I will give you one in exchange for fifteen necrotic runes. Necrotic Rune(15)
9320.completion: Here you are, <name>. Be careful out there. Our numbers are not so large we can afford many battlefield casualties.

9321.title: Major Healing Potion
9321.progress: In addition to our other supplies, we also have a number of major healing potions you may find useful. I will give you one in exchange for fifteen necrotic runes. Necrotic Rune(15)
9321.completion: Here you are, <name>. Be careful out there. Our numbers are not so large we can afford many battlefield casualties.

9322.title: Wild Fires in Kalimdor
9322.description:
The Midsummer Fire Festival is celebrated everywhere in Azeroth, and the diverse land of Kalimdor is no exception. You look fit to travel -- perhaps a journey is in order.

Midsummer cannot be truly appreciated unless you've seen the blistering blue fires abroad. The celebrants have lit fires in chilly western Winterspring, northeast from the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara, near Valor's Rest in the wastes of Silithus, and by the entrance to lush Un'Goro. Return once your journey is complete.
9322.progress: Are the flames of Kalimdor burning brightly?
9322.completion: Your spirit glows with the warmth of the Kalimdor fires, friend. Is the heat not invigorating? Once the power fades from you, perhaps these will help rekindle the feeling.

9323.title: Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms
9323.description:
Our celebration of the flame is spread throughout the land, <class>. Not a single place remains untouched by the heat of this holiday, and the strongest fires burn a brilliant blue. Seek them out.

You'll find one just north of Blackrock Spire. The others are located deep within the Eastern Plaguelands near a decrepit town, along the road to the cliffs within the mountainous Hinterlands, and on the way to the Dark Portal within the Blasted Lands.

Return once your journey is done.
9323.progress: Have you yet traveled the continent? Enlightenment awaits you.
9323.completion: Ah, here you are. A little wearier, a bit dustier, but enlightened! The heat touches us all during this season and unites us; your very being glows with the power of the fires you touched. Ah, but these days enlightenment is taken as a rather poor reward for being sent on a task, I suppose. Take these, then, and enjoy the celebration.

9324.title: Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame
9324.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Orgrimmar itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
9324.progress: You're practically glowing, <race>. What do you have there?
9324.completion: What's this? Unless I'm mistaken, this flame has been taken from the heart of Orgrimmar itself! The fierce hearts of the orcs and trolls are reflected in its searing heat. What a fine addition to our collection--how brave you are, stealing into the enemy's lair to retrieve the sacred flame!

9325.title: Stealing Thunder Bluff's Flame
9325.description: This flame, stolen from the shaman of Thunder Bluff, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
9325.progress: You're practically glowing, <race>. What do you have there?
9325.completion: Unless I miss my guess, this fire has been taken from the cliffs of Thunder Bluff! How it sings with the power of the spirits! You are quite the thief, <name>. Take this as just payment for your skill. Now, if only we had the flames of all three cities...

9326.title: Stealing the Undercity's Flame
9326.description: This flame, stolen from the ruins above the Undercity, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
9326.progress: You're practically glowing, <race>. What do you have there?
9326.completion: Hm... what a strange fire! It is subdued, nearly smoldering, but the heat is intense. And you received this from the Undercity, you say? Fascinating. With the flames of all three cities, who knows what we could accomplish?

9330.title: Stealing Stormwind's Flame
9330.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
9330.progress: You're practically glowing, <race>. What do you have there?
9330.completion: And this brightly-burning fire... you say it came from Stormwind? Remarkable! That must have been quite an adventure! I'll pay you for this, of course. If you find anything else like this, be sure to speak with me again.

9331.title: Stealing Ironforge's Flame
9331.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Ironforge itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
9331.progress: You're practically glowing, <race>. What do you have there?
9331.completion: This hearty flame must be from the halls of Ironforge; it's as stalwart as the dwarves themselves. A fine catch, <name>. If I had the fires of the other cities... ah, but never mind. Here is your payment.

9332.title: Stealing Darnassus's Flame
9332.description: This flame, stolen from the shores of Teldrassil, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
9332.progress: You're practically glowing, <race>. What do you have there?
9332.completion: This fire aches of ancient sorrow, <name>. You pulled this from the roots of Teldrassil, you say? Fascinating! Here is a reward for your skill. Return to me should you find anything else like this; I may have a use for it.

9333.title: Argent Dawn Gloves
9333.progress: If you bring me thirty necrotic runes, I will give you your choice of hand protection in return. These should prove valuable in our fight against the undead Scourge. Necrotic Rune(30)
9333.completion: You've done well, <name>. Take your pick of hand protection in thanks for your efforts.

9334.title: Blessed Wizard Oil
9334.progress: In exchange for the necrotic runes of the Scourge invaders, the Argent Dawn will give you one vial of blessed wizard oil. Necrotic Rune(8)
9334.completion: I hope that you will find these items useful in future battles.
