Ahh, yes, it would appear that you have gained much power, and word of your name has travelled to my ear. Perhaps it is time for your next step, troll, to learn the ways of our kind. We trolls have had a unique way with nature for a long time, one that these orc or tauren cannot understand.

It be the way of the witch doctor, and to learn, you must speak with one of our kind. Seek out Bom'bay at the Sen'jin Village, he'll teach you good.
40349.completion: Ahh, you be a new one, I can feel it within your spirit mon. Let us not waste time.

40350.title: The Way Of The Witch Doctor II
40350.description:
You wish to learn da ways of the Witch Doctor huh? We troll shamans be masters of the voodoo, and perhaps you can learn my ways. First, I need you to get your hands on some Skullsplitter Mojo for me. I will be usin' it in ma ritual to bestow power upon ye. That, and well, let's say I don't exactly like them Skullsplitters.

They can be found deep in the jungles of Stranglethorn, by ruins in the eastern parts of the region. Go there, and get me 20 of them, that should do, just nicely.
40350.progress: You be gettin that mojo mon?
40350.completion: Such fine samples, yes... This shall do nicely!

40351.title: The Way Of The Witch Doctor III
40351.description: With the samples you have provided I will begun to conjure a special serum, this serum will be needed for your next task. So please, give me some time to prepare it, for one mess up, be the end of ya!
40351.completion: Heh, it took quite a lot of concentration, but here we are mon!

40352.title: The Way Of The Witch Doctor IV
40352.description:
With this serum you may speak with the spirit of the toad, he is a patient, and incredibly wise one. We trolls have been hexin' our enemies for quite some time, and it is about time for you to pay respects.

N'ribbi is the one you seek, and he can be found deep in the Dustwallow Marsh.

In the north west of Dustwallow is a place called 'Bluefen' you can find him at the very edge.

Go there, and speak with him, bring this serum, and offer it to N'ribbi as tribute.
40352.completion: So, that is why you are here, you seek my wisdom, and my knowledge as your ancestors before you have, very well.

40353.title: The Way Of The Witch Doctor V
40353.description:
The power of the witch doctor is derived from the spirits of azeroth, the loa. It is us who look after the smaller of our kind, and channel our energies into those who follow us. If you so wish to prove yourself to N'ribbi, you must show me your courage and ability with magic.

Long has it been that a massive crocolisk named Clampjaw has terrorized the toads of Dustwallow. I do not have the power to challenge him directly, but perhaps with your powers, you can.

I want you to find Clampjaw in the Quagmire, and slay him for all of my kin. Do this, and I will bless you with my power young one.
40353.completion:
You have done it, I am impressed. You are worthy of my power, and I bestow upon you the energies that many of your ancestors have used.

May your travels be plentiful, there is a future ahead of you shaman.

40354.title: Naming the Vessel
40354.description:
Seems like the pirate life suits ye, ye scoundrel. Ah, I remember of me own adventures, to be young again. Anyway, since the ship's all yours and all, thought it'd be the time for you to name it, savvy?

I bet ye already got a name in mind, whenever ye feel ready.
40354.completion: Hm, not something I would've gone with. Alas, it be yer ship 'afore all.

40355.title: Sark's Grudge
40355.description:
The Admiral tells me Fleet Master Firallon picked a Dragonmaw nobody from the Wetlands to train and eventually lead one of our vessels because of his orcish battle experience. Long has it been since I was this insulted! Earn my favor, will you <race>?

This "Ironpatch" is right next to Firallon on one of the three ships at the Wild Shore. Challenge him to battle and bring me his head!

Blood and thunder, victory or death.
40355.completion:
This pleases me greatly, <name>!

You've begun your way towards my respect, thank you.

40356.title: Elf in the Jungle
40356.description:
'ello there boss mon! Time for Vil'do to send ya out for dat booty! What, were ya just thinkin' that ya'd be only drinkin' rum for da rest of ya days? No boss mon, ya must be huntin' treasure so ya can afford da money lust and whatever else ya got. Vil'do wouldn't guess and he shouldn't either.

Da loa say Vil'do would one day die talkin' since he be talkin' so much, but Vil'do don’t listen to them and neither should ya mon.

One of da boys from da Bloodsail Compound said dey be seein' some weirdo night elf fightin' nagas, said somethin’ about him wavin' his hand in da air and magic goin' "woosh".

No idea where he be goin' but Vil'do sees opportunity here and Vil'do thinks dis will lead boss mon to booty.
40356.progress: The notes appear to be torn and dirty.
40356.completion: The language is unreadable to you and you bet it'd be unreadable for the rest of your crewmates back at the retreat, it is by now you realize you should've probably recruited a historian.

40357.title: Lift the Anchor!
40357.description: While making a note to yourself about the thought you just had you try to put one and two together and see if there's something useful in these notes. Lady Luck seems to be smiling to your wicked self once more.

40358.title: Golden Elves of Feralas
40358.description:
Get ready boss mon, da trip be a long one! Vil'do will make sure to be makin' some room for the treasure ya be comin' back with. Remember what ya got from ya notes, ya be lookin’ for golden elves! Well ya know statues of golden elves but who cares.

Ya do dis and dis be da best haul da Bloodsail got in a long time. Make us proud eh, boss mon?
40358.progress: Comparing the drawing from the journal it seems you're in the right place and this is the right statue.
40358.completion:
You stare at the huge statue and can't believe your eyes, it's made of pure gold! You dare question whether it's still there when you realize you will not be able to move it one inch.

Several curses come out of your mind when you remember Vil'do's words. Not only did you come this far, but you can't even grab them!

40359.title: Mechaflame's Bargain
40359.description:
Alright, you're here to steal my finds? I've been keeping my eye on these statues for a while. I'm not gonna let some random <race> come in and take my loot, understand? Besides, we can't carry all of them anyway. There are four more scattered around these ruins.

Say, how about a truce? You get me some parts and I'll come up with a gnomish contraption that can shrink them down. We'll split up the statues, three for me, two for you. Remember, I'm the one who came up with this plan, after all.

So you got all that, bub? Then, get me those materials and let's make these statues more portable.
40359.completion: Okay bub, stand back while I assemble this thing, yeah?

40360.title: Highly Unexpected Event
40360.description:
It's done! Quite boring little thing but you know gnomes, blah, I hate gnomes. No refinement when it comes to these things, just look at this thing, the perfect way to steal stuff, and not to mention increase your own profit!

This thing was only supposed to shrink the statues, but guess what, it can now enlarge them too! Anyway let's be done with it yeah, no reason to wait any longer.
40360.progress: You stare at the statue with the engraved name once more and get ready to pull the trigger.
40360.completion: As you push the button the shrink ray activates! Mumbling all sorts of sounds at first you start cursing the corpse of the goblin who built this, not only was he a double-crosser but he was no engineer! Or so you'd think, sooner than later the statue began to shrink, no weighing less, and could easily be placed in your backpack.

40361.title: Taking the Booty Home
40361.description: Staring at the now little elven statue you remember Fazgel saying something about four others and so you decide to go find them. Placing Lyvdia in your satchel and with the shrink ray in hand you are ready to grab all of it and go home.
40361.progress: Aye boss mon, ya be back!
40361.completion: Dis be great mon, very great, and ya be sayin' ya can make dem big too? Ah dis be da greatest haul we got in a while now, great job mon, great job. Here be some coin for da troubles, I be takin' dem statues and dat ray now.

40362.title: A Historian Finds You
40362.description: On a cold and rainy night you decide to once more look at the notes as they remind you of your own first haul. As you reminisce about the past you also remember the wish you've had to find a historian or someone knowledgeable enough to aid in the future.

40363.title: New Bonds
40363.description:
Do not be alarmed, I am an exile of the Galak that seeks refuge and mean you no harm. I accompanied my brethren here with the intent to raid, but upon seeing the tauren and their peaceful life free from the pains of our clan life - I began to yearn for their freedom.

If we weaken the Galak's attack on the tauren, perhaps I can earn their trust.
40363.progress: Is it done, <class>? As an exile, this is my only chance to find acceptance in amongst others.
40363.completion:
Your kindness surprises me, <class>. With the Galak's raid crippled, the tauren will be free to continue their peaceful lives.

There is still yet work to do if I am to earn their favor.

40364.title: Seeking Acceptance
40364.description: As the immediate threat of the Galak has been addressed, perhaps you can seek out a member of the nearby village and speak on my behalf.
40364.progress: I see that you have something on your mind. Speak freely.
40364.completion: I have never heard such a strange tale and I struggle to believe it to be true. We have never known the centaur to be anything but beasts seeking our extinction. If she is yet true to her word, perhaps I can assist.

40365.title: A Trial of Sincerity
40365.description:
While we have received vague rumors of the centaur that strikes at her own kind, striking at our enemies is not enough to earn our favor - not for a centaur. She must show a respect and understanding toward our traditions and customs in a way that centaur are incapable.

Venture to the northern prairie across the lake and acquire pelts from the prairie stalkers. Bring them to her, she will know what to do if she is true to her word.
40365.progress: You've returned and yet it seems as if there is more for us to work toward.
40365.completion:
She had you retrieve the pelts of prairie wolves and did not tell you what I would need to do with them to earn their favor.

Although I am not the most gifted in the ways of magic, I believe I have just the idea to solve their trial.

40366.title: An Earnest Offering
40366.description: Through a few simple enchantments, I have turned the pelts into blankets that will protect the tauren's young from the coming elements. Please take this to Gennia as my offering to her village.
40366.progress: You've returned. Was she sincere in her words?
40366.completion:
These pelts are of even finer quality than I expected, <name>. The enchantment is almost as if it is naturally woven into the fabric itself and will serve to protect newborns through the harsh change of the seasons.

We will not deny Kherra the opportunity to prove herself further to us. We understand there is more to her than the average centaur. It will take time for her to be welcome in Bloodhoof Village, but I have to wonder... are there more like her?

40367.title: A Pebble to Pick with Them
40367.description:
Hail adventurer! You look like you can carry yourself in a fight. My colleagues and I ran into a bit of a pickle, you see. This is Bael Modan, a facility built by a powerful race that disappeared eons ago. According to some scholars, these Titans had a hand in the formation of our culture.

We were trying to open the door in the main chamber when a horrible screech echoed through the digsite. Dozens of statues we dug up came to life and went on a rampage. Those golems have no archaeological value when they try to kill you if you get near them. Get in there and smash them up so we can carry on our work.
40367.progress: Is it done <race>? These constructs killed some of my best diggers. I want them turned to rubble!
40367.completion: Well done. I hope this helps put my kin to rest while ensuring the safety of the survivors. Don't worry, their sacrifice was not in vein. Now we can continue the excavation and learn more about the Titans and this site.

40368.title: Honoring the Departed
40368.description: Pardon me for taking a moment of your time, wanderer, but I would ask you to help me honor someone as it is a special time of the year. Four years ago, my commanding officer and dear friend Jennalla Deemspring perished to the hand of Arthas Menethil. It is time to remember her and others like her. Please collect six sprigs of Auribloom from the village and the surrounding forest.
40368.progress: Is it done, <race>? The Auribloom should not be too difficult to find.
40368.completion:
Thank you, <race>. Four years ago my commanding officer ordered me to escort a caravan of villagers out of Lordaeron. I remained with them as they settled here and built Hawk's Vigil. Arthas himself had returned to Lordaeron to lead the genocide of his own people.

Many perished to give us a chance to escape, Jennalla among them. With the incense produced from the Auriblooms, we honor their memory.

40369.title: Further Studies
40369.description: Fascinating... I wonder if such changes may cause other creatures in the food chain to be affected. I think it is a matter worth studying further! But for that I would need samples of something larger... Ah, crabs! Yes. I believe we could find something new if we study those crustaceans.
40369.progress: As scary as those pinchy crawlers may look, they tend to run away from you faster than you can catch a fish. Have you gathered any parts we could study further?
40369.completion: Ah, what a lovely haul this is! Look at these samples! Fascinating! Wait... What's this? Ah, it seems you have found yourself a small companion! Perhaps you should study its behaviour before you decide on your favourite seasoning.

40370.title: Krilana's Magnificent Quest
40370.description:
Hello! You look strong and I need the help of someone like you!

I am Krilana, mama Eliza is taking care of me because my real mom has become a star in the sky. She has told me everything I know about my family. In one of her stories, mama mentioned a necklace that my papa gave to my real mom as a sign of their love, but it was lost in the shipwrecks by the northwestern coast of Gilijim isle.

Except for mama's stories I have nothing to remember my parents. Could... could you please look for the necklace? I heard that it was pretty and that it looked like the sun! I wanted to go and look for it myself, but mama won't let me: she says that ghosts haunt the place.
40370.progress:
I like stargazing at night. I know my mom is looking at me and I don't want her to think I've forgotten her.

Did you find her necklace?
40370.completion:
You found it! Thank you, thank you, thank you! Woooah, it really looks like a sun! You're my new best friend!

There aren't many children here besides me, so I feel lonely sometimes. But with this necklace, I can be brave like my mom and dad.

They were sailors and one day I'll be a marine just like mama Eliza!

40371.title: [DEPRECATED] A Diplomatic Mission
40371.description:
Greetings, <name>. While others see our people as only refugees and survivors of a once-great nation, we must show the rest of the Alliance that the Quel'dorei are here to stay.

With Alah'thalas prospering and our people slowly mobilizing into a formidable force, this is the perfect time for us to officially join the Alliance.

Our magisters have prepared a set of missives that need to be delivered directly to the leaders of the Alliance, and I think that the honor of delivering such important messages should be yours.
40371.completion:
The stories about Tyrande Whisperwind were true after all.

In her letter, she writes she was not only honored to stand with Prince Kael'thas, but once fought beside Dath'remar Sunstrider himself, the founder of our great kingdom!

But it seems not all Kaldorei think as she does. We shall soon work to prove ourselves in their eyes as well.

For now, with the approval of most of the Alliance's leaders, our future grows more secure.

I hope we can count on you again, should such need arise. And <name>, thank you for all you have done.

40372.title: [DEPRECATED] Appealing to the Alliance: Humans
40372.description:
Our magisters have prepared a missive that needs to be delivered directly to the Highlord Bolvar Fordragon, and I think that the honor of delivering such an important message should be yours.

Once you receive Stormwind's response, return to me with the news.
40372.completion:
I have no objections. During the Second War, the High Elves were instrumental in defeating the Orcish Horde. And I cannot deny that the refugees have done a lot for the Alliance.

It would be remiss of me to reject their aid. Even Lady Prestor has taken a personal interest in this matter and petitioned to send the military abroad to help.

With that said, please give my response to Alah'thalas.

40373.title: [DEPRECATED] Appealing to the Alliance: Dwarves
40373.description:
This one needs to be delivered to King Magni Bronzebeard himself, and I do not doubt that having you be the one to do it will only improve the outcome.

Once you receive Ironforge's response, return to me with the news.
40373.completion:
There is a saying among the Wildhammer dwarves of the north: "You can sooner count on a High Elf than on the hair of your own beard."

The Senate will need to discuss this matter in detail, but know that I am keen to believe the Wildhammers, as I have been supportive of the Quel'dorei's accession to the Alliance for a while now. Especially after all the refugees have done to help secure Loch Modan.

Not to mention the aid we received from them during the Second War, without their help and that of the Alliance, who knows how the war would have turned out for us.

As I see it, now is our turn to return the favor. Deliver my reply, and I wish you safe travels.

40374.title: [DEPRECATED] Appealing to the Alliance: Gnomes
40374.description:
We haven't had the pleasure of working too closely with the Gnomes, but they are an invaluable ally and a valued member of the Alliance. That is why I need you to deliver this message to the High Tinker Mekkatorque.

Once you complete this task, make sure to report back to me with the news.
40374.completion:
Hmm, an expected proposal. Even if we ignore the deeds that the High Elves have done in the past, one cannot deny that having another powerful ally on our side could prove beneficial.

Yes, you may let our friends at Alah'Thalas know that they indeed have the support of our brilliant people.

40375.title: [DEPRECATED] Appealing to the Alliance: Night Elves
40375.description:
Lastly, we prepared an unique message just for High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. Some say she provided aid to our people in the past; I can only hope she will still see that only by working together can we craft a better future for both our nations.

Good luck, and please return with her reply as soon as you receive it.
40375.completion:
The plight of the Quel'dorei is one that grieves me deeply. Their noble Prince Kael has been in my prayers since the day our paths crossed in Lordaeron.

I would gladly welcome Silvermoon into the Alliance, yet there are those among my people who believe they are beneath Elune's boundless compassion, those who see the High Elves and can only forebode the repetition of the darkest chapter of our ancient history.

I shall help you dispel these doubts. You may go, with my answer and my blessing.

40376.title: [DEPRECATED] The Kaldorei Problem
40376.description: You have done well. I think it is high time for you to meet our leader. She awaits your arrival atop the Citadel.
40376.progress:
So you are the one that everyone has been talking about. It's a pleasure to meet you, <name>.

My name is Vereesa Windrunner, and I wanted to personally thank you for your efforts in bringing our people closer to the Alliance.

Although it is unfortunate that some Kaldorei still doubt our intentions, we will prove we are not what they would fear us to be.
40376.completion:
You see, when the Scourge ravaged our lands, we were left beaten and broken. So I gathered those I could find and set out to reclaim this outpost. It was not an easy task, but now we have a place to call home.

I only wish Prince Kael'thas could have seen all of this. But, now is not the time to mourn. We have to hold our heads high and look forward.

40377.title: [DEPRECATED] Breaking the Felstar
40377.description:
With the pleasantries out of the way, it is time I let you in on our next move.

Tyrande Whisperwind has sent a Sentinel, Ashylah Starcaller, to warn us of a powerful Satyr plotting an invasion near the tainted thickets of Felwood.

I have sent a detachment of my best rangers to find him, hiding with his minions around an artifact of fel power: A Corrupted Felstone.

This is our opportunity to prove ourselves to any Kaldorei who still doubt us. You will find the artifact north of Raynewood's Retreat, around the border with Felwood.

The Satyr will be drawn by the destruction of his coveted stone: do not fear him, our rangers will come out of hiding to assist you during the battle.

When you have won, make sure to bring proof of your victory to Ashylah Starcaller in Darnassus.
40377.progress: What can I do for you?
40377.completion:
You found and slew Dra'lox Felstar?

I knew the High Priestess was right in her judgement of the Quel'dorei.

Now allow me to return the favor.

40378.title: [DEPRECATED] Thalassian Accession
40378.description:
There, it is done. I have prepared a writ for the High Priestess, explaining how instrumental you and the Quel'dorei were in slaying our ancient enemy Dra'lox Felstar.

His deeds were unforgivable, which is why your actions may prove just enough to sway even the stern Archdruid Staghelm and his stringent followers.
40378.completion:
I know the message you bear. Word of Felstar's demise has been spreading swiftly.

May the Night Warrior ever bear steel with you, <name>. May such be the fate of all those who dare threaten us.

<She lets out a long sigh.>

You might have begun to glimpse the rift that divides Darnassus. Many of Fandral's druids have rescinded their former protests about the accession of the Quel'dorei, but the Archdruid himself remains unyielding.

Yet with his support on the matter ebbing, nothing more ties my hands in granting Silvermoon my full support.

40379.title: [DEPRECATED] Darnassian Endorsement
40379.description:
Here at last is the formal endorsement of the Kaldorei. Bring it to the Highlord Bolvar Fordragon, along with my warm regards for the young King Anduin.

Together with the High Elves, we shall chart a bright course for all the peoples of the Alliance. One day, I hope, we shall stand together side by side as friends, beneath the eaves of a renewed Quel'thalas.
40379.completion: What wonderful news! With Darnassus' Endorsement, the Alliance has unanimously agreed that the Quel'dorei of Alah'thalas will officially join the Alliance. Let us discuss further steps, my friend.

40380.title: [DEPRECATED] The Magical Ailment
40380.description:
With the Quel'dorei's accession to the Alliance, I do not doubt that it is only a matter of time before we rise to our former glory. But as my people celebrate, I must keep track of the problems that remain.

For years my people relied on the magic of the great fount called the Sunwell. Its destruction made us realize how dependent we became on its energies.

Without it, we are vulnerable to succumbing to magic addiction.

Miraculously, the rangers who were hunting Dra'lox with you stumbled upon a mystical pool of restorative waters whose effects are reminiscent of the Sunwell.

If this is true, it could be our salvation. I need you to travel to Darnassus and ask Ashylah Starcaller if such waters can be procured for the Quel'dorei.
40380.progress: I take it the Quel'dorei sent you. What can I do for you?
40380.completion:
<Ashylah Starcaller blinks as you make your request.>

You have to understand, <name>, our moonwells are not like the Well of Eternity of old. Their waters have been cleansed, and sanctified by the Great Mother.

They can replenish health, mana and even stave off hunger. But we hold them as hallowed shrines, we cannot grant them to others so easily.

40381.title: [DEPRECATED] A Quest for the Moonwell
40381.description:
I do sympathize with the Quel'dorei's plight. Perhaps there is another way to provide them with what they need.

If the High Elves are willing to honor the sanctity of our moonwells, then there might be a chance to plead for a small well to be built in Alah'talas under the guidance and vigilance of a priestess.

After all, we agreed once before to do the same for Stormwind.

Travel to Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas and look for Vestia Moonspear. She is sympathetic to your cause and will be likely to listen.

Give her this missive and pay close attention to what she has to say.
40381.completion:
What you ask is difficult, but not impossible.

If you render me aid, I will do what I can to help.

40382.title: Sacred Waters of Eldre'thalas
40382.description:
As you must know, our moonwells are very sacred to us.

Having such a well corrupted is considered a great offense to Elune. Unfortunately, even with our constant vigil, this can happen.

A twin set of moonwells exists outside Eldre'thalas, known to many as Dire Maul.

While one well remains pure, the other was defiled by Ogres.

Help me cleanse the moonwell and bring those responsible to justice, and I will present your case to the High Priestess herself.

I will wait in the shadows until you arrive. You shall have to guard me until the ritual is completed, as it will require my full attention.
40382.completion: An exhilarating experience. Let us agree to avoid these perilous ventures from now on, yes? Jests aside, you have my gratitude. And as promised, I will do my best to help you with your case.

40383.title: [DEPRECATED] Vestia's Missive
40383.description:
Take this. I have convinced a few of my fellow priestesses to vouch for you and your Quel'dorei friends, but know that creating a new moonwell for Alah'thalas to use will not be easy, even with our endorsement.

Let us hope that the High Priestess will be amenable to extending her support once again.
40383.completion:
Hail to you again, <name>. What tidings do you bear?

<Tyrande opens and reads the missive>

I see. The ancestral sickness that once plagued even Dath'remar Sunstrider still assails the hearts of the Quel'dorei. That is a heavy burden to endure.

40384.title: [DEPRECATED] A People Restored
40384.description:
Our moonwells are pure springs of Elune's hallowed light. They are not tainted as the first Well of Eternity once was.

They will restore the mana of the High Elves, but will never grant them access to the pernicious power that drove others to madness.

I have sent Priestess Alunasha and a few of our masons and wisps to begin construction of a moonwell.

Alunasha shall remain there, to watch over the well and teach the High Elves how its waters should be used in accordance to our ways.

Ande'thoras-ethil, <name>, and thank you again, for your deeds in Feralas.
40384.progress: The preparations for the moonwell are ready.
40384.completion: Elune will soon lay her divine hand upon these lands. Stand back and watch as her silver light blesses this sacred ritual.

40385.title: [CANCELLED] Shalandis Isle
40385.description:
The time has come. The Kaldorei fleet has arrived and is making its final preparations, and the Theramore fleet should also be ready. Find a Theramore officer and board the ship as its vanguard.

There is no doubt that the Scourge will attack as soon as they see us, and having you onboard will undoubtedly improve our chances. Go and do what you must for the Alliance!
40385.completion: We have been waiting for you. We are ready to depart, on your word, but make sure you bring all the necessary equipment. There is no telling what awaits us there.

40386.title: [CANCELLED] Scourge!
40386.description:
This is a disaster! No matter how many we slay, they keep coming!

Our Rangers will secure the ship and provide ranged support, but we need your help before they overrun us!
40386.completion:
With the beach secured and our fortifications up, we have finally made a first step in reclaiming these lands. But we need to be careful. Their commander mentioned someone named Lord Dar'Khan.

Could he be their leader? And why does that name feel so familiar? Anyways, we won't get much from overthinking. Let us wait for the rest of the reinforcements before continuing our campaign in Quel'thalas.

40387.title: [CANCELLED] Returning to Alah'thalas
40387.description:
It is done... With the initial attack repelled, we can properly set up the defenses. With the Rangers, the Magisters, the Druids, and Moon Priestesses, we're more than capable of holding this isle until the fleet arrives.

Once the Rangers and Magisters have disembarked, we will return to Alah'thalas. I take it you can send word to Speaker Windrunner?
40387.progress: Welcome back, <name>. I hope that you bring good news.
40387.completion:
With the beach secured and our fortifications up, we have finally made a first step in reclaiming these lands. But we need to be careful. Their commander mentioned someone named Lord Dar'Khan.

Could he be their leader? And why does that name feel so familiar? Anyways, we won't get much from overthinking. Let us wait for the rest of the reinforcements before continuing our campaign in Quel'thalas.

40388.title: Foreign Threats
40388.description:
Opening the envelope reveals the symbol of a large skeletal boar as well as reference to a mighty crone. You recognize some of the names mentioned, but can't place the details.

This information could concern more than just Durotar, perhaps Gar'Thok would be interested in it.
40388.progress: You look troubled, <name>. Tell me what bothers you.
40388.completion: My suspicions confirmed, they are far more cunning than I gave them credit for. This does not seem to be over, <name>. Thank you for getting this information to me. I'll send a runner to Orgrimmar and Far Watch Post right away to make sure they hear of this Death's Head.

40389.title: Zalazane's Fall
40389.description:
If you don't require assistance from my assistant, could you please do our tribe a favor? Our chieftain, Vol'jin, remains in Grommash Hold, providing counsel to the Warchief as he grapples with several losses he has suffered since leaving the Darkspear Isles.

Take Zalazane's head to Vol'jin, assuring him that his people are primed and ready to share in his burdens.
40389.progress: I do not have long to speak, <class>. What is it you bring to me?
40389.completion:
The head of Zalazane? No, it could never be that easy.

<As you and the great chieftain observe the witchdoctor's head, it slowly loses its form and resembles that of another troll, perhaps a mindslave>.

It will not be so easy to reclaim the Echo Isles from Zalazane and his army of slaves, but at least we have contained the threat for now.

There are those who will not understand my decision to keep Thrall from reclaiming the isles for my tribe, but we are indebted once to the Warchief and his people and now we will prove that their faith was not misplaced. When the time comes, <name>, I hope to see you on the battlefield beside my tribe.

40390.title: Aggression's End
40390.description:
Through hard fought victory, you stand above the fallen centaur warlord and before the corpse can run cold, you take a trophy as proof of your battle.

Someone in Sen'jin Village would be interested in this.
40390.completion: The Kolkar have proven a long-standing threat to our people since settling on these shores, but it appears they will trouble us no further. Your victory over the centaur today is just one step closer to securing Durotar from local threats.

40391.title: A Hunt for Honor
40391.description:
Our new homeland has suffered greatly from threats of all measure since the founding of Orgrimmar and making our home upon Sen'jin Village, and this major step must be shared with our allies in Thunder Bluff.

When we first landed on these shores, we found the Kolkar leading the attack on the tauren and have since learned of their suffering under their raids. With one less threat in Durotar, we can begin to look to our frontiers.

Now go, share proof of your great victory with the High Chieftain of Thunder Bluff.
40391.progress: You carry the presence of a victorious hunt, <class>? Come closer, show me what you carry.
40391.completion:
The wretched Kolkar dwindle in their presence throughout Kalimdor under the watchful presence of the Horde. We are blessed for our alliance and may begin focusing on larger threats lurking just out of sight.

The very land we depend on cries out for help, <name>, and we must figure out how best to answer her plea quickly. Your victory brings me joy and solace to the many tauren that suffered under Kolkanis' cruel raids before the Horde's arrival.

Go with the Earthmother's blessing on your journey.

40392.title: [DEPRECATED] Summons by the Ranger-General
40392.description: Greetings <name>, I have received word from Alah'thalas that the Ranger-General requests your presence, please make your way to her as soon as possible.
40392.completion: Thank you for coming. I will get straight to the point.

40393.title: [DEPRECATED] Summons by Lady Windrunner
40393.description: Greetings <name>, I have received word from Alah'thalas that Speaker Vereesa Windrunner herself is requesting your presence. I wouldn't keep her waiting <name>.
40393.completion: Thank you for coming <name>. As you can surmise this is not a visit of convenience. I need your help.

40394.title: [CANCELLED] Summons by the Alliance
40394.description: Greetings <name>, I have received urgent news. Speaker Vereesa Windrunner needs your help as a dangerous situation has begun to escalate and the Alliance leaders are gathering. Please make your way to Alah'thalas and speak with her.
40394.completion: Thank you for coming my friend. I may need your help as a dangerous situation is unfolding.

40395.title: Food for Sailing Thoughts?
40395.description: You find this book in an awful condition. After some inspection, you make out the title of the book: "Guide to a Sailor's Stomach".

40396.title: Captain Grayson's Revenge
40396.description:
This is Cookie's cookbook, it's how I taught him to understand our tongue and how to make a somewhat decent meal.

I tell you, I am not sure if it’s because he's a Murloc or not but he barely has a taste for flavor.

I am getting off the sails here.

The night the ship sank, Cookie fled, leaving all of us to perish. I almost forgot!

I guess my mind gets foggy nowadays, not that I still have a working brain or a consciousness, mind you.

That motherless Murloc must pay for this bloody mutiny. Bring me proof of his death and I will reward you handsomely

Perhaps I will even be able to move on...
40396.completion:
I can't believe he didn't toss this away.

In my anger I might've mistaken Cookie’s actions, he was always a scared catfish. He must've panicked.

<Grayson sighs for a moment>.

Drying the book, keeping this necklace...

Oh <name>, what have I done.

40397.title: By Any Means Necessary I
40397.description:
This forest used to be bristling with life; it was my home once. Now, it is nothing more than a twisted abomination, a ruin of the beauty that once lay here. Those whom we once called brothers have played a big hand in the corruption of this land.

The Satyr can be found all across Felwood, lurking amongst the ruins and thinking of ways to further spread their corruption. I hate them with every part of my being, and I have killed many. You will assist me in the slaughter.

Bring me 60 horns of these beasts. Once you have retrieved them, I will know that you are capable of what is to come.
40397.progress: I grow impatient, have you dispatched the mongrels?
40397.completion: You have removed the taint of demonic influence from this world. Their vile schemes will not come to fruition, take heart in that.

40398.title: By Any Means Necessary II
40398.description:
You have proven to be a potential ally, and such allies are rare in these parts. If you truly wish to earn my favor, there is something you can do.

There is an elusive satyr named Pustax, a warped mockery of his previous name no doubt. He has caused much destruction and death in these parts, and has personally slain members of my family. I need his head; he has lived for far too long. He is known to lurk between Shatter Scar Vale and Irontree Woods, so start your search there. Bring me what I desire.
40398.progress: Each day we must stay vigilant to combat the growing darkness.
40398.completion:
This has been a long time coming, I would have never imagined this monster would be removed from this world so soon.

You may have the potential to follow in my footsteps, given your prowess in tracking demons.

40399.title: By Any Means Necessary III
40399.description:
If we truly wish to restore Felwood to its former state, then we must do more than what we have been doing. I have been fighting against corruption endlessly, but with seemingly no progress.

I desire an artifact that was stolen from me many months ago. I came into contact with an orc named Ulathek, who kept his intentions hidden from me. Despite his use of shadow powers, he seemed well-versed and willing to assist me.

He stole from me a gemstone of great power, which I want back to use for the greater good of this region. This orc now lingers among the cultists and demons of Jaedenar within Shadow Hold, the Barrowden they have corrupted.
40399.progress: Have you removed this deceitful orc from the world, have you recovered my Gemstone?
40399.completion:
<A smirk creeps across Niremius' face as he glances upward and nods his head..>

At long last, I have the gemstone. I thank you greatly.

40400.title: By Any Means Necessary IV
40400.description:
You have done me a great service in retrieving this artifact from the demonic worshippers. It will be better served in my hands, rather than to serve evil.

While I may have used you to further my own goals, I am not a traitor, and I will make it worth your while now that you have achieved what I desired. I will forge a Glaive in my namesake for you, one that can slay all that oppose you, especially those of the Burning Shadow. However, I will not part with such a weapon so easily.

I require one last exchange. Deep within the Sunken Temple are the guardians of the Green Dragonflight, corrupted and twisted from their long slumber in the Emerald Dream. One of their defenders, Hazzas, is one whom I knew long ago. He is a powerful being and should not be tormented any longer.

Bring me his heart, and free him from torment. Only then will you earn your reward.
40400.progress: There is taint all across Azeroth, can you feel the world itself calling for aid?
40400.completion: The Heart of Hazzas. You are more resourceful than I anticipated, <race>. Now, as promised, let's forge your weapon.

40401.title: By Any Means Necessary V
40401.description: The only thing left is to imbue the blade with my mark to give it the necessary power for its intended purpose. Allow me some time to concentrate and channel my energy, and only then will the blade be ready.
40401.completion: My work is done, as I have promised, a Glaive worthy of my namesake. Use it well, and keep Azeroth safe.

40402.title: Need Claws
40402.description:
You, <race>. Tharg sad. Tharg angry!

Tharg lost his hitting stick. Hitting stick special, hitting stick made by friend.

Tharg's friend angry with Tharg, Tharg angry with Tharg. Give friend gift, friend not angry! Bring claws, Bloodfen claws only! Me give reward.
40402.completion: Claws perfect, Tharg thanks new friend.

40403.title: Tharg's Gift to Friend
40403.description:
Tharg made gift.

Tharg wants new friend to give gift to old friend. Tharg really sorry he lost favourite hitting stick, it was gift from old friend.

Old friend name Bourok, he left with the little greens, in little green village. Go south, you find Bourok, give this, say Tharg sorry.
40403.completion:
Pretty gift! Me still angry at Tharg but less angry now. Thanks new friend for bringing Bourok gift, marsh dangerous!

Drink some grog, grog of friendship!

40404.title: Return to Tharg
40404.description:
Me bit happy now, Tharg gave beautiful gift! I send Tharg some big lizard meat, he loves big lizard meat.

Me wishes me had another funny hitting stick for Tharg but me have to ask goblin friend. Me send it later, but no tell! Big surprise!

<Bourok raises his arm in the air.>

Give sack to Tharg, Tharg happy! Goodbye Tharg and me new friend.
40404.completion:
Tharg friend sent him meat? Tharg love meat! Tharg love old friend, new friend too.

Here, Tharg had gift for new friend for help.

Tharg loves new friend.

40405.title: Spider Meat Good
40405.description:
Marsh ugly, stinky!

Me best chef in Kalimdor, but me only cook ugly and smelly things! Me so hungry, me could eat you.

<Ogg'mar laughs>

Joke, joke. But me has idea. Me make ugly spider in good food, give you some too. Hunt for Ogg'mar, hunt spider, bring white spider meat. Crack them good, hunt them good! Me cook them good, we eat them good together!
40405.completion: Yes, yes. Good meat, enough too, me make us sausage.

40406.title: Balai's Experiment
40406.description:
Hello mon!

Another beautiful day in the marsh, right? Some of the ogres here dislike it, but Balai sees great potential in the marsh.

Many plants and creatures to harvest from for potions and poisons. No better place Balai says.

Do you wish to do Balai a favour? Balai pay nicely. You will need to venture into the marsh and find Withervine Mire Beasts, kill them, bring me the core and you get paid.

The Mire Beast core can be a strong poison if altered properly, the Warchief said not to touch the humans of Theramore but if they come too far, Balai will know how to deal with them!
40406.completion:
Perfect mon.

This will make for great poison, Balai makes the poison and dips darts in it. Balai uses this small wooden thing to shoot darts at the enemy, with poison!

Small little things can kill you, the marsh teaches, think about the mosquitos. And here's your reward, it will help you one day.

40407.title: Mannoroc Demonic Sigil
40407.description:
It has been years since the invasion of the Burning Legion during the Third War, and while they have been defeated, they still hold much sway upon Azeroth. Demonic magic is extremely potent, and it is something I have been tasked with studying.

In the region of Desolace within an area known as Mannoroc Coven there is quite a sizeable demonic presence. It is there that I ask of you to acquire a Mannoroc Demonic Sigil, finding one may be rare, but if we are to have a chance to defeat the Burning Legion, then we must know all that we can.

Slay them, and bring me one of their sigils for study.
40407.completion: The power coming from this sigil is quite strong, and will prove useful for study, thanks again for everything you have done <class>, I will make sure it is put to good use in defense of the realm.

40408.title: Juicy Darkfang Legs!
40408.description:
Say, since you stopped by how about we have ourselves a nice meal, it's been a bit since I've been able to enjoy my special recipe! I damn near hunted all the Darkfang in the area, so you'll have to venture further out into the swamp to go and get me some of their juicy legs!

Five should do, the Darkfang spiders are practically everywhere in the swamp, but especially so around the Quagmire down in the south west.

Oh, and make sure they're extra juicy, I won't take no dang-nabbit unjuicy spider legs now, yahear?
40408.progress: Ye wrangle up them spider legs? Remember to get the extra juicy ones.
40408.completion:
Why look at this here, you out done yourself, truly! I haven't seen some dang-nab spider legs this juicy in a few years now, they've been getting extra fat down there!

Now we can have a real good meal!

40409.title: The Mirefin Nuisance
40409.description:
I've lived at this lighthouse for a long time now, and if there is anything that has bothered me most it's those damned Mirefin. They often venture deep out within the ocean and upon the shorelines to the north, but as of recently they have come down here if only to drive me mad and steal my things!

The Theramore Guard cannot have someone staying here full time, especially with us being seperated by a boat ride.

I ask of you to rid me of their annoyance, and for good. I feel like its only a matter of time before they do something more serious. You can find them all along the coast up to the north and on small little islands. Bring me twenty of their claws and thin out their numbers so they think twice before coming so far south.
40409.progress: I advise you to be careful when you're fighting them, they tend to stick together.
40409.completion: Well, I cannot thank you enough for what you've done, with less murloc around it means I can do my job in peace without having to constantly watch the waterline.

40410.title: Stolen Oil
40410.description:
It was about a week ago now when the damned Mirefin raided my Lighthouse and got off with all manner of supply I had been building up. A few weeks of food rations and some tools, but most importantly oil for the Lighthouse!

The Lighthouse in Theramore runs from oil collected in other parts of the world, and of which we only get a shipment in at the start of every month, without it, the Lighthouse will die out. I do not need to tell you how vital this Lighthouse is especially for a port city like Theramore.

I ask of you to gather it back from the Mirefin Murlocs, no doubt they have it stashed among their hovels up to the north west, make sure to check the isles there, they practically infest them.
40410.progress: Every minute that burns away is a minute less that we have.
40410.completion:
Ah, this is it, and it's still sealed, I would have expected those dumb creatures to pry it open, or use the oil to make a big fire or something, it seems they couldn't figure it out, or hadn't gotten around to it yet.

Thanks again for the help, you may have saved my hide here!

40411.title: The Good Snuff
40411.description:
Oh, how it is to be docked and not sailing the vast, and boring sea for months on end. All this time to myself and some dry land to stand upon, I just wish I had one thing.

I have a contact out in Steamwheedle Port that has been my hookup for a while now, and if you wouldn't mind picking up a special 'package' for me, it would be much appreciated!

At the port there is a goblin named Jabbey, he can almost get you anything you need, that is if you have the coin for his 'premium wares' he calls it. Head out there, and pick up a package for 'Groy' he'll know what I'm looking for.
40411.progress: I've been waiting patiently, have you gotten it yet?
40411.completion:
<Privateer Groy practically snatches it from your hands, a wide grin upon his face.>

Ahh, its been a while... a long while. I suppose you want something in return for running all that way. Here, some coin to cover the trip. If I ever need more I'll let you know, heh.

40412.title: Delivery Overdue
40412.description:
You wouldn't mind running a delivery would you? I got one that's a bit overdue, and that's mostly because my main delivery guy got reassigned back to Stormwind.

If you don't mind a bit of dangerous trekking, I got a crate of goods that needs to be sent to Jarl out at Swamplight Manor. It shouldn't be too hard to find, just follow the road northwest out of Theramore, keep going for a while after Sentry Point Tower until you see a small dirt pathway that leads to the right.

Once you see it, you'll see it, Jarl usually leaves a bunch of torches lit, just- don't startle him, the guys a bit... Quirky.
40412.completion:
What's this? For me?

I've been waiting a few weeks for this, didn't think it was even coming anymore! I don't go to Theramore much, but that yokel Lorman almost made me march down there I been waitin' so long.

40413.title: Old Bryan's Food Delivery
40413.description:
Hey there, I'm in need of assistance if you don't mind giving some. I have a delivery I need run to the Theramore Lighthouse to Old Bryan that resides there. His food delivery has run a little late and I need it to get to him as soon as possible.

You can find the Theramore Lighthouse just off the coast to the north east, the bright shining light should be enough to guide you.
40413.completion: Ahh, about time, I hate having to ferry to Theramore for a meal!

40414.title: Marglum Blood-eye
40414.description:
The local murlocs are becoming more, and more of a threat as time continues, they are no longer confined to just the depths or the shore, and are often seen traveling inland, or harassing locals.

They are led by a large, foul beast named Marglum Blood-eye, a hulking abomination of a murloc that patrols the coastline to the north-east shoreline.

Find him, and bring his head to me, and I will make sure you are rewarded.
40414.progress: Have you slain the foul monster?
40414.completion: This may not be the end of the murloc threat, but this will no doubt slow them down. Thanks again, as promised.

40415.title: Reports of Dustwallow
40415.description:
Hey there, you look tough enough to handle yourself, and Theramore is in need of some assistance. My last runner was ambushed on the roadway, and suffered a rather grevious wound. If we want to keep our defence of the roadway through Dustwallow then we need to remain steadfast.

As such, I haven't received the weekly reports from both Sentry Point, and North Point.

I want you to report to Captain Wallace Cross at Sentry Point Tower, and Captain Harker at North Point Tower, and bring their reports back to me.
40415.progress: Have you gotten those reports yet?
40415.completion: Well, thanks for gathering these reports, its good to hear news from the frontier, even if some of it is bad, take this coin as thanks for the work.

40416.title: Delivery to Cross
40416.description:
I once came from the city of Stormwind, and traveled to Kul Tiras, that was before the fleet ventured here, to Theramore. Ever since me and my brother have been seperated and while I have heard good things about him, and his business I haven't had any opportunity to deliver a letter, especially being stuck here at my post.

If you ever find yourself in Stormwind, would you mind stopping by The Silver Shield in the Old Town of Stormwind? My brother Bryan is the one that runs the place, and it would mean the world to me if you could run him this letter.
40416.completion: Well, I must say, this is the last thing I had expected to come into my shop, I haven't heard from Wallace in some time, not seeing family certainly makes you miss old times.

40417.title: Delivery to Wallace
40417.description:
While you are still here, could I ask of you a favor? I desire to send my brother something that perhaps can assist him. As much as he down plays his work in Theramore, I do know from stories I have heard that the swamp is crawling with all manner of orc and dragon.

I had a fireheated shield made some time ago, and haven't had the chance to sell it yet, I would much rather that it gets to him out there, then to sit in my shop and collect dust, aside, there is no finer gift I can give.

Take this shield to him out in Dustwallow Marsh, it would mean quite a lot to me.
40417.completion:
So, you have delivered the letter then? How did he like it?

Wait, he sent this? Truly this could have fetched a noble's wage in gold, I must thank you for not being a brigand and making off with it, I shall use it with great honor.

Thanks again, for all you've done. <name>, take this coin for all the traveling you have done.

40418.title: Securing Northpoint
40418.description:
With each passing week the roadways get more and more dangerous. Nature here is ever encroaching, always looking to gain more and more ground. If we want to keep our forward sentries supplied then the road to Northpoint must remain secured.

Our biggest threat is currently the Bloodfen Raptor's that have been breeding to the north of us.

If you could find a way to rid Northpoint of this threat, I would see to it that you were paid accordingly, I am sure Theramore could find a way to reimburse your troubles.

Head to the north, and slay the Bloodfen Screechers you find there.
40418.completion:
Now that those raptors have been culled we may be able to make more supply trips out in the swamp without worrying so much.

I took it upon myself to gather a payment for you on behalf of Theramore, it may not be much, but all help should be rewarded.

40419.title: A Blasted Land
40419.description:
Soldier, we need you.

A Few weeks ago I sent a small expeditionary force south, to Blasted Lands. I haven't gotten a word from them since. Go there, and see what happened. I ordered them to set up a camp in proximity to the Dark Portal, if it helps.
40419.progress: Ruag sent you? I didn't expect him to hire a search party that soon.
40419.completion:
We have our hands full of work. I wasn't able to spare any of my men to send the report back to Stonard.

But since you are here now, you might be able to help us with the matters at hand.

40420.title: Nethergarde Scouting
40420.description:
We have no presence in Blasted Lands. The Alliance, on the other hand, occupies a large fort north of our current position. They haven't interrupted our operations in the region.

Yet.

I need you to check what are they planning. There has been a lot of movement lately in a cave close to Nethergarde. See what is happening there. Try not to kill too many of them. We don't want an open war with the Alliance.
40420.completion:
A mine of extraordinary size, you say?

Good, I will write about it in the report. We still have other issues to worry about before I send this off, speak with Jaiymu and Bagaroh for more tasks.

40421.title: The Shadowsworn Enemy
40421.description:
The Shadowsworn cultists have been giving us a hard time here. In the last two days we faced three attacks from them. They were weak, and we managed to fend them off. I fear that in the future, they will send a bigger force.

We need to act quicker. Venture into the wasteland, find their strongholds, and thin their ranks. Buy us more time.
40421.completion: Good job, <class>. I wish I could've seen them dying.

40422.title: Shadowsworn Altar
40422.description: In the northwest corner of Blasted Lands, an old Altar of Storms looms over the wastes. Around it, elite soldiers of the Shadowsworn gather. I was never able to get closer to them, but with your strength, it should be an easy enough task. Kill them, and interrupt whatever they do.
40422.progress: Have you found the Altar of Storms?
40422.completion:
Hah, good job again.

Thank you, friend. Thank you for all you do for the Horde.

40423.title: Blasted Ogres!
40423.description:
Do you know what is the worst here? Not the heat, not the demons. Not even the alliance, sitting comfortably in their castle. It's the ogres. Why ogres? Because I hate them. And that’s a reason good enough.

That, and of course, they are a danger to our mission.

Bring me twenty ogre heads. Of any ogre, I don't care. I will personally write about your victory in the report.
40423.completion:
Twenty heads. I rarely smile, but you earned it.

<Bagaroh grins>

Time to get back to work.

40424.title: Report from a Blasted Land
40424.description:
Thanks to your actions, we have been able to rest for a while. I also wrote the report for Ruag. Deliver it, and remind him to send some booze too next time he thinks we need help.

Blood and honor, friend. You helped us and the horde today.
40424.progress: It's you! What happened to the expedition?
40424.completion:
<Ruag glances over the report>.

Great work, soldier. I am relieved to hear that the expedition is safe. I am also impressed. You did a lot of work, good work. Please, pick some equipment from our armory. Whatever you like.

Stay safe, soldier.

40425.title: The Tome of Arcane Intricacies and Magical Phenomenon IX
40425.description:
Long has it been rumored that the mystical ninth volume of the Arcane Intricacies and Magical Phenomenon has been stashed deep within the Stormwind Vault. So long has it been gone that it has almost become legend, the secret -lost- tome.

Well, it is a secret no longer, and it needs to be recovered before some vile vagrant gets their hands on something so rare.

Within Stormwind Vault lays this book, it needs to be recovered so that I can complete my records of it.
40425.progress: Have you delved within the depths of that accursed Vault, and recovered the rare tome? Or is it still collecting dust with chance of desecration?
40425.completion:
My my... This is it, the rare volume! I never thought I would lay my eyes upon it!

You've done us a great favor in getting this, and favors should always be repaid.

On behalf of the Academy of Arcane Arts and Sciences, I present you with this.

40426.title: Recovering Vault Shackles
40426.description:
Back when the Vault first was opened, it was used to house the most dangerous prisoners, to contain magical entities and the insane alike, we used Runic Constructs to patrol the hallways!

These Runic Constructs have fallen corrupt from the intense magic within the Vault, and need to be destroyed, their powerful bracers are what keep them intact, and they need to be recovered! I have plans to test what exactly went wrong with these bracers.

You can find them within the Stormwind Vault, slay them, and bring me a pair of Shackles, I will make sure you are rewarded for the task.
40426.progress: Be careful, the Runic Constructs are quite powerful, an overchage of magical energy gone rampant!
40426.completion: Ahh, here we are! This is them, thanks again, this means a lot, here, just as I promised.

40427.title: Ending Arc'Tiras
40427.description:
Many years ago the wizards of Stormwind discovered a large crystal that held an intense amount of magical energy. This crystal we named Arc'Tiras, and stashed it deep within the Stormwind Vault after many mishaps with the unstable magic it emitted.

Little did we know this crystal, Arc'Tiras had a mind of it's own.

It has driven the guards mad, and turned the Stormwind Vault into nothing more than corridors of madness. Our magic is enough to hold the crystal at bay, for now, but it needs to be destroyed, and for good.

Travel into the Stormwind Vault, put an end to this madness.
40427.progress: The longer Arc'Tiras remains active, the more danger Stormwind lays within, we cannot have rumors spreading, this must be dealt with.
40427.completion:
It is done, truly?

Why, thank you <name>, you've saved us a massive headache, and countless lives of this city. We have requisitioned a reward worthy of such feats from the treasury itself.

Please, take one, it is the least we can do.

40428.title: The Garrison Armory Disaster
40428.description:
Hey you, do you think you can help?

The Garrison Armory is nothing more than a trogg infestation. A trogg infestation that claimed the lives of twelve workers. It was one of the last dangers we ever expected to face, but when they came in, they came in fast.

The dead need to be avenged, and the mine needs to be cleared out for our own security.

The miners and I have collected enough coin to pay for someone to do the job right, go in there and clean it out good, don't show them mercy.
40428.completion:
The dead will not be forgotten, but at the least we have avenged their deaths. Thanks again for everything that you have done.

Take this coin, it is from all of us.

40429.title: Recovering Armory Supplies
40429.description:
The Garrison Armory is a place Nethergarde has stored extra supplies for some time now, and before long there will not be anything left if the troggs trample, and destroy it all.

I need you to go in there, and recover atleast ten Garrison Armory Supply Caches, that way when this mess is over, and the dead are buried, we can return to work, and still have the tools to do so.

Venture inside, and see if you can recover them for me.
40429.completion:
<Foreman Tanoth lets out a heavy sigh of relief.>

Well, that gives me some breathing room. It seems like you got to the Caches before the troggs mindlessly trampled over them, thanks for the hard work, I'm sure it wasn't an easy task.

40430.title: Dreadmaul Skull Bounty
40430.description:
Ogres, oh how I hate em! If it aint demons then it's ogres!

The Dreadmaul came with the orcs during the First War, and they've been a sore on these lands ever since they arrived. They are responsible for a lot of the dead and they need to be dealt with.

We currently have a bounty on their skulls, bring me thirty of them, and I'll give you something worth your time <class>.

You can find the Dreadmaul to the west, and southwest, goodluck!
40430.progress: You got them skulls I asked for?
40430.completion: Ahh, someone of action I see, you remind me of a young Harguf, bashin' skulls and the like, here, as I promised.

40431.title: Shadowsworn Pendant Bounty
40431.description:
Lookin' for some work eh? Well we got a bounty on those Shadowsworn cultist types if you're interested. Not sure when they started coming around, but more and more of em been gathering over the last couple months.

Now I don't know a thing about dark magic, but it certainly isn't good! If you don't know where to look, search in the south, and southwest, you'll find them quick!

Collect me twenty of their pendants, and come back, I'll see to it that you get something worth the effort.
40431.progress: Any luck on collecting them pendants?
40431.completion: Well, look at that, you do some good work, well, as I promised, here you are.

40432.title: The Smasher and the Trampler
40432.description:
The Garrison Armory is a disaster, many of our miners have been slain, and troggs run loose destroying our progress.

If work is to ever continue there, we must do more than kill some troggs, we must cut the head off the beast, and slay their leaders.

The troggs that took over the Garrison Armory go by the name 'Boulderclaw' and are led by two big monsters named Kroshmak and Gorlush.

Travel into the depths of the mine to the west, and slay their leaders, bring me one of their claws as proof.
40432.progress: Have you avenged the dead, has the mine been reclaimed?
40432.completion: You have done Nethergarde a great service, I must thank you for the hard work. Without you, who knows how long we would have had to wait until we could flush them out.

40433.title: Report from Burnside
40433.description:
Nethergarde is an isolated, and rather desolate place. We rely on a large garrison to help stem the tide of a potential demonic invasion, should such an occasion ever occur.

The soldiers under my command have homes and families, and morale here is paramount. I rely on my sergeants to give me a situation report on the status of those beneath me.

As of current the only one I am waiting from is from Sergeant Burnside, would you do me a favor, and collect it from him? You can find him somewhere outside the gate, he is probably with his troops.
40433.progress: Have you found Sergeant Burnside yet?
40433.completion:
<The Commander would take some time to look over the situation report.>

I see, well thanks again for your work, I don't have all day to look for everyone, take some silver for the trouble.

40434.title: Suppressing the Dreadweavers
40434.description:
It has come to my attention that a dark magic has been growing in power within the region. Our Analyser Wigglestip has documented an extensive amount of magic being introduced into the area.

There is no doubt that the Shadowsworn would be the ones utilizing such forces. Those that gather around the Altar of Storms are to blame, and our reports only confirm that.

I need someone to dispatch of the Dreadweavers that spread the corruption. Who knows what plans they have in motion, but I do not intend to sit around to find out.
40434.progress: The defense of Nethergarde requires us to be steadfast.
40434.completion:
I must commend you for your work, I am sure many of those here are relieved to have one less threat be waiting at the doorstep.

I have gathered a suitable reward for the work you have put in, may it help you on your journey.

40435.title: Genetic Alteration Anomaly!
40435.description:
The energy radiating off of the Dark Portal is sheerly astounding, and it's given me so many research opportunities that I do not know where to start! I was employed here as an analyst to watch the ever shifting arcane magic within the region, and its incredibly unstable, so unstable infact that it has warped the boars close to the portal itself, turning them into 'Helboar'!

I know it sounds like something straight out of fantasy!

I need you to get me a Pristine Helboar Brain, to see just how much the creature has been altered by the intense energy of the Dark Portal.
40435.progress: Twenty eight, carry the seven, account for arcane disturbances... Oh- it's you, have you had any luck?
40435.completion: Ahh, this is a fine specimen, take long to find?

40436.title: Finding Private Holson
40436.description:
Hey, you there, I need your help.

About a week ago on one of our patrols we ended up being attacked by a group of ogres, these ogres were fierce enough to make us retreat. During the struggle one of my Private's was captured by the Dreadmaul.

I don't know where they have taken him, but I want you to find him, I can't risk any more of my soldiers on such a mission.

If I was you I would search their camps, both to the west, and southwest, he may be in one of them.
40436.completion: <The Corpse of the soldier remains lifeless, battered and bruised it would appear that the body was beaten mercilessly. An abrasion can be seen upon the neck, where a medallion or necklace was torn off.>

40437.title: Finding Private Holson II
40437.description: <The corpse of the soldier appears to not have any marks of identity, you are sure that the mark on the neck is indicative of an amulet being removed, there is no doubt that the identification of this soldier is in the hands of one of the nearby ogres, you feel obligated to retrieve it, and return it to Sergeant Burnside at Nethergarde Keep.
40437.progress: Have you found anything, or any clues?
40437.completion:
<Sergeant Burnside would let out a quiet sigh>

I feared it would have come to this, it always hurts to lose someone, especially those under your command. I will forever wonder if there is more I could have done to save a life.

Thank you <class>, for risking your own safety to let us know the truth.

Take this amulet, I am sure Holson would respect it being in your hands after delivering this news.

40438.title: Fel Energy Irregularities I
40438.description:
Why, you wouldn't happen to have some spare time would you?

The master of this tower has been hard at work and has given me the task of gathering a report from Engineer Wigglestip. Sadly to say, I haven't had the opportunity to leave just yet, nor do I know how to find our gnomish friend!

Do you think you could speak with Wigglestip and gather the report from him? Once you've obtained it, you can bring it to Watcher Mahar Ba at the top of the tower.
40438.completion:
So that is why you are here, this is the report from Wigglestip yes?

<Mahar Ba would take the report, beginning to read it with caution.>

Interesting...

40439.title: Fel Energy Irregularities II
40439.description:
Well, this news certainly reinforces my assumptions, and what I have been studying. The Blasted Land's has become even more unstable, the energies within the region are beginning to grow in power.

I have been preparing a report that I need delivered to my superior's in the Kirin Tor, and I need you to deliver it at once. Communication at such a distance is impossible with the raging storms so I am relying on you.

Travel to Dalaran at once, and deliver this report to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver.
40439.completion:
Ahh yes, I sensed that you would be coming, I can practically feel the energy from the letter you carry.

<Upon taking the report, Ansirem Runeweaver would read with caution.>

I see.

So it is going as predicted, it would appear we may need to be more hands on to manage the growing instability within the Blasted Lands, let us hope there is no outside interferance that is causing the increased magical irregularities.

40440.title: Fel Energy Irregularities III
40440.description:
It would appear that fel energy has indeed begun to ripple across the Blasted Lands, sending the region into a torrent of arcane irregularities and unstable conditions. Let us hope this is simply due to the Dark Portal itself, and not its reactivation.

It will take many more of our kin to keep everything under control. Now then, I am asking you to deliver an important letter, one that is magically sealed. Breaking it will destroy the parchment.

I trust that you will do for the good of the Kirin Tor, and for the Alliance itself. Make sure this reaches Mahar Ba, so that he may begin the necessary preparations.
40440.progress: Have you travelled to Dalaran, and spoken with Ansirem Runeweaver?
40440.completion: It is as I feared, the magical energies are that of fel.

40441.title: Fel Energy Irregularities IV
40441.description:
The Riftwatchers and myself have much work to do in our studying now that we know what is happening. I will need you to assist and gather some items from the demons nearest to the Dark Portal.

From the Felguard Sentry, and Felhounds, we will need to analyze to see if these demons are fresh from the portal, in doing so we need specific items.

From the Felguard's, gather Felguard Cuffs, from the Felhounds, gather Felhound Claws.

Once they are obtained, return them to me, at once, three of each should suffice.
40441.progress: Have the items been recovered yet <class>?
40441.completion: Good work, now, let us see what mysteries these may contain.

40442.title: Fel Energy Irregularities V
40442.description:
We have spent many months studying and preparing for the future, and it appears the future may be upon us sooner then we had realized.

There is one I have not spoken with for a long, long time. An old friend who once studied within the Kirin Tor, lost to the ways of demonic, and dark magic.

I will simply say that he owes me a favor, and I ask of you to reach him, so that he may answer my questions about the Dark Portal and the irregularities of the magic in the region.

Travel to the Southwest, and venture within the Tainted Scar, find Daio the Decrepit, an old warlock who resides there, ask him if he knows anything, I would suggest bringing a friend, or recruiting mercenaries, it is a dangerous place there.
40442.completion: So.. Mahar Ba sent you, did he?

40443.title: Fel Energy Irregularities VI
40443.description:
Heh.. He has a question, does he?

<The old, withered man lets out a crooked laugh, a wiry smirk resting upon his aged features.>

I haven't spoken to Mahar Ba in a long, long time, if he wants information, than I need something done, favor or no favor!

If you want to know the truth, than I require something from you.

Within the Tainted Scar lies a secretive race of demon, the Dreadlord, I have been meaning to practice all sorts of magic and I need a singular heart. Bring me a Dreadlord Heart, and I shall tell you what I know.
40443.progress: Yes yes yes, do you have my heart?
40443.completion: A Dreadlord Heart, oh how I desired, and needed one. You've done me a real favor, I shall answer your question.

40444.title: Fel Energy Irregularities VII
40444.description:
So, he desires to know about the Dark Portal, and the influx of fel energy? The demon's have been gathering for some time around the Tainted Scar, and have been using it as a safe haven close to The Dark Portal.

With the increase of Fel Energy, there is no doubt that they have plans for the future. This future though, may not come for some time given what I have heard.

Go to Mahar Ba, and tell him to gather the best of his kin, and to prepare himself, time ticks slowly.

Now, begone, I have repaid his favor.
40444.completion:
<Watcher Mahar Ba would look on with a slightly concerned look.>

We must begin to prepare, and keep the magical energies stable, you have given us a great deal of information, and without you we would have been unable to figure out these clues and unearth the answers we need for our future.

The Kirin Tor thanks you greatly for what you've done, please, take one of these rewards, it is the -least- we can for how much trouble you have saved us.

40445.title: Dominance of the Skies
40445.description:
Hello there traveler, and welcome. There is something that I must ask of you to ensure the safety of the wyvern here at the Roost.

Wyverns are creatures that roam and explore, it is not something that we can control, though sometimes the wyverns venture too far, and into the claws of harpies.

The Windfury Harpies have gotten so bold as to organize scouting groups for wayward wyverns, and already we have lost one this past month. If we are to continue and keep our training, young wyverns safe, then we must take action.

Far to the north and the north west are Windfury Sorceresses and Matriarchs, they are the ones that need to be removed. Go there, and make certain the welfare of our wyverns.
40445.progress: Have you had any luck, child?
40445.completion:
Your actions have eased this troubled mind. We can now be more free with the wyvern and let them truly grow within this world, and for that, I must thank you.

Take this, as a symbol of my thanks young one.

40446.title: Halting Bristleback Expansion
40446.description:
The Bristleback are a ruthless and uncaring tribe of Quillboar, who expand their territory and domain without care for diplomacy or good will. They have recently attacked Suntail Pass, causing the Spirit Walker's that reside here to vacate the cave just to the east.

In battle they ended up wounding me, luckily Elder Pyrestrider came to my rescue, and we both escaped their wrath.

If Suntail Pass is to remain a safe haven for travel, and for the Spirit Walker's to remain in peace, then the Quillboar must be eradicated.
40446.progress: The Bristleback hold incredible disregard for nature, have the Quillboar been dealt with?
40446.completion:
With your assistance Suntail Pass is made much safer for travel.

Perhaps now the Quillboar will have learned a lesson, and the Spirit Walker's can resume their tasks in peace.

40447.title: Continuing Ceremonies
40447.description:
The Quillboar expunged us from our sacred cave and vantage points overlooking the expansive Mulgore. It is not the cave itself I am worried about, but many of the ceremonies that must be held in the next few days to help pass the dead into the realm beyond.

Left behind in the Quillboar's rampage are tools, and charms that we will need to reclaim for the upcoming ceremonies, and I need you to get them for me.

I lost the following items just to the east, A Silver Hawk's Feather, Ornate Spirit Beads, and the Drum of Passing.

Recover them, and help the dead ease their way to the afterlife.
40447.progress: Without the proper instruments, we cannot conduct our ancient rites and passages.
40447.completion:
I have been expecting you, it seems that you were sent to aid us at a time of dire need. The spirits have sent you to aid me, and now I must aid you for your help.

Take this, on behalf of the Spirit Walker's for allowing us to conduct what must be done.

Go now, and walk softly friend.

40448.title: A Mother's Concern
40448.description:
It's been a few weeks now since we've had to send Brian away to live with some cousins of mine in the city. It's not the safest place, but it's much safer then around here, especially with all of the defenders around Gallant Square.

I've had a lot of worries since he left, and I just want to make sure he is okay. I've prepared a lot of things to send to him so he feels a bit more comfortable during his stay, do you mind running them out for me, and making sure he gets them?

You can find him in Stromgarde, in Gallant Square, the part of the city that is under construction.
40448.completion: Oh, hello there, this is from mom? I miss her quite a bit, but it's nice seeing family! The city is kind of fascinating too.

40449.title: Protecting the Crops!
40449.description:
Howdy friend!

We have been dealing with all sorts of problems ever since we first started settling here, from raptor, to giant spider, to ogre!

Chaser has done well enough with scaring off the local wildlife but they have just gotten too aggresive as of recently, from trampling on our fields to even fighting with us. It's gotten so bad infact I had to send my son into Stromgarde until things calmed down.

If you could clean up some of the critters, that would go much appreciated for me and my wife. About ten of those Plains Creeper's and ten more of the Highland Thrasher's should do just fine.
40449.progress: Have you had any luck just yet?
40449.completion: Oh, well my my, you've really outdone yourself for us. Perhaps now we can finally get a plentiful harvest in for the season, here, take this, as a token of my thanks, its a spare.

40450.title: Repowering Chaser
40450.description:
Say there, you wouldn't happen to know anyone that knows a thing or two about engineering, would you? We picked up Chaser from Southshore about a year ago now, from a goblin merchant infact. He's been great, but, slowly he's been breaking down, or getting kinda slow.

I was told that he would need a backup Gold Power Core at some point, and I think that might be what the issue is. The problem itself though is that we're so far out here, and I don't really know much about engineering to craft one, or have the resources on hand infact! If you could get one, I'm sure Chaser would be quite happy.
40450.completion: <After inserting the Gold Power Core it takes a moment for Chaser to power up once again, the machine whirrs to life, beeping happily.>

40451.title: To Strike Back : Witherbark Village
40451.description:
It has been a while since the Troll Hunter's of Stromgarde have had the chance to practice their trade. We have been confined defending our section of the city now for too long, under constant threat.

Our main enemy is biding their time, and gathering their strength. The trolls have been at war with us for generations. My fathers, their fathers, and even their own have fought troll.

We will strike at them, to show them that Stromgarde will not lay down idle. Far to the east is Witherbark Village, go there, and kill ten Witherbark Shadow Hunters.
40451.completion: You make Stromgarde proud, the less trolls, the better for our ultimate survival.

40452.title: To Strike Back : Ruins of Zul'Rasaz
40452.description:
