We have received information of a battle that took place in the troll city of Zul'Rasaz, or what is left of it anyway. Deep within the hills to the north, hidden away is a troll city, destroyed by conflict and time. It would appear the Witherbark fought and defeated the Wildtusk.

Go there, and thin them out so that they cannot harm us down here in Stromgarde.
40452.progress: It may be hard to find the pass, but I am sure you will do what is neccesary.
40452.completion: You have done well, much better than I would have expected. Take this, as a thanks.

40453.title: The Boulderfist Outpost
40453.description:
The ogre's have caused us much headache, and have taken a section of the city from us. The last thing we need is more forces coming from outside of the walls to assist those that are within.

To the north just outside of the city is Boulder'gor, a small outpost that is an ogre sanctuary. I need you to go there, and bring the fight to them, so that more do not come pouring into the city.

Bring me twenty Boulderfist Truncheon's as proof, and Stromgarde shall reward you.
40453.completion: The Ogres are a mighty foe, and although you've done excellent work, I fear it will not be enough. Here, as I promised.

40454.title: Farwell Commission
40454.description:
A few weeks ago I had a ring commissioned from Old Farwell up at the Farwell stead far to the north. Old Farwell was once a prominent, and powerful wizard of the Kirin Tor, one who is now retired.

The ring is supposed to safeguard against the foul, and dark magic lingering within the city.

You can find the passage way on the north western corner of the Arathi Highlands leading into the mountains where his Stead is located.
40454.completion: Do I know you, is there something that I can help you with?

40455.title: Farwell Commission
40455.description:
Oh, Sergeant Karster sent you? Well, it's good getting some work from time to time, my magical abilities haven't been tested for a while now.

<Old Farwell produces a small, ornate ring, with a glowing violet gem.>

This ring should ward off any magical energies or foul tainting aura. Make sure you give my best to Sergeant Karster.
40455.completion: Old Farwell has done a lot for us. Thank you for delivering this ring, it should be just what we needed.

40456.title: Gadgetzan Times: READ ALL ABOUT IT!
40456.description:
Hey you, <race>! You look like the sort of cultured individual who likes knowing what goes on in the world! Well, I'm a trainee saleslady for the goblin owned Gadgetzan Times Newspaper! We cover only the biggest and explodiest stories around!

For just a few silver you will be known as an… ally of Gadgetzan, yes! And with also the useful tips and tricks within the pages, well, just imagine all the profits you can make for such a tiny investment now!

<She waggles a rolled up newspaper towards you.>
40456.completion: Enjoy, enjoy! I will record your name in our super duper subscriber log!

40457.title: Gadgetzan Times: READ ALL ABOUT IT!
40457.description:
Hey you, <race>! You look like the sorta cultured individual who likes knowing what goes on in the world! Well, I'm a professional saleslady for the Gadgetzan Times Newspaper! And you know us goblins, if it ain't worth its weight in gold, it ain't worth coverin'.

For just a few silver you can have your name written down as a supporter of the newspaper, and a friend to goblin business. And with the information inside, you can profit beyond your wildest dreams! All that for such a tiny investment purchase.

<She smirks and holds out the newspaper towards you.>
40457.completion: Wise purchase, pleasure doin' business with ya. Your name has been recorded in our subscriber logs.

40458.title: Rival Presence
40458.description:
Alright, the lookout reports just came in. Seems the ol' brotherhood isn't alone outside anymore. The reports indicate that the Shadowforge are setting up something at the other side of the mountain, a quarry of sorts. What they're digging is a mystery though, as nobody goes inside never gets out alive unless they're with them.

That's where you come in. Gather your friends or some mercenaries and venture into that quarry, find out what they are digging up out there. Now go!
40458.progress: All attempts to sneak in have failed, their hounds can smell everything.
40458.completion: This... green liquid is what they're brewing there? <Overseer opens the flask and takes a sniff.> Och, its quite acidic! This is certainly very concerning, if it the mere smells burns your nose hairs I shudder at the thought what it does to flesh. I will warn the others about this, you've proven yourself to be capable to the brotherhood.

40459.title: Gaining Orvak's Trust
40459.description:
You want to help us out do you? Well we need to know we can trust you, after all, we have many enemies in this region, and most regions of the world, probably.

You can start by gathering Thaurrisan Badges, carried by the Dark Iron in the Ruins of Thaurrisan. Gather 15 of them, and bring them to Orvak Sternrock, he will know you mean business then.
40459.completion:
Hmm, so you're the real deal huh, no way you're working with Shadowforge anyway.

You never can be certain, they have an alignment with the Twilight Hammer afterall.

40460.title: Hearing Orvak's Story
40460.description:
Not often we get someone wanting to help, especially one of your kind. That said, we aren't all too able to turn down a willing hand, especially given all of the others that died in our caravan.

I need you to understand my point of view, and what I have gone through. Maybe you'll think twice before you label me as another of my kin.

Speak with me, and listen to my story when you're ready.
40460.completion: Does it all make sense now? Orvak Sternrock has a vengeance, one that needs to be unleashed.

40461.title: The Sternrock Stash
40461.description:
Now that you understand we are on the same page, and are fighting the same enemy I would have you prove to me one last test of loyalty.

Before we can begin our grand revenge, I must plan for the future.

Long ago, before I held any position of power I buried a large stash of items and gold incase I ever needed to leave or escape, well that time has come.

If me and my comrades are to live this adventure than I will need that stash.

Travel to the entrance of the Blackrock Mountain, and search beneath the bridgeway, between the two pillars, you will find the stash there.
40461.progress: Have you recovered my lost items?
40461.completion:
With this our future is secure, but I will not leave until I taste the sweet sensation of revenge.

I will let the others know that you are to be trusted, speak with them, they should have tasks for you.

40462.title: Miners Union Mutiny
40462.description:
The Miners Union betrayed the High Foreman, and sentenced those that were loyal to Orvak into slavery. There is no other step than justice and it must be handed out to any, and all who remain!

To the east lays the Hateforge Excavation, we will begin by dealing with the Excavators who are working on a series of redoubts and defenses leading into the Quarry.

Slay 10 of them, and return to me.
40462.progress: We are on the road to justice, can you can feel it?
40462.completion: It feels good knowing that there are less of those scum on this world, but there is still more to be done.

40463.title: The True High Foreman
40463.description:
Bargul Blackhammer.

That vile scum has been working to get the position of High Foreman now for years, attempting every underhanded tactic that he could think of.

From violence, to deceit, nothing was off the table for scum such as him.

The idea of the Hateforge Quarry was an idea Bargul came up with, and sent to the senate. He ended up convincing the lot of them, and worked in tandem to get me outed from my position.

Bargul Blackhammer holds my title now from a position of underhanded fraud, and I want him to hold it no longer.
40463.progress: Have you culled that wretch from this world yet?
40463.completion: Also, take this key, I do not intend to return to the mountain. It should open a chest within the Black Vault, if they haven't already taken it away.

40464.title: Senatorial Revenge
40464.description:
Shadowforge was once a home that I was proud of. I know the truth of what it really is now, and it is vile, and corrupt.

At it's heart many of the decisions the Shadowforge Senator's make are only to further their own interests at the expense of the people who live within.

I ask for a favor, one more important than anything to me.

The Shadowforge Senate needs to be rooted out, they are safe, and comfortable deep within the city, make it so they feel fear.

You can enter Shadowforge deep within the Blackrock Mountain, go there, and brave the Blackrock Depths to find them, and kill them.
40464.progress: Has the deed been done, has the senate been removed?
40464.completion:
<Orvak would let out a small chuckle of enjoyment.>

The hatred instilled deep within me has begun to cool, the fire that once raged on has eased.

It fills me with vigor to know they met their end.

I know deepdown that Shadowforge can never be saved, regardless, I thank you.

I will not be needing this any longer, for I do not intend to return, perhaps you may find some use for it.

40465.title: Discovering Golem Secrets
40465.description:
Hey there, I got a strange request for you if you don't mind helping. I used to be an Arcanasmith within Shadowforge and worked with all kinds of Golem Cores.

My loyalty to ol' Orvak got me tossed out with the rest of the miners. Whenever we get out of this here camp I want to continue my work and I'd like a head start.

Up to the north are the Ruins of Thaurissan. The Dark Irons there have War Reaver patrols, which are powered by Golem Cores. Get me three of them, so we can see what kind of power they contain.
40465.progress: Any luck in obtaining those Golem Cores?
40465.completion:
<Radgan would take his time inspecting the cores.>

Flaws, cracks, hmm.. These are some second rate power cores, not the type of stuff I am looking for.

40466.title: To Purchase Secret Information
40466.description:
Well, I have the cores now. But they are as useful as pebbles, as I don't know what to do with them. I have a new task for you, if you're willing to accept.

There's this goblin I know, Jabbey, that lives in the Steamwheedle Port. I am sure he has some sort of information about arcane golem cores.
40466.completion: Hey look, it means a lot for you to travel all that distance for me, I made it worth your while in coin, now lets see...

40467.title: The Arcane Golem Core
40467.description:
This information contains all manner of suppliers, distributors and who is involved, it appears Argelmach is the one who would hold such an item.

If I am to ever get my hands on an Arcane Golem Core, it would be through him, and that means I need you to get it.

You can find Argelmach deep within the Blackrock Depths, he is usually seen around a team of weapons experts and Arcanasmiths.

Bring me a Arcane Golem Core, and I will make it worth your while!
40467.progress: Have you ventured deep into the Blackrock Depths?
40467.completion:
Look at the sheer power within this thing, it is much more advanced than what we used to work on in the Mold Foundry, this is intense.

You've done me a great favor, and now perhaps I may actually have something to work on when we get out of here.

I reconfigured one of the Golem Cores you got me from the War Reavers, hopefully you'll get some use from it!

40468.title: Miners Union Mutiny II
40468.description:
Now we will strike at the heart of the Miners Union.

Their main project lays just beyond the excavation, and deep within the Quarry. It is there they began their mutiny to get Orvak removed, and it is there they will feel the wrath of Morgrim Firepike.

Oh, and his mercenaries, of course.

Head to the Hateforge Quarry to the east, and kill twenty of them, they shall have consequences for their actions.
40468.progress: Justice grows ever closer, you can practically feel it.
40468.completion: You have done well by me, and truly made them bleed. Justice has been served, and their work has been slowed tremendously. I would like to offer you a reward for all of your hard work, take it, as a herald of justice, you deserve it.

40469.title: Vilegrip's Demise
40469.description:
Oh, how the name 'Vilegrip' brings a burning desire for blood to my head. His name has rung deep in my mind ever since the mutiny.

Slaver Vilegrip is responsible for the enslavement of all those that stood with Orvak, those who now rot deep within the Blackrock Mountain.

He shall pay for his crimes, and you will bring me his head. Search for him, he should be at the Hateforge Excavation to the east. Make sure he begs and cries for the atrocities he has commited, make him suffer.
40469.completion: It is about time Vilegrip got what was coming to him, even if he deserved torture. I prepared a reward for you incase you returned, and here you are, take it.

40470.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40470.description:
The mysterious animation runes... I've been trying to get my hands on one, but as a shopkeep, I ain't exactly suited to fight mechanical monsters.

I work for a... certain someone who is investigating the harvest golems in Westfall. If you could recover a rune, I'll make it worth your while!

You can find them in any harvest golem in the region.
40470.completion:
What a fine specimen! A little cracked, but this should work just fine. My client is trying to get to the bottom of what caused these golems to go haywire, and he needs all the samples he can get.

I have another task for you, and I'm willing to spare some coin for your trouble if you're interested.

40471.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40471.description:
Alright! Eager for additional work, aren't we?

So, my... employer is looking for even more animation runes for his experiments. Bring me an additional ten runes, and you will be greatly rewarded. But, be careful. They will accept only intact runes. Try not to damage them too much with this weapon of yours.

One more thing. Don't get yourself killed. Those harvest machines pack a punch, and I need you to run more errands for me.

Hah, I'm joking. But seriously. Take care of yourself.
40471.progress: Have you collected the runes already?
40471.completion:
Good job! And all of them are of extraordinary quality, too! I didn't think that you could do it, to be fair. The last adventurer helping me... let's just say, he got harvested, if you know what I mean. It's great to finally have someone who knows what they're doing.

So, would you want to help me once more? I need something else to be done, and I cannot leave Sentinel Hill for now. You know, I'm waiting for a shipment of supplies from Redridge and it could arrive any moment.

40472.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40472.description:
I knew you wouldn't pass another opportunity to earn some coin. Ever been to Stormwind City?

Oh, what am I saying, of course you have.

In the northern part of the city, there is a district inhabited mostly by non-humans. Dwarves, gnomes, even high elves lately.

One of my dear friends, a gnomish engineer with a lovely name: Lilliam, lives there. I need you to tell him that Hewen sent you.

He will give you a paper: a blueprint, even. You know what a blueprint is? Good. So, take the blueprint, come back to me, and I will pay you.

Easy enough! Good luck.
40472.progress: What is it? Don't you see, <race>, that I am kind of busy?
40472.completion: Hewen sent you? This son of a trogg couldn't even visit me himself? Preposterous! I got his blueprint, but if you knew how much hassle it cost me! If you only knew! Tell Hewen that next time he orders something from me, he pays double!

40473.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40473.description:
Here you have it. The Harvester Blueprint. The goblin, who sold it to me... I wish I never see his green face again! Bah!

I looked into these blueprints. I don't know for what Hewen needs it, but it is nothing good, I tell you! This is a machine of death and destruction! I am only giving you this, because he is my old friend and I... hope he still has some brain left in his greedy head.
40473.progress: Ahhh, <name> already! You got the paper?
40473.completion:
The Harvester Blueprints...

<Christopher Hewen looks into the blueprints and makes a disgruntled face.>

To be frank, my hard-working friend, I don't understand any of it! But it doesn't matter, as I am only the messenger, a humble servant. Those papers are for my employer, who, if you are willing, you will meet soon!

I would deliver them myself, but, believe me or not, those damned supplies have still not arrived! Also, traveling through these beautiful, golden plains became so dangerous lately. I am certain that you can handle it, though. Care to help me for one last time, friend?

40474.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40474.description:
Okay, listen then. I need you to bring this blueprint to a man named Maltimor Gartside. Maltimor. Gartside. Got it? Good.

He's an old man, in his fifties, maybe sixties. Long, gray hair, kind of skinny, pale skin. Hard to miss, you will know it's him. Yes, he's my employer. And yes, I know where he lives.

Wouldn't want you to scour through all of Westfall, of course. Go west of Sentinel Hill, but north of Moonbrook. He lives in a solitary cottage, usually spends his time outside of it. Don't know why, didn't ask, didn't care. So, you meet him, tell him I said hello and give him the blueprints. Easy!

Also, please, be careful. It is very, very important that those blueprints don't fall into the hands of those bandits with red bandanas, the Defias, as they call themselves. Light be with you, friend.
40474.progress: Who are you? What do you want from me?
40474.completion: Blueprints from Hewen, finally. He couldn't be any slower with it. Let me see what is written inside...

40475.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40475.description:
Excuse me for my bad manners. I was so excited to lay my hands on those blueprints. Never have I seen these lands in such a sorry state. And it is not only because of the Defias!

You see, years ago a salesman arrived in Westfall. He brought new commodity - Harvest Golems.

Farmers were overjoyed. Golems worked flawlessly, gathering crops and scaring the wildlife away. So more golems were being purchased. In a few years, they outnumbered the farmers. And then, it happened.

Golems turned on their owners. In a few weeks, almost all farms in Westfall were lost. And to make matters worse, the Defias arrived. It was only natural that the people of Westfall linked the sudden change to the Brotherhood.

I believe that it is a mere coincidence. Someone else manipulated the golems and now the Defias are using the situation to their advantage.

I will continue the story later, <name>. For now, I have a request. Go to Moonbrook. The smith had a stash of engineering equipment hidden in his forge. Check there!
40475.completion: Engineering tools. And they are all still intact. Unexpected, but a welcome surprise. Now I have all we need.

40476.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40476.description:
<name>, I have all materials to create a new Harvest Golem. If my calculations are correct, I should be able to rewire his mind.

I need your help. The Harvest Golem will be hostile at first, and the Rewiring Spell requires all my concentration. I need you to draw the golem's attention until I'm finished.
40476.progress: The golem needs to remain intact for this to work.
40476.completion: So the person who may manufacture the runes lives close to Darkshire. We need to hurry then; there is no time to waste. Tales of your exploits have probably reached him already.

40477.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40477.description:
I did indeed promise you the rest of the story. So where did we pause? Oh yes, the arrival of the Defias.

Very soon, they started producing Harvest Golems on their own. How they managed this is a mystery to me; I have my suspicions though. It requires a powerful mage to produce an Animation Rune, far beyond the level of the parlor mages The Defias possess. I suspect they are working with the person who turned the golems hostile in the first place. Their original creator.

I will handle rewiring the golems of Westfall. It will take months, maybe years, but it will be done. However, the Defias can still easily produce new ones faster than I can rewire them. We need to halt their production. Fortunately, I know where we can find the shipments of Animation Runes.

Go to the Jangolode Mine and Gold Coast Quarry. The Defias hide their runes deep inside, awaiting transport to their underground foundry. Bring them to me.
40477.progress: Have you retrieved the Rune Shipments?
40477.completion:
You found the note attached to one of the crates? But it's all written in gibberish? Don't worry, we will figure it out.

For now, we need to handle another problem.

40478.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40478.description:
The goblins of Defias produce harvest golems deep inside their underground hideout. The People's Militia in Sentinel Hill have been trying to find its location lately. Maybe they have discovered its whereabouts. If not, they will probably need your help.

Once you are inside, find the workshop and slay the mechanics and their greatest creation. This will stop their manufacturing operations for good.

In the meantime, I will reach out to Hewen. If anyone will be able to decipher this note, it's him, or at least one of his contacts.
40478.progress: Have you found the Defias hideout?
40478.completion:
The Deadmines... Interesting. I'm glad that you made it out alive. With their leader dead, I can focus on rewiring the remaining golems.

That, and finding the person responsible for all of this.

40479.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40479.description:
When you were gone, I spoke with Hewen about this mysterious note. It turned out, as I expected, that it is some kind of cypher. Worry not, as he recognized it. Go back to Sentinel Hill and talk with him. He will explain it better than I can.

Finally, we are getting closer to delivering vengeance upon those who wronged the people of Westfall.
40479.progress: It's you, <name>! I missed you! How's it going?
40479.completion:
Great job with these golems, stopping the Defias and whatnot. You and Maltimor did more for these lands than the People's Militia has ever done, and no one will know about your exploits…

Such are the whims of history, pal. But you didn't come here for a friendly talk, ay?

40480.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40480.description:
So about this cypher... I cannot read it. But my dear colleague, Franklin Hamar, who lives in Lakeshire used the same cypher when trading with Defias.

Don't look at me like that! It was him, not me. I would never ever trade with these vile people...

Regardless, he will be able to read it for you. He will probably need some convincing, but you can do it for sure. And since you are going to Lakeshire... could you please ask about my damn shipment?
40480.progress: I offer only the finest goods.
40480.completion:
What? Give me that.

<Franklin Hamar looks on the note.>

Yes, I can read it. But everything has a price.

40481.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40481.description:
I can decipher this for you, of course. But first: you say a word to any guard in the town that I can do this, you're gone. And second: it will cost you. You're lucky that I'm in need of an adventurer to perform some easy and simple tasks...

First, I need silk. But not any kind of silk. Spider silk bathed in moonlight, extraordinarily beautiful. Hard to get though. Only found in Duskwood, to my knowledge. Bring me at least ten samples, we will see if it's good enough.
40481.progress: Got the silk? I haven't got all day.

40482.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40482.description:
Alright, you helped me well. I will spare you running errands and just send you to do what you do best. Kill.

Gnolls in the hills of Redridge have been giving me and other traders a hard time lately. It's bad for business. I lost two shipments with rare materials this month only! They probably still hoard them somewhere in their camps up north. Check it out.

I want you to look especially for one lost shipment - rare needles from Lordaeron. You will know when you see them.
40482.completion:
Extraordinary. Great work. Those needles will serve me well. So thin, so durable. But I'm getting ahead of myself.

I made a promise. Let me decipher this message.

40483.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40483.description: If I were you, I would go back to Westfall. This seems serious.
40483.progress: Finally, it's you. Were you able to decipher the note?
40483.completion: So the person who may manufacture the runes lives close to Darkshire. We need to hurry then; there is no time to waste. Tales of your exploits have probably reached him already.

40484.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40484.description:
Venture to Darkshire, and ask the Night Watch about the whereabouts of F.W. If he was right with his suspicions, they would know where to find him.

I pray to the Light that he still hasn't moved out of Duskwood.

Question him, and if you find him guilty... do not wait for Stormwind's justice. Kill him. Avenge the people of Westfall.
40484.progress: The Night Watch stands firm against the darkness that surrounds us.
40484.completion: F.W.? I know of no-one by those initials, but I have a hunch of who it could be, if what you told me is true.

40485.title: The Harvest Golem Mystery
40485.description:
A few months ago, a mysterious blind man moved into an abandoned shack south of Darkshire. A goblin accompanied him, helping him with everyday tasks in exchange for mentorship. He was a renowned engineer, of some kind.

Strange couple, that's for sure, though they professed to only be seeking shelter.

With all our concerns across Duskwood, I was only able to spare a single Watcher to surveil their dealings, and what little I've heard has done nothing to quell my suspicions.

If you venture there and find out what you can as you go about your errand, you would render a fine service to the Night Watch.
40485.completion: The people of Westfall are safe. Thank you, <name>. These lands will heal in time.

40486.title: Investigating Hateforge
40486.description:
Bah, what a wasteland to be assigned to, it's insulting.

I want to get out of here as soon as I can, and to do so I need some work done, I take it you are willing to help huh?

The Dark Iron are up to something, and it's my job to confirm that -something- is going on.

What I need you to do is scout the entrance of the Quarry, and confirm Ironforge's suspicions.

Travel up there, peek in the entrance, and come back, easy ye?
40486.progress: So, have you ventured up the ridge?
40486.completion:
Hmm, so there is something going on up there.

Hold on just a minute, I got to write a report of my findings and send it to the highest authority.

40487.title: The Hateforge Report
40487.description:
<Senator Granitebeard makes quick work of writing his report, sealing it and stamping it with the seal of Ironforge.>

There, I need you to take this to Ironforge, at once, and report it to King Magni Bronzebeard, it should hold all relevant information based off what I have seen, and what you have reported back to myself.

Be quick, our enemies plot against us.
40487.completion: What brings you to Ironforge, how can you assist the Bronzebeard?

40488.title: The King's Response
40488.description:
<Magni would take the Hateforge Report, beginning to read it over with a calculated interest.>

The Dark Iron have been our foe for quite a while now, and I will not forgive them for what they have done.

It has been a while since we have discovered the efforts going on within the Burning Steppes, it was only a matter of discovering -what- was going on there.

It would appear that the Twilight Hammer has taken an interest in the project, they have been spotted entering.

Take my response to Senator Gravelbelt, you are dismissed.
40488.completion: So, how did things go in the capital?

40489.title: Assaulting Hateforge
40489.description:
It would appear that The Hateforge Quarry is of great concern to the King, and he has given me the authority to recruit any on behalf of the kingdom.

If you are looking to gain favor with Magni then this should be a good opportunity.

I am looking for anyone brave enough to venture deep into the Hateforge Quarry and remove the presence of the Twilight Hammer within. If you are interested, I would suggest bringing fellow adventurers, a group of mercenaries, or some kind of brigade.

If you end up completing the task, return to Magni, and he will reward you.
40489.progress: Is there anything I can help you with?
40489.completion:
<King Magni Bronzebeard would nod his head stoutly.>

The defence of the kingdom requires us to be steadfast in all manners, I have no doubt you have really shaken things up for our enemy, and put a stop to their plans.

On behalf of my people I reward you with an item from our armory, may it serve you well.

40490.title: Rumors of Hateforge Brew
40490.description:
There be rumors floatin' around about somethin' called 'Hateforge Brew'. The Dark Iron refer to it as something with reverance, and I know they aint makin' no ale in there.

The name is a cover up for somethin' else and we gotta find out just what that somethin' else is, ye get me? I do know that they have chemists within the Quarry, and my bet is they are linked to this Hateforge Brew.

I need you to head in there, gather me a Dark Iron Vial and some Hateforge Chemistry Documents. I bet they have them stashed away somewhere in there about what's going on.
40490.progress: You get a whiff of what's goin on in there yet?
40490.completion:
Ahh, would you look at all this huh?!

Those crafty bastards sure were keeping their secrets, I'll make sure to send this back to Ironforge when I get the chance, and they can look everything over, nice job eh?

I got some extra Thunder Ale for you, oh and me ol' gloves, they should treat you nicely, I got a new pair.

40491.title: Scrap Forager
40491.description:
Greetings stranger, it seems some new recruits from this new Horde are arriving at last.

I'll keep this short, we're not doing so well here. It's like everything is being held together by worg spit, and the lack of resources certainly doesn't help. I'll say it's about time we fixed that.

Dark Iron tends to be quite scarce in the surface of the steppes, though it is carried by many. Whether it be baubles, equipment, or sitting in a creature stomach.

Venture out and collect me a sizeable amount of scraps so I can keep forging equipment for our grunts to keep Karfang Hold safe.
40491.progress: Hard times call for desperate measures, knowing how to make do with what you have draws the line between life and death.
40491.completion: That's quite a haul, I'm impressed. Joining this new horde might not be so bad after all. You've scavenged so much I even have surplus to forge you an equipment of your choice. I believe you will wear it well.

40492.title: Fueling the Blood Fury
40492.description:
Whelping, I need your assistance.

The Blood Fury itself remains untapped to its full potential. Long has it been since we have followed the demons and worked in tandam with their magic to become stronger. I intend to explore what may be possible without their help. My dark magic is practiced and ready for use, I simply need the correct regeants.

This is where you come in. Within the Burning Steppes are imps of a demonic nature, no doubt remnants of the burning legion. Slay them, and bring me five of their scalding hearts.
40492.progress: The Blood Fury burns within us, and needs to be strengthened.
40492.completion: These shall do nicely, now. Let us see what power they truly hold.

40493.title: Fueling the Blood Fury
40493.description:
This region does not possess the potency that I am looking for, but I do know a place that does.

Far to the southeast is the Blasted Lands. It is where I came into this world, in awe by it's skies and the lush swamp. All that remains now is a hellish wasteland akin to what the Outland is.

It is there that demons rove the land and the energies of the Dark Portal itself fester and pulse.

Go there, and kill a Felguard Sentry that watches the portal, bring me a Large Felguard Heart.
40493.progress: I will not wait forever, have you done as I asked whelp?
40493.completion:
This heart belonged to a powerful Felguard, one that desired to serve its masters tirelessly.

<Darkseer Geshtol would examine it carefully.>

It would appear there are no large flaws, this should work nicely. You've done well out there and have done well for us, I have gathered something you might find useful for all of the hard work.

Now... Lets see what this is capable of...

40494.title: The Firegut Task
40494.description:
How disgusting.

You people dare call yourself the Horde, yet you know nothing about the Horde. We are the True Horde, the first and the very best.

I see no thirst for battle in your eyes, I see no glory, I see nothing. You're nothing more than a worm living in the legend of the real Horde.

You are lucky I promised Karfang to indulge fools such as you. But if you truly want to not be a simple pest in the eyes of our clan you have to prove your skill as a warrior.

Use whatever trickery you believe would aid you. I challenge you to take on the Firegut Ogres, slay them and prove yourself.

Now go or forever be shamed for your utter powerlessness.
40494.completion: The stench of ogre blood bathes you <class>. You might not be useless after all.

40495.title: Forest Troll Scum
40495.description:
Fine, you've earned yourself the right to breathe the air in Karfang Hold.

But I have one last trial for you. A grudge, yes, that's what this is.

All the Blackhands were nothing but fools, the father was a misguided mongrel who was fooled by the wretched Gul'dan. Maim isn't even worth mentioning, he died a fool's death, nothing more deserving for his kind.

And Rend? Rend is kneeling before that despicable dragon and doomed the entirety of the Blackrock Clan. But that's not even his worst call yet.

He made a forest frog his strategist.

War Master Voone?

<Ok'gog yells that name angrily.>

War Master? He's nothing but a disgusting frog that must meet his end. Bring me his tusks and prove once and for all that the Horde led by a wretch who grew up amongst Humans has at least a quarter of the former glory of the True Horde.
40495.completion: The arrogant fool lays dead. Ah to be alive <race>. I tell you, hearing the demise of those you hate while you're still well enough to eat, drink and kill feels like the embrace of a cold and grim fate. But we hold it into our arms with pride and we would never let go. Such is life living under the Horde's name, we greet death with open arms and weapons ready.

40496.title: Raider's Revenge
40496.description:
I have fought in many battles, against the Alliance, orcs, demons, ogres... Yet I never expected to face my own clan.

My clan no longer. A few days ago I was patrolling the wastes on my trusty wolf, Skullshatter. I encountered Rend's soldiers. Before I could do anything, they attacked! I was outnumbered. I manged to escape, but they hurt my wolf. I thought it to be only a scratch, as he suffered worse many times. Unfortunately, the arrow was poisoned and he died a few hours later.

I do not mourn his death. This was his purpose, after all. He joined his brothers and will now hunt among the ancestors. But I want revenge. If only I wasn't so severly needed here... <race>, go south of here, to the Pillar of Ash and slay as many Blackrock as you can. Bring me their heads. Forty will do.
40496.progress: Have you exacted revenge in my name?
40496.completion: Good. I feel better now. Yet, there is still much to do.

40497.title: Raider's New Mount
40497.description:
Good. Now, a new task awaits you. As I said, I cannot leave this place. Not until I have a new wolf. My legs are not as swift as they used to be in my youth.

Steal one from the Blackrock. Here, take this cage. Find a Young Blackrock Worg, capture it, and bring it to me. You can probably find a young worg in their stables in the Pillar of Ash. I will mold it into a worthy mount in no time.
40497.progress: I have trained many worgs in my life. My first one, years ago, on Draenor...
40497.completion: This one will do. I will get to training them as soon I can.

40498.title: Raider's Raid
40498.description:
Last thing to do. In the Blackrock Spire, they breed wolves. Go there, and slay the alpha. Gizrul the Slavener is his name.

Hit them where it hurts. Let them know my pain.
40498.completion:
I knew you had it. You severely weakened the Blackrock Clan with your feat. Without the alpha, it will take years to rebuild their worg population.

Soon, I will once again ride to battle. Thank you, <class>. Take this, a gift from myself.

40499.title: Preventative Antidote
40499.description:
Greetings, recruit of the new horde. I suppose you're here to aid? Then I got the task for you. To the west of the hold you can find the deadly venomtip and deathlash scorpids, their body might be fragile but their venom killed many aspiring orcs. I know how to brew an antidote to cure such ailments, but problem is that the antidote is made from the venom glands of the scorpids themselves.

Go out there and collect their glands, if you survive your efforts will save many lives. If you perish trying then you'll be forgotten like the rest.
40499.progress: Can never be too prepared in these hostile lands.
40499.completion: It seems you endured their stings and lived to tell the tale. Many lives will be saved thanks to your work. Please accept what little I have as payment.

40500.title: Removing Vital Assets
40500.description:
Can't you see I'm busy? Oh, the whelpling wants to make itself useful, then I have the task for you. Venture west near the doorstep of the Blackrock Mountain and you shall find the Blackrock Stronghold, where they prepare for assaults against those that would oppose their manipulative masters, truly fools to blindly follow them.

Slay their battlemasters and retrieve the stronghold documents where they plan their attacks. Now go and make yourself useful!
40500.progress: I don't have time to chat when there are things to be done, so get moving.
40500.completion:
So, you've done as I asked. Let's see what's in those documents.

<Molk takes the documents from you, and stares intently for a few seconds.>

Well, this will surely put a hamper on their plans, the information here must have taken them a while to acquire, and without it they have no leads.

You are more useful then you look, whelpling.

Take this gold, as a thank you from myself.

40501.title: Of New and Old
40501.description:
You are from the New Horde, are you not? After much discussing it has been decided that we cannot remain within the Blackrock Clan, and are seeking for new refuge and alliances outside of our boundaries.

On Behalf of Karfang I am tasked to make a request.

This Karfang Missive must be delivered to the Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar at once, I trust that you can carry it to him.
40501.completion:
How can I help you <race>?

<Thrall takes the missive, reading it over.>

Karfang, this name is not familiar to me.

40502.title: Of New and Old II
40502.description:
Another wishes to join the Horde, so be it.

I do hold concerns with those from the Blackrock Clan, for their evil runs deep, corrupted to the core. We have dealt with Old Horde refugees in the past but not an entire group looking to join us.

Eitrigg was once apart of the Blackrock Clan, and perhaps knows more about this 'Karfang'. Speak with him, and figure out what he knows.

40503.title: Of New and Old III
40503.description:
I haven't heard that name in some time, though I certainly remember it.

Karfang fought with the Blackrock Clan during our invasion of Azeroth, and rose through the ranks quickly. From my knowledge, he was a strong warrior, though not as blood thirsty as others.

The Karfang I remember was smart enough to deny suicidal orders, or challenge leadership when required, I am not surprised he has lasted this long.

Karfang can be trusted, he is certainly wise enough to see the doom of the Old Horde before him.

Thrall gives approval on my word take the Warchief's Response to Karfang Hold, we will see if he can prove his loyalties.
40503.completion:
<Karfang looks out at the Warchief's Response, beginning to read with caution.>

So it appears the Warchief is asking us for a test of loyalty, he shall receive his demands.

40504.title: Of New and Old IV
40504.description:
I know what it is the Warchief speaks, the Twilight Hammer has recently moved into the Hateforge Quarry, located just south of here.

It is an annoyance that was eventually going to draw in more attention from our former masters, and was something we would need to deal with eventually, now I implore you to help us with it.

We may have the strength to fight deep, but to stop the Twilight Hammer lurking deep within the Dark Iron clutches, requires covert strength, not brute strength.

As Warleader, I ask you to remove the Twilight presence on my behalf.
40504.completion:
On behalf of everyone here, you have done us a great service in securing our future, entrance within the Horde means we may get out of this ashen wasteland eventually.

I have seen much in my time on Outland, and in the Blackrock Mountain, but I look forward in what is to come, and for that you have my gratitude.

40505.title: Protecting Fresh Blood
40505.description:
We have had many join our ranks from the various battle groups dotted around the Burning Steppes, their names etched in paper marking their transfer to Karfang Hold.

To protect those that joined us we will need to destroy the documents that may lead any suspicious Blackrock our way.

You will find the Transfer Documents amongst the small camps around the Pillar of Ash, search high and low, and burn any you find.
40505.completion:
The runts of our group will now be invisible to the Blackrock Clan, vanished from thin air with no trace of where they have gone.

There is still work to do.

40506.title: Report to Molk
40506.description:
We will need to cover all of our tracks if we want to make it out of here alive. Karfang Hold is fortified, but not fortified enough to survive such an onslaught if they get wind of what is going on.

Molk is my strategist, and should know our next move, speak with him.
40506.completion: You will need to be prepared for what is to come outsider.

40507.title: Destroy All Traces...
40507.description:
I hope you understand that we are using you for our benefit. Do not take this the wrong way, for we are not looking to con, or cheat you.

We simply require assistance to achieve our goals, goals that a Blackrock Orc cannot be seen doing, lest our betrayal be discovered.

We need to destroy all traces of Karfang Hold, the records of its construction and garrison lay within the Blackrock Stronghold to the West. Gather these documents and return them to me so that I can make sure they are removed properly.

Be careful, it is a well defended location.
40507.progress: If I were you I would suggest bringing backup.
40507.completion:
Picked through the bones have you?

<Karfang lets out a small laugh.>

This would be what we were looking for, an excellent job outsider, Molk was expecting shoddy work from one of your kin, but you did well.

40508.title: Take No Chances
40508.description:
Raz'gol Deadtusk, the name makes me regret what is to come.

He was one of the first I told of my plot to depart from the Old Horde, a dearest friend from the days on Outland. He was too stubborn to accept, his loyalties rigid, and hard.

He will not be coming with us, and we both know what must be done.

It hurts me to ask it, but Raz'gol Deadtusk must be slain. Should he find out that I went through with my idea his loyalties to me will be pitted against the Blackrock Clan, and I cannot trust him to hold to his word.

You will find him atop the large spire in the Pillar of Ash, he looks down upon the region with an iron glare, slay him, and bring his blade back to me as proof of your deed.

<name>, do not make him suffer.
40508.completion:
<A deep and heavy sigh escapes Karfang, his face full of emotion.>

I was always impressed with this sword and the way in which he wielded it, he fought with tenacity, and strength, he shall be remembered for it.

40509.title: The Final Crack
40509.description:
There is one crack left that can break everything apart. His name is Zigris, Quartermaster for the Bloodaxe Legion deep within the Blackrock Spire.

Upon setting out we borrowed all manner of tools and supplies to begin construction of Karfang Hold, these materials will eventually need to be collected. It will only be a matter of time until he will press to look for them.

I am asking of you to slay Quartermaster Zigris, without him, there will be none who can figure out our motives.

You will find him within the Blackrock Mountain, at Blackrock Spire's lower portions.
40509.progress: Have you braved the Blackrock Mountain?
40509.completion:
<Karfang's old features begin to crack a smile.>

I cannot express my thanks, for this, and everything done.

<Karfang would remove a ring from his finger.>

This ring was taken upon my entrance to this world, from some noble human lord in battle.

This keepsake is now yours, thank you.

40510.title: Broodling Imposters?!
40510.description:
Howdy there friend! Wanna hear a little story I was told from a friend? It's so crazy you wouldn't believe it!

Aparently while she was venturing through the Burning Steppes she ran across a Black Dragonflight Whelp, which, isn't out of the normal, given just how many there is in the region. When she ended up shooting it, no blood came out, just puffs of smoke, and whirrs of machinery!

Upon inspection it was discovered to have been a mechanical creation layered with replica skin, can you believe that?!

Now that sure is magnificent engineering, so magnificent it has fooled even the dragons. I'd like to see how it was done, if you wouldn't mind helping. Get me six bundles of Robotic Broodling Guts from each one you find, that should be enough to figure things out.
40510.progress: You found any of them fake whelps?
40510.completion:
Wow, this is complicated stuff!

<Masey looks baffled by the sheer complexity of the parts!>

This was truly a piece of art, no wonder those black dragons were fooled.

I'm gonna take some time to figure out how this stuff works, thanks again.

40511.title: To Eperius' Aid
40511.description:
Ah poor Eperius, she ran like the lightning and kicked like a mule. Since her wound from our last encounter with ogres she refused to eat anything and I fear the worst. Everything we tried has failed, but I have one last idea.

I heard rumors about a magical grain, its taste so sweet it gives your horse enough energy to gallop to Stormwind and back. Alas, its location was lost long ago and I don't have any leads on it.

Perhaps someone in Refuge Pointe knows something about it. You should check there. While you're gone I'll make sure she is comfortable. Please make haste as I don't know how much longer she can last.
40511.progress: Hello, welcome to Refuge Point. How can I help you?
40511.completion: A magical grain you say? Its been a long time since I've heard about it.

40512.title: Eperius Needs Grains
40512.description:
Magical grains huh? Well I'm the one that enchanted them long long ago. They were made to help the cavalry and help the livestock plow the fields faster and longer, but then tragedy struck.

The orcs invaded what is now known as Go'shek Farm and the entire stock of the grain has been lost since then.

If you're lucky you might still find a sack of it, presuming the orcs didn't get their filthy hands on it.

I wish you good luck and I hope we meet again one day.
40512.progress: I don't know how much longer she can last.
40512.completion: You found it! Her recovery will be slow but I believe she'll back on the road hunting trolls with our cavalrymen in no time. This is all I have in my pockets, even if not much you made this old handler happy today. Thank you.

40513.title: Polymorph Enslavement!
40513.description:
Baaaaa! You must help me!

The wizard in the house turned me into this form while I was out travelling.

Baaaaa! Baaa!

You got to do something, he's residing just inside the farmhouse, kill him, and bring his Azureborn Ring to me so I can be released from this torture!

Baaaaaa!

<The sheep looks at you with pleading eyes.>
40513.progress: Hurry, I cannot stand another second of this! Baaaa!
40513.completion: Hurry, smash the ring, it contains the magic that has kept me enslaved!

40514.title: Thalassian Diplomacy
40514.description:
Warm greetings friend.

I am Meldralis, a diplomat. I have been sent from the Farstrider Lodge to thank our forever friends, the dwarves, for their hospitality. We are preparing a gift for King Magni and his daughter, Princess Moira.

Alas, that is for Nel'doriel to explain. He will probably need your aid as well! My task is to give this pamphlet to Illyanah in Stormwind City. The Humans of Stormwind were kind enough to offer us a small place in the Dwarven District, we have called it Little Silvermoon.

Your kindness and help are highly appreciated, friend. May the Eternal Sun guide your steps.
40514.completion: Ah, you bring news from Lady Meldralis. Much appreciated, friend. I am glad to know the diplomatic representative has made it that far through the mountains. I am more than sure she will strengthen the bond.

40515.title: It Broke...
40515.description:
I just can't seem to get it to work! I managed to fix it once as we took it from Silvermoon to Farstrider Lodge, and it worked on the journey here, but I simply cannot understand what's wrong with it! It might've been damaged. Arcane Golems aren't easy to build or repair. If only my master was still alive...

Wait, that's it! I remember that Thalestien, my master, gave his notes to a friend of his in Gnomeregan. He was so enthralled by the gnomish inventors that he gave Masey Wirefuse his notes, hoping that the gnomes could assist in improving upon his work. See if you can find her in Tinker Town. I truly hope she survived Gnomeregan or else I'm doomed.
40515.completion:
Hello, hello!

Welcome to Tinker Town. Got anything that needs fixing?

40516.title: Thalestien's Notes
40516.description:
A student of Thalestien? How exciting!

Thalestien was not exactly like the rest of the High Elves; he really enjoyed tinkering with gizmos and scraps as much as we did! But his craft also used a hefty amount of the Arcane, which in truth was a very smart choice. It's no less to tell that people like him were a true inspiration to Engineering today.

The Arcane Golems were the product of high ingeniosity, but I'm afraid Thalestien's notes are lost. The last time I had them I was in a small house North West of Brewnall Village. You could try there. Just be aware that Leper Gnomes might guard the area. If you were to get those notes, I believe a new age for Engineering could begin! Working with the High Elves from this aspect would be very exciting.
40516.completion: Great, great news <name>. I haven't seen these in quite a while now!

40517.title: Back to Nel'doriel
40517.description:
I'd love to take a peek through those again. I was sure they were lost! Thalestien was such an awe-inspiring engineer. So many exciting stories about people and their crafts. $Have you ever heard of Brymidaine Zecker? A trickster dwarf, that's what he was! Many believed he was the greatest dwarven mage of all time, but rumors say that his magic was no magic at all.

But the benefit of Engineering and Technology! Look at me babbling... Nel'doriel surely awaits these notes. Oh well. Do tell Nel'doriel I'll visit soon... maybe even help with his golem!
40517.completion:
You return with the notes! Much appreciated, friend.

Now I can finally start working on this this again. I'm glad Masey would like to help me. I'm intending this as a gift for Princess Moira: her own personal bodyguard!

Here, this is for you.

40518.title: The Ramolus Gem
40518.description:
My trip to Stormwind has been a failure, and truth be told, I don't really have the courage to return just yet.

I was ambushed by a group of troggs heading to Ironforge, and I just so happened to drop the most important item on me, The Ramolus Gem.

The Trogg that happened to take it was enfused with the latent arcane power of the gem, and now has some ability with magic... Or so I heard.

<Ansela pouts.>

Can you recover it for me by chance? The Trogg named Grash can be found deep in the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
40518.progress: Yes, have you had any luck?
40518.completion:
<Excitement perks across Ansela's face!>

Oh, oh thank you! I cannot express my excitement, I never thought I'd get this back.

I thought I'd have to go get a stern talking to in Little Silvermoon about my failure. Here, take this, as thanks for helping me out.

40519.title: Drifting Across the Sand
40519.description:
<The troll's ghostly visage speaks in a broken, howling tone that is hard to understand fully.>

I... be lost... Forever wandering across the desert... to try and find a way out. But it don't feel like... there be a way out.

Go to Zul'Farrak... the place where my body is... and find my Ancient Troll Remains... in the burial grounds... Free me mon, from this... eternal torture...
40519.completion:
<With the remains close to the spirit, the howling tone becomes more clear.>

I can feel the end. It is in sight. My vision is no longer blurred and faded mon. You have shown me the way. That cursed Zum'rah and his magic brought me back from my rest, and left me to wander aimlessly. But I got no grudges mon, for I am free now.

I will find the way, thanks to you.

<The spirit drops a chained necklace onto the sand below, leaving it as a reward as he collects his remains.>

40520.title: Da Unforgiving Lands
40520.description:
Ever since we left Zul'Farrak, hunger and thirst be constant companions for us. Da greedy goblins of Gadgetzan control da Wastes and dey do not see us any different than our Sandfury brethrens.

Mon, our village needs ya help. We are starving here. I plead, venture into the desert and find some meat. Meat of da roc, while not tasty, is nutritious enough to keep ya alive. And while ya be out there, gather some hyena skins as well. Hingozu make ya armor for da effort.
40520.progress: Do ya have da food and skins?
40520.completion: Thank ya, mon. These supplies won't be lasting for long, but they will allow us to live for a few more days at least. Here, take this as a reward mon.

40521.title: Desert Voodoo
40521.description:
You. You can help me, us. The ogres of Dunemaul be driving us away from our ancient temples. I will not tolerate them defilin' our sacred grounds and relics. Their foul warlocks and mages tarnish the idols of our gods.

Venture south to where the Dunemaul reside and slay them. Retrieve three Loa Charms and bring them to me. We shall unleash their wrath upon dem!
40521.progress: Our mad brethren in Zul'Farrak no longer revere our gods as dey should. Only we can stop the ogres.
40521.completion: Da ogres will fear da might of our gods. Their vengeance be scary, no mercy be shown. Curse de ogres. Theey will learn not to mess with da Sandmoon.

40522.title: Sandfury Redemption I
40522.description:
Our tribe... Da Sandfury

We lost everything. Zul'Farrak, once a shining jewel of this desert, be ruled by lunatics. Few of us, who be seeing the imminent fall, left the city and settled here. As ya see, there be only a handful. Not enough to stop da so called Chief Sandscalp and his minions.

Da name of the Sandfury Trolls has to be redeemed first. Among people around us, dey need to see that we changed.

We be in need of a diplomat, a representative. You be da one to fulfill da role. Show dem in Gadgetzan dat da Sandfury are not all crazed bloodrinkers.
40522.completion:
The Sandfury have changed and want to cooperate? What do they have to sell then? I guess nothing! My friend, you know, Gadgetzan has its reputation. I cannot just let in some filthy sand trolls here.

Unless they pay.

A lot.

40523.title: Sandfury Redemption II
40523.description:
Tell your troll friends that I can - convince - the guards here to let them in for… let's say... five hundred gold.

Each.

Sorry fella, just can't risk the business!
40523.progress: Have ya speak to da goblins?
40523.completion:
Dey be no less insane than our brothers in Zul'Farrak, mon. Sandmoon be not paying dem, never. If dey want us enemies, so be it.

My mission still stands.

40524.title: Sandfury Redemption III
40524.description:
If dere is one who could see our struggle, it be Vol'jin of da Darkspear. Like no otha he be understanding how is it to be outcast and lose da homeland.My kind be not welcome in Horde lands, but maybe ya be able to show our new ways.

Travel to Orgrimmar, and speak to Vol'jin. Tell him what be happening in Zul'Farrak and offer our assistance.
40524.completion: I require your assistance in helping Sandmoon Village, brave <class>.

40525.title: Of the Sandfury and the Darkspear
40525.description: Go, speak to the leader of those Sandmoon. Tell them, they have support of the Darkspear, and by extension, of the Horde. I will send my best hunters and scouts there soon. But for now, help them with any matters at hand.
40525.progress: So ya be the new one among us. Maz'ek told me he sent you to negotiate with Vol'jin. Were you successful?
40525.completion: That be good. I think. We Sandfury be never open to da outsiders. But these be different times now. As Maz'ek be sayin': we have to change or face extinction. I wish I could speak to Vol'jin myself about our... cooperation. I cannot leave my people yet though. I be needed here. I be needed here as long as Chief Ukorz lives and my people are in danger.

40526.title: Plight of the Sandfury
40526.description:
It pains me much, but my brethren be beyond saving. They do not see the corruption of our tribe. I tried everything. Dat why we had to run. They wont be listening. We got to stop dem.

Outside of Zul'Farrak proper, many Sandfury Trolls scour the desert, attacking trade caravans and assaulting water towers. I can't be risking their influence spreading further, mon.

Thin their ranks.
40526.progress: Have you finished your... grim task?
40526.completion: It does not bring me joy to hear about de death of my kin. It be necesarry, sadly. It is de only way for Sandfury to survive.

40527.title: End Ukorz Sandscalp
40527.description:
It has to be done. Ukorz Sandscalp and his foul right-hand man Ruuzlu have to be stopped.

Venture into our ancient city of Zul'Farrak. Kill Ukorz and Ruuzlu and come back to me.

There will not be celebration, or a feast. This is just what needs to happen. In time, de lands of Zul'Farrak will heal.
40527.completion:
So it is done, I Thank you.

Ukorz Sandscalp was not always so brutal and cold, his mind be warped from the magic he and his lackeys dabbled within'. It almost be sad to think of what a promisin' future he brought when he first became chief, for it all to drift away like sand on de dunes.

Perhaps we find a new future now, all thanks to you mon.

40528.title: Meat for Viceclaw!
40528.description:
Ya be the one who be pokin' in our village! Ya better get yourself useful or else Ekka feed ya to da Viceclaw!

Viceclaw be likin' good, tough meat. Da turtles from da shore be his favorite. Ekka can't go dere, da goblins would shoot her to death! Bring Viceclaw da meat from dem, and as a reward he will spare you!

<Ekka laughs maniacally>

Good Viceclaw, good.
40528.progress: You can find da turtles on the shore, next to da port.
40528.completion: Good, turtle meat for Viceclaw! Ya be useful outsider. Ya can stay, Ekka be likin' ya.

40529.title: Letter from Maltimor
40529.description:
Dear Farad,

We made a mistake. You need to stop distributing the golems. Our plan will not work.

I know you are still angry at me for what I did to you. It was an accident, I swear! But you have to listen, please. I cannot stop the golems from killing people. The spell does not work! Oh, how stupid I was.

Please, Farad, stop this nonsense with the Stonemasons Guild and come back. We will figure out how to fix them together, like the old times. Please.

I await you in our old workshop in Moonbrook. Where everything started. Our friendship, our plans, our failure.

Your good friend, Maltimor Gartside.
40529.progress: What is it, friend? Oh, by the Light...
40529.completion: I bid you farewell, <name>. Thank you for understanding. And once again, thank you for all you did. You truly are a hero.

40530.title: The Way of the Spiritwolf I
40530.description:
I have been awaiting your arrival for some time now. I have heard tales of your deeds from the very spirits themselves, and it is time to prove your worth as an Orc.

It is time for your next challenge, and to prove your worth to the very spirits themselves. If you think you are worthy for such a task, seek out Margok Hatewind at Camp Mojache, he will be your guide.
40530.completion:
I have been expecting you.

It is about time you have arrived. I have heard many tales of your prowess, but now I shall see if such tales are true.

40531.title: The Way of the Spiritwolf II
40531.description:
You have begun to find potency within your use of the elements, though now comes a different matter entirely. Within Feralas is an Ancient Wolf Spirit, one of whom can bestow great power upon orc shamans capable enough to prove their worth.

If you wish to prove yourself you must first gather a Pristine Wolf Tooth from the Longtooth wolves in the region. Be patient, it may be hard to come across. When you have found one, bring it to me, and you can continue on this journey.
40531.progress: Exert cunning, for the wolves of Feralas can be a rather intimidating foe.
40531.completion: <Margok Hatewind would inspect the tooth for some time.> Well, this would appear to be what I was looking for, you have displayed great patience, and great ability to hunt.

40532.title: The Way of the Spiritwolf III
40532.description:
It is said long ago, a large and magical wolf dominated these forests, and hunted with great power, only succumbing to a fatal wound near a large waterfall. It is here that you will take a powder I have grounded from the pristine tooth you brought me, to pour over this site. This ritual will be neccesary to gain the blessing of the Ancient Wolf Spirit.

To the south east of Camp Mojache is a large waterfall, find a way up, and there you will find the Wolf Spirit, do as I have instructed, and it will be willing to speak with you.
40532.progress: <The Wolf Spirit seems to not notice your presence.>
40532.completion: Another comes to speak with me, you wish to prove yourself, do you think you're strong enough? These are all questions one must ask themselves before they approach me, for I am not one that you should dissappoint.

40533.title: The Way of the Spiritwolf IV
40533.description: If you wish to truly grow, orc, you must heed my advice as many before have. When you are ready to listen to my tale, speak with me, and I will tell you what I know, so that maybe you may learn a thing or two in your journies.
40533.completion: Another comes to speak with me, you wish to prove yourself, do you think you're strong enough? These are all questions one must ask themselves before they approach me, for I am not one that you should dissappoint.

40534.title: The Way of the Spiritwolf V
40534.description:
You listen, and listen well, perhaps you are worthy after all. I have one final challenge for you, one to prove that you are truly worthy of my power. I challenge you to combat, show me your abilities, and show me your strength.

If you truly have the strength to defeat me, and can take my advice in heed, you will truly embody my spirit, and I will grant you my gift.

If you think you are worthy enough to challenge me, speak with me once more. Make sure you are ready, for I will not hold back.
40534.progress: Do you truly think you are ready?
40534.completion: Well orc, you are stronger then I had anticipated, and carry all the traits of the wolf, I am honored to bless you with my power. May it bring you great power in the hunt, and strike terror into your enemies.

40535.title: From Stomach to Heart
40535.description:
May the Earthmother guide the path you're traveling, young one. Welcome to Red Cloud Roost, where we keep the wyverns of Highperch, which have a unique bond with members of the Horde.

Wyverns are intelligent and generous creatures that have been invaluable allies to our ways for many years. Many would like to journey to the skies with them, and if that is your goal, I would be happy to teach you.

To begin, listen to what their stomachs crave and offer meat as a bribe to earn their trust. I recommend obtaining meat from adult plainstriders.

Simply bring back two pieces of leg meat, but be mindful that if you hunt these majestic birds with excessive force, you may cause irreparable damage, making it impossible to harvest the meat.

I look forward to seeing whether you will demonstrate the virtues of patience or creativity to complete this task.
40535.progress: If you fail to feed your wyvern, it will one day feast upon you.
40535.completion:
You return, and with the meat. By which means you've decided to obtain it, I will not question.

Now, onto the real task.

40536.title: Bond Through Battle
40536.description:
Now that you have the meat, it is time for the actual test. This will prove if you are capable enough to be gifted a wyvern cub which will become your most trusted companion.

Take this meat to Sunchaser, he is one of the Wyvern Alpha and my most trusted friend. Note that this will not be a gift, but a challenge. Presenting yourself in front of the alpha with the hunted game is disrespectful, Sunchaser will know you seek one of his cubs and by presenting the meat you will imply that you can be as much of a guardian as he can, and he will test that himself.

He will not kill you, probably.
40536.progress: All who seek to become windriders must first challenge an alpha.
40536.completion:
Ah, blessed be the ancestors, you truly have potential.

I haven't seen old Sunchaser pushed back like that for a long long time, you have my blessing, and his.

One final task remains.

40537.title: Eager Little One
40537.description:
My friend, you are ready to receive your own eager wyvern cub. But for it to accept you as its new companion you must bring the wyvern a gift. For many years the wyvern and the harpies battled on the wind for domination over the skies.

Prove yourself an ally to the cub, bring him the most beautiful feather of a harpy's wing. This might prove difficult but understand that if the feather isn't chosen both by fate and your own consciousness you will never be able to appeal to him.

The Windfury Harpies can be found around Mulgore, slay them and bring me back a feather you think will please your cub.
40537.progress: Domination over the sky, my hooves are shaking.
40537.completion:
Gorgeous, just gorgeous.

The Earthmother truly had blessed this harpy with beautiful feathers, a pity her life ended. Yet, as the cycle of life and death continues one must always remember that our actions always lead to a greater purpose.

<Tokala ties the feather in the wyvern cub's hair. The cub eagerly makes its way into your backpack, ready to face the world together with you.>

40538.title: Peculiar Won't Even Cut It
40538.description:
One of our scouting parties took this worg with them. They had to face some whelps, and they claim that some of those are as hard as the very metal we shape and forge. I would never mistrust my clan, <name>. But I will not endanger the scouting party either, they are not cut for this kind of work. I can't even send this worg with you, it is wounded and seems too afraid to return, it must be reshaped.

I urge you to go and find these peculiar dragonlings and bring an end to them. My clansmen say they can be found to the east of the Steppes, where the dark irons that assumed the name of Hateforge have been roaming.

Kill them and find out what kind of trickery these dwarves have been up to.
40538.completion: So they were not real whelps? But constructs made of metal by someone that bothered to put their name on each and every one of them? Convenient for us, we now know who to kill.

40539.title: Hunting Engineer Figgles
40539.description:
Engineer Figgles.

This creature has the ego of Nefarian himself. Who would be arrogant enough to put their own name on everything they've ever created.

Alas, this is in our favor. I am not certain what the dark irons plan with these whelpings but we must definitely stop them.

Although we have nowhere, to begin with, I am certain, that a valiant warrior such as yourself who has earned the respect of my clan will surely be able to find this Figgles.

Go with the worg's swiftness, and may the blood in your veins burn with the rage of a thousand lava pools.
40539.completion:
The Dark Irons have a new quarry? What were they even digging? Not that it matters since you've put an end to it, I must however report to Karfang.

I've managed to collect a few things from the willing clan members that'd see you rewarded for your efforts, but you can only pick one. Such is the way of the Blackrock Clan.

40540.title: An Unusual Find
40540.description: As you walk across the shore, you notice something out of the ordinary. A murloc tadpole, left alone in the reeds. It looks malnourished. You should feed it. It probably likes turtle meat.
40540.completion: You pass the meat to the murloc. Let's see if it really was that hungry.

40541.title: Family Above All
40541.description: The murloc tadpole stares at you, like it still wants something. But what? More food? No, it's impossible. Maybe it got lost and is looking for its parents? You should look on the shore, they must be somewhere around here.
40541.completion: Poor little murloc. The search yielded no results. Maybe the locals would know what happened to the murloc family?

40542.title: Loneliest Murloc in the World
40542.description: If anyone here could know anything about the murloc family, it would be the gryphon riders of Aerie Peak. Maybe they have noticed something unusual during one of their flights? You should ask.
40542.progress: The Aerie Peak welcomes you, outsider.
40542.completion: Weird question, <race>. But to my knowledge, none of my gryphon riders reported murloc presence on the shore. Revantusk, yes, but no murlocs. Are you sure your information is correct?

40543.title: Loneliest Murloc in the World
40543.description: If anyone here could know anything about the murloc family, it would be the Revantusk trolls. Maybe they have noticed something? You should ask.
40543.progress: Katoom be fishin', mon. Be quiet.
40543.completion: Kattom be not seein' any murlocs around here, mon. Da turtles ate dem all. Murlocs be good snack, taste like fish, but betta'.

40544.title: Nat Pagle, Murloc Expert
40544.description:
If ya be wanting to help your little murloc friend, ya better find Nat Pagle. He be the best fishermon in da world. He be legendary among us. Katoom knows dat he be spending a lot of time among murlocs, to learn fishing from dem, mon. He must be knowing somethin'!

Katoom be not knowing where to find Nat Pagle. He traveled to Kalimdor some time ago.
40544.progress: I am Nat Pagle, master fisherman. What can I help you with?
40544.completion:
Murlocs... I have spent months amongst them, trying to learn their fishing techniques. During this time, I learned a lot about their customs and behavior.

Sometimes, I feel like I can understand their language. It creeps me out.

Regardless, when it comes to your little friend, I don't have good news...

40545.title: Nat Pagle, Murloc Expert
40545.description:
So you want to help the little murloc? Valiant effort. We, the Wildhammer, value compassion above all. Unfortunately, I can't help you find his parents.

But I know one person who could.

Nat Pagle. The legendary fisherman. When I last met him, he wanted to learn fishing secrets from murlocs. If you are committed, you could try to find him. Maybe he knows their language? I heard he is now in Kalimdor.
40545.progress: I am Nat Pagle, master fisherman. What can I help you with?
40545.completion:
Murlocs... I have spent months amongst them, trying to learn their fishing techniques. During this time, I learned a lot about their customs and behavior.

Sometimes, I feel like I can understand their language. It creeps me out.

Regardless, when it comes to your little friend, I don't have good news...

40546.title: Small Murloc in a Big Pond
40546.description:
It pains me to tell this, but his parents are probably... ehm, dead. Murlocs, while ferocious and territorial, care deeply for their tadpoles. I have seen them sacrificing themselves so their children could live. Truly, we should appreciate these creatures more.

And one more thing. If you want this little murloc to live, it will need your help. Hinterlands are dangerous. It won't survive on its own.
40546.completion:
The tadpole is waiting for you. You are the only one who can save him now. You will become his new family, his new friend.

But wait, it needs a name. Gurky! Gurky is perfect.

<Gurky hops into your pocket.>

Oh, the adventures you will have together!

40547.title: Small Murloc in a Big Pond
40547.description:
It pains me to tell this, but his parents are probably... ehm, dead. Murlocs, while ferocious and territorial, care deeply for their tadpoles. I have seen them sacrificing themselves so their children could live. Truly, we should appreciate these creatures more.

And one more thing. If you want this little murloc to live, it will need your help. Hinterlands are dangerous. It won't survive on its own.
40547.completion:
The tadpole is waiting for you. You are the only one who can save him now. You will become his new family, his new friend.

But wait, it needs a name. Gurky! Gurky is perfect.

<Gurky hops into your pocket.>

Oh, the adventures you will have together!

40548.title: Report from Falgran
40548.description: Alright, <class>. While you were gone I received a report from Falgran, the scout who I sent to investigate the footprints. He requires your immediate assistance. He set up a camp somewhere close to the border with the Barrens, between Shady Rest and Lost Point.
40548.progress: <name>, right? Thanks for coming so fast.
40548.completion:
I followed the footprints and I found our suspect. I couldn't do much more. I'm just a scout.

That's why you are here.

40549.title: The Quillboar Suspects
40549.description:
So, <name>, the footprints were definitely quillboar hooves. I followed them well into the Barrens, thinking they would lead me to the Kraul. I was wrong. The raiding party actually stopped just outside Bael Modan, which makes your job easier.

Venturing into the Kraul... The mere thought makes me shudder.

Back to the topic. The camp is north of Bael Modan, close to the road. You should have no trouble finding it. Try to sneak in, or kill them all. Doesn't matter to me. What is important - find some evidence, maybe some items that could've been taken from the inn.

And to address the elephant in the room: the orc. He said that he is here to investigate the inn too. I'm keeping an eye on him- I don't trust him. I feel like the Horde is trying to cover up something. Good luck.
40549.progress: Back so soon? The camp is west of here.
40549.completion: You say that their chieftain had this tablet with drawings resembling the burned inn... curious. We will need someone able to read the quillboar scripture.

40550.title: The Goblin Linguist
40550.description: Let's think... If anyone is able to translate this, it would be some goblin. These fellows do trade with everyone, there must be someone who has at least a basic understanding of this language. Could you please take this to Ratchet? I will stay here for now and observe the camp.
40550.completion:
Ah yes, quillboar writing. Very hard to learn, very hard. I can read it, though. Did some business with them a long time ago. Nasty bunch, I tell you.

However, you know how it is here. Everything has a price.

40551.title: A Strangle Favor
40551.description:
While I am busy translating this, you help me. Easy.

I need something from Stranglethorn Vale. I know, it's far, but fortunately, we have a beautiful ship that will take you straight to Booty Bay! Wonderful, isn't it?

I heard about some mining operations being done in the northern region, close to some lake or something. By no other than our competitor, Venture Company. I need you to go there and, ehm, borrow some stuff from them.

Bring me 10 samples of ‘the thing' they are excavating. I heard it's some blue crystals. I think you will be able to find them on their dead bodies. But you didn't hear that from me.
40551.completion:
Hah, good job. I hope you didn't have to dispose of too many Venture Co. workers... And I hope their insurance covers this!

<Sputtervalve laughs.>

Let's get to translating this thing.

40552.title: Back to Falgran
40552.description:
<Sputtervale focuses on the tablet.>

Their writing is not exactly like ours. They just draw some pictures, and you have to interpret it on your own. There are some clues that help you with grasping the meaning but...

You probably aren't interested in quillboar lore, yeah.

So, what I get from this: a band of quillboars wants to attack an inn. They go there with a raiding party, but they find the inn already burned to the ground. Then some angry pictures. I guess they wanted violence.

So, yeah. This is what I got from this, pal.
40552.progress: Were you able to translate the tablet?
40552.completion: So it wasn't them... Unless the quillboars are the masters of deception, we reached a dead end.

40553.title: Suspicious No More
40553.description: Go and report our findings to Captain Vimes. I will stay here for some time, to watch over the inn. I can't leave the orc alone with the evidence. I still don't trust him.
40553.progress: Welcome back, <name>. What did you discover?
40553.completion:
Damn it. If it was the quillboars, it would make it so easy. Shame, but at least we ruled out one of the suspects.

Nevertheless, good work. Finally we got at least a step closer to solving this mystery. Please, take this gold as a reward from lady Jaina herself.

40554.title: The Shield's Owner
40554.description:
I had a talk with one of our scouts. He is, well, responsible for spying on Camp Taurajo, deep in the barrens. And he is certain, and I believe him, that no Taurajo tauren ever wielded this shield.

I tell you about this, because if it was really of Tauren craftsmanship, then the owner of the shield must've lived in the swamp for some time.

I sent our infiltrators to check upon the Brackenwall Village, the horde outpost here for any sign of Taurens. While they are on their mission, I have a request. Gather intel from our watchtowers in the marsh. Maybe our soldiers remember something remarkable.
40554.progress: Were our scouts of any use?
