40554.completion: So this is all we have. Well, it is a lead as good as any other. But what can we do with this information?

40555.title: The Search for the Grave
40555.description:
These Grimtotem have been under our constant observation since they moved into Dustwallow. They are a nasty bunch, but I assure you, if it was them, we would already know. However, if this tauren the scouts spoke of really existed, we could ask about him in Brackenwall Village.

In theory.

Tensions with the Horde are high, and I don't want my men to see us negotiate with them. I had way too many deserters in recent months. You could try to find his grave. The tauren mummify their dead, but since he was the only one here, I doubt the ogres knew about it. Just search for a graveyard, or something like this close to Brackenwall. I doubt you will find anything, but it is the only lead we have.

And let's hope Lieutenant Caldwell returns soon with some information about Reethe.
40555.progress: This grave is big enough to fit a tauren for sure. It's worth investigating.
40555.completion:
In the grave, you find skeletal remains of a tauren. He must've died at least a few years ago.

The grave, however, has been recently dug up and hastily buried with earth. The dirt is still loose, it must've been no longer than a few weeks.

Some equipment is buried with the tauren too. Leather straps, metal coins and pauldrons, and a beautiful, one handed axe.

40556.title: Another Mystery to Solve
40556.description: Who dug up the grave? Why? Did they take the shield from it?

40557.title: The Troubles Ahead
40557.description:
Lieutenant Caldwell still hasn't returned from his mission to find Paval Reethe. I fear the worst. But, alas, we can only wait.

When it comes to our investigation. Well, another dead end.

However, Falgran reported that the horde has been causing some trouble. Please, assist him with this matter. He is where you met him before.
40557.completion: I suspect they might know something...

40558.title: The Meeting with the Enemy
40558.description:
You remember the orc, right? He wants us to talk. He knows something that we don't.

<name>, please remain calm, and try not to provoke them. I know it may be difficult, given our history, but they are much like you and me.

Just perhaps a bit more green.
40558.progress: Back already? What did you learn?
40558.completion:
You met with the Horde unauthorized? This could've provoked a major diplomatic incident!

At least you learned important information.

40559.title: The Betrayal from Within
40559.description:
So the shield really belonged to the tauren from Brackenwall. Good work.

On the other hand, the reported killing of Paval Reethe by our soldiers is troubling. Deeply troubling. I cannot just trust the Horde on this. My role, as a captain, is not only to order, but also to serve.

I'm worried that Lieutenant Caldwell only acted in his self defence. But, if the orc was really speaking the truth, you may find some evidence in Caldwell's belongings. You can find his quarters downstairs. He was sent there with a soldier named Hallan. Check hers, too.

I will prepare the report for Lady Jaina.
40559.progress: Have you found their rooms? They should be downstairs.
40559.completion: This is embarrassing. Especially for me, as a Captain.

40560.title: The Betrayal from Within
40560.description:
So it is true. My soldiers, who I thought unwavering in their loyalty, were deserters. I wonder how many more hide in our midst.

For now, let's review the information: Caldwell and Hallan were deserters. They killed Paval Reethe when he was questioned by the Horde. Did they do it just to spite the Horde, or... Did he know something...

Once again, our findings lead us to the deserters in the swamp. Well, I doubt that we could make them talk. They resent Theramore, perhaps more than they hate the Horde. Any mindless attack on their base will not provide us with answers.

We need to turn to magic. Forbidden magic. If we had something that belonged to Paval Reethe, we could commune with his spirit. It is a dangerous practice that many would consider unethical.

In this case, I feel the ends justify the means, and fortunately, we have his badge. Since he passed recently with unfinished business, his spirit may still be in Azeroth.

Go to the Mage Tower in Theramore and explain the situation to Magus Ha
40560.progress: I studied the Arcane Arts for decades. Yet I always craved... Something more.
40560.completion: The Ritual of Divination. Yes, I am able to perform it. But be wary, <race>. It is extremely dangerous for the spirit, and for the caster.

40561.title: Preparation for Divination
40561.description:
Very well. If it is Captain Vimes' wish... who am I to say no? But, if we are to make the ritual as safe as possible for the spirit and for us, I will need some rare ingredients. Your best bet would be buying them in Dalaran... well, if it still existed.

I have heard rumors that the Kirin Tor is trying to rebuild the magical city, so if you don't mind traveling... Maybe they have some ingredients needed. The rest can be found in these swamps, if you have a keen eye.

I need 1 Arcane Resonator from Dalaran, 3 Lesser Moonstones and 10 Swamp Ooze Ichors. I heard reports of ooze abominations in the south.
40561.completion:
Ah, the Arcane Resonator. I thought this technology to be lost when Archimonde crushed Dalaran. Fortunately, Kirin Tor is tougher than I expected.

Shall we begin?

40562.title: Ritual of Divination
40562.description:
I shall need your help during the ritual. Perhaps we may learn more from the spirit realm.

Let's begin.
40562.progress: I heard terrible noises coming from the Mage Tower. What happened?
40562.completion:
So it was the deserters. Very well, I suspected it, to be honest. These people have no honor. We shall send our best men to deal with them. But before this, I think the Horde should also get an explanation and... an apology.

And when it comes to this Mariner, let me consult with some of my advisors. I think I may have heard of this man before.

40563.title: To Meet Again
40563.description:
Go to Falgran and Kagoro, explain the situation to them, and..

Apologize for us blaming them. We need to make this right, and show our good will.

Perhaps they will forgive us.
40563.progress: Did our people really betray us?
40563.completion:
The deserters. I knew they were vile people, but to burn innocents alive... Light, save the souls of these poor people.

So be it. Kagoro is already around here, we should meet him at once.

40564.title: The Second Meeting
40564.description:
Here we are again, for another meeting with the Horde.

Kagoro has explained some things to me, but we are ready for our meeting.
40564.progress: The Horde have been honest about their investigations, it makes me happy that we disclosed our own information.

40565.title: And Justice for All
40565.description:
It does appear that the Deserters are behind the burning of the inn. If there is ever to be justice, we must stop them from continually dragging more and more of our most loyal into their ranks.

There shall be no quarter, they are wanted and we shall dole out justice, for all of the lives lost. For the deceit caused.

Directly to the west of Theramore, to the north eastern edge of the Quagmire is the Deserter's Hideout, it is there that they gain their strength.

Find Sellick Voss, the new leader of the camp, slay him, and bring his medallion to me as proof of the deed.
40565.completion:
Without you, we would still be in the dark. Who knows? Maybe you stopped another war between the Horde and the Alliance.

You are a hero of Theramore, for all of the work you have done to ease these tensions and solve this mystery. For this, I would like you to take one of these weapons from my personal armory.

Concerning the Vengeful Mariner: Sailors coming to Theramore have reported seeing a shadowy figure stalking the coast. A question does remain: why was this figure so important to the deserters?

I would not lose sleep. This is not a mystery for us to worry about, or another investigation to be launched. Let them keep their mariner in whatever grave he occupies.

40566.title: Sleep Paralysis
40566.description:
Excuse me, <class>!

<The lady seems to force a smile, but her eyes betray a deep fury.>

You look the gallant sort, the sort to help a poor damsel, yes? I find myself in need of some rather... odd substances. They may even be dangerous to acquire, but looking at you – I think you can certainly handle it. I will even pay some decent coin for your troubles!

I need some poison. But not just any poison. There are spiders in a cave somewhere East of here, that have a very painful bite, even causing brief paralysis. If you could collect for me a few vials of their venom, I would be eternally grateful! Surely you aren't afraid of a few little arachnids, no?

And what do you mean, why? Are you truly asking a lady her personal business?
40566.progress: Have you got what I need, or are you just being nosy?
40566.completion: Oh perfect, thank you! This should teach him a lesson. here's your silver, now shoo!

40567.title: Sleepwalking at Day
40567.description:
Oh, I can't do this.

<She sighs loudly and massages her eyes.>

My fiancé is dog-tired all the time, disappears randomly during the night, and recently I found long black hair on his clothes.

I just can't figure out how he could do this to me! But I must be certain. Please, <class>, can you go look into this for me? Before I do anything rash. I can't even bear to speak to him, never mind go back to our old bedroom. Just find out his damned side of things, and tell me what lies he speaks. Any extra evidence you can find would be good too, I suppose.

<She screws her face up tightly.> He's probably avoiding me and pretending to be useful, chopping wood by the lumber mill. Bert Mano is his name.
40567.completion: Poison? Wow, this complicates things greatly. We may need to take a more direct approach.

40568.title: Daydreaming at Night
40568.description:
Okay, okay, I know it looks bad. But Bert has been suffering with sleep paralysis of a very interesting kind, you see. The poor soul has something, and I have my suspicions what, reaching out to him during his dreams. I was skeptical too, until I witnessed it myself while observing him slumber.

I am sure it is a demon! The peasants have countless stories of this sort of thing, but it's the first time I've gotten irrefutable evidence of it happening! Regardless, my studies must be put on hold, if his marriage and, if you are correct, his life may be in danger.

This demon must be either expelled or brought into the physical plane, then killed. Unfortunately, I have very little idea how to do so directly.

But I know who does. I made contact with a shady fellow in Stormwind. He conducts his business from a cabal hidden away in the basement of a tavern there. I do not know which one unfortunately. His name is Gakin the Darkbinder.

Please, hurry, <class>. Bert isn't a perfect man, but he doesn't deserve thi
40568.completion:
From Hawk's Vigil? What a juicy predicament indeed!

<He trails off into a quiet, throaty laughter.>

40569.title: Sweet Dreams are Made of This
40569.description:
Okay then, your first task for me. What, you thought I would do this for free? No, no no! Oh by fel no. In any normal circumstance I would have you killed for stumbling down here, but it just so happens, I need some materials myself, and some of these will also be required to solve your. Predicament.

A connection to the void will be required, plus some sort of tonic that elicits lucid dreaming to bring forth this night-demon of yours, and banish it. My colleagues have whispered about a certain location that may just do the trick!

<He smirks wickedly.>

Fire Scar Shrine. Name ring a bell? I doubt it. You can find it in Ashenvale, south west of Astranaar. There are foul beasts dwelling there, dog-like, ravenous and demonic. I need you to go there, kill them, and bring me their hearts. I will need one for you, but I never, ever work for free. Make it ten.
40569.completion: Well well, look at those beautifully tainted hearts. Perfect. You have done me a great service today, <race>. Here... When you feel strong enough, take one of my special creations, a token of thanks.

40570.title: Back to Reality
40570.description: You know what? You've actually impressed me, <race>. I will consider your payment complete. Take this pendant back with you. It has a powerful tether which will draw demonic energies into our world. Needless to say it is HIGHLY forbidden, so do not show it to anyone but the one who sent you here.
40570.progress: You have returned! What news do you bring?
40570.completion: This? This will do what I think it will, yes? Then I think I have one more thing to ask of you, <class>.

40571.title: Strange Bedfellows
40571.description:
This is it. If you have any friends who can work discreetly, I suggest you contact them now.

The energy will be strongest either around Bert himself or where he sleeps. Hold out the pendant and see if it reacts. Hopefully, this will give you the opportunity to confront this demon and put an end to the torment.

You should probably take some evidence of its existence once you kill it, too, you know. So he can prove his situation and resolve the troubles with his fiance.
40571.progress: I haven't slept a wink. Not only with this damn evil presence, but my wife kicked me out the house too!
40571.completion:
By the light, what is that! This is what tormented me for months? I... I think I remember those eyes, yes.

As much as it pains me to do so, I must show this to Rose. There is no other way to prove what she means to me, that I would never do what she thinks I did!

And your name, friend? Ah, thank you <name>.

40572.title: Aid Kagoro
40572.description:
Kagoro had just left to investigate the hoofprints. He should be scouting the road to the Southern Barrens. A scout like no other, that orc, for many days has he tried to be worthy of a surname.

His actions will one day speak, and when that day comes he will earn his honor. I hold high respect for Kagoro, <race>, but I believe he will be in need of your help if you were willing to offer it.
40572.completion: Krog says you were the one to find the hoofprints. You have a keen eye, I'm more than willing to accept your aid.

40573.title: On a Boar's Trail
40573.description:
Krog's suspicions were founded, he was right to believe the quilboar may have had something to do with the burning of the inn.

Before you arrived, so did I. I followed a track, or should I say smell towards a pack of quilboar, they donned the colour of war and were headed towards the Razorfen Kraul, their main den.

Luckily for us, they have stopped in their trails close to it, conveniently near the road.

Your task will be to extract information from them, if any. Although I highly trust my tracking skills, I find my brute force lacking. Judge me if you must, but see the deed done.

And the human... He is here to investigate, too. Better leave him alone, for now.
40573.completion:
This isn't much <name>, but we'll make do.

Something seems to be scribbled on this tablet, you said you found it on one of them?

40574.title: Someone With A Pig's Tongue
40574.description:
I'm afraid I can't make anything out of these symbols, we must find someone who knows this type of speech and who would be willing to aid us.

<Kagoro ponders for a moment.>

I hear the Tauren of Camp Taurajo recently captured a quilboar, perhaps he's willing to hold a conversation. Nothing to lose after all, he's a prisoner, force him if he's not willing.

40575.title: Willing to Serve
40575.description:
You need Mangletooth to translate you a <snort> tablet?

Mangletooth will do so for a special treat! <snort> Mangletooth craves for basilisk eyes, down in Thousand Needles you will find <snort> Saltstone Basilisks, at the Shimmering Flats!

Bring about <snort> 20 of them and Mangletooth translates, favor for a <snort> favor!
40575.progress: Mangletooth could <snort>. really <snort.> <snort.> REALLY enjoy some <snort.> eyes right now.
40575.completion:
Mangletooth happy, give Mangletooth eyes!

<Mangletooth snorts loudly as he munches the eyes with gluttony, a real pig in your eyes.>

40576.title: A Glutton's Honesty
40576.description:
<Snorts happily.>

A feast! A feast for Mangletooth! Now about that <snort.> tablet. It was meant to <snort.> reach the leader of the Kraul as report that the quilboar did indeed <snort.> wish to attack the inn but when they reached it, it was already <snort.> burnt!

Not sure which <snort.> inn they are talking about <snort.>, but seems like you do.

Mangletooth happy to <snort.> help, the Tauren are really nice to Mangletooth.

Even this cage is <snort.> now open, but I choose to <snort.> stay.
40576.completion: This makes no sense, <name>, the quilboar were a good lead but it only sent us to a dead end.

40577.title: Behind the Hoofprints
40577.description:
I'll keep looking around the ruins, meanwhile you should go back to Krog, and inform him of our findings.

There's simply nothing more we can do here <name>. As little as it may mean, you have my appreciation for the help, Lok'tar.
40577.completion:
From frog in the well to frog in the ocean it is then. It would've been so easy if the quilboar had done it, but the ancestors test us still.

It is time to evaluate the evidence we have and look to the other leads perhaps.

40578.title: Dragging It Back To Brackenwall
40578.description:
No matter how many times I may look at it, <race>, I simply can't recall to whom I've sold or for whom I've forged this.

The sole thing I can say is it was meant for a Tauren to bear. The size, the grip, it feels natural in the hands of a Tauren. You have my sincere apologies but this is all I can offer.

Tell Krog to take good care of his armor, farewell.
40578.completion:
Another dead end.

<Krog ponders for a moment.>

Dead end. Exactly!

40579.title: Memory of An Ogre
40579.description:
I remember Do'gol speaking of a friend of his, a Tauren to be more precise. He said the Tauren befriended the ogres during the siege of Theramore, quite always mentioning how much of an unstoppable shield he was.

I wonder, Do'gol, as many ogres, may be a bit slow, if we were to jog up his memory about this Tauren perhaps we can find out if the Tauren itself was the shield or that he carried a shield.

I have this feeling <name>.
40579.completion: You again? Need something fixed, I fix it good.

40580.title: Mighty Wattapo, the Wall
40580.description:
Tauren friend? What Tauren friend.

Found anything about shield yet? Wait.

<Do'gol is trying very hard to think for a second.>

Tauren, shield, large shield. Wattapo!

Yes, yes. Tauren friend name was Wattapo, we call him the Wall. Great warrior with big shield! He died, his shield buried with him. Grave out at the back of the village, under tent, you can find him there.
40580.progress: The grave was dug out, you can see a Tauren skeleton but no shield.
40580.completion: As you look around, you are able to identify some footprints. This grave was clearly tampered with.

40581.title: Mysterious Shield No More
40581.description: You're saying this Tauren was supposed to be buried with his shield and there was no actual shield? I knew I had a weird feeling about this. This could only mean one thing and one thing only, someone came to rob our graveyard, for something that would incriminate the Horde if placed in the burned inn.

40582.title: Tedious Diplomacy
40582.description:
I'm more than certain this was meant to brew turmoil between us and Theramore, however I am not sure why. While you were out trying to figure out the shield part of the mystery, Kagoro has kept company with a scout from Theramore.

I'll send you to meet with them, so Kagoro can share what information we gathered. For all that we know we're all simply trying to get to the bottom of this, without any more bloodshed between the factions.

If they sniffed around the inn, they probably know what killed their soldiers in self defence, when we were questioning Reethe. Or at the least, they are wondering what happened to them. We need to explain the situation, it is important.

<Krog Grunts.>

Ah, one more thing. Our goblin allies at Mudsprocket have sent me a message, they believe that the Black Dragonflight could have something to do with the burning of the inn. It makes sense, to be fair, we will check this later.
40582.progress:
I have spoken with the Alliance representative and they have agreed to exchange information, though I fear the news we must deliver.

I hope your diplomacy is better than mine. It's customary to speak in their tongue if you are to call the meeting, but we've only learned some of their language in internment camps. Bah!

Now that I think about it, you don't talk much do you? We're doomed.
40582.completion: I'm afraid that the human won't act rationally when we tell them about the death of their comrades. They will think of us as savages.

40583.title: A Curious Leaf
40583.description: You have found what appears to be a rich lively leaf on the ground. Touching the leaf gives you an odd sensation, there is also no sign of the leaf dessecating. Perhaps the Druid trainer in Bloodhoof Village would know more?
40583.progress: Greetings young <class>, what can I do for you?
40583.completion: By the Spirits?! That is no ordinary leaf. I have only seen a leaf like this during my time as an apprentice in Moonglade. This may be very urgent <class>, and I will need your help.

40584.title: A Dryad in Mulgore
40584.description:
Such leaves do not grow on plants <class>, but on Dryads. Dryads are the children of Cenarius, the one who is said to have originally taught us the way of druidism.

They are kind, gentle, and nurturing under normal circumstances but will become fierce and deadly if their forests or the wild are in danger. Why would a Dryad be here? This is a fresh specimen that was removed from the Dryad very recently so she cannot have gone far.

Please scout the area where you found this leaf and do your best to locate this Dryad.
40584.progress: Oh hello! It's urgent, it's really bad!
40584.completion: Oh? Wait, that is my leaf! Did someone send you to find me? I appreciate it! My name is Melyndella. I have no time to chat though, things are bad! Kaylee was poisoned by Centaurs.

40585.title: A Quest For an Antidote
40585.description: Kaylee and I were coming to Mulgore, for... Stuff! I'll tell you later, but she was poisoned by one of their arrows. It's taking all my concentration and power to slow the poison down and not let her die. Please find someone that can help wherever you came from! I need an antidote!
40585.progress: Hail friend, what is the matter?
40585.completion: You need an antidote for Centaur poison? I'm afraid my last batch was used days ago... Do not despair though, I may still be able to help!

40586.title: One Small Favor
40586.description: I cannot give you a batch, but I can help you prepare it. You can find the herb known as Cottontail out on the plains. Bring me six sprigs of the herb and I will fashion an antidote for you that you can take to your friend.
40586.completion: Well done, <class>. I will now prepare an antidote for you.

40587.title: A Dryad's Gratitude
40587.description: Now, hurry and give the batch to your friend before it is too late. Time is of the essence!
40587.progress: Oh it's you! Did you get it? Did you?
40587.completion: Yay! This is amazing! Stand back, I will heal her to speed up the antidote's effect!

40588.title: The Story of a Dryad
40588.description:
Thank you so much, <name>! I should properly explain why I came. A long time ago, my great grandfather taught the Tauren people the ways of Druidism. These teachings have since been lost but have recently been rediscovered.

My grandfather Remulos even helped the Tauren rejoin the Cenarion Circle. In spite of that though, many Tauren know very little about my people, and we in turn know little of them.

I've come here to live in Mulgore so we can learn about each other. Kaylee is my friend and a druid student. I will help her recover then join you, please return to whoever sent you and inform them that we're coming!
40588.progress: Welcome back young <class>, it has been a while.
40588.completion:
So you have not only earned the friendship of a Dryad, but saved someone in need? We are blessed to have a Dryad living among us, truthfully I am impressed with your deeds.

I will make sure to inform the village and ensure that Melyndella is properly accommodated here. May the ancestors smile upon you, friend!

40589.title: Chasing Sand
40589.description:
We sent out a crew weeks ago to begin doing some studies over the ruins down west and they haven't showed up yet, not even a peep.

The desert is a dangerous place so now rumor is going around they may have met some terrible fate. It is possible I suppose!

What is really important is what we sent out with them. You see, when we trust someone, we usually give them some valuable gear. Something worth a lot of coin, you dig?

I need you to go out there and find that crew, or more importantly, get the Turbo-Scan Filtronomitor from whatever is left!

They should have been down near Eastmoon Ruins, check around there.
40589.progress: That Turbo-Scan Filtronomitor is state of the art, losing that is like losing twenty goblins.
40589.completion:
Oh baby, its still intact, look at this thing, a bit of heat damage, and some sand where it shouldn't be, but its not broken.

You saved us a heaping pile of gold recovering this thing, and that's like giving it to me yourself!

Here, this should make up for the work you did.

40590.title: Golden Glasshide Scales
40590.description:
The desert, such a unique place, I've heard rumors of people perishing from the harsh and brutal sands, the extreme heat, and the lack of water. It kind of reminds me of where I come from aye?

In such a place only the most brutal creatures can survive, one of which has spent its entire life within the sun.

The Glasshide Gazer has a distinctive golden scale that my benefactor wants to get ahold of.

You can find them down in the south roaming the vast desert, collect me twelve of these scales and I will make sure you get paid well.
40590.progress:
Aye, it be hot out there huh?

Any luck with them scales?
40590.completion: Oh, would ye look at these, so bright and shiny, they practically look like golden coins!

40591.title: Favor for Gelwig
40591.description:
Hey, look I appreciate all you did for me with those scales, my higher ups at Shadowfor - Err, back out in the Eastern Kingdoms are going to be very pleased, and that pleases me!

But I just have one more favor to ask for you.

Down to south you'll find a place called Southbreak Shore, it might be tricky, just a bit southeast of the Caverns of Time.

All along that coast are large Coast Striders, massive giants that roam the coast and call it home. Well you see, I need an eyeball from one of them, and I really don't think they'll give it to you, infact they probably will hate you for being there!

So, you go and gather a friend or two, get me an eyeball, and we finish our dealings, aye?
40591.progress: Well I see you're not smashed to a pulp, any luck?
40591.completion:
Would ye look at that? Well, you actually went ahead and did it then aye?

Me and my benefactors appreciate all the work, this has really scratched off the main difficult things I needed.

Well I suppose you earned something, here, take these, they should do you well, with all your adventuring and what not.

40592.title: The Gusting Vortex
40592.description:
This desert holds many secrets and magical properties, much of which is buried deep within the sand. Leaking emanations have begun to stir up the ground into swirling elementals of sand and wind!

At least, that is what I am here to look into anyway!

To get concrete proof I'd like you to find one of the many Gusting Vortex that roam all across Tanaris, kill them, and collect a single collection of Harmonized Sand.

I warn you, Harmonized Sand is rare, and valuable, many brave travelers have died in search of it.

Not all of the Gusting Vortex elementals will be within a harmonized state, so don't give up, and keep looking until you find it!
40592.progress: Have you had any luck in finding that fabled Harmonized Sand?
40592.completion: Oh, would ye look at these, so bright and shiny, they practically look like golden coins!

40593.title: The Old Church of Westfall
40593.description: Upon opening the chest you discover several old, and worn out items, various church tomes and writings with a small out of place letter resting at the top, it looks aged, and written in a shrewn handwritting which reads :

40594.title: The Old Church of Westfall II
40594.description:
You found this at the Westfall Church?

It has been a long time since I have heard anything about that place... another abandoned relic of a potentially bright past. It is a shame what happened there, but it is a story that is much like the rest of the region.

The western side of Westfall was the first to be removed, and there are not many who remain who can give us information. Many of those farmers were either murdered or disappeared into secrecy.

There is someone that I can think of: Baros Alexston. He made something of himself after everything went down and became an Architect in Stormwind City. You can find him in Cathedral Square if you don't mind looking into this matter. Maybe he can give us some details about who ran the church or even what happened to it.
40594.completion: Why, hello there. Are you here to inquire about civil architecture in the city of Stormwind?

40595.title: The Old Church of Westfall III
40595.description:
Oh, so you speak of that old church out in Westfall? It has been a long time since I have been there... an incredibly long time. I must say that I do not believe I will be of much help. Most of what I can remember is the sun beating down on me as I walked there and back.

<Baros Alexston chuckles at the memory.>

The one who ran it was an old fellow, though. He was always quite nice and cheerful. He raised the spirits of many downtrodden farmers back then and helped out where he could.

It's a shame that such a thing could happen to an honorable man. If you're looking for information, your best bet would probably be the Cathedral here in the city. Find Bishop Farthing. He might have an idea.
40595.completion: Why, hello there. Is there anything that I can help you with, <race>?

40596.title: The Old Church of Westfall IV
40596.description:
A priest from Westfall, huh? Well, that is certainly familiar. There was only one church there, and I recall him having had all sorts of trouble from brigands to thugs who threatened to end his life. The Light can be testing at times, but no one should go through something like that.

He spent some time here in the Cathedral of Light before he moved on to Northshire Abbey. He helps out around there from time to time and goes by the name Brother Neals.
40596.completion:
Oh, that is why you are here.

It's been a long time since my Westfall days, but hopefully I can be of help.

40597.title: The Old Church of Westfall V
40597.description:
So, you're here about the Old Church in Westfall, huh? Well, it's been a while since anyone has asked about such a thing. The Cathedral inquired what happened, but nothing ended up coming of it.

The crooks got away with what they did, and so I decided I would just retire to some peaceful corner, only to hear that they are now here in Northshire as well.

<Brother Neals lets out a soft sigh.>

I'll go over what happened when you're ready; it might be a bit.
40597.completion: So, do you see what has happened, and who is behind it all now?

40598.title: The Old Church of Westfall VI
40598.description:
Now that you've heard my story you can understand what has happened. If anyone is responsible for shutting down the church and the murder of the Easton Family, my suspicions lay toward Carver Molsen. He inherited that farmstead and was always greedy for more, even going so far as to join the Defias.

Hopefully my information is relevant for you. Perhaps you can bring it to Gryan Stoutmantle. He is in charge of the People's Militia there.
40598.completion: So, you’ve found the priest who led the church. Has he said anything about what happened?

40599.title: The Old Church of Westfall VII
40599.description:
Carver Molsen.

That is a familiar name. He leads various gangs and crews of thugs in the region. If the rumors and word from Brother Neals are correct, then he is no doubt in possession of the missing deeds for both the Molsen and Easton plots.

There is an insider within Stormwind named Larry Ryder who has given us some information on the Defias. Perhaps he knows information on how to find this Carver Molsen.

You can find him in Stormwind, usually skulking about the Pig and Whistle in Old Town.
40599.completion: So, what... you want information? It won't come easy.

40600.title: The Old Church of Westfall VIII
40600.description:
Oh, I know who you're looking for. Rowdy type... wants more than he has.

You know what I'm talking about.

If you want information then I'm going to need help. You do a favor for me, I do a favor for you, understood? I have a few contacts that are looking for a somewhat rare poison that comes from Greater Tarantula Venom. You can find it from those Greater Tarantulas out in Redridge Mountains.

Go there, get me seven, and come back. Easy right? So don't take that long. I don't like waiting.
40600.progress: Have you got the Venom yet? My contacts won't be happy waiting around.
40600.completion:
Well, would you look at that, you survived the trip, most people around here don't really want to collect venom from giant spiders.

Either way, you did good by me, so I'll do good by you.

40601.title: The Old Church of Westfall IX
40601.description:
So, who was this about, Marven Horsen? Larsen Wormen?

<Larry lets a crass smirk rest on his face.>

Carver Molsen, he certainly is a character, hangs around that old farmstead, goes by the name 'The Dead Acre' these days, used to be called the Easton Fields.

You got what you needed, now go on, and tell who you need to.

40602.title: The Old Church of Westfall X
40602.description:
It is time for justice to be dealt. For the murder of the Easton family, and the disruption of peace in Westfall, Carver Molsen shall not be spared any mercy in these lands.

Bring some good news to the remaining people of Westfall, and travel to the Dead Acre, just to the south east. Kill him, and recover the Deed of Easton Fields, the Deed of Molsen Farm, and the Westfall Church Key.

With him gone, there may yet be hope for a future in these lands.
40602.progress: Has he been brought to justice, <name>?
40602.completion:
You have brought justice to the Eastons, and have removed a dangerous criminal from our lands, for that we cannot be more grateful.

With these deeds there is hope we may resettle the land once the Defias threat is removed. Let us hope such a future comes soon, <name>.

For your efforts I have prepared some items, they should serve you well.

40603.title: The Old Church of Westfall XI
40603.description:
There is one last thing I ask of you in regards to the matter of the Old Westfall Church. Brother Neals is responsible for much of the information we have discovered, I have prepared a letter to be sent to him.

I have also included the Westfall Church Key, when this land is restored to order, I would think of one no better to return it to working order.

Head to Northshire Abbey, and bring it to him with my letter.
40603.progress: So, what news comes from Westfall?
40603.completion:
<Brother Neals reads the letter, his face easing, and an expression of relief washes over him.>

It feels good to know justice has been met out to that ruffian, for all the misery he has caused.

I am just happy that my information was able to assist and bring justice to that lawless land.

<Brother Neals takes the Westfall Church Key, tucking it into a pocket of his robe carefully.>

40604.title: Digsite Deterioration
40604.description:
I was sent here to get an estimate of the damage done, and it looks to be beyond salvage. The troggs have gone and smashed much of the track, rail and work that was done within that valley. If I am to send a report back I hope to atleast show some sign that it is recoverable, maybe that is where you can come in.

The trogg infestation needs to be dealt with before the real work can be done, head just past this tunnel 'ere, and clean them out, do some real good skullthumping, and return to me, aye?
40604.completion:
Why, you managed to thin their numbers aye?

Impressive work, more then I expected even. Now I can get to work with gathering my report.

40605.title: The Redbrand Archive
40605.description:
The Redbrand Digsite was a location of both mining and archelogy, many of their records and achievements are recorded in a book named the Redbrand Archive.

I was primarily sent here to recover that book, and return it to Torwyn Redbrand back in Ironforge. If you could do me a favor, and gather that for me, it would mean a lot while I remain and clean up this mess. It should be located within the main building of the digsite, gather it, and bring it to Torwyn, you can find him at the Mystic Ward near the Redbrand Estate.
40605.progress: Can I help you with anything <class>?
40605.completion:
Why, this is the Archive from our digsite in the Badlands, is it not?

<Torwyn lets out a small chuckle of approval.>

By my beard, we've been looking for this, a chance to log it within our shelves, you've done good work recovering it, you have our gratitude.

40606.title: Lost Secrets of the Witherbark
40606.description:
You again?! I'll forgive your bar tab if you do me a favor. What do you mean, you don't have an open tab?

I suppose I might be mistaken, all of you <class> types look the same to me.

Look, the Witherbarks have developed a secret ritual that produces alchemical products with powerful properties, or so the tale goes. I've got to get ahold of it - these are vital secrets that could change the whole situation around here! Nobody around here seems to know any details, but perhaps the Elves down by their waterfall have an idea - ask for Lieren's sister, she's usually clever about these sorts of things. Oh, and don't mention this, but would you mind getting this taken care of before the holiday party?
40606.completion:
"Ritual secrets", is that the line that mangy dwarf fed you?

On the other hand, he's been generous with his wares, and I suppose he isn't too terribly looking, either. Perhaps just a little bit of information couldn't hurt.

40607.title: Ritual Secrets of the Witherbark
40607.description:
The Witherbark are descended from our oldest enemies, the Amani Empire, but have since lost even the veneer of civilization. I don't even want hazard what sort of dark practices happen when they cook their ritual secrets in those boiling cauldrons of theirs, but supposedly those concoctions are careful and deliberate. A quaff of their brew serves as anesthetic for their cruel and barbaric rituals; the victim is rendered indistinguishable from a blind drunk for hours, and remembers little afterwards. If you want a copy of this dark formula, you'll have to snatch them from the Witherbark Callers of Shadra'Alor.

Do be careful, will you? You don't seem the type to drink poison deliberately.
40607.progress: I knew plying those elves with some ale would pay off one day! Where did Loania say to get the recipe?
40607.completion:
Up a pyramid, you say? Never would've guessed!

You've done good, but these trolls might as well be doctors for how readable their handwriting is! I'm not even sure if this recipe calls for fresh cherries, or if grenadine will do... heck, we'll just have to try it out both ways!

At any rate, have one on the house!

40608.title: Salvaging the Crops
40608.description:
Weeks it took to fertilize, and toil that ground, and make useable soil, all ruined by a flock of buzzards that swooped down, and ravaged the place for some fresh feed.

Bah, dang dumb buzzards!

There may still be some of the crop harvest left, lucky for us I had just finished bundling it all before those bastards came down and sent me running. Head down the hill toward the farm, kill some to make the rest think twice about freeloading there too long, and gather up 4 bundles of crop harvest, would ye?
40608.progress: We can't take all day now, if you wait too long they might eat it all up.
40608.completion:
Ahh, ye done it!

I be a bit too old to fight them off, it's a good thing you came around.

40609.title: With Us or Against Us
40609.description:
Hah! Who is this puny <race>? You dare speak to Warug?

I spit on your words! You come back after you show strength and allegiance. Kill Gelkis until you are soaked with their blood. Only then will you speak to Warug.
40609.completion: You are red. Is that Gelkis blood? You smell of death. Perhaps you can speak with Warug after all.

40610.title: Fighting the Pack
40610.description:
You want me to sing your name to the tribe? Then excite me. Fight against the scariest creatures of Mashan'she.

Best fights are with multiple enemies! To the death! Seek the Bonepaw of the north. They hunt in packs. They rip apart their foes. They pull organs out of bellies and fight over your scraps when you fall.

<She swishes her tail and paces with her hooves in excitement while thinking about it.>
40610.progress: You are still alive, then you have not done as I asked.
40610.completion: You have bested them, very good. But they were wasting away, weak. You have more yet to fight.

40611.title: The Blood of Lizards
40611.description:
There is something else that excites me. Fighting when the enemy is so much larger than you! Hah! The satisfaction when they fall!

If you do as I ask, then seek the giant lizards to the north. You can see some from Magram Village even! They will leave you a charred corpse trampled underfoot.
40611.completion: Scouts say they see you bringing down mighty lizards. I am impressed. But there are bigger ones out there yet.

40612.title: Earning Respect
40612.description: You have done strong deeds already. Continue to prove yourself to me, to us! When we talk your name at our campfires, I will tell you of the greatest challenges we set to mightiest Magram.
40612.completion: You have the heart of a Magram. It is a shame you were not born with four hooves, hah!

40613.title: The Forbidden Arts
40613.description:
There was a time when we would do anything for power. Shamans, dark arts, rituals and sacrifices. But when we rejected the protections of Theradras, we also rejected many weak magics!

<She growls deeply.>

We are Magram! We are strong! We do not need tricks, we do not need mothering! We smash what we can smash and burn what we cannot. See the burning forests north! Puny elven lands are proof!

We cast out those who would not drop dark arts. But they threaten us with risen dead thanks to our foolish mercy at not killing our own. Find our outcast sisters nearby. Show them no mercy, for we never should have to them.
40613.progress: You have done as I asked? Yes? No?
40613.completion: And did you laugh as you cut them down, <name>?

40614.title: Almaudrak
40614.description:
<name>, it is good you are here this day. Come, sit, listen.

When we returned from the northern mountain forests, we were glorious, high spirits, sharing stories of our kills! But many of us did not make it back to village. Something vengeful sought us out...

We named the beast Almaudrak. He is a bringer of death. He circles the dark skies still. Rarely do I tell anyone of Almaudrak. Many think he is legend. Whoever seeks him out is never seen again. But I know his lair. It is far to the north, near the path to the mountain forests, near ruined elven tower.

If you wish to be a true name among us. Find and kill Almaudrak.
40614.completion: I cannot believe my eyes. This is his heart. It is bigger than my head! You are always welcome now, in Magram Village. I will tell of your tales!

40615.title: Fear Incarnate
40615.description:
There is but one more thing in these lands I dare not tell of the tribes, <name>.

Magram would never claim to be scared of anything! We are strong! We are the rightful conquerors of Mashan'she! But... even we do not war with demons to the west. Foul magic, fire, death and decay.

<She tenses her hands into fists for a long moment.>

There is something I have seen there. Giant, green fire, pure anger and destruction. I do not believe anything could bring it down. I respect you already, <name>, and you are liked among us. If you wish to become legend... find and kill Baelfyr.
40615.progress: You do not need to do this, <name>.
40615.completion: <She lets out an ear piercing war-cry at the sight of the infernal's head.>

40616.title: One of Us
40616.description:
You are a hero among our tribe. When we crush our enemies underhoof, you will be at our side, yes?

<She lets out another loud war cry, and for a moment, something approaching a smile appears on her savage face.>

Go! Speak to true Khan! He has heard of your victories. It is time to join us, <name>.
40616.completion: From now, you are <name> the Fearless! Walk among us with pride. We share with you, now.

40617.title: The Maraudine Front
40617.description:
The Maraudine are the strongest in the region, and could pose a more significant threat if their leadership ever had the desire to spread influence.

They hold our most sacred site, Maraudon as home, for this alone, they should be wiped off the map.

If you truly wish to become an ally of the Magram, then you will need to prove yourself. Gather ten Maraudine Bracers, and bring them to me as proof of your loyalty.
40617.progress: Ride into battle with swiftness, it is the only way to victory.
40617.completion:
You have checked their arrogance, and weakened their position, this is good.

I will spread word of your accomplishments outsider.

40618.title: Raiding The Lesser Tribes
40618.description:
Desolace is filled with the weak, those that should be culled so the strong can rise to dominate. I speak of the lesser tribes that hide in our mighty shadow, those that tremble in fear of our wrath.

The lesser tribes of the Gelkis and Kolkar need to be raided, and reminded of their place, and you will enact our fury.

Travel to the Kolkar Village to the north, cut down their battle lords. To the west, head to Gelkis Village, slaughter their stampers, earthcallers, and windchasers.

Make sure they learn their place in the natural order.
40618.progress: Unleash our dominance upon the lands, trample them to dust!
40618.completion:
It is only a matter of time until the Magram rise to their destiny.

Your actions are worthy of praise, and I will let the others know of your deeds.

40619.title: The War for Food
40619.progress:
If we've learned anything in our campaign of war, it is that food is more important even than the deadliest of weapons. Without energy, one cannot fight. In such a desolate landscape with such scarcity, we are far from achieving our true ambitions. I ask that you remedy this situation.

All across Desolace you will find the mighty kodo, full of thick, heavy, abundant meat. It would make for the perfect meal for any warrior. Ride out and collect this Heavy Kodo Meat for the Magram clan. Do not disappoint me.
40619.completion:
Did you have trouble downing such a large beast?

<Warcaller Dekshar smirks at you.>

This food will fill the stomachs of our warriors, and they shall regard you with newfound respect for your contributions to our efforts.

40620.title: Picking a Side
40620.description:
You are not Gelkis. You are not even centaur at all. Leave now!

We have no reason to speak. Little will prove your friendship or worth to me. Except perhaps the conquering of the Magram, hah!

I am wise enough to know you would never wage war on our behalf, and you are not even strong enough to do so anyway.
40620.progress: Did I not tell you to leave?

40621.title: Meeting an Elder Centaur
40621.description:
Perhaps there is more to you than meets the eye, <race>. You have shown yourself willing to be an enemy of the Magram, but that does not make you a friend of the Gelkis.

But, you may be in time. That is not for me to decide. In the tents nearby, seek out the oldest among us. He has even more stories to his name than I do. His name is Yesu'gei.
40621.completion: You are the one the scouts spoke of, hmm? The one who slaughtered Magram?

40622.title: Sympathy for the Dead
40622.description:
You may think that a death is simply a death, <race>. But that would be a foolish thought, a foolish thought indeed. To die in glorious combat, received back into the earth, this is a good death.

Hmm, I remember friends, good Gelkis, falling down as they trotted, poisoned by stings from Scorpashi. I have seen those laid to rest, picked apart by giant carrion birds. This is disgraceful, and I will not have it happen to any more of my tribe.

Prove yourself useful. Go out and kill as many of these creatures to the north as you can find.
40622.progress: Have you avenged those disrespected Gelkis?
40622.completion: This brings me some solace, <race>, and I am sure the fallen would cheer if they could.

40623.title: Troubling Winds
40623.description:
It is a mistake to ignore nature. We, Gelkis, can learn a lot from a troubling breeze, a red sky, a lightning air.

Hmm. Recently the land has been scoured, even the rocks themselves, by roving air elementals. I cannot tell why they are so agitated! Ignoring their presence is a danger to us, and also ignoring omens of things to come.

Disperse any that you see, <race>, and bring me their cores. We may give these to our shamans, and we may learn from them. We will bolster our magic directly with the elements!
40623.completion: These are far lighter than I imagined, hmm.

40624.title: Protecting the Weak
40624.description:
You have done well so far, but there are bigger predators yet that must be felled. To the north there are the remains of mighty kodo. Majestic creatures, and in death they nourish the earth with their bodies. However, they have made the carrion birds greedy, and they attack weakened centaur too.

Go. Kill the venomous creatures you find, and any carrion birds that may threaten Gelkis Village. You will earn my respect if you do this.
40624.progress: Have you brought some protection to the village yet?
40624.completion: I am beginning to like you, hmm.

40625.title: A Friend of the Tribe
40625.description:
Hmm. One day, you may walk among us as an esteemed visitor, <race>. You should be thankful some of our kind already respect you.

When we think you have helped us enough to be truly accepted, I will have further words with you. There are some matters that I cannot entrust with many in the tribe, let alone an outsider.

<He continues rambling quietly to himself for some time after his business with you is finished.>
40625.completion:
What is your name, <race>? <name>? Very well... You have earned our trust enough.

Listen to what I have to say next...

40626.title: Contempt for Necromancy
40626.description:
Our mother, Theradras, provides and protects even in this harsh land, <name>. Perhaps you do not fully understand it. But know one thing: she cannot abide those who desecrate the dead.

The Gelkis would never stoop to such dark magic as to manipulate the dead for strength and personal benefit. The thought alone is enough to make my hooves itch.

<He shakes himself and a few grey hairs fall to the ground.>

Hmm, I do not know which of the tribes have been practicing necromancy, but recently there have been sightings of centaur doing just that to the East. Do not bother trying to converse... simply remove their wretched lives from their bodies. And make it slow, if you can, a merciful death is too good for those who deny souls their proper rest.
40626.completion: Do not feel any remorse, this goes far beyond a petty tribal war. I imagine any sane centaur would have wanted them dead.

40627.title: Unforgotten and Unforgiven
40627.description:
I do not believe in coincidences, I do not. Hmm... I firmly believe in our desecration of the Northern vales, the centaur provoked a being of vengeance to menace us. Do you know of what I speak? Hopefully not, if you had seen or heard him, you would likely not be alive.

I hardly expect you to do this, <name>, but if you are equally brave and foolish, then seek Almaudrak to the north, just before the path opens to the fiery woodland vale. The winged horror stalks the road and makes nest in the western mountains.

You will truly be an honored name amongst the Gelkis if you can bring me his heart.
40627.progress: I do not blame you for not wanting to seek him out.
40627.completion: Hmm, you are a special sort, <name>. This heart will make a fantastic feast, and all will know you were the one to provide the Gelkis their strength this night!

40628.title: The Raging Oceans Blue
40628.description:
I have kept one bit of information from all the tribe, save the Khan himself, <name>. Even Uthek, for all her wisdom, I do not trust to not act rashly upon this.

While we do not fish much, the seas provide life and nourishment to surrounding creatures... which we may in turn eat. We rely on her as much as the land, this suffering land, despite what others may think. Which is what it pains me to say, something has angered the elements of the deeps too. I can feel it, <name>.

I sense, far to the north, where the mountains overlook the sea. There is something roiling, raging, ready to enact vengeance for the suffering land, or perhaps some transgressions I am not aware of. This is something we cannot ignore, and it will panic the Gelkis if it becomes common knowledge! Our village is not miles from the sea after all. We are not great swimmers.

Find a way to quell this being, and I promise, you will become an honored visitor in this village. Perhaps more.
40628.progress: Dare I ask if you have news?
40628.completion: That! That is a core! Is it over? Yes... I can feel peace dawning once more...

40629.title: An Honorary Gelkis
40629.description:
I may be respected for my age, <name>, but I cannot offer the proper thanks you deserve. Khan Shaka, our leader, wishes to meet with you directly now. He never meets with outsiders so this must be important.

He is communing with the earthen spirits within the cave at the centre of our village. Do not delay. And, <name>? I am glad you came and listened to this old centaur.

<He retires to his tent with a loud sigh, old bones creaking the entire way.>
40629.progress: I am unsure how to speak to outsider.
40629.completion: You are Gelkis now. <name> the Earthstrider! Yes! You feel strong, can feel the earth spirits whisper your name? Yes? No? In time.

40630.title: Collapse of the Maraudine
40630.description:
There was a time when the Maraudine were picked from the most loyal of the tribes, gathered to honor and protect our ancestors at a place of great worship.

Such times are gone, lost to the drifting winds, spat upon, and dishonored.

The Maraudine are now just a glorified tribe who have claimed the Valley of Spears as their own, they do not respect Maraudon as a holy place as it once was. We are not allowed to visit the tombs of ancestors, or pay respect to the fallen.

They are our enemy, and they must be destroyed. Travel to the Valley of Spears to the north, and slay them, bring me 10 of their bracers as proof.
40630.completion:
To think, there was a time that being Maraudine was an honor, something to strive for.

These bracers once meant the world, and now, they only anger me. I thank you for the work, I will spread word of your valiant deeds.

40631.title: In Commune With Wind
40631.description:
We Gelkis are unlike many of the other tribes in that our connection with the elements is powerful and deeply entrenched in our culture. It is a connection we value above all else in this world. Yet our irreverence and brutish abuse of this gift in the past has strained our relationship with the spirits.

If we are to make a future for our clan and repair the damage we have caused to our spiritual strength, we must commune with the elements and plead our case and offer deference to them. To this end, we will need a great deal of elemental energy.

All around this region are swirling vortexes of wind and air. From them, I would have you gather 12 Elemental Air.
40631.progress:
We Gelkis are unlike many of the other tribes in that our connection with the elements is powerful and deeply entrenched in our culture. It is a connection we value above all else in this world. Yet our irreverenc and ebrutish abuse of this gift in the past has strained our relationship with the spirits.

If we are to make a future for our clan and repair the damage we have caused to our spiritual strength, we must commune with the elements and plead our case and offer deference to them. To this end, we will need a great deal of elemental energy.

All around this region are swirling vortexes of wind and air. From them, I would have you gather 12 Elemental Air.
40631.completion:
I see you have returned from chasing the storms, at last. Did the spirits prove to be as torrid and unforgiving as the rest of this land?

You have done us a great service, <name>, I will make sure that these materials go to good use.

40632.title: Our Mortal Enemies
40632.description:
Long has it been since the Magram and Gelkis fought, warred for territory. We have been on the defensive for far too long, fighting back raiding parties that thrusted into our lands, and killed our kin.

It is about time we did our best to fight them back, and cull their ranks to end this bloodthirsty aggression.

I would have you fight on our behalf, to rid us of our enemies so that we may find a higher calling.

Magram Village is located to the east, travel there, and slay them.
40632.progress: Has the dust settled? Have our foes been weakened?
40632.completion:
We may yet survive this conflict, and we may yet remove our mortal enemy from this world.

Your efforts have not gone without notice <name>.

40633.title: Enter the Village
40633.description: You start to impress me, <race>. If you want name to be more known amongst the tribe, walk into our village. Find Jochi, smartest and most beautiful Magram! She will task you.
40633.completion: <name>, very well... I hear you are stained with the blood of Gelkis. Perhaps I have use of you.

40634.title: To Fix A Shredder or Two
40634.description:
THIS. WAS. NOT. IN. MY. CONTRACT.

Un-freakin'-believable!

I had to crawl through the savannah and this dusty red rock to get here and find out there's nothing to work with?!

Klazfit welcomed me with: "Deal with it, kid. You got a job to do kid." Son of a leper gnome!

Don't tell him I said that. This is fine, it's okay, everything's fine. This is -NOT- fine!

Listen up chum, you gotta do something. Blacksand Oil Fields, lots of spare parts laying about, the Venture Co. classic. Bring me as many as you can carry and you'll get paid handsomely.
40634.progress: How am I supposed to fix not one but -TWO- shredders with no parts?!?
40634.completion:
Bummer, I actually gotta work now.

Yeah, yeah, here's your pay.

40635.title: Gnomes Were Always A Leper
40635.description:
Hey, how you doing chum?

I'm really positive you're here for work but I smell an amateur when I see one. My gut tells me you're more brawn than brain and I got the perfect deal for you, friend.

So listen up.

Rumors say the good ol' gnome city got boomed with green, and it wasn't even us goblins, can you imagine that? Idiots called us suicidal but they gone and done that. Calling themselves leper gnomes now, they were always a leper if you ask me.

What's even funnier is that they're now employed by the Venture Co.! Undermine ain't what it used to be, sounds like.

Long story short, go show those idiots who the superior green is and bring me back those coils. Hear that? Coils. C-O-I-L-S.
40635.completion:
Never thought you had it in you kid.

Sheesh, is that someone's gut? Ugh, working with amateurs.

Take the coin and get out of my sight.

40636.title: Blacken Their Eyes
40636.description:
I'm the law around here bub. Dis the law and you dis me, dis me and I have my boys turn you into gunpowder for our bomb, got it?

Good.

Since you're already here, I got a business proposition for you. You get to smack some lizards, peace still stands, everybody wins eh?

Now listen, leaving the pure comedy aside, we got some real issues with the basilisks around here. Why? Well because they can fit a goblin in their mouth bub, that's why.

All you gotta do is go out there and kill some of them! Just some, gotta leave something for my boys too, right.

Simple bread to earn, simple!
40636.progress:
I saw some poor kid getting eaten by one of those things yesterday.

Horrifying sight, funny, but horrifying.
40636.completion:
You made sure to leave some for my boys right?

One of the basilisks spit these after eating some of our townsfolk. Just take one.

40637.title: Earth Rumble
40637.description:
Great job with them lizards bub! Left enough for my boys to have fun too. Eh, to be honest, some got eaten. But they had fun! Right? Don't look at me like that kid, I'm a great boss! Do you think I got this job because I rubbed someone the good way?

Oof, can't take back those words. Still! New job handpicked just for you my uh very capable comrade, yes, comrade.

The very explosive nature of the Venture Co. seems to have woken up some very very angry earth elementals or something. Salrog was spouting some orcish spiritual nonsense.

You go deal with them and I pay you, best deal you'll get in Powder Town! That is if the town is still standing when you return.

Blasted Venture Co., it was clearly them, right? Not the tests we've been performing with the bombs, right?
40637.progress: So, has the ground settled yet?
40637.completion:
Great work kid, knew you were the perfect idi- man for the job!

Remember when I said some of my boys died? Well, you can have some of their stuff I guess.

40638.title: Blasting Stonetalon!
40638.description:
Busy day in the port, kid. Always is, since the day our big boss, the Warchief, gave us his blessing to make our home in this dusty place. No complaints here, o'course. We're just trying to get by and earn our keep after all.

Speaking of which, I've sent an expedition to the Stonetalon Mountains. Our horned friends, the Tauren, told us of a place where we can freely field-test our engineering experiments. My most trusted man, Nazz, has been given the task to oversee the construction of the BIGGEST bomb to ever exist.

This is one of two things we can provide to the Horde. The other being the best economics in Kalimdor! Report to Nazz in Powder Town, close to the Charred Vale. See what explosive progress he's made on The Big One, for the Horde!
40638.completion: Nert sends yet another employee to me. Perfect, we need all the hands we can get.

40639.title: Not Useless!
40639.description:
Heya kid, ready to do some actual work?

You'll be under my guidance, if I were you, I'd worry about how large my pockets are because I am about to fill them if you're doing a good enough job.

Backstory time. Notice from yours truly, most of the time the things I am about to say require a tax per sentence for the listener but since you came from Nert himself I am willing to eh, oversee it.

Anyway, where was I, ah yes. I used to be a big shot in Undermine back in my day, there was nobody, and I mean nobody I wouldn't cheat, lie, kill or steal from for my own goals!

<Nash rubs his hands and giggles quietly to himself as your skin begins to crawl.>

Naw, don't worry kid, those days are behind me. I was saying, I and the Venture Co. got history and especially with this idiot they've sent to oversee the oil fields.

Go beat some of these idiots up and see if you can find any info on them.
40639.progress: Hurry it up bub, you wouldn't want me to finish sharpening this dagger.
40639.completion:
Not, I repeat: NOT USELESS. Do you hear that you blasted maggots?

<Nazz shouts for the whole town to hear.>

I SAY IT AGAIN, NOT USELESS! UNLIKE THE LOT OF YOU.

40640.title: Nazz's Got A Plan
40640.description:
<Nazz reads the documents you brought him.>

Hoo boy, the Undermine at its finest.

I remember those days. There is nothing worse than Goblin nature, <name>. The ones above will always work the other lot to death. And the other lot? They’re trying to be the whip bearers rather than being whipped. Nothing worse, ain’t NOTHING, NOTHING WORSE.

This is why the Union is a much better deal, most of us live equally, more or less. The Goblin nature applies here too, but in different ways and measures. Anyway, I got a plan.

I need you to do what you do best, go out there, kill stuff, and bring the stuff back for money. Easy. Easy.
40640.completion: Great job kid, you deliver yet again!

40641.title: Grand Theft Shredder
40641.description:
All right, shrink ray is done.

You're probably wondering why we need a damn shrink ray to kill that doofus Higgle, right? Well, we don't. Call this a pet project of mine. You're gonna go back into those fields, find the B-33 Shredder and beat it around a couple of times. Once the pilot is dead, it should automatically begin shrinking, just pick it up!

Do. NOT. DAMAGE. IT

Just wanted to make clear, after you beat it up real good, you'll use the shrink ray, pocket it up, and come back to me. While you cause this commotion, I have a friend of mine finding the location of their boss.
40641.progress: Remember this! It won't stay shrunk for a long time, so hurry it up!
40641.completion:
Quick take it out and place it on the ground.

<Nash grins.>

Finally got my own shredder.

40642.title: Lighting the Oilmaster
40642.description:
Right. While you were gone a friend of mine discovered the location of Higgle. And before you say it, yes, he's at the top of the stupid building. I had a hunch too, don't be a smartass about it.

Higgle reminds me of our dark past bub, his stupid bossing around should end here. But, I know I am sending you on a pure suicide mission, you don't have to do it if you don't want to do it. But after all you've done, I am more than sure you will.

Kid, I'm proud I got an employee such as you. Stay on your toes, during your many, many trips to the oil fields they should be very alert right now. Humor this old Goblin, after Higgle's blood is spilled spare any who mean no harm, perhaps some of them will see reason and simply leave or seek a home in the union.

Whatever your choice might be, do this one last job for me.
40642.progress: Goblin on Goblin, I wonder if this is also in our nature, <name>.

40643.title: A Rat Among Them
40643.description:
KABOOM!

Oh, sorry to startle you bub. What's up? Here to see the BOMB, right. Man, I tell you, this puppy got the power of the sun in it! For real, that's what Nash said and Nash is always saying the truth!

Speaking of true things. One of the bruisers said there's a kobold among the Venture Co and he's their Overseer. Can you imagine that? A kobold, the Overseer.

<Blammo laughs hysterically>

I need to see this with my own eyes, but I can't leave the bomb! Say, won't you go kill that guy if he's real and bring me his candle?
40643.completion:
You took it! You took the candle! He was real.

KABOOOOOOOM

Sorry about that, my excitement is as explosive as this bomb.

40644.title: Siphoning Oil
40644.description:
Not sure what these guys are planning to do here but they're missing a great thing.

Oil. Funny isn't it? The Venture Co. are here for oil and they are clearly salvaging it. Someone should tell them that they're also salvaging it for us.

Someone, someone who will be paid handsomely if he won't ask any dumb questions should go and thank them for it while also grabbing what actually is owned by Powder Town.

Got all that or do I gotta draw it for you?

I need 6 barrels.
40644.progress: I hope your back holds kid.
40644.completion: Ah so someone did go and collect, great, great, this should turn a good profit.

40645.title: Favouring the Drunk
40645.description:
Huh?

What do you want, ugly? Want a piece of Gig, EH?

Come here! Why you little, don't dodge!

<Gig falls on his face.>

Huh? Where in the blazes am I, and who are you? More importantly, got anything to drink? Ah, screw you then pal. Can't a goblin catch a break every now and then? I got some great important news for the law in this town if I were to be offered a cold one.
40645.completion: Oy! Oh, ale? Cheapskate. Meh, thanks, kid.

40646.title: Least Paranoid Goblin
40646.description:
<hic> ... listen up kid, I hear stuff. A lot of stuff <hic>, people ignore ol' Gig because he's an alc- alco- because he drinks too much! But I drink and I know stuff, get it? Anyway, I was outside the inn yesterday drinking and I heard one of them two boys talking about sabotaging the bomb and blowing us all up!

It's the golden honest truth my friend, go tell Mort, he should do something about <hic> it!

<Gig falls on his face.>

Oy, what you looking at bub, you want a piece of the champ?
40646.completion:
Sheesh Gig, not again. Sorry about that kid, Gig's a special sort. Great when he's sober, but he hasn't been sober once ever since we came here. His paranoia took over. Nobody's blowing us up, don't worry about nothing.

Here's something for the trouble.

Golddammit Gig.

40647.title: Knowledge on Withering
40647.description:
Shadow welcomes you, <name>. My name is Artemus and I've traveled long and far from Hillsbrad Foothills to do business with the Goblins of Powder Town. They are very unique to call them so. Madmen that would do anything for their goals and even for someone of my condition, this is very exciting!

I used to study herbology in Dalaran when I was younger, regretfully I was nowhere near my home when the plague struck and there we have it. I won't bore you with a soapy story of how I came to be undead and how much I hate myself or whatever others say. I'm quite happy with my condition, I finally have the time to experience and learn everything I want to.

I have traveled all this way to continue my studies, more specifically in decay. The local ancients in the Charred Vale have become withered, and tortured.

Bring me one of their Decaying Roots, it shall prove useful.
40647.progress: Have you found their twisted forms?
40647.completion:
These will do perfectly!

You have my appreciation, this will surely be very useful.

40648.title: Roses are Red, Dragons are Blue...
40648.description:
<The small whelpling flutters his wings and tries to escape as you approach.>

No! No hurt!

<It pauses and looks up with wide eyes.>

No ogre. No dark dwarf. You good? You help? Yes? Please! Up ramp. Family, brood family. Mind control! Tyrant. Cave. Teleport, crystal, cave! Jewel control. Jewel mind control, jewel mind control!

<It hops up and down in a panic.>

Kill! Get jewel! Asza reward. Asza reward!
40648.completion:
<The whelpling flaps its wings excitedly and bounces around.>

Hero! Hero <class>! You not kill many brood family? No? Only tyrant?

40649.title: The Shadowforge Menace
40649.description:
Well met, <race>. I have a mission to test your skills, and prove your mettle to the Kargath Expeditionary Force. Make no mistake, your performance will make itself known to not just us, but our brothers in Orgrimmar as well.

So. Assuming you won't flee with your tail between your legs, head to the dwarven fortress to the north east. You will notice it jutting out of the land like a boil, ready to be lanced. Decimate the denizens there. Return when you have slain the bulk of their forces.
40649.completion: Well done, I have not expected you back so soon, or back at all in fact.

40650.title: The Shadowforge Captain
40650.description:
Have you seen a chicken with its head cut off, <race>? It runs around, aimless, panicking, before finally dropping dead. When you head to Angor Fortress, to the north east, strike deep into it. Go for the one who organises them, and the rest who survive will be just as aimless as the beheaded bird.

Barlgruf is his name. He will not be alone, nor will he be accommodating, so strike first and strike hard. Return to me when he lies in a puddle of his own blood.
40650.progress: Is it done? Is he dead? Or must I find someone more competent to carry out the task?
40650.completion: Yes, I heard from my scouts the commotion over there. Well done indeed, the Dark Iron Dwarves shall not recover from this wound quickly.

40651.title: A Heart of Stone
40651.description:
I get really tired sometimes of working on rocks, you know? And then, something comes along that really blows your socks off! Quite literally sometimes when it comes to engineering, but...

<He coughs awkwardly and wipes the sweat from his brow.>

Listen! The dwarves in Angor Fortress? They have begun automating their golem protectors recently. I don't know exactly how they do it! I witnessed one zapping the chest of the big statue and it came to life right there and then! Can you believe it?

I need that zap-o-matic thermojigger, or whatever it is! Find it, please, and bring me a few of their hearts to play with while you're at it, yes?
40651.progress: Have you had any success? I can't wait to tinker with those hearts!
40651.completion: Oh my word they are heavy! How did you carry them all this way? Well done, well done indeed!

40652.title: Eyes on the Prize
40652.description:
Ah, a moment of your time please, <name>?

Yes, yes, I know who you are. I was planning on discussing this issue with Senator Redstone, since he appears to have a passing interest in the goings on in the Badlands. But since you have fortuitously come to me, perhaps you will listen to my request.

My brother is part of an expeditionary party down there, you see. A prospector, but he has his mind set on ridiculous fairy tales and is chasing legends. He has lost sight of what is important! There is much wealth and knowledge to be gained from scratching the surface of the earth, never mind delving into its depths.

Seek out the digsites in the northern part of the Badlands. Beware, I think the Dark Iron Dwarves are excavating there and are unlikely to enjoy onlookers. Come back when you have a nice collection of artefacts.

Oh, and <name>? If you can't pick them up from the ground, feel free to take them directly from their hands.
40652.completion: What beautifully dull looking objects. This is all you found...? Hmm... very well.

40653.title: Digging a Little Deeper
40653.description:
<He massages his temples and looks awfully exasperated.>

Frankly, I was not sure I had to spell it out so clearly. I want the best of the relics here. The real findings from the digsites. Not old pieces of pottery and... whatever these are. Go back to that digsite. Find their leader, for he will surely preside over the more prestigious treasures. Take, steal, whatever you have to do, to bring back something actually worthwhile to me.

Just do be careful, I hear the lead archaeologist there is a rather powerful spellcaster. I am sure that is no trouble for one of your stature though, correct <name>?
40653.progress: <He barely looks at you as you approach.>
40653.completion: Ah, now that is more like it! Did you have to kill... actually, no, let us not discuss that here. Perhaps over an ale later on? Hmm? Or do you prefer rum?

40654.title: Glittering like Gold
40654.description:
The coin is much larger than any coin you have seen before, and quite a bit heavier. It appears to have someone's head engraved in the surface, but is too covered in muck and dust to be made out clearly.

Rubbing some dust off the surface, the material seems to get shinier and shinier. Is this gold?
40654.progress: Hmm? What are you coming to me with this time, <name>?
40654.completion:
<His eyes widen and he quickly fishes into his pockets, extending out a handful of golden coins.>

Take them. A good find, a good find indeed.

<He begins to beckon to the surrounding guards. This seems to be an offer you can't refuse...>

40655.title: Scaling the Ridge
40655.description:
I am sure it goes without saying, I have no great love for little young creatures. I have nothing but contempt for humans, for example, and their little pets.

<He sneers beneath his mask.>

But I have recently been made aware of an encampment in Lethlor Ravine, and the skinned corpses of countless whelplings thrown into the sun to rot. The Dark Iron Dwarves once again. Now, why would anyone set up a guarded camp to slaughter whelplings and drakes, if not to harvest something important? I do not particularly care what they hope to achieve, but if we strike now before they are more fortified, we will cut off this venture at the knees.

Find this base of operations, and slay the dwarves you find within.
40655.progress: Has the camp been torn apart yet?
40655.completion: Hmm, this encampment sounds like it is being built more quickly than I anticipated. Perhaps this is urgent indeed.

40656.title: Bane of Scalebane
40656.description:
Perhaps I should apologise for not being as informed as I would have liked. Had I known how established this camp already was, I would have tasked an assassination of their leader.

Actually, perhaps you are ardent for blood and glory. Head back into that camp, find their leader, and kill him. Not a complicated task, but one that may be more dangerous than before. He will surely be prepared for this, given your previous efforts.
40656.completion: Excellent work indeed, <name>. I will ensure your name is glorified for your grisly work, here.

40657.title: Scalebane Ridge
40657.description:
<He throws up his hand to halt your approach.>

That is close enough. And speak quietly, lest you irk us with your prattle of adventure and questing...

Actually, I do have a request. Scalebane Ridge, heard of it? No? Lethlor Ravine, then? No? The Badlands? You are a truly a dense one...

I need you to find the encampment known as Scalebane Ridge. It is a new base of operations for the Dark Iron Dwarves in that area, and their hunting of the whelplings in the area gives me a very bad feeling about what they could be used for. In any case, better safe than sorry. Head over there, and slaughter their hunters.
40657.completion: Ah, yes, a suitable conclusion to a necessary task.

40658.title: The Head of the Hunters
40658.description:
Before you run off like a fool, I have one more task to add. This Scalebane Ridge, it has not cropped up out of nowhere. I would bet my large fortunes that there is a lieutenant of some sort leading the operations.

I want him dead. Certainly taking him out of the picture will impede all the work that goes on there, hopefully indefinitely. I trust you have a few friends that may help you with such a task? Good, go. I will compensate you appropriately.
40658.progress: This had better be good news, or I'm calling the guards.
40658.completion: Somewhat impressive, though I suppose it speaks of your general demeanor that I was rather expecting failure. Here. Take these coins.

40659.title: A Razor's Edge
40659.description: The knife embeds itself into the palm at the slightest press. Truly this could cut through almost any living tissue, but the handle is awkward and heavy.
