Holding it up, the sun glints across the pristine surface. Perhaps someone interested in survival techniques could make use of this beauty.
40659.progress: Hail, adventurer! I see you are a capable... hmm? What do you want?
40659.completion: Oh my, oh my! No, this isn't a survival knife, this is a skinning knife. It's obvious, see, hold it like this and… there you go. Perfectly crafted that is, not sure I've seen anything like it before. Hold onto it, I suspect it will serve you well.

40660.title: Controlling Sailors
40660.description:
The life of a Petty Officer is much akin to herding sheep. I am in charge of keeping my men in control, and while that is easy on a ship, when docked in Stormwind it can be -very- difficult to have my attention on all of them at once.

They are spread around the city, sight-seeing, and no doubt getting quite drunk.

I could use a favor, if you don't mind. There are three sailors that I know of in the city, Hylreth, Brewen, and Pardol. Find them, and find out what exactly it is they are up to, just make sure they are not in any trouble is all, for my sake.
40660.completion:
Hmm, well, that is not all bad, some fighting will certainly need to be discussed with the Admiral, but otherwise I expected much worse...

Here, take this silver, as trouble for running around the city.

40661.title: A Sailor's Love
40661.description:
Oh, it has been a long, long time since I have been in the city of Stormwind, what seems like a life in itself!

Around three years ago I traveled to this city with the fleet on other business and met a rather charming, and mysterious woman named 'Charys Yserian'. Never since has a woman left such an enchanting impression upon me, and I feel as though I am squandering my time stuck here on the coast with menial jobs unable to see her.

I ask of you to help, mainlander, it will be a few days until I get some free time, and I would like to make an impression... If she can remember me.

Travel to the florist Bernard Gump, he runs a shop called 'Fragrant Flowers' in the canals between Old Town and Trade District, buy a Red Rose and deliver it to Charys, word has it she runs a shop in the Mage Quarter now.
40661.completion:
A rose? Why, isn't this something else..

From the Sailor Borus?

<The woman would let out a soft snicker, smirking openly.>

I remember the name, and that Kul Tiran man well, I never assumed him such a romantic.

40662.title: Charys' Response
40662.description:
Who would suspect a Kul Tiran sailor to show so much affection? Those that many call crass, blunt, and overly loud at that.

He has surprised me, in a rather nice way; to be remembered after such a long time really is a compliment.

Here, I prepared a letter for him, and - just - for him. Do not think to pry it open, my magic will know if you do.

<She gives a wicked stare, and lets out a laugh to ease her feigned threat.>

Take it to the sailor, and let him know his actions are appreciated.
40662.completion:
<Sailor Borus would let out a loud, and heavy sigh of relief.>

I can't thank you enough for this, so much time spent worrying, at the least I was able to finally do something!

Here, for the cost of the rose, I forgot, and some bit extra for doing this on my behalf.

40663.title: Embassy Blues
40663.description:
All this time stationed around and yet we hardly have any ale to tide over the boredom.

Say mainlander, you must have freedom to walk the streets of the city without a job looming over your head, how about a favor?

We are currently busy with tasks during the day, but we could use some loosening up during the night, if you catch my drift.

Head into the city, it should be ripe with ale, find me 3 Flasks of Port, that should do quite well.
40663.progress:
So, you find the port...?

Like the ale.
40663.completion:
Ahh, this is the good stuff.

Well, from one sailor to, whatever you are mainlander, thanks a bunch.

40664.title: Protecting Aerie Peak
40664.description:
We live in harmony here with nature, to let our gryphon's grow strong and roam wild.

I have seen to watching our borders and have noticed the stunning growth of the Silvermane population. The wolves have become more and more aggresive as their territory expands and now they are at our doorstep more often than ever before.

We will need to cull their numbers, lest they begin to strike at us or kill our roaming gryphon. You can find the Silvermane wolves all across the Hinterlands, bring me fourteen of their pelts as proof.
40664.completion: You've done well, your work will certainly go a long way in halting their aggresion and lowering the chances of any potential hostile run-ins. The Wildhammer thank you for the effort.

40665.title: The Second Wave
40665.description:
War is upon our lands, <class>.

The arrogant Kul Tirans think us weak and it is up to the brave sons and daughters of the Horde to teach them otherwise!

A second wave of their old fleet, the same we vanquished years ago, has landed just off our shores, posing a threat to our people.

On the southern edge of the Echo Isles, their scouts and commandos can be found, probing and plotting for their next move. Slay them in the name of the Horde, and return to me!
40665.progress: Throw them back into the waves. Let the sea churn red with their blood.
40665.completion: You have done well, but do not yet sing for victory: Our foe is as vicious as it is relentless.

40666.title: Expedition Supplies
40666.description:
Only shortly ago, we learned that not all of Daelin Proudmoore's lieutenants were slain in the War for Durotar. We were expecting their return, but we did not think they'd be so well-armed.

All wars are fought on supplies, however, and there is no doubt they are stretched thin so far from their homeland.

Search their camps on the southern rims of the Echo Isles and pillage their stocks — they may be forced to leave before ever setting foot near Orgrimmar.
40666.completion:
Proudmoore thought us ill-made mongrels, unthinking and mad with bloodlust.

But true warfare requires strategic acuity as much as it requires a sharp edge and strong guts.

You have done well, <name>. We have defeated the Kul Tirans once, we shall defeat them again.

40667.title: The Warchief's Orders
40667.description:
You have made glorious battle upon our enemies, <name>.

The Horde honors those who bear our banner so proudly. For your might, I bestow upon you this commendation. Wear it well, for your next task will take you to our great Orgrimmar.

In the Valley of Wisdom, our Warchief waits for tidings of the ongoing Kul Tiran conflict. Tell him all you have done and all you have learned.
40667.progress: Lok-regar no'gal, <race>. I bid you welcome.
40667.completion:
I see you carry Dar'nakk's commendation. I've never known him to grant such accolades freely.

You did well in defending our coasts, and for that the Horde owes you its gratitude.

40668.title: The Balance of Power
40668.description:
It has been a long time since we did battle with the Kul Tiran's in such a manner. Tiragarde never really posed such a major threat, but the news coming to my hall is worrying. Lieutenant Alverold is the one who leads their Expedition Fleet, and it is he I wish to direct my attention to. In the past, Admiral Proudmoore was not willing to discuss in terms of diplomacy, and I do not think his loyal Lieutenant will either.

My concern is not with these foreigners, but with the Alliance, for I do not know their standing with Kul Tiras, the last I heard an embassy opened in Stormwind. The last thing we want is an all out war between our factions. I must know more before I directly engage and I would trust you to speak with an agent in Ratchet that goes by the name 'Mally O'Flor', he is a human.
40668.progress: What can I do for you?
40668.completion:
So, he sent you?

I see.

40669.title: A Favor for Mally
40669.description:
So, Thrall sent you huh?

Interesting, I was sent here to replace another, but I never expected to be contacted. The last two before me were never spoken to in regard to anything.

I work for an organization that has deep ties with Stormwind and has its eyes all over the world, so to say.

I will share the information I hold, but I need a favor from you and your kin beforehand. I am here for another purpose, one I need completed in short time, but do not fret, it is within the region.

In the Barrens can be found a very specific type of raptor, Sunscale. Some of our agents have been looking to gather vials of their blood. Three in total for archival purposes.

Gather me those vials, and the information is yours.
40669.completion:
<Mally O'Flor would take careful time analyzing the blood.>

You honor your word, and so I shall honor mine.

40670.title: Information for Thrall
40670.description:
I have stashed away the Vials, and am ready to speak, should you be prepared to listen.

When you are ready, speak with me, and I will tell you what it is I know.
40670.completion:
It is always useful to have information, it helps one not step on their own feet.

Do not forget that <name>.

You've done well, and now we can act without worry.

40671.title: A War Worth Fighting
40671.description:
There are few things I loathe more than needless war, <name>. It might be an irony to you, for the title I bear, but I saw what horrors wake in men and women when ashes and bloodshed are all that is left of their lives.

I led my people to Kalimdor because I wished to give our children a better world to grow into. I believe that world is still within reach: Woe betide anyone that would threaten it!

I have sent envoys to treat peace with Alverold, to make him see sense. Return to Dar'nakk, and if Alverold refuses... it can only be victory or death.
40671.progress: You return, and not a moment too soon.
40671.completion:
I advised the Warchief against the sending of envoys. It was no use with a man like Alverold.

Our men were cowardly assailed under the flag of peace. Those treacherous Kul Tirans tied them to stakes, soaked them in tar and burned them alive on the shore.

Now we hold nothing back, now we put an end to them!

40672.title: Anchor's End
40672.description:
There is an island south of the Echo Isles the pinkskins have come to call Anchor's Edge.

The time for planning and talking is over.

Travel to Anchor's Edge with as many comrades as you can find and kill every Kul Tiran armed with either blade or spell. Take the rest prisoner. That is my command!

GO FORTH FOR THE HORDE, FOR BLOOD AND THUNDER!
40672.progress: Have they been overcome, have they been destroyed?!
40672.completion:
If my duties did not keep me here, I would have gladly joined you in the thrill of battle.

You have delivered the Warchief's reckoning to our enemies. For that, the whole Horde shall sing your praise.

40673.title: Cutting Ranks
40673.description:
If we wish to utterly dismantle the Expedition Fleet, then we must crush the head of the snake: Captains, commanders, officers and other figures of interest. The Shattered Hand Clan was kind enough to provide me with a list of their names.

Go to Anchor's Edge, south of the Echo Isles in southeastern Durotar.

Once you arrive, you must look for and kill Hydromancer Shaleborn and Deckmaster Darkhollow, along with any breathing officer on the isle .

Their whole leadership shall crumble!
40673.progress:
It must be done, their leaders must die. They, more than the luckless footsoldiers they throw at us, are at fault for the persecution of our people.

Do not forget it.
40673.completion:
It is done, then. With their chain of command gone, it might take months for their expedition to re-organize.

We shall not give them such a luxury.

40674.title: Lieutenant Alverold
40674.description:
You have bested their warriors, killed their champions, breached the heart of their stronghold.

Only one deed remains to be done: Alverold himself must follow Daelin Proudmoore to the grave.

He is likely to be hiding in the most fortified structure on Anchor's Edge, guarded by a paladin knight known as Danuvis.

End them both, then return to me with Alverold's head.
40674.progress: I have not forgotten Alverold's heinous pyres. Give him and the last of his expedition what they deserve!
40674.completion:
<Dar'nakk holds the head of Alverold aloft.>

Here you are, pinkskin. Burn in your hell, knowing it was the Horde who vanquished you.

We orcs are here to stay, you make sure you remember that when you bring my regards to Daelin!

<Dar'nakk looks back to you.>

Now, you and I shall have a talk.

40675.title: A Hero's Reward
40675.description:
Your dedication to the Horde and your courage in battle are both beyond question.

You have earned one of the highest honors Orgrimmar can bestow: A Lok'tra shall be composed of your victory at Anchor's Edge, forevermore to be sung by our people in memory of what transpired there.

But that cannot be your only reward.

The Warchief wishes to see you again — he is known to be generous to his loyal warriors.
40675.completion:
I feel sorrow in having to be forced to violence a second time in so few years.

But I feel no shame in ordering the deaths of our enemies when our sovereignty is infringed. A war in the defense of our people is a just war.

Take pride in your bravery, <name>! For I now name you Champion of the Horde and give you this mighty signet as recognition of your triumphs! Bear it with honor!

40676.title: Drowned Love
40676.description:
Greetings! You're a long way from home! Are you looking for me?

I'm Selendra. I'm desperately trying to right the wrongs of the past here in Mashan'she! You do know that is this place's name, yes? Not Desolace, no! That's a horrible name for it, just because the life has been sucked out and... never mind.

Look, there are signs of life, I'm sure of it. I just need someone to help prove it, convince the world that this land is still worth saving, for the flora and fauna that can still survive!

I would like to see how far the life-leeching has gone. Theradras may have stripped life from the land, but what about the seas?

The Kaldorei ruins of Ethel Rethor are mostly underwater now. But there used to be beautiful blooms of Alor'el, the lovers' leaf, which grew there. They can survive underwater though, <race>! This is known! Please, search the sunken depths and bring me back some of those flowers as proof, if they still exist.
40676.completion:
<She swishes her fawn tail and small flowers drop from her hair in her visible excitement>

Oh, fantastic, simply fantastic!

40677.title: Lofty Heights
40677.description:
I have one more test to prove my theory, and redirect some attention here from the Cenarion Circle!

If the loss of life did not reach far out to sea, perhaps it did not reach far into the mountains either?

There is a beautiful bloom native to here, Mashan'she Silversage. It grows high up, but where there is a sea breeze too. I would start on the northwestern shore, <race>. Search whichever hills and mountains you can climb, and try to find some of those blooms! It matters so much to me, I would be eternally grateful.
40677.progress: Yes? Yes? Do you have it?
40677.completion: Fantastic! Oh, I could kiss you! You probably… wouldn't like that though, right? Right. Oh, Thank you so much! I will report this immediately to the Circle.

40678.title: Health and Safety, mon
40678.description:
Why do you think I fish, mon? It's a lot calmer and less dangerous than fighting... that's for sure.

Now, recently I've been getting my fishing rods stolen by Drysnaps, huge they are! And they can rip an arm off if you're not careful...

This isn't what I need in my mornings, mon. If you be killin' them for me, you'd be doing myself and the village a big service.
40678.progress: Have you made the seas safer for me, mon?
40678.completion: Ah, I watched you killin' them from the pier!

40679.title: Reunite Tribe-Tribe!
40679.description:
Mosshide was once strong tribe, ruled strong, was strong!

No longer, mosshide fight with no purpose, bicker, fight-fight. I was once Mosshide pack leader, then they kick me out, send me away! I here again, but I become leader, I reunite tribe-tribe, you help yes? Bring me Mosshide Armband from gnolls, twelve, yes yes!
40679.completion: Gowlfang is rightful leader, Gowlfang strong, you help Gowlfang!

40680.title: The One Alpha
40680.description:
Many alpha Mosshide run many smaller groups, these groups fight eachother, and cause problem-problem.

These Mosshide leader must be killed so that Gowlfang can rule! You can find alpha Mosshide to the west near place called Saltspray Glen, go there, track alpha, kill Alpha! After, only one alpha left, Gowlfang!
40680.progress: They killed-killed? You slay alpha for Gowlfang?
40680.completion: Gowlfang is one true alpha, Gowlfang lead-lead soon!

40681.title: Cursed Sagepaw!
40681.description:
Cursed Sagepaw, he was one who exiled me, sent me away, let me rot in small goblin town called Sparkwater, now I come back, and I get last laugh-laugh!

<Gowlfang cackles wickedly and begins to snarl.>

You find Sagepaw, you kill-kill him, kill-kill Sagepaw good!

When Sagepaw dead, no one stand between me and lead-lead Mosshide, me become strong!

You find Sagepaw south, near big waterfall, go and kill-kill!
40681.completion: Gowlfang happy, you kill enemy, Gowlfang now able to lead!

40682.title: Raptor Ridge
40682.description:
My job keep gnolls safe, I defend, I fight, and I watch-watch!

Long ago raptor almost made Mosshide extinct, now raptor growing in number, many raptor nearby, could be end of Mosshide tribe if not careful, Dagdag can not fight against that.

Raptor Ridge is where they breed-breed, they are strong there, but maybe you stronger?

Travel east to Raptor Ridge, and fight Razormaw raptors, bring me Razormaw Talon as proof you kill-kill to keep us safe, yes?
40682.progress: Razormaw strong, they kill-kill quick, you must be quick-quick too!
40682.completion: Razormaw no match for <name>, you strong-strong, and quick-quick, one day Dagdag be like you.

40683.title: Dragonkin Annoyance!
40683.description:
Always problem-problem for Mosshide, first with Raptor, now with dragon! Every day-day more and more dragon whelps roam the countryside, so many that it is hard to properly walk the land without worrying about dragon fire!

Bogpaw need valuable herb-herb, and many of my good spots are now crowded with dragon!

Go kill whelp-whelp for Bogpaw, let Bogpaw get good spot again. You find dragon whelp to southeast, now go-go!
40683.completion: Bogpaw Truthsay thank you for work-work, less dragon means more good spot for herb!

40684.title: A Pandaren Brewmaster
40684.description:
Hello <race>, Have you heard? A Pandaren, one of the most reclusive races, has been seen in Ratchet.

The merchants say he is celebrating a festival native to his homeland. If you have some free time perhaps you could go and see this Pandaren and what this festival is about.
40684.completion: Hail to you friend, I am Chen Stomstout, Brewmaster from Pandaria, and perhaps you can aid me with a little something in return for a jolly time!

40685.title: The Return of Stormstout
40685.description:
Lok'tar <race>! Have you heard the news? Chen Stormstout has returned to Kalimdor! Chen Stormstout was integral in the founding and defense of Orgrimmar alongside the likes of Rokhan, Cairne, and Rexxar!

Many are journeying to Ratchet to meet him, perhaps you would be interested as well, rumor is that he is looking for something and may reward whoever assists him.
40685.completion: Hail to you friend, I am Chen Stomstout, Brewmaster from Pandaria, and perhaps you can aid me with a little something in return for a jolly time!

40686.title: A Pandaren Brewmaster
40686.description:
I have come to visit my good friend Drohn, to celebrate the festivities of the Brew festival from my homeland, and to create a new brew.

Drohn has gathered some exotic ingredients that would make for a very interesting and potent brew. Mayhap you would be interested in assisting me too, yes? I would share my newest surprise brew with you in return.

Acquire the following for me, a pinch of Magic Dust, Fourteen Hops, and some Goldthorn Tea. The ingredients can be found around the world so you may have the travel to exotic locations and markets.
40686.progress: Did you get the ingredients? Yes?
40686.completion:
Ah, Wonderful! I shall then prepare something really special for you. These were the final ingredients I needed for the Stormstout Surprise! Go ahead and enjoy it to your heart's content.

Ah this has brought back some good memories of my homeland where many of my people would be competing and collaborating to make the brew of the year. I believe I will go a step further with the festivities here next year and organize something grand, yes? It shall be Pandemonium!

40687.title: Daelin's Brigade
40687.description:
Theramore was founded by many from the nation of Kul Tiras; our leader Jaina even hails from there. Our stance of cautious neutrality with the Horde has caused problems for many of the veterans. These soldiers once saw brothers and sisters die in combat, or had families pass in war.

More and more of our kin stray from Theramore with each day. Either deserting outright or being exiled for overly aggressive and divisive actions in attempts to lead us to conflict.

While I hold respect for those that served I do not tolerate disloyalty. The Deserters have begun to go too far, wearing our tabards, uniforms, and lurking within the swamp.

They must be dealt with before they bring all-out war to us. The Hideout is located directly to the west of Theramore, within the Quagmire. Head there and remove their presence.
40687.progress: Have you find the hideout, and dispatched the turncoats?
40687.completion: You have done well, their actions could have cause chaos for us should their plots and ploys come to fruition. Take these coins, as thanks for us here in Theramore.

40688.title: The Blackhorn Conflict
40688.description:
Weeks ago a patrol of our sentries were attacked by Tauren of the Blackhorn Tribe nearby, it was unwarranted and somewhat unexpected. Of those attacked two were killed and others severely injured, the threat of the Blackhorn have only made us be ever more wary in our actions in Dustwallow.

The leader of the Blackhorn is named Targos Hatewind, a vile a cruel warrior who does not even seek affilation with the Horde.

It is him that must be stopped, you can find him at Blackhorn Village to the north west at the northern edge of Dustwallow Marsh.

Go there, kill his kin, and collect his head.
40688.progress: Each day the Blackhorn are left to their devices is another day more of our patrols may be ambushed.
40688.completion: You have done well, their actions could have sown chaos in the region. Here, take these coins as thanks from us here in Theramore.

40689.title: Theramore Deserters
40689.description:
We have learned that desertion is rife in the ranks of Theramore. Human weakness makes itself clear to see.

But do not take those to be good news, <class>, as those cravens are only quitting their posts to come harry us here.

Already their rabble draws close past the border established by the truce in Dustwallow. We cannot allow them to go any further.

Venture southeast of Brackenwall and punish them. Ensure they think twice about trespassing again.
40689.progress: Have the wretches been dealt with, <class>?
40689.completion: You fight well and kill better, <name>. With you at our side, who knows, we might even conquer Theramore a second time over!

40690.title: Blackhorn Village
40690.description:
The Grimtotem in the region are a spineless, and traitorous bunch. They once spoke with us in talks of unity, and now ambushed and killed a friend of mine in combat within the Quagmire.

They must pay for their insolence, and disrespect. They are led by a craven named Targos Hatewind, it is he that I want dead.

Head northeast to Blackhorn Village, and bring ruin to them, they are enemies of the Horde.
40690.progress: The Grimtotem must be checked, and trampled.
40690.completion:
You ease the blood that boils in my veins, it is good to know such a craven has been removed from the world.

You have my gratitude <race>.

40691.title: A Journey for Vengeance
40691.description:
Stonetalon.

The name brings anger to my core, this is the place my brother died in his fight during the Third War.

While I served in Ironforge he sought glory in these lands, but he did not find what he sought. His tale deserves to be heard, when you are ready, speak with me, and I will recount it.
40691.progress: There is a reason for me being here, beyond all else.
40691.completion:
Now you see why it is I traveled so far?

I will reclaim my families glory.

40692.title: The Battlebeard Legacy
40692.description:
My family's history is stained, our heirlooms lost in time, and our axe in the hands of an orc who slayed my kin.

There is no greater fall for a dwarf, and I must right the wrongs.

I have had some luck in tracking this 'Scartusk', for he is one of the Warsong, lingering in the forest of Ashenvale just beyond the Talondeep Path to the north. Just past Talondeep Path, head westward, to the Ruins of Stardust, it is there he resides, scouting for the enemy.

Bring my family's axe to me, and honor my brother.
40692.progress: Each second that orc breaths is longer that my family remains dishonored.
40692.completion:
<The sight of the axe nearly brings a tear to Grumnir's eyes.>

I cannot believe it, after all of these years, and finally before me again.

You have honored our family beyond belief, and given me justice, and relief.

I will not forget this moment <name>.

40693.title: The Ornate Windshear Gemstone
40693.description:
Have you heard the tale of the Ornate Windshear Gemstone?!

It really is a wonder of prospectin' I tell you what! It is told by rumor that those Venture Co. hooligans up and dug some rare crystal deep beneath Stonetalon, one that glimmered a deep, and shiny red.

You see, I aint out here to see the sights, no, BAH! This place be more ugly than Westfall, and trust me, I been there.

If I want a chance to get out of this hell hole, it lies in that Windshear Gemstone, and I want my hands on it.

What say you make your way down to the Windshear Mine down in the Crag and do ol' Flinthammer a favor huh?

I'll give ye somethin in return, how about that to spice up a deal?
40693.progress: Windshear Gemstone....Oh, what a beauty that'd be aye?
40693.completion:
<Flinthammer's goggles begin to fog up.>

Oh by sweet Ironforge!

That is it, it really is it! I can't believe you went and recovered the thing, good and honest work you did for me.

Here, take these, and some coin on top. Maybe I can find a new place to look for rare crystals now.

All thanks to you of course.

40694.title: The Sputtervalve Conductor
40694.description:
My beauty, trapped in a sea of vultures.

I am a brave dwarf, but if I ever want to fly again, I can't go risking my life now, can I?

You look like someone who knows a thing or two about slaying vultures, and Sputtervalve Conductors. The eyes of Harlek can spot talent when he see's it!

My flying machine is down below, I was doing some repairs before me and farmer Segwar were attacked you see? Sadly I left behind the Sputtervalve Conductor, a rather valuable part that I was trying to get fixed to do some scouting in the perimeter.

I need you to go down to the flight pad, and go get the part for me, do that, and I'll give you a nice drink of ale, good?
40694.progress: Grounded, unable to soar the sky! I lament at such dark times.
40694.completion:
Ahh, now lets see...

<Harlek takes his time, inspecting the part over.>

Blasted, it would appear the part took even more damage during my retreat from the assaulting birds... I will need some specialized equipment if I am to have a chance at getting my turbo-charge beauty back in the sky.

Oh, about that ale, I had one, sorry about that, a troubled mind is a thirsty mind, as they say.

40695.title: The Sputtervalve Fix
40695.description:
Bah, dangnabbit!

I don't have anything to fix this, I suppose I need to find someone who know's a thing or two about marveled engineering on such a delicate part...

<Harlek Vaultshield lets out a chuckle.>

Oh, that's right, I do know! Tansi Sparkfuse is in town... Somewhere, no doubt working on something, find her and see if she can fix the Sputtervalve, would ye?
40695.completion:
Harlek sent you?

<Tansi lets out a sigh.>

This is the fourth time in the past few weeks he has asked for my assistance with parts, that flying machine of his keeps breaking down.

40696.title: The Fixed Sputtervalve Conductor
40696.description:
<Tansi Sparkfuse blinks at the Sputtervalve Conductor.>

Well, that wasn't too hard, all it required was a few wires and some tubing.

Harlek is going to have to owe me for all of these favors I am doing for him.

Take it to him, he should be pleased.
40696.completion:
<Harlek Vaultshield visibly lights up.>

Haha! I am free to fly again, a savant of the skies to soar once more!

Thanks to you and Tansi I am no longer land locked.

Good work <class>.

40697.title: Pursuing Harmony
40697.description:
Our new neighbors certainly are quite an interesting bunch. The dwarves here at Bael Hardul have been quite gracious in their hosting.

I am Maloran, a delegate on behalf of Stonetalon Peak, sent to make sure that the natural order is not disturbed. I will admit I held caution when I first arrived, but thus far, Whitepeak has been fairly respectable.

This has left me to pursue my real purposes. Beneath us to the west the Venture Co. has laid unmarked terror to the fabric of nature, and I wish to see if the local Deepmoss have been affected.

Travel to the west, and gather me a Pristine Deepmoss Brain, I will use it for study.
40697.progress: There is no doubt in my mind that nature is being disturbed.
40697.completion: Why, I must say, you have certainly gone above and beyond what I have asked, this is quite a perfect specimen, and will help me with my work.

40698.title: Conflicting Questions
40698.description:
<A look of displeasure marks Maloran's features>

It would appear my research has proven me correct. Whilst the Deepmoss population is in a state of increased aggressiveness, there is something more, lingering just beneath it all.

I sense corruption of a magical sort, and this finding has left me with more questions than answers.

A friend of mine named Faldan Moonshatter has taken it upon himself to study the corruption of furbolg in Ashenvale. Perhaps he may have some answers as to how such a thing could have happened.

You can find Faldan within Astranaar, at the heart of Ashenvale itself.
40698.completion:
I am once again left with more questions...

<Maloran clutches his jaw, musing to himself in thought.>

More work will be needed to uncover a solution to the problem.

40699.title: A Flickering Flame
40699.description:
Why hello there!

What, shocked to see a gnome so far west? Well, you should be, there isn't many of my kind so far from home.

Or well, what used to be home.

Either way, I'm looking to conduct experiments now that I have some time and space to myself, the first of which requires some flammable, and quite dangerous materials!

Far to the west is a place called The Charred Vale, it is there that roving flame elementals can be found, from them I'd like to acquire something called a 'Flickering Flame'. Get it for me, and I'll make sure you're compensated.
40699.progress: My hands are eager for some practice, have you had any luck?
40699.completion: You honor your word, and so I will honor mine.

40700.title: The Cursed Bramblethorn Pass
40700.description:
Perched above Bael Hardul is the dreaded Bramblethorn Pass, occupied by Quilboar and their haunted kin.

The wayward spirits have cause us all sorts of trouble, and have had us on high alert since we arrived. We could use someone to disperse the spirits to let our limited Mountaineers a chance to rest.

You can find them just to the south west, up the slope, head up there, and deal with them for us.
40700.progress: Have you dealt with the dead <race>?
40700.completion: It eases my mind to know that we may just be a little more safe in our, somewhat isolated position, I thank ye for that.

40701.title: Gorras Thorncrusher
40701.description:
When the dwarves first arrived in Stonetalon and had built Bael Hardul, a mighty Quilboar ruled over Bramblethorn Pass. He was named Gorras Thorncrusher and was quite a formidable enemy.

After many battles with the Quilboar, Gorras was slain, though his indomitable spirit remains, perched overtop of Bramblethorn Pass, still occupying his throne. His hatred for our kind is unmatched, and it is only a matter of time until his soul comes for vengeance. We must put an end to such evil.

Travel again to Bramblethorn Pass, and find Gorras Thorncrusher. Destroy him once and for all.
40701.progress: Gorras Thorncrusher will not cease, and must be dealt with.
40701.completion:
You certainly have eased a troubled mind. Many a stronger dwarf than me fell at the hands of Gorras, and I hoped not to be another.

I thank you for everything you’ve done for us. Take this, as a token of my thanks.

40702.title: Exploring in Peace
40702.description:
My name is Whitepeak, I lead this group of would-be explorers here to Bael Hardul after hearing stories that it still stood. To my surprise it was, workable. There was a lot of clean up, but now that the work is done, it will be a good base of operations.

There is, however a hitch.

The last thing I expected was to have the Venture Co. at our doorstep, that was one detail we did not hear, and now that we are set up they keep moving more, and more people into Windshear Crag. If we ever want to have a chance to explore, do so without constant protection we will need to remove this threat.

Down the hill is Windshear Crag, it is there that the Venture Co. operate, head down, and remove their threat, on my behalf.
40702.progress: Have the Venture Company been removed as a threat?
40702.completion:
By my beard, I must say, this is astounding work.

Hopefully they will get the memo and leave Windshear Crag for good.

40703.title: Bar'thog the Wicked
40703.description:
...I fade, in and out of existence, my spirit is drawn to this world by foul powers, with my kin having much worse of a fate in Westhaven.

During the Third War, Kul Tiras waged war against the Horde, it was the orcish kin who came here, and left this place in ruin. We settled again after this conflict, only for an orcish warlock to bring havoc in his wake..

He goes by the name Bar'thog, his foul, and horrific magic having raised the dead, leaving those who once lived here to shamble and fight on his behalf.

End this curse, and free us from suffering.
40703.progress: I can not rest, while this evil still lurks.
40703.completion: I feel it now, severed from this dreadful link. I am at peace, and for that I thank you.

40704.title: When Opportunity Knocks
40704.description:
Blasted Gizzin, we're going to be extremely late with our delivery, and that means less money. A goblin must always think about the future, and with us stuck here there needs to be some creativity.

Nearby local Earth Elementals are wandering the cliffside, and perhaps there can be some profit made afterall.

My family always said, when opportunity knocks... Whatever that means. Either way big shot- you go, and get some Disturbed Elemental Cuffs, and bring them to me, sounds good yeah?
40704.completion: Immaculate condition, not really sure what they're worth, but, it'll be something. Thanks for the trouble <class>.

40705.title: Back on Track
40705.description:
We're way off schedule, and now we're missing supplies.

One wrong turn and everything turns belly up! Hey wait a second, you look like you can handle a few Quilboar.

We almost walked directly into the dreaded Bramblethorn Pass, luckily for me I realized it when the stinking pigs came running at us! I turned everything around, and big Hork here scared them off, not before they took a bunch of supplies from our wagons though...

If I am to keep my job I need those supplies back, maybe you can help me out.

Head to the north west of here, into Bramblethorn Pass down the road, and gather eight Stolen Crates.
40705.completion: Ahh finally! A chance to pack up and get back on the road, here, take some silver for the effort, you may have saved my job.

40706.title: An Affront to Nature
40706.description:
The devastation caused by the Venture Co. knows no end. Each day, we hear more and more news of the sheer horror they commit against the land.

The balance of nature is a delicate matter, one that must be handled with care.

Yet, the Venture Co. cares little for it. They are driven by greed and their actions are directly responsible for much of the suffering of the lands they inhabit. I've recently received news of their most terrible operation yet.

To the southwest, just north of the Charred Vale, a new passageway into the mountains has been carved out for their latest exploitation of the land.

This path leads to the Blacksand Oil Fields. The land has been ripped asunder, dominated by a large oil platform that oversees the entire operation.

Put an end to their operation, once and for all!
40706.completion:
Your efforts are truly spectacular, without your help, I am not sure how we would have been able to put an end to the Venture Co. within the Blacksand Oil Fields.

I must thank you, and from the bottom of my heart, perhaps we may bring balance to Stonetalon after all.

40707.title: Ending Blacksand
40707.description:
For too long have we druids been merciful towards our enemy, The Venture Company.

They care nothing for the world around them, stubbornly working towards their goals for their own greed. If we are ever to put an end to their callous destruction of the land, then we must match their brutality.

There is too much at stake for us to stand idle, and so I ask that you slay the workers at the Blacksand Oil Fields. Collect their Blacksand Badges as proof of your deeds, cutting down as many of their numbers as you can.

You can find this misbegotten place northwest of the Charred Vale, through a passageway they've cut into the mountains.

Go there and put an end to this madness.
40707.progress: If we do not act decisively, the world will continue to be devastated and exploited for the Venture Company's profits.
40707.completion: They will think twice when placing their hands upon sacred land, we will not stand aside any longer.

40708.title: The Nexus of Dalaran
40708.description:
Greetings <race>, I am Archmage Talyvanah representing Dalaran. As you may be aware, our city suffered much in the third war.

Dalaran is currently still rebuilding but there are reagents we need from the outside world.

Nexus Crystals in particular are essential for high level enchants. If you can get me a sample, you will earn a lot of favor with my nation.
40708.completion:
Well done! I'll let you in on a little secret. We're working on a way to replicate this, the one you got us will be the template.

I will let the Kirin Tor know of your service to the nation. Stay safe, friend.

40709.title: Minor Magical Fortifications
40709.description: Greetings. The Council of Dalaran is currently accepting donations of the magical kind from outside sources. Even though weaker magical essences are more plentiful than other more powerful fonts they are still appreciated. For 3 Greater Mystic Essences I'll put in a good word of your efforts within Dalaran.
40709.progress: Greetings. The Council of Dalaran is currently accepting donations of the magical kind from outside sources. Even though weaker magical essences are more plentiful than other more powerful fonts they are still appreciated. For 3 Greater Mystic Essences I'll put in a good word of your efforts within Dalaran.
40709.completion: Any donation is appreciated, no matter how small.

40710.title: Medium Magical Fortifications
40710.description: Greetings. The Council of Dalaran is currently accepting donations of the magical kind from outside sources. Small Radiant Shards are a quite potent font of power used for many tasks within Dalaran and are always needed. For a Small Radiant Shard I'll put in a good word of your efforts within Dalaran, more than donations of weaker magical essences.
40710.progress: Greetings. The Council of Dalaran is currently accepting donations of the magical kind from outside sources. Small Radiant Shards are a quite potent font of power used for many tasks within Dalaran and are always needed. For a Small Radiant Shard I'll put in a good word of your efforts within Dalaran, more than donations of weaker magical essences.
40710.completion: Nicely done, I'll make sure this is known.

40711.title: Major Magical Fortifications
40711.description: Greetings. The Council of Dalaran is currently accepting donations of the magical kind from outside sources. The innate power of Large Brilliant Shards are only rivaled by the enigmatic Nexus Shards, only found on locations of major interest and acquired from artifacts of great power. For a Large Brilliant Shard I'll put in a good word of your efforts within Dalaran, the most you can get from a single donation.
40711.progress: Greetings. The Council of Dalaran is currently accepting donations of the magical kind from outside sources. The innate power of Large Brilliant Shards are only rivaled by the enigmatic Nexus Shards, only found on locations of major interest and acquired from artifacts of great power. For a Large Brilliant Shard I'll put in a good word of your efforts within Dalaran, the most you can get from a single donation.
40711.completion: I'll personally make sure this is known, Dalaran thanks you for your donation.

40712.title: In Your Own Defense
40712.description:
Well met, you that wanders the lands of my ancestors. As the last keeper of this temple, I welcome you to the temple of Zeth.

Behold the flame of kings, stranger. Gaze into it, perhaps it will tell you of the future as it told me of this day, for I was one of the few to keep their sanity only to wait for this day to come. Understand me, stranger, I do not know your name, and even with sight beyond sight before me stands exactly what you see when you look at me. A ghostly figure with no shape whatsoever, and yet, the fire spoke so many moons ago. Be it fates hand or simple coincidence, you were sent to aid me, and you will do so, either by the kindness of your heart or simple curiosity.

The curse of Zetharia still haunts Corthan, as we speak the spirits are getting ready to strike you, as they do not see you for who you are but a memory of an enemy which has passed a long time ago. If we are to continue our discussion you must make sure to dismiss them.
40712.completion: It may seem cruel of me to ask you to put them to rest, my own people. But fear not stranger, as the sun comes up on the morrow, they too shall rise again.

40713.title: The Land of Kings
40713.description:
This land was once ruled by many kings, each strong enough to contest, and dominate the landscape with a fist of iron, and strength eternal.

To understand what it is I speak, I ask of you to travel to the lost city of Corthan.

To the west, search within the mountains, it is there you will find what is left of what once was. At the very top, amongst the temple, you will find a gong, take this mallet, and ring it to begin the cycle of our end.

I trust you will do what is right.
40713.progress: It is only a matter of time now.
40713.completion:
The cycle has begone, no doubt you have seen an echo of the past before your eyes, the last king, crowned before the temple.

An honor to witness one last time.

40714.title: The Curse of Zetharia
40714.description: Now that you've laid in the effort to begin our salvation I truly owe you an explanation, my friend. A lesson in history if you will. When you are ready, speak with me.
40714.completion: Perhaps now you understand it all.

40715.title: The Last Corthan
40715.description:
To break the curse, Zetharia must meet her end. Although I feel remorse for sending you to end my own daughter, we must be freed and rid of this curse.

...Yet I have no idea where she could be, but I know who will. Buried under these red rocks lays the tomb where our last king yet remains. I pray he has kept his sanity, and that he will know of her location.

March south wanderer, and look for something that I assume will to the naked eye look like a crypt today, it is there you will see the last stand of Corthan.
40715.completion: The Keeper sends our promised salvation. It seems the time has finally come for our curse to be undone.

40716.title: A King's Plea
40716.description:
I am Corthan, last of my name, Marauder-King of a fallen kingdom.

During our last stand, my Keeper told me that even if we are to suffer the curse of undeath a day will come when one from future generations may stumble across us. I suppose he filled your mind with the promise of destiny and fate, but to my eyes, I only see this as a greater coincidence in the grand scheme of all things.

You do not strike me as a hero of legend or some great adventurer, and I am not particularly sure why you'd go to such lengths to aid us. Not that I am against it, and surely I am grateful. I suppose the seed of curiosity was planted and you truly wish to meet Zetharia, the one who could cause all this.

No matter how this turns out, you will be the last living being to ever lay eyes upon me. There is a book within this room, it contains our history. I wish for you to take it, and place it somewhere to be remembered.
40716.progress: <Corthan stares at the parchment you have in your hand.>
40716.completion: I do not know what came to be of the newest generations, but the Keeper once told me that the written word is history's greatest triumph and I wish to be remembered.

40717.title: Undoing the Curse
40717.description:
I feel pride. The fire that had settled before has once again been fueled. It's time for my last order.

<name>, I command you to find Zetharia and end this nightmare. As a last gift to my people, the Lord of the Living Flame has granted me the way to find her.

Far to the south west in these lands and atop the rocks, she lingers, forever searching for new souls to torture. Make sure you succeed, if not she will probably torment your soul for generations, as she did to me and my people.
40717.completion:
The witch is dead, and the curse uplifted. It was by sheer will that I've yet remained to thank you.

I bestow upon you, my crown and blade, may they both serve you well. I will now become an everlasting flame in the lands beyond.

40718.title: Next Course of Action
40718.description:
I'll do the talking since you don't really seem to feel like it. Listen <name>, we don't want a conflict with Theramore, that would mean we spit on our Warchief's honor.

While we're talking, remind yourself of one thing, it is not friendship, but respect we hold for them.
40718.completion: Kagoro? What does he want now? I'm not making him another of those super spyglasses again, just so you know!

40719.title: Exquisite Goblin Engineering
40719.description:
Well, we great goblins here at Mudsprocket have managed to do a little digging. We gathered some of the ash from nearby the burned down inn, and are looking to study it to see if the fire was truly caused by dragons.

To do so, we need some materials, we will need to construct a Gizz-matic Scope, a personal creation of mine to look deep into the ashes properties.

I would also like to gather a Pristine Flame Sac, from the nearby whelps in the region, it will give us good insight into what exactly we are dealing with!
40719.completion: Perfect bub, let's do some investigatin'.

40720.title: Conclusive Evidence
40720.description:
So.. It would appear our sound reasoning was proven incorrect.

This is sometimes quite common for goblin engineering, as much as we hate to admit it. Either way, maybe this helped clear up some things for the investigation.

If I was a gambling goblin, I surely would have placed a wager on those dang dragons. It is a good thing I am not foolish enough to gamble!

Bring this information to Kagoro, surely he has use for it!
40720.completion:
So, is that true?

It clears up one more lead for us, we should bring our evidence forward to the Alliance.

40721.title: Tedious Diplomacy Once More
40721.description:
Theramore, and Falgran have once again requested a meeting. He has returned with new evidence, where we have met a dead end.

Hopefully Falgran found out more than we did, because truthfully we still got nothing.
40721.completion: It seems we know our next course of action.

40722.title: Justice for Dustwallow
40722.description:
Sellick Voss.

I have not heard of the human, but his actions reek of dishonor, and cowardice. He hides deep within an encampment, hidden in the swamp.

<Kagoro grunts his disapproval.>

We must make ourselves useful, to show our might within Dustwallow Marsh. If we have an opportunity to kill Sellick Voss, and bring peace between Horde, and Alliance, we shall.

Gather what friends, or mercenaries are available, and scour the swamp, find Sellick Voss, and bring his Medallion to Krog at Brackenwall Village.
40722.completion:
I wish I could have joined you on the battlefield. It must've been a glorious sight.

I am proud of you, and of Kagoro. You really proved yourselves for the Horde this day. The justice was served, deserters will no longer steal our supplies and war with the Alliance was avoided. It feels like there are only winners.

Well, maybe except the Hyals. Poor family.

As a reward, please, take any one of these weapons. They are sacred to Brackenwall, and deserving of one such as yourself.

40723.title: Honoring Treaties
40723.description:
We have done our part within these swamps, and now we should make things right with the Alliance. Take this Medallion to Falgran Hastil, the scout who was meeting with Kagoro.

He can bring this token back to their leaders, and let them know of our assistance.
40723.completion:
This is..

I...

<Falgran Hastil clears his throat, and nods his head.>

The Alliance thanks you for this action, friend.

40724.title: The Ape Bounty
40724.description:
The Highvale Gorillas have terrorized Tel Co. , attacking our property and sending us all the way back to this here Basecamp. They used to be in the surrounding forests, attacking our walls and fortifications, but as of recently, they returned farther north.

I know they are plotting something.

You look tough kid, maybe you can deal with these banana eating savages. You can find them up north near the Highvale Rise, and around the Derelict Camp, travel there, and get me 12 Highvale Paws from the Gorillas there.
40724.progress: The apes can be a savage bunch, I would be careful out in the wild.
40724.completion: Well, would you look at that, perhaps you're as good as killing apes as O'ggon!

40725.title: The Spitefin Bounty
40725.description:
Ever since our operations have slowed, more and more murlocs have gathered to the beaches. These murlocs are posing a direct threat to the Basecamp and making it harder to venture out.

If we ever want to establish work once again, they will need to be dealt with and dealt with seriously!

Look around the beaches, and you will find their hovels packed together all around the island. Find those grubby murlocs and gather twenty of their claws. Return them to me, and I'll make sure you're paid, bub.

Easy, yeah?
40725.completion: Well would you look at that, you got the claws. As much as I hate to see money go away, it needs to be done, here.

40726.title: The Backup Seal-Valve
40726.description:
Blasted valve! Each and every day we are having more leaks from the main water pump. If Tel Co. Basecamp is to last, it needs a supply of fresh water, regardless of what Telraz or Nokrot say.

Many of our backup parts were located far to the north of the island at Bixxle's Storehouse, but there's been -very- little traffic between us and them since, well, everything fell apart.

I need you to head there. Just follow the road all the way north, and rummage around for the 'Backup Seal-Valve'. Bixxle should have plenty, just look around for a crate labeled with the name, and return it to me. Simple yeah?
40726.progress: Had any luck finding the damn thing?
40726.completion: Would you look at that, perfect size too. Thanks a bunch!

40727.title: Derelict Supplies
40727.description:
It's getting difficult to maintain repairs on much of the machinery, especially with all of the chaos recently.

I'm experienced, but I'm lacking a lot of my tools, bub. You know how hard it is to work with a spanner when you really need a spin-wrench?

Just to the north of here is a place called 'The Derelict Camp'. Well, at one point it wasn't so derelict. We used to have many operations there: wood cutting, banana collecting, and much more. It's there I lost my toolbox with all my gizmos, and I want it back.

You can find the camp on the western edge of the island. Follow the road up north, and you'll find it.
40727.progress: You find my tools yet, kid?
40727.completion:
Why, this is it! I'll be honest with you, I thought the apes would tear you apart when you trundled out of here, but to actually have it in my hands...

Here, take this ring. I'm trying to save gold just in case this Tel Co. thing goes even more pear-shaped.

40728.title: Highvale Rise
40728.description:
I didn't think you had it in you, you certainly aint no ogre, but you did survive, and bring me those paws as proof.

If we want to -really- deal with the problem, we need to fight it at the source. All of the apes come from Highvale Rise, the giant mountain at the center of Tel'abim. It is there you will find the biggest, and strongest of their packs.

Travel there, and slay fourteen Elder Highvale Gorillas, that should put a dent in their aggression, and maybe even save some wise goblin minds.
40728.progress: What are you waiting for, we don't give bonus around here kid.
40728.completion:
Maybe we stand a chance after all! You really took the fight to them, you might of even made O'ggon jealous.

Nice work out there, here, as a thanks from us here at Tel Co.

40729.title: Collecting Specimens
40729.description:
My research has only just begun, and already there are so many possibilities it is making my head spin!

What do you mean you have no idea what I am talking about? I am trying to discover the secrets of the Gargantuan Banana! Rumor has it that they used to grow on Tel'Abim long ago; that was until they were all harvest.

Now, all that remains is myth and legend, but I will get to the bottom of it!

My first hunch comes from strange bananas grown on the island just off the coast to the east. I haven't really had much luck... murlocs are all along the coast! I am but one gnome, but perhaps you can go there and gather me three samples of the strange bananas that grow there.
40729.progress: The longer you stand around, the longer my work will take, go on now, quick quick!
40729.completion: These should do. You have aided my experiments.

40730.title: Early Testing
40730.description:
Those bananas from the island were warped. Not like the ripe Tel'Abim bananas on the island here, but something deformed.

It seems we must turn to a different solution, but I am running out of ideas all cooped up in this shack alone.

Why don't we try something... obvious? What if you procured an Elixir of Giant Growth and we just... simply poured it over the banana? It's worth a shot, right?
40730.progress: So, you end up finding that Elixir?
40730.completion: Well, here we go... Maybe it really is this simple.

40731.title: A Costly Favor
40731.description:
Well, I am stumped, All of my ideas either end up worthless, or failed. There must be something that I can...

<Tazzo's eyes blink back to life, but soon a sigh escapes him.>

There is something actually, I just remembered. A 'friend' of mine named Leezza used to work far in the north. When we were on better terms she once told me about seeing a ridiculously large banana, too big for her to move.

This has to be what we're looking for, but if we want this information, I know its going to cost me an arm and a leg... You could go to Tel Co. Basecamp, speak on my behalf, aside, I don't really got any gold, and I know she will ask.
40731.progress:
Tazzo sent you huh? He's finally coming back crawling for that information. He made such a point about being able to figure it out all on his own, and here he is, sending a mule to do his dirty work.

<Leezza begins to laugh.>

That is almost as insulting as his stupidly big head wandering here and asking himself.

Look <class>, you want that info, it'll cost you.
40731.completion:
Tazzo sent you huh? He's finally coming back crawling for that information. He made such a point about being able to figure it out all on his own, and here he is, sending a mule to do his dirty work.

<Leezza begins to laugh.>

That is almost as insulting as his stupidly big head wandering here and asking himself.

Look <class>, you want that info, it'll cost you, lets make it one gold, fifty silver, and a favor afterwards while you're here.

40732.title: Two Favors For The Price of One
40732.description:
Hello again mule, ready for work?

I will be honest, I aint sticking around on this rock as Tel Co. burns to the ground, and to get my way out, I need materials, ones a goblin can't find back on Kezan.

All around the jungle are these flying serpents with wings. They go by the moniker 'Venomflayer', you see, they have a really potent Sac deep within them, and it is this Venomflayer Sac that I am looking for. Lets make it eight of them, bring me eight, and I'll tell you about this stupidly large banana.
40732.progress: So, mule, you get those sacs yet?

40733.title: Gargantuan Information!
40733.description:
I suppose you did me a few favors, and paid that gold that Tazzo owed me.

Whenever you're ready to hear my tale, let me know, and then you can bring that to Tazzo like a good mule.
40733.completion:
So, her rumors -were- true!

The secrets of the Gargantuan Banana were real!

40734.title: A Must Have Discovery
40734.description:
Nestled deep within the largest of the Jagged Isles, tangled in roots and bushes, It's almost like we're finding a relic lost in time!

<The gnome looks absolutely eager and excited with the information.>

If that is the only Gargantuan Banana left, than I must have it. I want you to recover it, and bring it here, if I had a chance to study an actual Gargantuan, I could possibly even work to replicate it!

Head north, immediately, and find that banana!
40734.completion:
It's... It's...

<Tazzo is lost for words, his face a mix of wonder, and amazement as he takes his time to study the banana. Placing a single hand upon the skin, the gnome would gently pat it.>

Beautiful.

40735.title: The Micro Filter Tazzo-Scope
40735.description:
Would you just look at that thing? A sheer Marvel of nature itself!

I wouldn't want to risk planting this in the ground before I use all other options. I am a mage after all, and what better way than to make a formula to transform regular bananas into something like this!

For that to be an option, I need to study the Gargantuan Banana. I need a Micro Filter Tazzo-Scope, patent pending.

To create the scope I need you to get me the following materials, but trust me, they will be worth it! I need a Star Ruby, A Blue Sapphire, and an Accurate Scope. Once you get them, come back to me, and I'll make it.
40735.completion:
My my, you are resourceful!

I could probably tell you to go and get me the head of Illidan, and you'd be back in a couple days!

Now now, lets get to it..

40736.title: Gargantuan Studies
40736.description:
It took me a little bit, but I was able to fully analyze our specimen. It really is a marvel of nature, full with nutrients and extremely dense.

After studying and taking notes I believe I may have some ideas on how to replicate such a feat. Firstly, I will need enchanting materials, their arcane properties will be maniputed by yours truly. Secondly, I need Ripe Tel'abim Bananas, they are scattered around the island, get me five of them.

Once you have gathered everything, we can do our final testing.
40736.progress: You get a chance to find everything I need?
40736.completion: Brilliant, I will make sure to put them to good use.

40737.title: The Final Test
40737.description:
So, it appears some of these materials are not exactly cooperative with what I am trying to do, that said I think I may have figured it out!

It appears that Dream Dust, with the Banana, and some arcane energy could indeed produce what it is we are looking for. All I need to do is one final test to make sure everything works properly, so stand back, and speak to me after the experiment.
40737.completion:
We did it <name>, with my powers, and your handiness we figured out the secret to the Gargantuan Banana. I never thought I would see the day where I could pull something off like this!

I have you to thank for this, without you, I'd still be here fiddling with bananas and putting giant elixirs on them if I was lucky.

From now on, if you ever need another Gargantuan Tel'abim Banana, you come here, and I'll make one, should you have the materials of course!

40738.title: News for Danonzo!
40738.description:
I can't believe we were able to do it, but if there is anyone to thank aside yourself, it has to be Danonzo, he convinced me to continue my work and even vouched for me to stay here at this shack.

He has been wanting to work on a unique recipe for a while now, aparently he is having trouble thinking of something, well, special.

Perhaps a Gargantuan Tel'abim Banana will help him!
40738.completion:
What is this thing, it's massive! Such a unique texture, this is one of those gargantuan bananas that Tazzo has been going on about, he finally did it?

<The goblin smirks from ear to ear.>

With this thing I could become a legend back at Kezan. Say, why don't you help me develop some recipes? You help me, and I'll even share. With my name on them of course.

40739.title: The Tel'Abim Banana Transmutation
40739.description:
So then, back for another Gargantuan Banana, are you? I know: The flavor is so spectacular, I couldn't get enough of it!

All I require from you is three Ripe Tel'Abim Bananas and a single Dream Dust. Once you bring me the materials, I can transmute another three big bananas for you. Yes, it's that simple!
40739.progress:
<Within a matter of seconds, the gnome processes the bananas and procures three Gargantuan Bananas before your eyes.>

There you have it, one transmuted Gargantuan Banana. If you ever want more bananas, stop by any time!> Ripe Tel'Abim Banana(3)Dream Dust
40739.completion:
<Within a matter of seconds, the gnome processes the bananas and procures a Gargantuan Bananas before your eyes.>

There you have it, one transmuted Gargantuan Banana. If you ever want more bananas, stop by any time!

40740.title: Tel'Abim Banana Transmutations!
40740.description:
I have refined my transmutation process and even expanded my lab! The ability to create multiple Gargantuan Bananas at once is now a very real possibility. All I need, of course, is the required materials to begin the process.

To make fifteen Gargantuan Bananas, I will need fifteen Ripe Tel'Abim Bananas as well as five Dream Dust. If you need a bundle of those giant bananas, bring me those materials and I'll make your dreams come true!
40740.progress:
<Within a matter of seconds, the gnome processes the bananas and procures fifteen Gargantuan Bananas before your eyes.>

See? It's all refined now! If you ever want more bananas, stop by any time!> Ripe Tel'Abim Banana(15)Dream Dust(5)
40740.completion:
<Within a matter of seconds, the gnome processes the bananas and procures five Gargantuan Bananas before your eyes.>

See? It's all refined now! If you ever want more bananas, stop by any time!

40741.title: Shipments on Time
40741.description:
If you're wanting to help, kid, then buckle up. First things first though, I need bananas! Wheelbarrows full of them, buckets full of them, barrels full of them!

We have a shipment due to Kezan in a months time, and all my workers are unable to venture into the jungle. Without those bananas, there will be no more Tel Co.

Without Tel Co., there will be no more bananas seen around the world. Do you see how serious this is?!

Now, I know you're much more brave than the others, so why don't you go out and get me 18 ripe bananas. That way, we can at least fulfill our next shipment on time.
40741.progress:
So, you get those bananas?

<Baron Telraz appears to be on edge.>
40741.completion:
<A massive sigh of relief escapes from Baron Telraz>

Oh my, you just saved my day, and my company at that! I was seriously -FREAKING OUT- here, and you went and got this all done for me.

Here, I pay those that help and save my hide. You can take this gold coin from me-a gesture of good will.

40742.title: The Work Must Continue
40742.description:
If we ever want to get back to work, we need to make sure things are, safe again. The apes are not my workers biggest concern. It is those snakes. Can you believe that?'

All of my workers are more terrified by those Brushtails than the massive gorillas.

Goblins right?

They slither in the brush and attack at dark. They need to be dealt with.

Once this monkey threat is dealt with, there will still be snakes, and I hate snakes. Why don't you deal with them for me? The Brushtail Adders and Cobras are aggressive, attacking anything in sight. Eradicate them, and maybe my workers will have the courage to pick bananas again.
40742.completion:
Heh, those pesky Brushtails never bothered me any, maybe the workers will be able to finally get back to work with less danger out there.

Thanks for the work, here, as a reward, we have a bunch of extra stuff laying around these days.

40743.title: Exchanging Foreign Food
40743.description:
Winter. A time to eat, and eat well! I always love to try new foods and exchange cultural foods of my people with others.

Perhaps we can make a trade, yes? I would like to sample some of the foods of other races. You find some, and I will offer you a special dish in return.

Gather for me a variety that my people and I may enjoy a feast, and I will make sure you are well rewarded for your seasonal spirit!
40743.progress: I sure am hungry, you find an assortment of food?
40743.completion:
<Chieftain Icepaw looks on with astonishment.>

You really are a festive individual, I prepared some things for you upon the fire, a tray of our famous cookies here in Icepaw Village, I hope you enjoy them, they are fresh and right off the pan!

I will share these goods with the others in the village!

40744.title: Gifts to Wrap
40744.description:
The year has come to an end, and with it, our celebrations. Our celebrations are met with exchanging gifts, for there is no better way to rejoice and share in one anothers company.

This year we are a bit light on wrapping paper, a very cheerful gnome delivered the last batch. It did last a few years, but we will need more before long, lest our holidays be ruined!

Maybe you know a place to retrieve wrapping paper?
40744.progress: So, have you got any wrapping paper for us?
40744.completion:
Oh, the young ones will be pleased. I may be old, but celebrating the holiday is always the highlight of my year, and to wrap gifts for others is always a favorite past time.

Here, take this, as a thanks from myself.

40745.title: Thieving Little Grell!
40745.description:
Those little, thieving, coniving Grell, they pulled the snow over my eyes this year when I was least expecting it.

They stole my gift right out from beneath my nose. Though I will admit, I was a bit drunk, and awoke to find it missing, but that is here nor there.

I have good suspicion that it is the Grell to the south west who are responsible. Trust me, this gift means a lot for me, and I really want to give it to someone special, do you think you could recover it from their camp for me?
40745.completion: I cannot thank you enough for recovering this, those Winter Grell surely got the best of me this year, but thanks to you, all is better now, here, as a token of my thanks, have some ale on me.

40746.title: The Evil Winter Grell
40746.description:
The Winter Grell arrive at the start of every season, their minds filled with ideas of trickery and theft to disrupt the festive seasons here in Winter Veil Vale. They are sent by their lord Krampus, an evil spirit who despises the holiday season.

It is up to brave souls like us to prevent the Winter Grell from doing their biding and stealing presents from beneath the tree at will.

You can find them to the south west, near the edge of the mountain and the frozen lake, slay them, and remove their presence. Do not worry about causing too much harm, they will simply be sent back to the realm in which they came, only to return another season.
40746.progress: It is a never ending conflict with these Winter Grell..
40746.completion: Excellent work out there, another season of celebrations will go with less tomfoolery.

40747.title: A Programmer?
40747.description:
Huh, what are you doing here, I don't recall you being on any lists, or expecting anyone on the island here.

Did Mr. Shang send you, or Dragunastrasz?

I assume you must be new here, a programmer like the others no doubt, we go through them quick around here with all the bug reports.

When you're ready to begin, speak to me, and I'll issue you a set of Programmer Socks.

Yes they are required.
40747.completion:
Well, here you are, and here are your pair of Programmer Socks.

They are extremely comfortable and increase your skill by a considerable margain.

I better not catch you without them.

40748.title: Winter Veil Brew
40748.description:
What a better way to cap off the end of a long year other than drinking? Of course, the best of the best only makes the celebrations better.

You heard tales of the Winter Veil Brew I made a few seasons past? Oh, it surely was magical, probably the best batch I made in my wee life.

Those dastardly Dark Irons stole it, no doubt hidden away in their tavern deep within the Blackrock Depths.

You recover it, and I share some of it, that sounds like a deal, yeah?
40748.progress: You had any luck finding the barrel down there?
40748.completion:
<Bomarn beams with excitement.>

Oh, this is it, the mystical keg of Winter Veil Brew! I haven't had a drink in ages past.

<Bomarn quickly drinks from the barrel with an eagerness.>

Oh, where has me manners gone, here, like I promised, take a couple tankards, only the best for a brave adventurer like yerself.

40749.title: Translating The Unknown
40749.description: The parchment is written in an unknown script that appears to be logographic. Judging by your surroundings, this building does not belong to any native culture to Tel'Abim. The calligraphy is elegant. The strokes for each character appears perfect. Seek out someone who may be able to decipher the script.
40749.progress: Yes? What do you have there? It appears to be written in my language.
40749.completion: Ah, so you need someone to translate this for you? Let me see it.

40752.title: Danonzo's Tel'Abim Surprise
40752.description:
Now, where to begin, so many ideas, so many possibilities, why not a tried and true classic, with a twist. Banana bread is a staple to some and quite delicious, but Danonzo can put a twist on things.

Enfusing the Gargantuan Tel'Abim Banana into the bread with a dash of Heart of the Wild can calm the nerves and much a keen aftertaste that lingers upon the tongue.

Gather me the ingredients, and I can prepare it at once!
40752.progress: You gather everything yet? I'm dying for the opportunity to cook wonderous dishes here!
40752.completion:
Here it is, a magical delicacy for fresh minds!

I present Danonzo's Tel'Abim Surprise, just like its name implies, a sheer treat to the tongue. A mix of both chewy and sweet textures served warm with a sheer lovely taste. Thanks to the garnish of Heart of the Wild.

As I promised, here is the recipe. Don't forget to tell people who figured this all out now, ya'hear?

40753.title: Danonzo's Tel'Abim Delight
40753.description:
My mind is flooding with ideas, so much to choose from, so much to do! I got it why don't we create a wonderous stew, the Gargantuan Banana itself is surely capable of producing a wonderous cream.

A creamy broth served hot with fresh chunks of grilled banana overtop, now doesn't that sound magical!

All I need is a Gargantuan Tel'Abim Banana, an Icecap and Soothing Spices, bring them to me, and we can get cooking kid.
40753.progress: My destiny is ahead of me, what's taking you so long to collect everything?
40753.completion:
Here it is, a magical delicacy for fresh minds!

I present Danonzo's Tel'Abim Delight, just like its name implies, a sheer treat to the tongue, a mix of bow chewy and sweet textures served warm with a sheer lovely taste thanks to the garnish of Mountain Silversage.

As I promised, here is the recipe, don't forget to tell people who figured this all out now, ya'hear?

40754.title: Danonzo's Tel'Abim Medley
40754.description:
Oh how the other goblins of Kezan will bask in the awe of my genius once they discover all of the recipes in my mind. My idea of a cold Banana cake filled with banana cream is the next on my mind, that sure does sound delicious, does it not?

Cooked at a high heat with a seperate filling added later and cooled after completion will add quite the punch of flavors, its just missing one thing... I got it!

Gather me the following ingredients, and I can get to work, A Gargantuan Tel'Abim Banana, a Golden Sansam, and Soothing Spices, once you acquire them, I can get started.
40754.progress: I can wait no longer to start, hurry up with gathering what I need!
40754.completion:
It is complete, Danonzo's Tel'Abim Medley!

Served cold, this banana cake is filled with a airy banana cream, incredibly sweet, with a crumbly outer layer! With this, I shall dominate Kezan, and potentially even other markets!

I did promise to share this recipe, and I am an honest goblin, perhaps rare for my kind.

Just remember where you got it huh, I don't want anyone stealing my ideas now, you know?

40755.title: Operation Screwfuse 1000
40755.description:
Look, I have a favor I need to ask, and one that is really important to me. Do you know the meaning of sunk cost fallacy? Well, in my world it's completely true. I have spent years, and buckets of gold working on a machine that can appraise bananas on being worthy to collect or not. It is able to judge ripeness, age, and all sorts of factors to determine if it is worth our time to collect.

Let's just say... the buffoons that I sent it out with got lost and left it at the camp to the west of here.

I don't have a bunch of people to waste getting ripped apart by Venomflayers to go get it themselves, so why don't you do it? Recover the Screwfuse 1000 and be sure to bring it back gently. It should be down the road to the west at a small abandoned camp.
40755.progress: So, you have any luck yet <class>?
40755.completion: By my ears, this is it! Well done, this has saved me an extraordinary amount of time, and as you know, time is money, especially in this case.

40756.title: Operation FIX Screwfuse 1000
40756.description:
Those, absolute idiots!

The entire mechanism is broken, my backup Arcane Regulator, and my Spingadge Flange are both broken. Do you know how long it took to acquire such rare parts, special ordered from Kezan!

If only they were still alive, I'd be the one to send them to whatever misbegotten afterlife they are rotting in. I have only one source for rare goods from Kezan, and I need you to speak with him. He goes by the name 'Jabbey' an alias of sorts, he is an undercover operative from Kezan and works through various back channels, go speak with him, and let him know -Bixxle- sent you, bring him this list of items.
40756.completion:
Huh, what is it you want, you here for something special?

Oh, Bixxle sent you huh, that idiot? He spent a good five years making some banana sorter, what does he need?

40757.title: Operation Help Jabbey
40757.description:
<Jabbey looks at the list with an expression of disbelief and laughs.>

"Haha! He thinks I’m just going to hand over such valuable items that easily? Look, kid, these things are rare and worth a fortune. If he really needs them and wants my help, I’ve got a little favor I need taken care of first. Fair deal, yeah?

So, here’s the deal: I did some business with one of those Dark Iron types—goes by the name Darneg Darkbeard. Let’s just say I lent him a considerable stash of high-value goods to sell. Problem is, I haven’t heard a peep back, and now I’ve got confirmation that the guy swindled me. I need you to head into Blackrock Depths, into Shadowforge City, and track him down in the Domicile. Recover the ‘Extremely Potent Snuff’ he owes me. Think you can handle that? Easy, right?"
40757.progress:
You find that good for nothing thief, and give him justice yet?

Better yet, you recover my stuff?
40757.completion:
<Jabbey looks on the small pile of snuff with displeasure.>

Well this certainly is a disappointment.

40758.title: Operation Help Jabbey 2
40758.description:
Well, I hate to do this to you kid, but that dwarf went and... 'used' most of the snuff, looks like you're a bit out of luck. This certainly isn't enough to recover even a fraction of the cost for the parts you're looking for, but I do have another favor, that will pay for the rest of it.

Let's just say I have some clients that are looking to 'research' toxic materials for, scientific, purposes. They are looking to get their hands on a 'Blighted Essence' which can be acquired from the Blighted Horrors in Eastern Plaguelands. So, get me the Blighted Essence, and that will pay off the rest of the parts, easy yeah?
40758.progress: Careful holding that Blighted Essence when you bring it around here, last thing I want is some super disease in Steamwheedle.
40758.completion: Well, I didn't expect you to actually return, that's a bummer. Oh well, a goblins word means something in this world, to some people anyway.

40759.title: Operation Return to Screwfuse
40759.description:
Nice job in getting all that stuff for me, didn't take all too long as well, Kezan could use some individuals like you.

Now, I boxed that fool Bixxle's goods, take them to him, and be quick about it, I've had you linger around here too long, last thing I want is people to catch on about my business, got it?
40759.completion: Oh, they were that hard to get, huh? Hope it wasn't too much of a fuss getting them for me. Here, take some coin for all the trouble.

40760.title: Operation Final Repairs
40760.description:
Now that I have all the materials, I just need to put in the last bits of repairing, and for that, well I'm going to need more materials.

I hope I am not being too much of a bother, but do you mind getting me some engineering supplies? I need the following, six Thorium Bars, a Gold Power Core, some Fused Wiring, and a Thorium Widget, with all of that I should be able to fix the Screwfuse 1000.
40760.progress: You get all those things yet?
40760.completion:
<Bixxle let's out a sigh of relief, smirking from ear to ear.>
