The scepter is but a useless bauble if not infused with the essence of the guardian, as it was his touch that awakened it. Unless we find a way to attune it to Medivh, utilizing it will be impossible.

Seeing as the guardian does not dwell here any longer, finding such glimmers of him appears impossible. Please, it is imperative for you and me to locate it, or the scepter will forever remain inactive.
41370.progress: We stand before a fundamental moment in history.
41370.completion: I am trembling at the sight of the guardian's essence, that you were able to carry it here is a testament to your mental resilience and physical prowess. Now that all pieces are assembled, restoring the scepter will take but a few moments. Please take a step back, unstable energies and raging magics are expected to erupt during the process.

41371.title: The Otherwordly Scepter of Medivh
41371.description:
The scepter is complete, yet... different to how I remembered it. It looks identical, but the presence it has feels dull, almost empty. While the guardian's power is very much noticeable, there is an unmistakeable residue of foreign energy within the scepter itself. This energy lies dormant, asleep and longs to be awakened. <name>, I fear we are not done yet, before we have released this magic from the relic.

When I focus my mind on the artifact, I recognize floating stone, a land tormented and fire being spewed from the ground. A race of traveling mystics, subdued by an emerald flame.

<name>, please forgive me for not being helpful enough. In order to harness the foreign magic of the scepter, I would need to harmonize it with an energized item from that plane I described to you. Where you would find such a thing, eludes my eyes, however.
41371.progress: Think about the place I saw in my vision. Perhaps what you heard reminded you of something or someone you met on your journey already.
41371.completion: I've never seen anything like this gemstone before. The teal color, its structure and surface are incomparable to anything here on Azeroth. Yet again I am amazed by the lengths you go for in search for the truth. Now, let us finish this at last.

41372.title: A Pathway Opened
41372.description: The attunement will take some of my time and energy. Please tell me once you wish me to start the process.
41372.progress: Let us not wait too long. We don't want to let the magic remain untamed.
41372.completion:
I entrust you with the Scepter of Medivh, conduit of ley magic and the primal energies of an alien world. With it you may command the violent magical torrents of Karazhan itself. Don't get complacent; while you are certainly powerful, the scepter' former owner is the only person to properly wield it. Nevertheless, the deepest secrets of the accursed tower now lay at your feet, begging to be unveiled by the one strong-minded enough to brave its treacherous reaches.

Go forth and claim the truth you fought so valiantly for! Let the conquest of Karazhan be one of the milestones of your heroic legacy!

41373.title: A Chef's Majesty
41373.description: The text is written in a very sluggish Goblin slang. As you circle through the pages familiar recipes meet the eye, but nothing too interesting. With a sigh, you turn to the next page to notice a missing page. You would pay no mind to it were the book not to end there, but now that it did you were weighing in the possibilities.

41374.title: No Honor Among Chefs
41374.description:
Gastino's recipe book was quite common as you may have already noticed. But it did contain a certain recipe that rejuvenated the focus of any healer. Oddly enough, while the priests acknowledged the goblin's greedy ambitions, they couldn't help but feel grateful for this recipe he left behind.

In a way, I think they appreciated the simplicity of it. Since it was nothing but an assorted salad. I am afraid I don't know the recipe by heart but I think this missing page should be somewhere in the crypts. This book belonged to someone buried there. Be wary, I feel time hasn't been kind to that place.
41374.progress: Did you find what you seek?
41374.completion: A crumbled piece of paper. It's sad to see it reduced to this, no matter what. I will restore it for you, as holding it made me remember it.

41375.title: A Study of Magical Trees
41375.description: Upon first glance, the book seemed to be a perfectly normal tome. Yet as you began to study its contents, you quickly gathered that its appearance was more akin to that of a rough journal than an expertly written work. By the title, it claimed to be a study - yet the tattered pages and sloppily drawn text seemed as though they had passed through the hands of a child.

41376.title: Wrapping Warpwood
41376.description:
I do recognize this journal. It is something I used to keep for Prince Tortheldrin. We used to meet and discuss various things, not just he and I but most of the Lorekeepers. Eldre'thalas was a place of knowledge. Sadly it is nothing but a shadow of what it used to be. I appreciate you bringing this back.

If you have the time, I have a request. Upon examining this tome, I have discovered an incomplete glyph carved upon the final page. As we never concluded our research, I must ask of you to travel to the Warpwood Quarter and defeat the tainted Treants that roam the area. With any luck, they may still carry upon their foliage the blue color that once adorned them. If you bring to me these leaves, I will reward you with the results of our investigation.
41376.progress: A certain nostalgia flows through my bones.
41376.completion: And there we have it, with the glyph complete it can now be used. As to whether you choose to or not, remains up to you.

41377.title: Scythe of the Goddess
41377.description:
Now, it will take me some time to delve into Ur's teachings. I must ensure that no vital detail escapes my attention. The tome is expansive, and Ur is known to embed secret messages for those who are keen of mind.

In the meantime, I have a task for you. Among the wise sages of this world, few possess the wisdom and insight of Fandral Staghelm, the leader of our order. He resides in Darnassus.

Journey to Darnassus and inform him of your findings. Surely, he will offer valuable counsel regarding this potent artifact.
41377.completion: So, the fabled Scythe of Elune has been found. Dreamwind has been wise to send you to me, even if his efforts to heal Hyjal are misguided.

41378.title: Blood of Vorgendor
41378.description:
Elune's mysteries are profound, and even I, with all my knowledge, can find them inscrutable at times. I do not fully grasp why She would entrust Velinde—yes, that was her name—with such an artifact as the Scythe of Elune. Yet, its power to summon worgen may indeed be the very key to unlocking its deeper truths.

I have long been engaged in research into a peculiar herb known as morrowgrain. Interestingly, my studies suggest it might be instrumental in purging the dark energies that cling to the Scythe from its time in Karazhan. But to activate the morrowgrain, a potent catalyst is required. Therefore, bring me blood—the blood of the worgen, collected from various tribes lurking in the darkest recesses of Karazhan, prowling the abandoned streets of Gilneas City, and hiding within the shadows of Shadowfang Keep.

Do this, and bring them to me. Do not delay. The power of the Scythe must be harnessed and understood by one as capable as I.
41378.progress: It is imperative that the Scythe is cleansed.
41378.completion: Impressive. Now, give the blood to me. I will prepare what is needed.

41379.title: Wolfblood
41379.description:
I was right, as always. Thanks to the morrowgrain, I have successfully purged the darkness from the worgen blood you gathered. Now, witness!

<Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm extends his hand, displaying a vial of pure, blue blood.>

This may not seem like much to you, but what you see before you is a testament not only to the strength of their bloodline but also to their connection to Elune. Look closer. Do you notice it in their blood?

Indeed. As pure as the waters of our moonwells. That's what they were before blood magic tainted their species. Bring this to Dreamwind at once. He will know what to do next.

And, should you ever find the burden of wielding the Scythe too much for your weary shoulders... you know where to find me.
41379.completion: Pure worgen blood, just like Ur described... Yes, this will be very useful. But now listen, as I have much to share.

41380.title: Scythe of the Goddess
41380.description:
Now, it will take me some time to delve into Ur's teachings. I must ensure that no vital detail escapes my attention. The tome is expansive, and Ur is known to embed secret messages for those who are keen of mind.

In the meantime, I have a task for you. Among the wise sages of this world, few possess the wisdom and insight of Fandral Staghelm, the leader of our order. However, I fear that he may not be as receptive to your presence as I am.

Yet, not all hope is lost. Among your tauren allies, there is one who is nearly as wise as Fandral. I speak of Magatha Grimtotem. Despite the occasional unruliness of her clan, they have always revered Elune, whom they call Mu'sha.

To my knowledge, she now resides in the great city of Thunder Bluff. Go there and seek her counsel. Perhaps she holds knowledge about the Scythe that eludes even me. Your journey is far from over, and the wisdom of the Grimtotem may prove invaluable.
41380.completion: So, the fabled Scythe of Mu'sha has been found. This Arch Druid Dreamwind has been wise to send you to me.

41381.title: The Wolf, the Crone and the Scythe
41381.description:
I have heard many tales of this weapon and the vile fate that befell it. Yet, not all is lost, for we may be able to cleanse it from the darkness of Karazhan.

Recently, some members of the Cenarion Circle, especially those closest to Fandral Staghelm, have begun amassing significant amounts of a certain herb called morrowgrain. From what Archdruid Hamuul has shared with me, I believe that this herb might be the key to purifying the Scythe.

However, for it to work, a powerful catalyst is required. We need the blood of the worgen—blood from various tribes lurking in the darkest corners of Karazhan, prowling the forsaken streets of Gilneas City, and hiding within the shadows of Shadowfang Keep.

Gather their blood and bring it to me. Together, we may yet be able to cleanse the Scythe and restore it to its true purpose.
41381.progress: Scythe of Musha must be cleansed.
41381.completion: Exquisite work, as always. Now, hand it to me.

41382.title: Wolfblood
41382.description:
Whatever Fandral's lackeys are planning with morrowgrain must be truly extraordinary... But I digress. The blood has indeed been cleansed. Here, take a look, child.

<Magatha Grimtotem extends her hand, displaying a vial of pure, blue blood.>

Pure as the waters of the moonwell, shining like the stars themselves. Before whatever horrible fate befell these worgen, they were the favorite children of Mu'sha, no doubt.

Bring this back to Dreamwind at once. He will want to know.

And keep the Scythe close. Some members of the Cenarion Circle may not be so pleased that it is in your hands.
41382.completion: Pure worgen blood, just like Ur described. Yes, this will be very useful. They were once the favourite children of Elune, and to have their uncorrupted blood... It will be the key during the ritual... But now listen, as I have much to share.

41383.title: Wisdom of Ur
41383.description:
During your absence, I delved deep into the teachings of Ur, scrutinizing every passage, every word, and every hidden meaning within the tome. The knowledge I uncovered is both enlightening and deeply unsettling.

Stay awhile and listen, young <race>. The wisdom contained in Ur's writings is profound, but it also reveals a grim truth about the Scythe of Elune and the nature of its power.
41383.completion: So now you know. We don't have much time left. You must find them, so that the Scythe can be cleansed.

41384.title: Pricolich Gnarlmoon
41384.description:
It is time to bring down Keeper Gnarlmoon. The fate of our world depends on it. His presence in Karazhan is a blight that cannot be tolerated, and his schemes must be thwarted before they come to fruition. The balance of nature itself is at stake.

You have already ventured into the Upper Chambers of Karazhan in your quest for the tome, so you are familiar with the labyrinthine corridors and shadowed halls. The journey ahead will not be easy, but your previous experience will serve you well. Gnarlmoon has entrenched himself in the very heart of Karazhan's dark magic, drawing power from the cursed place to fuel his malevolent plans.

But beware, for Gnarlmoon is no ordinary adversary. He is a bloodmage of legendary power, one who has dabbled in the darkest arts for centuries. His command over blood magic is unparalleled. To face him alone would be folly. You will need allies, strong and brave companions who can stand with you against the tide of darkness.
41384.completion: The foul pricolich Gnarlmoon is dead! Impressive indeed. You have saved us all.

41385.title: Gilnean Pricolich
41385.description:
My ravens have whispered of a dark presence that once shadowed the streets of Gilneas City. Far across the sea, amidst the gloom and mist, a worgen bloodmage was seen weaving his vile magic. This creature has left an indelible mark on the already troubled land. The details are scarce, but one thing is certain: he often conspired with the infamous regents of Gilneas, the Harlows.

The Harlows are a cunning and ruthless family.It is said that they would align themselves with anyone who could further their ambitions, no matter the cost. The bloodmage found in them willing accomplices, ones who would turn a blind eye to his dark practices as long as it suited their needs. It is within their shadowy dealings that the key to the bloodmage's plans may lie.

If I could leave the sacred groves of Hyjal, I would journey to Gilneas myself. But you, young one, have the freedom to venture forth where I cannot. Your path is clear, and it leads to the mist-shrouded streets of Gilneas City.
41385.progress: I cannot leave Nordrassil, not yet.
41385.completion: Father Lycan... A name steeped in shadows, yet one that may hold the key to our salvation. This journal you've unearthed, while enigmatic, could be the catalyst for unlocking the truth behind his sinister presence. Let us delve into Ur's teachings once more, for within lies the wisdom to decipher this mystery.

41386.title: Pricolich Lycan
41386.description:
In the annals of ancient lore penned by Ur, it is whispered that the mere utterance of the pricolich's name could serve as a beacon, drawing forth his dark presence into our realm. But heed me closely, for there exists a stratagem, a cunning plan to entice him forth under our control.

Take this arcane orb, a relic of ages past, infused with the essence of primal magic. With it in hand, venture westward to the site of an ancient Circle of Power, a nexus of energies both primordial and potent. There, amidst the whispering winds and the rustling leaves, speak the name of the pricolich.

But do so with caution, for his arrival must be orchestrated with precision. Once summoned, we shall wield the Circle's might to ensnare him, stripping away his dark powers and rendering him vulnerable. It is then, in that moment of weakness, that we shall strike, banishing him back to the shadows from whence he came, and securing our realm from his malevolent grasp for eternity.
41386.completion: The vile pricolich Lycan is dead! You stopped him and avenged Velinde!

41387.title: Iron Determination
41387.description:
So you step before me. Surely to seek tutelage in the art of war - why else would you search for the master of arms. You are one among many who wish to reach expertise in the martial arts, but will you be one of the few to actually achieve it? I've lost count on how many gullible and naive warriors think they are worthy of my teachings, only to fail at the slightest challenge. Unless your worth is proven to me, I cannot be sure you are suitable for what's to come.

High up the mountains to the north lies a defiled forest called Felwood. Even further north you will find the Irontree Cavern; from within this cave a root, cold as iron and equally heavy, is what I require of you. Pick the root and bring it safely to me.
41387.progress: This ordeal will show me if you got what it takes.
41387.completion:
The Ironvine Root is an aggressive plant. When uprooted it clings around its captor, trying to drag it to the ground, ultimately wearing them down. You, however, did not bend to this natural force. Your mind was clear, your will iron. The last person to pass this test was my apprentice Sakgoth, many years ago. Perhaps I have found someone extraordinary in you. The upcoming trials will tell if I am correct in my assumption.

<Mathias takes a dagger and with a swift cut you almost couldn't see, he removes the gripping vines from your body.>

We shouldn't let it get to waste, you can brew excellent tea with this root.

41388.title: Wisdom From Failure
41388.description:
Apologies for my brash demeanour, but I have to make sure you are cut out for the path of war. You may be experienced in the martial arts, but following my path takes more than what you’ve accomplished so far.

As previously mentioned, many ambitious people stood where you are now, but only a few succeeded. It is important to learn from mistakes, our own and those of others. Speak with my former pupils, and they will share stories of failure. Only if you really understand their faults will you proceed. Speak with Sakgoth and Klannoc on this island and Ka’fai in Tanaris. I heard the thrill of the desert lured him to the city of Gadgetzan. Once you’ve done so, return and answer my questions about their tellings.
41388.progress: No lesson is the same. Comprehending the connection between them and the mistakes made allows you to grasp their wisdom.
41388.completion: Commendable. Taking these lessons to heart is imperative for your future success on this road you've taken.

41389.title: Proof
41389.description: Here, take the glass marble and bring it to Sakgoth. It is proof of your deeds and signals you as his equal. Be ever vigilant and remember what you learned. I am excited to witness your further growth!
41389.progress: Just what happened up there? It smells like burned flesh in there.
41389.completion:
The master is an enigmatic man, and I will most likely never fully understand the ways of his mind. Luckily that's not what we are here for, right?

This pearl you brought, truly something else. Every student of the master's receives a personal gift from him - and technically me - as proof of their accomplishments. Mine is the stinger of a scorpid I've slain in the Thousand Needles. And for you... what do you think of a pendant?

41390.title: Drones In Westfall
41390.description:
Hey, you. Headed to Westfall, by chance? The SI:7 is on a big lead about the Defias' machinations involving individuals outside of Westfall. We suspect they're dealing with some sort of highly volatile chemical that could pose a threat to not only Stormwind, but the rest of the Eastern Kingdoms as well. We could use some... 'additional muscle', per say, as this job may very well not be the stealthy type of deal.

One of our agents is situated down in Westfall at the bridge leading to Duskwood, near the abandoned mage tower. I want you to go and meet her, and be quick about it. There has been a sudden turn of events worth investigating. Kearnen is her name; and once you find her, do as she says.
41390.completion: Renzik sent you? Good. I could use a bit more manpower.

41391.title: Venture Delivery
41391.description:
I've been spying on this tower for quite some time and anything happening around it is unfathomably strange. The Defias are sparse here, but certainly well equipped. That alone is concerning enough, yet what puzzles me the most are those zombies patrolling the perimeter. Every now and again, some of the Defias enter the tower; but instead of them leaving again, a completely new specimen of these zombies shows its ugly face.

I'd like to investigate further of the internal machinations of this tower, but I am waiting on reinforcements from the SI:7. What you are here for is fairly simple, but all the more crucial. At the dock near the tower, I noticed a shady goblin mooring her rowboat full of crates. Surely a delivery of some sorts, what we need however are documents, preferably with names of the people involved in these operations. Deal with her how you like, but bring any valuable info directly back to Renzik in the SI:7 headquarters.
41391.progress: Back so soon? I hope not with empty hands...
41391.completion: Jared Voss? I hate that this name rings several bells. If what is in this document is true, then we should make haste immediately.

41392.title: Turning Off The Tap
41392.description:
Jared Voss is the son of William Voss, a highly skilled and educated alchemist. His father had an alchemy shop here in the Old Town, beloved by many. When Stormwind was burnt down a second time, his family's home was among those burned to ashes. During its rebuild by the Stonemason's Guild, Voss naturally assumed his house to be restored, given his importance as Stormwind's most renowned alchemist. Ironically, it would not come to pass.

Stormwind's nobility had different plans of reconstructing the city and in the end, Voss and his family became homeless. With a growing hatred in his heart, he condemned those responsible for their fate. We're assuming Voss sent his son to the Stonemason's before his death, who shared his disdain. It seems Jared succeeded his father in both hate and abilities.

<name>, Voss cannot be allowed to operate any longer. According to the list you brought, he dwells in the Deadmines. Liquidate him and bring me samples of his newest brew.
41392.progress: Don't waste time. I'm not as patient as Master Shaw.
41392.completion: By the mines of Kezan! This smells horrible. One whiff of it and any grown sailor will fall over in a heartbeat. <name>, excellent job. While we were able to secure this end of the operations, we still have to investigate where exactly they're getting all the supplies from, as I am sure the Venture Co. is simply a middle man. Still, so far you did great and for that I've got a reward for you. Stay clear of trouble, adventurer, wouldn't want to see you getting killed.

41393.title: The Strength To Move Mountains
41393.description:
You possess an iron will. You draw wisdom out of past mistakes. Now demonstrate to me the strength you carry. I will keep it short, so listen up.

To the far east, in the Burning Steppes north of the Redridge Mountains, a simmering giant slumbers, his power unparalleled. Search the northern mountains, slay the fiery beast and bring me his burning eye.
41393.completion:
<The giant's eye is incredibly hot, yet it matters little to Mathias. Sizzling noises erupt from his hand while he inspects the stone you brought him. After having marveled at it long enough, Mathias dunks it into a nearby water bucket, filling the room with steam. The steam clears, and what you see in his burned hand is an immaculate glass marble.>

Such an interesting material. I've always wanted to get my hands on one of these, just to experience their intense heat. Impressive work, <name>. You've proven yourself to me. Welcome to the fold.

41394.title: Scythe of the Goddess
41394.description:
With the lingering shadows of the pricoliches dead and their influence waning, the time has come for us to clenase the Scythe of Elune. Yet, such a feat is no simple task, for the tendrils of dark magicks woven within its very essence are deeply entrenched.

Gather close, young one, and heed my words. To commence the purification process, we shall require six Eternal Dreamstones and twenty Mooncloths. These shards shall form the cornerstone of our endeavor, serving as conduits for the purifying energies that shall flow through them.

But the path to purity is fraught with peril, for the dark magicks that infest the Scythe yearn to be unleashed once more upon the world. To contain such potent forces, we must fashion a vessel of unparalleled strength – the soul of a powerful demon. Among the ranks of the nether, whispers abound of a dreadlord named Mephistroth.

Venture forth into the depths of the nether, and seek out the essence of Mephistroth's soul.
41394.progress: Have you found the materials needed yet?
41394.completion: The soul of a Dreadlord... Everything seems to be in order. Now, it's time to cleanse the Scythe of Elune!

41395.title: A Hidden Compartment
41395.progress: <There are three indentations in the shape of a rhombus.> Palatinate ShardCobalt ShardCardinal Shard
41395.completion: <You place the three shards inside the empty spaces and after a short clicking noise, a lid opens underneath. Within you find a singular, ordinary gemstone.>

41396.title: Woven Dreams
41396.description:
<name>, please halt for a moment. Just now, I felt a surge of energy from my grandfather's spirit fragment. A welcoming warmth, one I missed for many millennia. That is not all, though. It is difficult to understand, but I feel the great Malorne is trying to communicate with us - with you. I can feel the urgency in his presence. It can't be any other way: Malorne wishes to put his blessing on you, I am certain of it.

To receive grandfather's blessing, it is imperative you are in tune with the Emerald Dream, just as I am. However, aligning yourself with Ysera's realm is a task only veteran druids succeed in after years of meditation. Yet still, there is another way. For that, preparation is required. Aid me, <name>, and I shall pave the way for you to gain Dreamsight.

First, we need a dreamveil, woven from dreamhide and dreamthread. Furthermore, viridian mushrooms, drenched in Dream energy. Find these at Jademir Lake in Feralas. Lastly, bring me plentiful potions of dreamless rest.
41396.progress: It may be within my abilities to peer into the Emerald Dream, but those boons only affect myself - it cannot sadly be used for others. Fret not, however. I will assist you wherever I can.
41396.completion: These will do just fine. Alongside these potent mushrooms, I can create an exceptionally powerful dreamveil for you. Without it I fear you may be pulled into the Dream prematurely, without ever being able to return. Now brace yourself, <name>. For you to be granted Dreamsight, you will be seeking an audience with one of the oldest green dragons known to Azeroth.

41397.title: The Eternal Sleeper
41397.description:
With the gift of Dreamsight, an ancient ability of the green dragons, you may be able to see through the Dream's curtain and commune with grandfather directly. Among the Green Dragonflight was once a kind paragon, Vithekus, who was particularly fond of the mortal races. Known as the Eternal Sleeper, he entered an endless meditation and eventually left his physical body behind before anchoring his spirit to the Dream. He is the one you need to speak with. Find his remains and light this incense I created with the leftover mushrooms, it should allow you to summon his spirit.

The last time I saw Vithekus was well before the Sundering, so I do not know where his remains lie in the current age. Yet the woods whisper a name - Seradane. Seek this place and I am certain you shall find Vithekus. Do not forget to wear the Dreamveil! Its protection might not be strong, but it should suffice for your conversation with Vithekus.
41397.progress: It concerns me to not have heard of Vithekus for so long. I wish for his safety, the Dream is no longer the sanctuary that it used to be.
41397.completion:
I see. As solemn as it is, Vithekus' disdain is understandable. An ancient being like himself can all so easily be swayed from his benevolence after witnessing the misdeeds of mortals throughout the eons. Still I had hoped he would continue to see the potential your people hold.

Nevertheless, knowing he can be reasoned with and did not fall victim to the Nightmare lifts a burdening worry from my heart.

41398.title: Under The Vibrant Moonlight
41398.description:
It is time, friend. Now that you are able to gaze into the Dream itself, you may pay reverence to my grandfather - and receive the boon he intends to place upon you. While you were gone, I returned Malorne's spirit fragment back to him. He is complete once more, albeit still weak. Under much strain he informed me about the place he plans to meet you. I implore you, do not let him wait. We may have weakened the Nightmare's influence, but it would be unlikely for such a force to give up its prey that easily.

<name>, stand proud, as your deeds and commitment to this world's balance are exceptional. Being a chosen recipient of the Waywatcher's blessing is an honor like no other. Now venture into the Twilight Grove yonder the Great Sea. Peer into the Dreamsight Gem atop the stone ramp and bask in the White Stag's radiant grace.
41398.progress: <The great stag stares at you, instilling awe in your very being. You stand before a demigod.>
41398.completion:
<Tranquility sets upon the Twilight Grove. The Nightmare has been fended off once more, but for how long, no one can tell. Your heart tells you the battle for the Emerald Dream is not yet over, yet you find solace in knowing its stalwart defenders will continue the righteous battle. In front of you towers arguably nature's greatest force. The teal fur, glistening like a starlit sky; his eyes reflecting a deep blue sea of infinite wisdom. You expect the force of his power to crush you, but instead that all so familiar warmth, like a sunny breeze gliding over dew laden grass in the morning, washes over you.

Turning your eyes upwards, your gaze meets the demigod's and a feeling of power rushes through your body. An incomparable sensation; of growth, appreciation and love. As quickly as it came, so did it vanish. Feeling reborn, you pay your respects to the Waywatcher before leaving him to his duties.>

41399.title: Ring of the Dreamwalker
41399.description:
Many heroes fell in the last war and many continue to perish at the hands of the Scourge to this day. From the corpses of the fallen, the armor is stripped and taken back to Naxxramas to be used for unknown purposes.

Among these objects somehow a desecrated signet can be found. You must return it to me and I'll purify it into something you can use.

Now take it and get out of my sight.

41467.title: Frostfire Ring
41467.description:
As a Watcher, I was allowed access to many of Medivh's personal effects. Among those items, I found the tomes most enlightening. While the majority of the books were filled with - to put it bluntly - tripe, there were some gems. One of those tomes documented the creation of a set of armor fit for an archmage: Frostfire.

<Angela points to her head.>

You might be able to find a ring bearing that name, were it not to suit your abilities–with the knowledge I hold we can mold it for you.

Would you honor me by returning the armor of those that fell in the defense of these lands?

In your many hardships you will also find a desecrated signet. With it, your armor will be complete.

It may have not been forged to mold around the use of your skills, fret not. Return it to me and I will change it for you.
41517.progress: Have you brought me that which I require?
41517.completion: This ring is infused with the power of my ancestors! Tread wisely...

41518.title: Mastery of Staves
41518.description:
Now tell me: How does it feel to be proven worthy by the master? When he chose me as his apprentice, it was the greatest honor I ever felt, you surely feel the same.

If the master wishes to share his knowledge with you, I can assist you with that - for a price, ofcourse. He may be benevolent, but not foolish enough to act in charity, you have to contribute your share of work as well. Hidden within the most dangerous places of Azeroth you will find texts, those from ancient times, containing long forgotten teachings. Find them and with a bit of gold from your end, I can get you on the right track to unlock new battle strategies for you.
41518.progress: Nothing in this world is free. Your growth has to be earned.
41518.completion: A wise contribution. This text will be of ample use for the master. As for your reward, take this book; a summary of the master's knowledge he amassed over the years. Once you are done studying, return it to Nora upstairs.

41519.title: Staff Meeting
41519.description: <The heavy book is a testament to Master Mathias' rigorous devotion to the art of war. Just trying to get an overview by flipping through the pages makes a daunting expression on you. Who would have thought that something as simple as fighting with staves could fill entire volumes? What captures your interest most is a brief section about the Pandaren, an enigmatic race of bear-like humanoids from across the sea. Apparently, they are renowned as the unparalleled masters of staff combat. Intrigued, you decide to bring the book to Nora.>
41519.progress: Greetings! I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
41519.completion:
Pandaren? Yes, I heard about them, but many consider them a legend, or a fairytale for the kids. But I heard from some very credible people that they actually exist!

That's not really important, right? You want to know more about the art of staff fighting. Not my strongest suit for sure... Master Mathias could tell you more, but his time is very valuable, so you have to prove yourself! And actually, I have an amazing idea how you can earn his respect!

41520.title: Stormstout Legacy
41520.description:
We are often visited by the Theramore soldiers, and they always tell this story.

Picture this: during the siege, those who stood by Jaina and Thrall's New Horde had an extraordinary ally—a pandaren Brewmaster named Chen Stormstout. I'm talking about someone who fought with such passion and skill, it was like watching a whirlwind of power and precision! Chen's mastery with his staff was nothing short of legendary.

But get this—after the battle, the guy just planted his Brewmaster staff right into the ground and walked off into the horizon. Can you believe it? They say the fight was so brutal and intense that he just couldn't bear to be reminded of it ever again.

Now, I'm not saying this story is gospel, but if there's any truth to it, Master Brightheart would be over the moon if we could recover that Pandaren staff! Just imagine what we could learn from its design and construction. It could totally revolutionize our understanding of weapon craftsmanship!
41520.progress: Pupil, a pleasure to see you hard at work. Nora told me all about it. Did you finish the task she sent you out to do?
41520.completion:
Are my eyes deceiving me? No, they cannot be. It is indeed the staff of the legendary Chen Stormstout—brewmaster, warrior, and a friend to many. So, it seems the old tales were true after all. Well done, <name>.

Now, considering the effort you've put into recovering this relic, it would be a travesty to simply shelve it, don't you think? So, let's see what secrets it holds. Shall we?

41522.title: Throwing Hands
41522.description: <The weighty tome stands as a testament to Master Mathias' unwavering dedication to the art of war. Merely flipping through its pages leaves a formidable impression, showcasing meticulous accounts of Amani trolls, techniques for wielding various thrown weapons, and the intricate art of throwing glaives. However, historical knowledge alone does not equate to mastery. Since you must return the book to Nora, perhaps she can aid you in applying its teachings practically.>
41522.progress: Greetings! I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
41522.completion:
Mastery of throwing weapons? Why on Azeroth would you want to focus on that?

<She eyes you, surprised and curious.>

Well, I have to be honest with you. I've never spent much time on understanding the intricacies of thrown weapons. I just never felt it was worth the effort. So, I can't really help you with it myself. However, with direct tutoring from Master Brightheart, we could get you up to speed in no time!

I can arrange a private lesson with him for you, but there's a catch. You'll have to help us in return!

41523.title: Throwing Axes of the Amani
41523.description:
Master Brightheart has expressed a keen interest in obtaining a set of peculiar throwing axes crafted by the Amani trolls. Regrettably, ever since Arthas ravaged Quel'Thalas, news from Zul'Aman has been scarce, and no merchant in their right mind ventures there to trade with the Amani. These axes were rare even before the war; now, they are almost unattainable.

However, there is a glimmer of hope. These axes are typically wielded by high-ranking Amani Chieftains. One such chieftain, War Master Voone, is loyal to the Old Horde rather than Zul'Jin. It is rumored that he possesses these coveted weapons, though he is unlikely to part with them willingly.

Should you succeed in acquiring them, deliver them to Master Brightheart. He will provide you with further instructions for sure!
41523.progress: Pupil, a pleasure to see you hard at work. Nora told me all about it. Did you finish the task she sent you out to do?
41523.completion:
<Mathias Brightheart studies the axes carefully>

Ah, you may be wondering what makes these axes so special. To the untrained eye, they may seem like ordinary throwing axes, perhaps a bit larger. But there is more to them than meets the eye.

Observe how perfectly balanced they are, right at the midpoint of the hilt. The Amani, a truly ingenious tribe, mastered the art of balancing these axes so precisely that they spin rapidly and unpredictably in flight, making them nearly impossible to dodge or parry. Countless elven lives have been claimed by these weapons, and many more will fall to their deadly precision...

But I digress. You have done well to recover these for me. Now listen closely, for I will not repeat myself!

41525.title: One Bullet at a Time
41525.description: <The heavy book is a testament to Master Mathias' rigorous devotion to the art of war. Just trying to get an overview by flipping through the pages makes a daunting expression on you. The book goes on and on contradicting itself most of the time since it claims the gun is both useful and flawed. While its destruction power is grandly considered its loudness and requirement of powder is a considerable drawback. As a researcher, Nora might have more insight to offer.>
41525.progress: Greetings! I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
41525.completion: Effective and loud–why yes, that would be a gun. What got you so curious?

41526.title: Blackrock Powder
41526.description:
I am rather confused, truth be told. It is true guns are loud yet still effective, but how does one accept that and willingly use them? We must see someone using this in action, perhaps it will inspire you to use them as well.

Information I hold speaks plainly about the most logical place to find a gun user–Blackrock Depths, it holds the capital of the Dark Irons dwarves. Bound to have at least one gun user, but just so that I don't send you blindly inside I know the name of the man that you must hunt. Journey to the Blackrock Depths, find and slay Houndmaster Grebmar and return some blackrock powder to the master if you happen to find some.
41526.progress: Pupil, a pleasure to see you hard at work. Nora told me all about it. Did you finish the task she sent you out to do?
41526.completion:
Powder from the Blackrock Mountain, exquisite. Its explosive power is more destructive than usual. So, how was it, facing someone with a gun?

<Mathias frowns at your answer.>

He used an axe and hounds to fight? How disappointing, I will have to scold Nora later. It matters not, come pupil let me give you that which you crave for.

41528.title: Crossing The Line
41528.description: <The heavy book is a testament to Master Mathias' rigorous devotion to the art of war. Just trying to get an overview by flipping through the pages makes a daunting expression on you. A detailed history of the crossbow's invention and refinement can be surmised from it, yet you feel like the true essence and connections of it all elude you. As you need to return the book to this Nora either way, perhaps she can assist you in comprehending it more.>
41528.progress: Greetings! I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
41528.completion:
Mastery of Crossbows, yes… Very technical literature. Can't blame you for not grasping its lessons right away - took me two years of study to understand Master's intellectual meanderings. But I guess you don't really have that much time… Of course! What about doing Master Brightheart a favor? Arranging a meeting with him afterwards for some personal training would be definitely possible. With direct tutoring you could be one step closer in mastering the crossbow.

Coming back to that favor; I reckon you're familiar with the Scarlet Crusade?

41529.title: A Crimson Stake Through Their Heart
41529.description:
You might've read about them already in the book before, but there are a whole of three chapters dedicated to the achievements of the Willey family and their breakthroughs in crossbow development. None other manufacturers in recent history perfected the creation of crossbows like they did. Formerly in service to King Tereneas II of Lordaeron, they fell victim to his son's crusade and were soon forgotten about. A legacy of generations, wiped out in an instant. Atleast we assumed so - with the rise of the Scarlet Crusade, the name Willey rose up again. Now a general within said zealous organisation, he commands their artillery; utilizing the knowledge of countless generations before him.

Master Mathias showed interest in one of his family's crossbows, but never came to find a way to find one - until now. Willey is holding the Scarlet Bastion against the undead hordes of Stratholme. Seek his armory and find a Willey family crossbow; once you have it, bring it directly to Mathias!
41529.progress: Pupil, a pleasure to see you hard at work. Nora told me all about it. Did you finish the task she sent you out to do?
41529.completion: What a tragic decision to join the Scarlet Crusade. Talent like his would've been more useful elsewhere, but that is irrelevant now. I reckon you disposed of him? Oh, don't give me that look. His fate was sealed, and Willey knew that as well. While I wish he could tell me his family secrets in person, I am no fool to think he'd ever agree to that. So for now, this beautiful crossbow must suffice - and what a beautiful one this is. I will have a great time analyzing it thoroughly. Now for your reward - shall we begin?

41531.title: Let The Arrow Fly
41531.description: <The heavy book is a testament to Master Mathias' rigorous devotion to the art of war. Just trying to get an overview by flipping through the pages makes a daunting expression on you. A manifesto over centuries of Night Elf archery, the early beginnings of Arathi bow crafting and the strange techniques used by the Zandalari trolls are but a fraction of the wisdom contained in these pages. Feeling overwhelmed, you ponder if this Nora Sakgoth mentioned could help you make the most use out of it.>
41531.progress: Greetings! I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
41531.completion:
Oh! Mastery of Bows - yes, I know that one very well. A heavy topic among the ranged weapons, considering the bow is older than its younger counterpart, the gun. Many civilizations, especially those not prolific in magic, have this weapon ingrained in their culture. Still, before I digress too much into the finer details - you seek assistance with understanding the essence of one of the master's compendiums?

I'm afraid I'm not the most suitable person to help you, given that I lack the practical prowess to demonstrate the teachings to you. And the master is incredibly busy, as you surely know… But I think I can help with that, if you assist us in turn.

41532.title: The Bow of Oaks
41532.description:
I have read about an ancient bow, a weapon from times long forgotten. It dates way back to the time before the Sundering! A certain type of Highborne bow that forces the wielder to adapt to a specific technique, otherwise it would not properly shoot its arrows! It seems the archers of that time used this method to achieve incredible speed and accuracy - exactly what the master's looking for.

While I arrange a lesson with the master, it's up to you to actually get your hands on one of those bows. But a Highborne weapon… There are many of their ruins strewn about Kalimdor, the largest being the Ruins of Dire Maul. I'd say those are your best bet. Best of luck to you, zealous student. Should you succeed, please bring the bow directly to Master Mathias!
41532.progress: Pupil, a pleasure to see you hard at work. Nora told me all about it. Did you finish the task she sent you out to do?
41532.completion:
Oh! What a marvelous weapon you carry. Nora told me all about it. Time has gnawed heavily upon this weary thing, but with a few touch ups here and there, it will regain its strength to be properly wielded yet again. Where do you say you found it? On a Highborne specter in the Ruins of Dire Maul? How thrilling, please tell me all about it once we are done with the training.

Now then, listen well. You will not get another chance to be tutored about this. You earned my time and I value it highly - don't disappoint me!

41534.title: Polearm, Polearm...
41534.description: <The heavy book is a testament to Master Mathias' rigorous devotion to the art of war. Just trying to get an overview by flipping through the pages makes a daunting expression on you. Polearms are described as effective and strong. Due to their long shaft the wielder can strike without engaging in direct close combat. It is stated that human armies preferred using them in battle against orcs due to their difference in size. You feel like this type of weapon isn't given the respect it deserves and such you seek Nora to learn more.>
41534.progress: Greetings! I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
41534.completion: You believe polearms to be neglected as a weapon? Bah, you're starting to sound like the master more and more.

41535.title: Appreciated in Time
41535.description:
I believe I can understand the way you feel. Perhaps in truth the polearms aren't given the respect they deserve since other warriors would claim it as a last choice. But it is a matter of preference and skill. You see, Mathias says every type of weapon serves a purpose and its strength comes from its wielder.

Friend of mine from Tanaris sent me a word. It seems the local dragon population has opened its caverns to adventurers, seeking to send them beyond the reason of time and space. This friend of mine is a great gossiper you see. Whispers speak of a tall dragonkin holding a spear, one that appears like a toothpick in its hands.

It appears this creature called Chronar claimed the weapon after he was stabbed with it by a human in one of his personal time shenanigan adventures. Forgive my nonchalance when it comes to it but I hold no dear interest in time travel magic and whatever includes it. Journey there and see how Chronar wields it.
41535.progress: Pupil, a pleasure to see you hard at work. Nora told me all about it. Did you finish the task she sent you out to do?
41535.completion: Was it ridiculous to fight a large opponent wielding a smaller armament? I doubt it–after all, I believe you have now seen that the polearms are getting the respect they deserve. Come pupil, I will tell you the story of the Dancing Spear and afterwards I will teach you the dance.

41537.title: Scourge of Darrowshire
41537.description: <The heavy book is a testament to Master Mathias' rigorous devotion to the art of war. Just trying to get an overview by flipping through the pages makes a daunting expression on you. It describes the Battle of Darrowshire and a certain Scourge Warlord that sealed the fate of it. The book describes his actions as vile and cruel yet misses no opportunity to describe the swords that Marduk the Black used. Confused by the admiration offered to such a monster the blood inside your veins begins to boil as you make your way towards Nora.>
41537.progress: Greetings! I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
41537.completion:
A hard potion to swallow that one, isn't it? To both condemn and praise a being almost in perfect balance. It may make you question the concept of right and wrong, wouldn't it? Well, it shouldn't. Remember that the purpose of the book is connected to the skills of war–the fact it vilifies Marduk to that point is already something noticeable and out of place.

Close your heart to it, and open your mind to your next task.

41538.title: Mourning Blade
41538.description:
There is little we know about the Battle of Darrowshire. After all, none but few survived it. Whispers claim the Scourge Warlord corrupted a human soul which had in turn ended all the efforts of the protectors. The story is told differently everywhere you go. Which is why it is not our focus.

Marduk holds what any other death knight would, a runeblade. One twisted and darkened by the depravity of the Scourge, one named Mournblade. How do we know? Well, you may see he boldly exclaims its name in battle. Your task will be to find him and return the blade for research. Last we know he has drawn back to Scholomance–as a trainer, nonetheless.
41538.progress: Pupil, a pleasure to see you hard at work. Nora told me all about it. Did you finish the task she sent you out to do?
41538.completion: A good deed, one that I will reward with my teachings. A welcomed justice for the people of Darrowshire was served, one that I dearly hope brings them some peace. Nora will handle the runeblade, you should not concern yourself with it further. Now, ready your arms pupil, I will not hold back.

41540.title: Hammer, Fall!
41540.description: <The heavy book is a testament to Master Mathias' rigorous devotion to the art of war. Just trying to get an overview by flipping through the pages makes a daunting expression on you. The book speaks of the importance of hammers in dwarven culture. While you aren't able to make out most of it, the book ends with a legend. Allegedly dwarves used to claim hills and mountains by tossing their hammers into the air, and wherever it landed that was to be their new home. Intrigued by the legend you make your way to Nora.>
41540.progress: Greetings! I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
41540.completion: Truly our dwarven cousins have a grand admiration for hammers. But I am afraid that legend is just a legend–until proven otherwise of course.

41541.title: Fingerbreaker
41541.description:
Not all dwarves deserve to be admirable, hence some are devoid of honour and morality. Although it pains me to speak so of others, the Dark Irons have earned a reputation that would make most see as unsalvageable.

Only the future may tell if this is to be true or not–a concern for tomorrow, then. In a frail attempt to serve the will of their master the dwarves of the Blackrock Mountain have called upon their twilight allies and dug a quarry to the east of their land. A despicable man known as Bargul oversees the work there. Rumours claim he bears a hammer called Fingerbreaker–since he uses it to break the fingers of those that do not meet their quota.

You are to break his bones and retrieve that hammer. While I do not usually wish for others to meet their end, that one deserves what is coming to him.
41541.progress: Pupil, a pleasure to see you hard at work. Nora told me all about it. Did you finish the task she sent you out to do?
41541.completion: I suppose you could tell Nora was acting a tad personal when it came to the High Foreman, but if she didn't share her story I most certainly won't. You did well to return Fingerbreaker. Let us begin our lesson and afterwards you may tell me how Bargul was with that hammer.

41543.title: The Warsong Echoes
41543.description: <The heavy book is a testament to Master Mathias' rigorous devotion to the art of war. Just trying to get an overview by flipping through the pages makes a daunting expression on you. A study of the Orcish Horde's love for axes. Through the pages one name is being honoured several times. Overwhelmed by the deep respect portrayed between the lines you find yourself eagerly pacing towards Nora, so that you may know more.>
41543.progress: Greetings! I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
41543.completion:
I was wondering when you were going to find that one. Believe it or not it is a favourite of the master. You would believe that not to be the case given the history between humans and orcs. Alas, the master sees beyond the concept of race, after all to him there is only the mastery of war.

Are you ready for a humble pilgrimage?

41544.title: Honoring the Warrior
41544.description:
To many a villainous enemy, to some a chieftain and for few a brother in arms. That is merely the beginning of a description of the man that Grommash Hellscream was. As Mathias travelled here and there, through towns that allowed both Alliance and Horde, he would sometimes be met with the story of Grom, both plague and hero to his people.

Looking beyond the past and actions of this one orc, only one truth stands atop all others–he was a natural born warrior. Even those that'd spit at the hearing of his name would not shy away from recognizing his skill in battle. Set your feet straight, <name>, and ready yourself to pay homage–return with speck of dirt as proof of your travels. Bearing such a gift would reward you the master's attention for a while.
41544.progress: Pupil, a pleasure to see you hard at work. Nora told me all about it. Did you finish the task she sent you out to do?
41544.completion: An ominous yet symbolic gift. Does his battle spirit still echoes that canyon? Ah, I often dream of meeting him in battle. Ready your weapon pupil, and learn. I will honour you as a warrior as you honoured a warrior of the past.

41545.description:
