Find them and with a bit of gold from your end, I can get you on the right track to unlock new battle strategies for you.
41545.progress: Nothing in this world is free. Your growth has to be earned.
41545.completion: A wise contribution. This text will be of ample use for the master. As for your reward, take this book; a summary of the master's knowledge he amassed over the years. Once you are done studying, return it to Nora upstairs.

41546.title: Fists Against the World
41546.description: <The heavy book is a testament to Master Mathias' rigorous devotion to the art of war. Just trying to get an overview by flipping through the pages makes a daunting expression on you. You begin to realise that you have always been carrying a weapon. Since the dawn of the first races of Azeroth the beginning of evolution itself started with a fist. How else would they have survived and adapted? You stare at your fists with admiration–you need not a weapon if you are the weapon. You are ready to speak with Nora about your newfound admiration of your fists.>
41546.progress: Greetings! I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
41546.completion: You're an amusing sort <name>. Your fists against the world, eh? Admirable...

41547.title: Legend of Eskhandar
41547.description:
Let me tell you a story. The story of a nightsaber called Eskhandar, one that hunted in the lands of Feralas. It was such a prestigious beast that it would claw down all of its enemies within seconds. But as with all living things, death follows. And when this beast met its end it was torn apart to use as items. It is believed you can find its mittens somewhere in this vast world and perhaps borrow the power of its former owner.

I believe finding its grave and paying respect to it might earn you its boon from the world beyond our own–if you believe in that sort of thing of course. It fell near the left twin colossal in Feralas. The night elves say that when it died, its blood wet and nourished a dying sapling, a tree growing there now. Seek it and perhaps you will gain something. Return to Mathias afterwards.
41547.progress: Pupil, a pleasure to see you hard at work. Nora told me all about it. Did you finish the task she sent you out to do?
41547.completion: A mighty legend among the elves of Kalimdor. You show great spirit taking on it with nothing but your fists! Come, let us spar--perhaps I can teach you something new.

41548.title: Mastery of Daggers
41548.description:
Now tell me: How does it feel to be proven worthy by the master? When he chose me as his apprentice, it was the greatest honor I ever felt, you surely feel the same.

If the master wishes to share his knowledge with you, I can assist you with that - for a price, ofcourse. He may be benevolent, but not foolish enough to act in charity, you have to contribute your share of work as well. Hidden within the most dangerous places of Azeroth you will find texts, those from ancient times, containing long forgotten teachings. Find them and with a bit of gold from your end, I can get you on the right track to unlock new battle strategies for you.
41548.progress: Nothing in this world is free. Your growth has to be earned.
41548.completion: A wise contribution. This text will be of ample use for the master. As for your reward, take this book; a summary of the master's knowledge he amassed over the years. Once you are done studying, return it to Nora upstairs.

41549.title: Vital Anatomy
41549.description: <The heavy book is a testament to Master Mathias' rigorous devotion to the art of war. Just trying to get an overview by flipping through the pages makes a daunting expression on you. While much of it revolves around the different shapes and lengths of daggers, as well as parrying and stabbing techniques, the majority of the book is about anatomy: Placement of vital organs, muscle groups, sinew and arteries. Intrigued and overwhelmed all the same, you decide to talk to this Nora about the work of Master Mathias, in hope of understanding more of it.>
41549.progress: Greetings! I am usually busy deciphering these old texts Sakgoth is bringing me, but I got a moment to spare.
41549.completion: Quite the odd one, right? The master's a knowledgeable man even beyond the art of war. Even I was astonished by the range of anatomical research I could find within this book. Still, theory is certainly fine, but what does it accomplish if not applied into practice? Luckily - well, lucky may not be the proper word to use in a situation like this - I can make sure the master teaches you the practical aspects of his work, if you assist us in a more delicate matter.

41550.title: The Ripper
41550.description:
We've set our eyes on a peculiar set of daggers for a while now. Most would view them as knives, but to a schooled eye like our master's, they are deadly weapons of silent murder. They belong to a man named Damian, although he is most commonly known as The Ripper. His past is draped in a bloody curtain, a monster without morals. Yet, even a monster like him can have its purpose.

Damian is held within the Stormwind Vaults, a high facility prison inside the city of the same name. We've heard its occupants broke free due to some supernatural intervention; leaving him to pursue his desires upon anyone left alive. <name>, venture inside, relinquish Damian of this set of daggers and bring them to Mathias. Do so and I will make sure he tutors you.
41550.progress: Pupil, a pleasure to see you hard at work. Nora told me all about it. Did you finish the task she sent you out to do?
41550.completion: You look lively, considering the place you've been to to get your hands on this. I expect this Damian to have been quite skilled with daggers, a shame his delusions and frail mind rendered him into an abomination. My gratitude for removing this pustule from our world. Aberrations like him cannot be allowed to wreak havoc, neither now nor in the future. I expect you to continue assisting in keeping Azeroth a safer place. Now then, join me - let us take a look at what those beauties can do.

41551.title: Pupil Once More
41551.description: A pleasure to see you return, my pupil. Rarely do my old students come back to their master for relearning things they already internalized. But I cannot fault you. One's mind has only so much expanse and it is only natural for someone as young as yourself to experience other venues as well. Now then, shall we proceed?
41551.completion: I knew you wouldn't forget my teachings that easily. Still, the renewal was very much needed. An art as intricate as Goldsmithing cannot be mastered unless one focuses on it entirely. I am grateful for your continued interest in this ancient craft, my pupil. May you find enlightenment in it.

41552.title: Renewed Teachings
41552.description: <An expression of joy muses across Thegren's face, atleast you surmise is to be one of glee. His gesticulations suggest him wanting you to kneel before him, like you've done many times. The ancient Earthen is eager to become your mentor once more.>
41552.completion: <You kneel down and his stony palm gently touches your forehead. In an ecstatic rush of power, all the basic knowledge you acquired by his teachings long ago come rushing back to you.>

41553.title: Welcome to the Brewing Festival!
41553.description: Hear ye, hear ye! A one of a kind competition unfolds in the bustling port of Ratchet! Any connoisseur of fine ale, grog and stouts should not miss out on this unparalleled occasion. Grab you drinking buddies and help out in making the perfect alcohol in all of Azeroth!
41553.completion: If that bloody bastard thinks he can one-up me, he can think again! Once I have formulated the recipe for the perfect brew, he can come here and kiss my boot!

41554.title: Welcome to the Brewing Festival!
41554.description: Hear ye, hear ye! A one of a kind competition unfolds in the bustling port of Ratchet! Any connoisseur of fine ale, grog and stouts should not miss out on this unparalleled occasion. Grab you drinking buddies and help out in making the perfect alcohol in all of Azeroth!
41554.completion: If that bloody bastard thinks he can one-up me, he can think again! Once I have formulated the recipe for the perfect brew, he can come here and kiss my boot!

41555.title: Razorfen Grog
41555.description:
It is my life-long goal to create the most potent, delicious and savoring beverage known to Azeroth: the Hornfang Reserve! Its rich flavour and unique texture will enchant anyone indulging in its foamy top and bitter taste. That is when I am done getting the formula right. I hate to admit it, but my previous attempts at it were falling flat in one way or another. There is always something missing that really brings all of the ingredients together. I just need to find out what it is! That is why I came here to Ratchet, so I can gather all sorts of rumors and stories about potential components that might be missing for my brew.

Apparently the local quillboar of the Razorfen Kraul are brewing their own alcohol. Who would've thought that these primitive pig people are able to produce grog on their own? I need to find out what this grog is all about, how it is made and whether it has the secret ingredient I am looking for!
41555.progress: I sure hope they don't brew it from briarthorn; I once tried it myself and it was absolutely horrible!
41555.completion:
Aha! There it is, the elusive Razorfen Grog. Pass it over, I'll give it a thorough test.

<Hal'togg uncorks the bottle and takes a deep whiff of the ale's scent. He grimaces, but quickly regains composure. Putting the bottle to his lips, he takes a small sip of the alcohol.>

Yes, ofcourse. This is definitely brewed with briarthorn, it has the same distinct flavor. But something is different. Perhaps?

41556.title: The Hottest Hot!
41556.description: I think I have a good understanding of how this grog was made. It's not unlike what I used to brew before with briarthorn, however they must be utilizing a different method. Maybe they used a higher temperature...? Yes, that must be it! A higher temperature when brewing the briarthorn could reduce the bitterness to an enjoyable amount. How they achieved such a potent flame I still don't understand, however. They surely must've used magic. As I have no magical means on my end, we have to find something else. The elements of this world sometimes leave a flicker of their essence behind. One such thing could potentially heat the flame to the required level. <name>, go out and bring me elemental fire from any fire elemental out there - we need it to fan the fire!
41556.progress: That I would learn brewing techniques from Quilboar is something I wouldn't have expected to happen today.
41556.completion: Yes! These are nice and hot, perfect for stoking the fire. I will keep these for now and use them at a later point; right now we have more urgent things to do!

41557.title: Scarlet Schnapps
41557.description:
Thaldon over there just blabbered about discovering something groundbreaking about the Lordaeron Ale from the Eastern Kingdoms. I cannot let this little man get an advantage over me, which is why we will go even higher! While he is content with his lousy and boring Lordaeron Ale, our goal is the enigmatic Scarlet Schnapps, a brew that so few had the chance to drink, it is said to be a legend.

A culinary peculiarity of the Scarlet Crusade, I have heard they are brewing it in their monastery in the Tirisfal Glades as some sort of light-inducing drink. If this brew really has these magical properties, then I need to get my hands on it!
41557.progress: These zealots protect their secrets viciously, but we are even more vicious in our quest for the ultimate brew.
41557.completion:
You really found it! A legendary schnapps, rarely seen or tasted by the outside world. Let's give it a try!

<A deep chug and half of the schnapps is missing. Hal'togg's green face turns slightly red. This brew seems to be a kicker!>

Wow, this drink surely packs a punch, now I know why they say it fires you up. A burning taste combined with a sweet aftertaste. If I didn't know better I'd say they mixed a special sort of hops into it. Finding out which type of hops they used might be difficult however...

41558.title: Silver Hops
41558.description: The Silverpine Forests have a unique vegetation that thrives in the mountainous and harsh reaches of the area. Their flavour is deceptively bitter, so it is rarely used by inexperienced breweries. We, however, can make ample use of this plant. It might not have the properties needed to replicate the fiery feeling of the Scarlet Schnapps, but with the brewing technique of the quillboar, we might be able to distill it enough to acquire a distinct flavour for our own brew.
41558.progress: Any luck with the Silver Hops?
41558.completion: Ah, I remember their distinctively strong smell. The earthy tones will perfectly compliment my other ingredients once I brew it at a high enough temperature.

41559.title: Red Hops
41559.description:
Finding a plant with a pungent fiery taste can be difficult. Many I've come across in my brewing adventure had a certain spice to them, but nothing to the level of the Scarlet Schnapps. Luckily I picked up some rumours from the goblins at the docks; you'd be surprised how many stories they pick up with all the trade happening here.

Over in the Eastern Kingdom, the Badlands are home to a vibrant red type of hops. Apparently the resident ogres pick up these clumps of hops and chew on them - raw! These bulky meatheads surprise me anew every time I have to deal with them. Relieve them of their hops and bring it to me, we'll make better use of it.
41559.completion: Very good. I'm tempted to try chewing one myself, but luckily my voice of reasoning is loud enough to prevent me from doing it.

41560.title: Black Hops
41560.description: Let us try something unorthodox. Recreating the heat of the Scarlet Schnapps will prove to be a challenge without the same exact recipe, yet I am certain we can try something different instead. The Searing Gorge is a scalding hot desert with little to no vegetation. Nevertheless, some plants seem to grow splendidly on the vulcanic soil - one of them being the black hops. My assumption is that hops absorb the nutrients from the heated ground, naturally imbuing them with a natural smoky spice. The best way to find it out is to grab some and test it out ourselves!
41560.progress: Their living conditions may cause them to be brittle, care on how you handle them.
41560.completion: Saying they are smoky was an understatement. Such a potent aroma. I'll tell you what, <name>, we might've struck gold with this one!

41561.title: Runn Tum Rum And The Perfect Brew
41561.description:
Okay, <name>. We're very close to perfecting the formular, I can feel it! We have the silver hops with its heavy earthen bitter flavour, the spice and smoky texture of the red and black hops, as well as the heat and technique needed to distill it into a clear but pungent brew! All we need is that sweet aftertaste to complete the package; and I know the perfect source for it!

Down in the verdant wilds of Feralas lies the dreaded ruins of Dire Maul. Within its cursed gardens grows a root, I believe they call it the Runn Tum Tuber. This root is said to possess a powerful sweet taste, that even survives the highest of temperatures when cooked. We need this root to complete the Hornfang Reserve! We stand at the precipice of greatness, <name>. Don't waste time!
41561.progress: I cannot contain my excitement. My year long endeavors will finally bear fruit!
41561.completion:
The Runn Tum Tubers! At last, the final ingredient for my magnum opus. Quickly, hand them over.

<Hal'togg cuts up the roots and throws them into his distillery. The intense heat of the apparatus causes the tubers to quickly cook, adding their unique flavour to the mixture. The brew turns into a dark, golden hue, exuding a strong scent you've never smelled before.>

Aha, Success! <name>, we've done it; we've created the perfect brew! Once the distillat cooled down, you'll be the first person to taste my greatest creation! You have my thanks, friend. Together we've shown that the dwarves are not the so-called masters of ale that they think they are! Cheers!

41562.title: Yellow Hops
41562.description:
It is my life-long goal to create the most potent, delicious and savoring beverage known to Azeroth: the Thunderbrew Golden Lager! Its rich flavour and unique texture will enchant anyone indulging in its foamy top and bitter taste. Atleast I wish that was the case, but my previous attempts at it were falling flat in one way or another. There is always something missing that really brings all of the ingredients together. I just need to find out what it is! That is why I came here to Ratchet, those dunderheads in Ironforge are all blabbering nonsense out of their unwashed beards. They can't see greatness if it bites them in the arse!

To brew a truly delicious lager, many different types of hops are needed. Since the more common variants of it did not have the potent kick I desire for my brew, I need to look for something unusual. The Quillboar from the deep south of these lands seem to be versed in the art of brewing, or so I heard. They must have their own hops to brew from!
41562.progress: Any luck with the Yellow Hops?
41562.completion: Ouch! These are quite spiky, how peculiar. Just their soft texture and lovely fragrance tell me these will have a strong sweet taste, perfect!

41563.title: Hillsbrad Hops
41563.description:
A sour flavour is something needed in every ale, some have more, some have less of it. The Lordaeron Ale is of the former kind, you won't find any alcohol as sour as this beauty. Personally it's not my type of drink, but I can appreciate the variety created by different cultures... Even if the way humans are brewing their alcohol is just child's play. Ha!

Still, we can use their resources just the same. In the southeastern hills of Hillsbrad grows the Hillsbrad Hops, a truly unique hops with the most pungent sour flavour in all of the Eastern Kingdom. I will need these for my new brewing attempt!
41563.progress: I once tried Lordaeron Ale. Oh boy, let me tell you, the fight that followed was a nasty one.
41563.completion: Ah, nothing like the rich smell of a freshly picked bundle of hops! Great work out there.

41564.title: Stout Hops
41564.description: I may be a proud Ironforge dwarf, but even I have to acknowledge the fine ales and grogs our Wildhammer brethren are producing. Rarely have I had the pleasure of enjoying such an extremely bitter stout. Just one sip blew me off my boots, it was an experience like no other! This kind of bitterness needs to be in my perfect ale, it has to! A good friend of mine told me that the most bitter hops grow in the Hinterlands, just short of Aerie Peak. My brew cannot be complete without the powerful bitter flavour of this hops.
41564.progress: The soil of the Hinterlands is fertile, which makes for a sturdy and durable plant.
41564.completion:
<Thaldon takes a deep whiff of the uprooted hops. He looks ecstatic.>

What a dream, with this at hand I cannot lose!

41565.title: With A Twist Of Magic!
41565.description:
You may have caught on to it already, but this amateur of an orc over there thinks he can create a brew better than what us dwarves can produce. If you ask me, a fool's errand. But I am no fool myself, so we have to make sure his ambitions fall flat on its face.

I overheard him eagerly announce using elemental fire to stoke his distillery fire, so we will make use of the elements ourselves. Seems only fair, no? I already began brewing the hops you gave me, but they are not properly blending together. Elemental water may just be the thing to circumvent this problem - and on top of it, it may even add an extra kick to the concoction!
41565.progress: Some may brand me a heretic for putting elemental water into my ale, but to those I say: You lack vision!
41565.completion:
Excellent, let me try it immediately!

<Thaldon pours the magical water into this distillery, turning the dark brown beverage into a sparkling golden brew.>

Incredible, simply amazing! My brew will reach unmatched heights of taste and texture!

41566.title: Goldthorn Grog
41566.description: I've stumbled on a... let's say ‘small' issue with my current brew. Mixing the three types of hops together was a brilliant idea, yet the bitterness of the stout hops is overpowering every other flavour! If we keep the distillate as is, I might as well just brew with stout hops. Good thing for us, I picked up a rumour down at the port that might be exactly the solution to our problem. Goldthorn Grog is a brew that should taste incredibly bitter as all grogs are, yet its flavour is surprisingly smooth and mild, a perfect afternoon drink! I suspect the secret ingredient for that is the Goldthorn itself. With a few roots, I could test if my theory has any merit.
41566.progress: The Arathi Highlands are a place with lots of Goldthorn vegetation, if you're a skilled herbalist you could pick your own in its vast fields and hills.
41566.completion: Good samples, I will have them added into my mixture and tell you if anything changed. Their scent alone is giving me a good feeling about it!

41567.title: Our Dark Iron Rivals
41567.description: <name>! It's a disaster! I was just checking my tent for more ingredients when I noticed my plans for the Thunderbrew Golden Lager weren't there! It must have been those damned Hurley Blackbreath, he and his kin have been rivals to our family since countless years. They can't live with the fact that our beer is the superior one, not like their lukewarm sludge soup. We need to get it back. The recipe contains the last few crucial steps required to finalize my perfect brew. Blackbreath surely scuttled back into the Blackrock Depths, find him and bring me back my plans!
41567.progress: <Thandol is murmuring unintelligible curses into his beard.>
41567.completion: My plans, completely torn apart! I hope Blackbreath got what he deserved for disrespecting the result of year long hardship, blood, sweat and tears! Luckily I can still read the important parts of the formula. Thank you, <name>. I know you risked hide and hair going into that accursed mountain for me. With these back in my possession, we are finally at the end of the journey.

41568.title: Great Golden Hops
41568.description:
We have the hops, our magical component and the Goldthorn to reduce the bitterness of it all. With my plans back with me, there is just one thing left to finalize the Thunderbrew Golden Lager: The Golden Hops.

An ingredient of mythological status, many dwarves believe it to be a mere fairy tale told by the drunken mountaineers of Ironforge's taverns. But I know better - I have seen it! It appeared to me in a dream, after emptying ten ale kegs on my own. A golden rabbit, shimmering like the finest beer you've ever seen. There it stood, ominously between these great bones in a vast desert, like an omen. Yet I knew what it really meant. It beckoned me to seek it out; to create the Golden Lager with the Golden Hops! Find this rabbit, wherever it may be. The Golden Hops will be ours!
41568.progress: We are this close to achieve something of magnanimous gravity! I will go down in history as the creator of the legendary, ultimate ale!
41568.completion:
<Thandol's eyes widen in bewilderment at the sight of the Golden Hops.>

You've found it! You've really found it! This is a once in a lifetime occurrence, <name>. The Thunderbrew Golden Lager will become the ultimate brew with just a few small sprinkles of this legendary hops. Friend, I cannot thank you enough. Through your courage and resilience, I was able to realize my family's century old endeavor of creating the perfect ale. It is only fair for you to be the first to taste my magnum opus. Once my distillery cooled down and I tapped the first pint, you'll be able to taste a beer worthy for the Creators!

41569.title: Shut Up And Dance With Me
41569.description: Oy, I'm telling ya, there's nothing more invigorating than pouring beer after beer after beer down your threat and getting into the rhythm of the festival. Come, grab your pint and start shaking those hips! I wanna see you get completely smashed, dancing with everybody here. Cheers!
41569.progress: You better start shuffling your feet.
41569.completion: Now that's what I call a boogy!

41570.title: Murder On The Dancefloor
41570.description: Oy, I'm telling ya, there's nothing more invigorating than pouring beer after beer after beer down your threat and getting into the rhythm of the festival. Come, grab your pint and start shaking those hips! I wanna see you get completely smashed, dancing with everybody here. Cheers!
41570.progress: You better start shuffling your feet.
41570.completion: Now that's what I call a boogy!

41571.title: Dance The Night Away
41571.description: Oy, I'm telling ya, there's nothing more invigorating than pouring beer after beer after beer down your threat and getting into the rhythm of the festival. Come, grab your pint and start shaking those hips! I wanna see you get completely smashed, dancing with everybody here. Cheers!
41571.progress: You better start shuffling your feet.
41571.completion: Now that's what I call a boogy!

41572.title: A Hat For The Occasion
41572.description:
Oh my, good gracious! Is this how you want to go see the Guardian? Bold, I must say, but perhaps a tad too bold. I cannot for the love of all that encompasses fashion allow you to ascend the tower in those rags. Harsh as it may sound, it is the truth!

Just looking at that headdress you’re wearing gives me the creeps and shivers. Whoever designed this atrocity deserves to be put to trial. I can help you out and get you the designs of a new, more fashionable one - if you help me out with some of my own supplies. We have a deal?
41572.progress: Please, hurry up. Any moment longer of laying my eyes upon this hideous attire and I am going to puke.
41572.completion: Excellent materials, truly magnificent. Now, take one of these and craft yourself something not as revolting to look at.

41573.title: Legs For Days
41573.description:
Oh my, good gracious! Is this how you want to go see the Guardian? Bold, I must say, but perhaps a tad too bold. I cannot for the love of all that encompasses fashion allow you to ascend the tower in those rags. Harsh as it may sound, it is the truth!

Just looking at that legwear you’ve put on your body gives me the creeps and shivers. Whoever designed this atrocity deserves to be put to trial. I can help you out and get you the designs of a new, more fashionable one - if you help me out with some of my own supplies. We have a deal?
41573.progress: Please, hurry up. Any moment longer of laying my eyes upon this hideous attire and I am going to puke.
41573.completion: Excellent materials, truly magnificent. Now, take one of these and craft yourself something not as revolting to look at.

41574.title: The Weight Of Fashion On Their Shoulder
41574.description:
Oh my, good gracious! Is this how you want to go see the Guardian? Bold, I must say, but perhaps a tad too bold. I cannot for the love of all that encompasses fashion allow you to ascend the tower in those rags. Harsh as it may sound, it is the truth!

Just looking at these pauldrons you’re wearing gives me the creeps and shivers. Whoever designed this atrocity deserves to be put to trial. I can help you out and get you the designs of a new, more fashionable one - if you help me out with some of my own supplies. We have a deal?
41574.progress: Please, hurry up. Any moment longer of laying my eyes upon this hideous attire and I am going to puke.
41574.completion: Excellent materials, truly magnificent. Now, take one of these and craft yourself something not as revolting to look at.

41575.title: The Embrace Of Good Taste
41575.description:
Oh my, good gracious! Is this how you want to go see the Guardian? Bold, I must say, but perhaps a tad too bold. I cannot for the love of all that encompasses fashion allow you to ascend the tower in those rags. Harsh as it may sound, it is the truth!

Just looking at that chestpiece you’re wearing gives me the creeps and shivers. Whoever designed this atrocity deserves to be put to trial. I can help you out and get you the designs of a new, more fashionable one - if you help me out with some of my own supplies. We have a deal?
41575.progress: Please, hurry up. Any moment longer of laying my eyes upon this hideous attire and I am going to puke.
41575.completion: Excellent materials, truly magnificent. Now, take one of these and craft yourself something not as revolting to look at.

41576.title: A Cloak Of Immaculate Quality
41576.description:
Oh my, good gracious! Is this how you want to go see the Guardian? Bold, I must say, but perhaps a tad too bold. I cannot for the love of all that encompasses fashion allow you to ascend the tower in those rags. Harsh as it may sound, it is the truth!

That cloak you’ve draped around you gives me the creeps and shivers. Whoever designed this atrocity deserves to be put to trial. I can help you out and get you the designs of a new, more fashionable one - if you help me out with some of my own supplies. We have a deal?
41576.progress: Please, hurry up. Any moment longer of laying my eyes upon this hideous attire and I am going to puke.
41576.completion: Excellent materials, truly magnificent. Now, take this and craft yourself something not as revolting to look at.

41577.title: Sovereign of Desolation
41577.description:
In your hands lies the still-beating heart of the Dreadlord Mephistroth, ruler of the Rock of Desolation. You and your expedition foiled his plans of using Karazhan as an entry point to invade Azeroth yet again. Expelled into the Great Dark Beyond forever, this is all that remains of the nefarious schemer.

You should bring it to someone able to expunge its life, just to be sure.
41577.progress: This horrible stench! <name>, what have you brought with you?!
41577.completion:
What a horrid prospect. To think we stood at the precipice of another invasion by the Burning Legion. <name>, your actions and those of your compatriots did not only save Azeroth from another war, but also quelled the threat of one of the most powerful dreadlords known to us. Second to only Tichondrius, the harbinger of the Legion’s invasion seven years ago, legends of his might circulated the Council of Six in Dalaran. Unimaginable to see such a commanding figure finally meet its demise.

You were correct in bringing his vile heart to me. I am able to burn the fel essence from its flesh, albeit very taxing for my body. That is but a small sacrifice, however. Nothing is too little when given the opportunity to remove such a putrid presence from our world. Whatever remains of this, you can keep. As a trophy; a remembrance of the feat you accomplished this day.

41578.title: Helm of the Talon
41578.description:
This crown bears the symbol of the Kingdom of Azeroth, and it closely resembles the one King Llane used to wear. Perhaps even in his madness, Medivh still kept his friend close to his heart.

Fractured, almost crumbled—just like the Tower of Karazhan, a lost vigil of history. It is upon this history that we may reforge something anew. Bring me the materials I require, and I will ensure that this crown becomes of use to its new bearer.
41578.progress: Gathering the materials shall be no easy task.
41578.completion: Behold, your reward awaits: the crown, forged anew and ready to serve you in battle.

41579.title: Shoulderguards of the Talon
41579.description:

Alas, that is neither more nor less important—for not only did you manage to slay such a formidable foe, but you also retrieved its armor. This armor shall serve as the foundation for your next piece of the puzzle; in truth, it may even be considered the final piece. As before, bring me the materials I require, and claim a prize that will make even the mighty Eredar tremble in their boots.
41622.progress: Whatever the cost, it will be worth it.
41622.completion: Don it with pride; you have more than earned it.

41623.title: Legs of the Guardian
41623.description:
Doomguards were the elite bodyguards of their master—none could face a fiercer enemy, and yet you confronted one of their best. Surviving the wrath of the Highlord would have been a worthy feat in itself, and yet you managed to defeat him.

I sense that you possess something of his—a memento from a worthy battle, one that we could use as the basis for a piece of your armor. What say you? Bring me the materials I require, and we will ensure that you wear this fight both in spirit and upon your body.
41623.progress: Trust in yourself to find the materials; you must do so if you wish for us to continue.
41623.completion: May they serve you well until death claims you.

41624.title: Boots of the Guardian
41624.description:
Your journey through a fleeting glimpse of both the Twisting Nether and Outland was not without its hardships. Still, I can sense an item in your possession—a relic that emanates an otherworldly essence.

Allow me to examine these boots. It seems the adversary you faced was indeed formidable, perhaps even capable of traversing the planes. Yet, while its previous owner now lies dead, remnants of its magic persist. What say you? Bring me the materials I require, and I shall forge this item to suit your needs, ensuring you carry the essence of this battle with you.
41624.progress: Bear in mind that without the materials, we may not continue.
41624.completion: Steady your feet; your new boots suit you well.

41625.title: Amulet of the Guardian
41625.description:
This amulet bears the emblem of House Wrynn, a treasured gift bestowed upon Medivh by his friend, King Llane, for the many noble deeds he performed for the people of Stormwind. Even in his madness, Medivh clung to it.

Broken and battered—much like the Tower itself, a once-mighty sentinel of history. Yet perhaps this fragment of the past still holds value. Bring me the materials I require, and I shall see to it that this amulet serves its new bearer well.
41625.progress: You must gather the materials if you wish to see the item restored.
41625.completion: Behold, your reward awaits: the amulet, now stronger than ever.

41626.title: Lionheart Helm
41626.description:
This crown bears the symbol of the Kingdom of Azeroth, and it closely resembles the one King Llane used to wear. Perhaps even in his madness, Medivh still kept his friend close to his heart.

Fractured, almost crumbled—just like the Tower of Karazhan, a lost vigil of history. It is upon this history that we may reforge something anew. Bring me the materials I require, and I will ensure that this crown becomes of use to its new bearer.
41626.progress: Gathering the materials shall be no easy task.
41626.completion: Behold, your reward awaits: the crown, forged anew and ready to serve you in battle.

41627.title: Lionheart Shoulders
41627.description:
I imagine your journey through a brief glimpse of both the Twisting Nether and Outland was not without its share of trouble. Yet, I sense an item in your possession that carries an otherworldly aura.

Allow me to lay eyes upon this mantle. Hm, as far as I can tell, the enemy you faced was indeed formidable—perhaps powerful enough to shift between planes. No matter; while its previous owner lies dead, some of its magic endures. Were you to bring me the materials I require, I could perhaps mold this item to suit your needs.
41627.progress: You must obtain the required materials if you wish to wield the power of this item.
41627.completion: The item is restored and improved. May it serve you well in battle.

41628.title: Lionheart Chest
41628.description:
Defeating a Nathrezim of such power is no easy feat. Even beyond the veil of life and death, many cursed the existence of the accursed Mephistroth. You could hear the echoes of the tormented souls in the Twisting Nether rejoice the moment the demon lay dead.

Alas, that is neither more nor less important—for not only did you manage to slay such a formidable foe, but you also retrieved its armor. This armor shall serve as the foundation for your next piece of the puzzle; in truth, it may even be considered the final piece. As before, bring me the materials I require, and claim a prize that will make even the mighty Eredar tremble in their boots
41628.progress: Whatever the cost, it will be worth it.
41628.completion: Don it with pride; you have more than earned it.

41629.title: Lionheart Legs
41629.description:
Doomguards were the elite bodyguards of their master—none could face a fiercer enemy, and yet you confronted one of their best. Surviving the wrath of the Highlord would have been a worthy feat in itself, and yet you managed to defeat him.

I sense that you possess something of his—a memento from a worthy battle, one that we could use as the basis for a piece of your armor. What say you? Bring me the materials I require, and we will ensure that you wear this fight both in spirit and upon your body.
41629.progress: Trust in yourself to find the materials; you must do so if you wish for us to continue.
41629.completion: May they serve you well until death claims you.

41630.title: Lionheart Boots
41630.description:
Your journey through a fleeting glimpse of both the Twisting Nether and Outland was not without its hardships. Still, I can sense an item in your possession—a relic that emanates an otherworldly essence.

Allow me to examine these boots. It seems the adversary you faced was indeed formidable, perhaps even capable of traversing the planes. Yet, while its previous owner now lies dead, remnants of its magic persist. What say you? Bring me the materials I require, and I shall forge this item to suit your needs, ensuring you carry the essence of this battle with you.
41630.progress: Bear in mind that without the materials, we may not continue.
41630.completion: Steady your feet; your new boots suit you well.

41631.title: Lionheart Amulet
41631.description:
This amulet bears the emblem of House Wrynn, a treasured gift bestowed upon Medivh by his friend, King Llane, for the many noble deeds he performed for the people of Stormwind. Even in his madness, Medivh clung to it.

Broken and battered—much like the Tower itself, a once-mighty sentinel of history. Yet perhaps this fragment of the past still holds value. Bring me the materials I require, and I shall see to it that this amulet serves its new bearer well.
41631.progress: You must gather the materials if you wish to see the item restored.
41631.completion: Behold, your reward awaits: the amulet, now stronger than ever.

41632.title: Ring of the Cryptstalker
41632.description:
I imagine a floating citadel filled to the brim with undead proved itself quite the hunting ground. Though unlike any other you have faced so far, I am confident in believing you are capable enough to continue what may well be the greatest hunt of your entire life.

As we have discussed before, the Cryptstalker armor could be within your grasp—yet, unlike any set of armor before it, this one is only considered complete with a powerful ring. Should you find something resembling such a thing, return it to me, and together we shall unlock its true potential.
41632.progress: Return with the trophy of your hunt. Desecrated Signet

41633.title: Bonescythe Ring
41633.description:
It seems I am in possession of many finger bones. I will spare you their 'proper' anatomical names, as educating you in the structure of the hand is neither my purpose nor my job. However, as a Rogue yourself, perhaps you should study... yet—never mind. We are veering off-topic.

As I told you before, Don Julio managed to teach me his craft of the Bonescythe Armor, which I will provide to you—for a price. Should you come across anything resembling a ring while fighting, not only for your survival but for the rest of us, bring it to me. I will ensure it is adorned with these finger bones, which, in turn, will complete your set of armor.
41633.progress: Let us hope your pockets do not feel loose. Desecrated Ring
41633.completion: You may yet prove to be a decent <class> after all.

41634.title: Magilou's Magical Mishap
41634.description:
What an impudent child! I've lost count on how many times I have instructed her about the dangers of arcane magic. That reckless curiosity of hers will one day be the doom for all of us.

You've surely noticed the tower uphill from this humble abode? Usually I would reside there with all the other magically interested from around Northwind and elsewhere, but my ‘dearest' apprentice Thronda thought it would be a brilliant idea to summon her own assembly of arcane elementals to help with her chores. Too bad that they grew out of control and are now terrorizing my tower!

<name>, ascend it, and retrieve my almanach as well as residue from their demise. Once I am attuned to their energy, I can cast a spell to stop them from rematerializing.
41634.progress: How are your dealings with my tower faring?
41634.completion:
Simply marvelous. A job well done. Thronda should listen well and follow your example. She has great potential, but her lack of discipline is a dire thorn in my side - and hers, too. Still, I can only partially blame her, for it is my sworn duty to her parents to foster her magical talent as much as her growth as a person.

You have my deepest gratitude, good traveler. Before you go, take one of these as compensation for the troubles. Be sure to step wary during these trying times.

41635.title: Chopping Defias
41635.description:
I've spent my entire life here in Northwind and it had never been in such disarray since the First War. Gnolls, Orcs and Dark Iron all roam our peaceful hillsides and sow chaos wherever they go. Even the roguish Defias seek to benefit from it all. These brash brigands dared to assault our logging camp not far from here, northeast of Ambershire. All of the workers fled of course, but the town doesn't have enough space to shelter them, so for now they are resting here in my warehouse. If only Amberwood's guard would be ambitious enough about helping the good citizens of Northwind!

It seems to fall into the hands of the people again. Adventurer, you appear of good health and mind, will you aid us? Drive out the Defias from the logging camp; help us restore even a sliver of peace to our beautiful home!
41635.progress: Stay safe, adventurer. Northwind's hills are not meant to be drenched in the blood of the innocent.
41635.completion: Is it done? Is this the head of their mongrel leader? Good riddance to them, their lot has chosen what path to tread - a path leading to their timely demise. I appreciate your courage, adventurer. Here, take this as reward for the good deed. With your actions, we may soon live our solemn lives yet again.

41636.title: Who Will Think Of The Children?
41636.description:
<class>, could you spare a moment? I am in a bit of a crisis right now, and you seem the right person for my problem. I am a traveling merchant selling books for all ages and interests. Once a month I come here to Ambershire with a delivery from the Church in Stormwind; donations from the citizens for all the orphaned children attending the lectures and school held at the Ambershire church just across the river. However, on my way here, I've been robbed by thieves, and among their loot was said donation crate!

I tried following them, but my old age is catching up to me. All I saw was them fleeing into the mountains to the north, one of them wearing a raven black scarf. Please help me fulfill my duty to the innocent children of this kingdom. Should you find the crate, bring it to Sister Argent to the church north of Ambershire.
41636.progress: Welcome to our humble church. Are you here to visit a lost one, or perhaps for silent prayer?
41636.completion: The crate from Mister Melain! I had met him on my short trip to Ambershire when I gathered the children for school, he told me what happened. Shocking that there are faithless heathens stealing from those who have already been dealt a bad hand by fate. The Light will shine upon you with benevolent rays for your heroic deed, good <class>.

41637.title: School Assistance
41637.description:
Again, thank you very much for bringing these books back to us. The children will be overjoyed to hear that we don't have to cancel today's school. You would expect them to be annoyed having to attend school, but they actually enjoy coming here and learning more about the world together. It's a heartwarming sight and gives me hope they'll be set on the path to a promising future.

Due to the robbery, we're a bit behind on time, and I need some time to prepare today's lecture. Would you be willing to lend us a hand? The children will certainly be eager to speak to the one who valianty saved their books from that brigand! Last week we taught them the history of Balor, an island to the west of here. Perhaps you can help them strengthen their knowledge by reminding them. You can find the book we used here in the church.
41637.progress: How are you faring? I hope the little rascals aren't too much to handle.
41637.completion: Wonderful, their delighted expressions cast a smile on my own face everytime I see them. These children are the future of the Alliance, and it is our responsibility to prepare them for their own decisions as best as we possibly can. I will make sure the Church knows about your contributions today, good deeds will not go unnoticed. Did you learn something yourself, by chance? The island of Balor is a divisive topic within the kingdom, many of the superstitious dare not mention its name still. Regardless, it is part of our past and as such should be remembered.

41638.title: The Grateful Dead
41638.description:
It is mortifying to see what's happening to Northwind. When I returned here under recommendation of Archbishop Benedictus to assist Sister Argent, I could have never imagined this is what I would find. The people are terrified of the invasions from the eastern lands and criminals have set foot in our hills. Even the old abbey is...

Excuse me, I spoke out of turn, forgive me. You see, Northwind is my place of birth, I remember its mellow nature and the carefree days one could spend here. But I guess those days are gone. If I had known, I would've taken Mother with me. Her resting place being overrun by horrors of the past; it breaks my heart. She died when I was still young, her urn being placed in the crypt of Saint Mara Abbey.

<class>, what I ask is by chance too much, but would you be willing to gather my mother's urn? It would mean the world to me and not be to your disadvantage, I vow it by my oath to the Light.
41638.progress: With the wars over, I thought Northwind may finally return to its peaceful roots. Maybe I have been too naive to think so.
41638.completion: Oh, mother... I am so sorry to have left you in that lightforsaken place. Be rest assured, you will find a new resting place in Stormwind, my new home. Thank you - <name> was it? With mother's ashes returned, I will deliver them to the Church before continuing my duties here with Sister Argent. Farewell, kind soul. May the blessing of the Light shine your way.

41639.title: The Woods Have Changed
41639.description:
What an unusual sight, rarely do folk wander into my coven; let alone enter my home so brazenly. Do you think these to be appropriate manners for a <race> such as you? Certainly not. But I would rather not waste any of my precious time critisizing your lack of etiquette, if I instead can make good use of your presence.

I am in need of a selection of ingredients. Normally gathering them poses no issue to me, but the woods of Northwind have changed in recent times. There are unsavory individuals skulking about, which I would welcome to not lay eyes upon me. Rather you will go out and bring me what I desire. A simple task to make me forget your unruly transgression into my home. I am sure you will be capable of fulfilling it splendidly, darling. You can gather them from the local wildlife all around Northwind.
41639.progress: You better not question what I need these for.
41639.completion:
<The witch is cackling in an uncomfortable manner.>

Useful after all. Here, some homebrewed potions of mine, just for you. You may stay a while and ask me anything. The woods have knowledge most don't dare to ask...

41640.title: Restless
41640.description:
How could this happen? Just this morning I was preparing beer and food for the mountaineers, when the next thing I saw was Dark Iron storming my beloved tavern! The Titan's must be watching over me, as I managed to escape with only minor injuries. The mountaineers of this garrison helped me recover a bit of my strength, yet I am still shaken from all that happened. Be that as it may, I cannot let this injustice stand any longer! As the good men here cannot aid me on such short notice, perhaps you are willing to lend this old man your sword and spell? You look robust and hardened enough for the task.

South of Helm's Bed Lake is a passageway to my mountain rest. I am certain it has already been overrun by those fiendish Dark Iron. If you and perhaps a friend of yours could retrieve my personal belongings from my tavern, it would soothe my worried heart immensely.
41640.progress: Have you been successful yet? Please, be careful and don't act reckless on my behalf.
41640.completion: There it is! I cannot thank you enough, truly! Had I lost these, I wouldn't know if I'd be able to bear it. Everything in here are memories of the good friends I made during my time as a mountaineer, ones that visited me and my mountain rest whenever their duty took a toll on their bodies. For their sake, we have to reclaim it as soon as possible.

41641.title: Gone With The Wind
41641.description:
Aka'magosh, <class>. Our spiritual site of communion, the Earthen Ring, had been taken over by a large group of air elementals, wreaking havoc without bounds. Luckily, my compatriots Zo'luuli and Tectonius were able to expel them with the help of brave shaman adventurers. Now that many of our members returned from their pilgrimage to mend the ailing world and its disrupted balance, we can focus once more in quelling the elemental unrest.

While you are, your aid would be much appreciated. The spirits of the earth whispered to me, informing me that the elementals we had driven off still remain here in Stonetalon, plotting. We need to thwart their ambitions for good, so that we can focus on the task at hand. The spirits told me of a place, northwest of Stonetalon Peak, on a mountainous passageway. Look out for the mighty eagles nesting there. Once you see them, you will know that you are close.
41641.progress: Their hostility appears unreasonable. I wonder, what is their motive?
41641.completion: A splendid display of your abilities, <class>. I can see that you comprehend the fundamental teachings of shamanism, atleast when it comes to its utilization in combat. Thank you for lending a hand; I will relay what has happened to Far Seer Earthfury. It is our duty to nature and the spirits to ensure the elemental chaos is kept in check. It will take time, and perhaps your help again in the future, to uncover what Al'akir's minions are scheming. Balance has to be maintained, at all costs.

41642.title: Lonesome Arnold
41642.description:
When the logging camp northeast of here was raided by the foul Defias, the lumberjacks were quick enough to escape mostly unharmed. My father and I tend to those injured here in his warehouse, since there is no other place for them to stay for now. Still, while there are many familiar faces among them, one of his good friends Christoph working at the camp hasn't shown up yet, neither here nor in Ambershire.

Christoph has a young son, and I'm afraid the worst has come to pass. Please, do me this favor, and search for him. Maybe he has hidden himself somewhere near the camp...
41642.progress:
<Mirabelle is lost deep in prayer.>

O, Blessed Light, guide this lost lamb back into your fold. May his son not suffer the pain of solitude, may he be reunited with his kin and compatriots.
41642.completion:
What a tragedy, Christoph was a truly good-hearted man and father. Seeing him succumb to such a senseless death breaks my heart. But what about poor, poor Arnold? I fear for him, now that he is orphaned. Please, let me take care of how to tell him of his father's fate. The revered sister at the church of Ambershire will know what to say.

Thank you, kind soul. You've done a good deed today. May the blessing of the Light shine your way.

41643.title: Empty Houses
41643.description:
King's Honor, <class>. ‘Tis not an opportune time visiting Northwind, I must admit. Normally this vale is a tranquil place, untouched by the troubles of the world. But recently, many crises came crashing down on these hills. If you journeyed here from Stormwind, you've seen what I am talking about. There are, however, more harrowing events transpiring in the shadows of the night.

For several weeks now, we've received reports of disappearances occuring in the kingdom. They were seldom at first, nothing out of the ordinary, but the number has risen to an alarming amount. This is technically confidential, but I've been assigned to this as the solitary investigator, and cannot by no stretch of the imagination accomplish this alone. The SI:7 has its hands full with the Defias in Westfall, so I will deputize you to assist me. Don't fret, I'll arrange just compensation for you.

Start by questioning the remaining townsfolk; the groundskeeper, bailiff and one of the victim's relatives.
41643.progress: <Operative Hawthorne is noting something down in his journal. With a stern expression of contemplation, he is lost deep in thought.>
41643.completion: Interesting. With the testimonies you've presented and my own information, we should be able to pinpoint potential suspects. Well done.

41644.title: Defying Odds
41644.description:
Ignatz' and Judith's testimonies match with our reports of increased Defias activity in the region. With a more than high probability, these ‘skulking characters' mentioned have to be Defias scoundrels, scouting the area for thieving opportunities. We haven't located their base of operations yet, so we may kill two birds with one stone here.

Search the area around Ambershire for Defias activity and potential intel on where they delegate their minions from. Once you do, infiltrate it and bring me any clues that may help us find the missing people.
41644.progress: The people of Northwind are wealthy. So far we haven't received any ransom demands, but I would not rule out the possibility of that happening sooner than later.
41644.completion: This is troubling news. Not only does it confirm VanCleef's schemes to run on a much grander scale, but we have to rule out the Defias being behind the rampant kidnappings. Leaving us to pursue a more grueling lead...

41645.title: The Slavemakers
41645.description:
In the lands of Khaz Modan, just past the icy mountain range, the dwarves of Ironforge are in constant strife with their estranged brethren, the Dark Iron. These dwarves call the volcanic Blackrock Mountain their home and are known for their rigorous mining operations inside its blackened caves. Much to the Alliance's dismay, they do not achieve this by themselves, but through ruthless and unforgiving slavery. Major Birkton informed me of their recent insurgence into Northwind - a foreboding turn of events.

Should the possibility of them abducting Northwind citizens for slave labor exist, then we have to investigate it. Travel to Sherwood Quarry to the northeast and gather intel about our current investigation.
41645.progress: Our relationship to the Dark Iron is strenuous, to put it lightly. The Bronzebeard dwarves of Ironforge have a more... creative way to describe it.
41645.completion: Again, a dead lead. We're running out of options, deputy.

41646.title: Covering All Possibilities
41646.description:
Our last option are the Blackrock Orcs, who you've undoubtedly met already. According to our reconnaissance, they started advancing into Northwind a few weeks ago, with no apparent motive or reason. It occurred very shortly after the Dark Irons made their move of aggression, so there may be a connection present. Sacking Birkhaven was just the beginning, I'm afraid.

For now we will shift our focus on the orc unit that secured the watchtower to the north. They are far ahead of the mainforce, a different aim must be at play here. You know what to do at this point; I'll wait for your results here in Ambershire.
41646.progress: If you wish to assist in driving out the main force from Northwind, a local marshal is conducting his own operation in the Plump Pumpkin. You can find it to the southeast at Grimmen Lake.
41646.completion:
<Operative Hawthorne lets out a deep sigh hearing your findings. Looking clearly exhausted, he begins rubbing his eyes as a sign of defeat.>

This whole ordeal proves to be more of a conundrum than I had hoped it would be. All three suspects act unrelated to our case, setting us back to zero. As much as it dismays me, I have to start my investigation anew. I will revoke your deputization; what you've done for me saved me valuable time, but I cannot demand any more of you. If I am fortunate enough, then the SI:7 will send someone to support me here. Until then, I must focus on my work. Farewell, <name>.

41647.title: Unconventional Means
41647.description:
<class>, can I speak with you for a moment? I overheard your discussion with Operative Hawthorne. A commendable effort of the both of you to solve our most prominent issues, but Stormwind only assigning him to do so is concerning, to say the least. Northwind was struck at the worst time imaginable, with Lord Amberwood sending most of his military to Stormwind itself. Strange course of action, if you ask me, given how the Kingdom's other regions are faring. Regarding your investigation - I believe I can show you the way to resume what you had to abandon.

Far to the northwest, you will find a grove nestled in the mountains. An old woman lives there under the dark red trees - she will be able to help you, I am sure of it.
41647.completion:
<The old woman is stirring her cauldron, which violently bubbles exuding a most pungent odor.>

Well, well, well. What do we have here? A lost sheep trying to find a place to rest?

41648.title: Deathcap And Widow's Frill
41648.description:
So you are lost. Darling, I can see it in your face as clear as day. You need someone to guide your way, and you've been told that someone could be me. Must have been that foolish girl Lydia, ever since she left my coven she did not care to visit me again. Her ambitions and duties as Mayor tie her down, locking her true potential, would she just accept it. Regardless of all that rambling, she is right. I can and will assist you in your needs, but not out of the goodness of my heart. All these ruffians marching into my woods have no business here!

What I need from you is fairly simple: Deathcap and Widow's Frill, mushrooms native to these hills. Deathcap grows in caverns and has an orange cap, Widow's Frill grows in groups of three near wet soil; search the woods at the Great Birch near Grimmen Lake. Bring me these and something personal from a recently abducted person. I am sure you will find what I desire in town.
41648.progress: Now, now. Don't let me wait too much.
41648.completion: Oho, splendid, darling. The Widow's Frills are especially thick this season, if we didn't need them for now I would make a loveable stew out of them. They're quite delectable, perhaps you can try them yourself once all of this is over. And this comb you've brought - it's from a young woman. Let us not tarry any longer. Now then, to mix this all together...

41649.title: The Everlook Broadcast Hijacking
41649.description:
If there is one thing Zappo Zapblast can't stand, it's grouches going out of their way to ruin the fun for others. During yesterday's broadcast, my team and I lost the connection to our tower, only to hear a mysterious message sent through our output channel seconds after! The cheeky fella stole the spotlight during my advertisements and started slandering us more than an intoxicated zombie! Turning off the broadcasting tower wasn't an option either, we worked all day to keep it up and running following the recent snowstorms! All we're broadcasting now is endless static! A catastrophe!

You look lively... more or less. I could use some help in exposing this phony. Nobody simply interferes with Zappo Zapblast and gets away with it!

You can find our recording box next to me. Just press the green button, then pull the slider down and turn the knob left all the way to the maximum output! Listening to the interference again will help us get to the bottom of it all.
41649.progress: Remember: green, slider down and then turn the knob to the left!
41649.completion:
If this bugger didn't use a voice modulator, I would be able to tell you EXACTLY who he is. My big, green ears are the best in all of Azeroth, no fancy elf can compete with my auditive recognition!

Nevertheless, hearing the recording again may have in fact just helped us solve this mystery.

41650.title: Crashing Waves, Screeching Thunder
41650.description:
As you were listening to the recording, I noticed a distinct sound–no, TWO distinct sounds even I hadn't realized before. It seems the modulator only altered the goon's voice and not the entire input channel. What an amateur; more clueless than a forsaken seeking life insurance.

You see, I can remember any sound I hear. And what I recognized wasn't just any ordinary noise: The others and I went on a journey to gather some impressions for our diverse broadcasting just a few days ago. One of the places we ventured to were the amber hills of Azshara. It was precisely the northern cliffs where the hijacker chose to intercept our radio. Impressive, you say? I know, but that's Zappo Zapblast for you.

An adventurer like you could earn some fine coin if you would venture there and confront the fella. Search the northeastern cliffs. That's where the sounds of crashing waves and screeching hippogryphs are most prominent.
41650.progress: <The site that unfolds before only raises more questions. The leads you have are not many, but one sticks out the most: the Blood Elven dagger sticking out of the goblin's chest. Your theory is that the blood elves you passed on your way west of here ambushed the goblin for an unknown reason. On their search for something they took the goblin's possession along with the key to the locker they couldn't find.>
41650.completion: <The site that unfolds before only raises more questions. The leads you have are not many, but one sticks out the most: the Blood Elven dagger sticking out of the goblin's chest. Your theory is that the blood elves you passed on your way southwest of here ambushed the goblin for an unknown reason. On their search for something they took the goblin's possession along with the key to the locker they couldn't find.>

41651.title: Pieces Falling Into Place
41651.description: <Flipping through the journal, you infer the goblin's identity to be that of Bizzbang Zipperbox, an engineer from Kezan that apparently worked with Zappo on some prototype machinery back in Undermine. Judging from what you can read, he must've been more than unhappy about not being included into Zappo's Everlook Broadcast ambitions.

41652.title: An Unusual Interference
41652.description: <Shortly after the first few broadcasts, the program suddenly gets cut off and is replaced by a strange and ominous interference. It didn’t last long, as it was over as quickly as it appeared. Now all you can hear is mindnumbing static that drills deep into your ears. Clearly not sent by Zappo Zapblast or any of his guests, you are puzzled by what you just witnessed. Intrigued by the whole scenario, you decide to pay the radio goblin himself a visit in Everlook.>
41652.completion: Oh, you heard the interference and are here to help? Perfect, I could use a capable pair of hands!

41653.title: The Great Spirit Of Wisdom
41653.description:
Greetings, traveler, and a welcoming Lunar New Year! This time of year beckons for new aspirations, dreams and ambitions we strive to achieve in the coming year. As such, it is important to reflect and listen to those that bear wisdom in their words and actions. My ancestors traveled throughout Kalimdor and met many mythical creatures and spirits. One of them, an unremarkable one for most, possessed the most profound insights there were. To this day, my tribe seeks this spirit for guidance in times of need.

I want you to pay it a visit, to learn from its words and take them to heart. Nature whispers of its den; in the northwestern swamps of Dustwallow Marsh you will find it.
41653.completion: <Speaking to the frog, its gaze drifts into the bog behind you. If not told otherwise, you would've guessed there were no thoughts behind its eyes. Yet, before giving up, the amphibian spirit bloats itself up, more and more, before releasing a cacophony of croaks and ribbits. Blown away, your mind is filled with visions of the world, some more ancient than the other. After the croakophony ended the frog spirit resumes its stance and gazes off into the distance once more.>

41654.title: Forefathers' Honor
41654.description:
The Lunar New Year is a feast for the many tauren tribes and families. While we share customs here and there, the majority of them are unique to their tribe. I still remember the stories my father used to tell me, about the first hunt he participated in during the new year's celebrations. Back then, it was common to find boars roaming the savannah of the barrens. Their herds could be seen far and wide, and our huntsmen would gather every year to prepare a feast for the whole tribe.

Nowadays, the boars have long been perished or corralled by the quilboar. <name>, I wish to pay respects to my ancestors by preparing a feast myself, so please help me achieve that goal. Slay boars of any kind and bring me ten of their carcasses, that should be enough for all the joyful travelers here in Moonglade.
41654.progress: My father and grandfather will not be the last generation to honor this tradition.
41654.completion: These look wonderful, <name>! I am impressed by your tenacity and display of skill. Truly, in the name of my forefathers, I thank you deeply. Now, let me conjure up a feast for everyone like they've never seen before!

41655.title: Reverence To The Ancestors
41655.description:
Ishnu-dal-dieb, traveler. The festivities are in full swing, and visitors from across Azeroth come steadily into Moonglade, eager to celebrate with their compatriots, no matter their origin. I see that you are still young, full of spirit and ambition; admirable qualities for those living the adventurous life. If it is a challenge you seek, then the Lunar New Year is the perfect time for that. It is a time of struggle, of overcoming burdens that still cling to your soul, so that you may enter the new age with an unbound spirit.

Venture into the world, dive into the dens of evil and confront your inner doubts. Present to me a token of your victory, proving to me how you conquered yourself and I will reward you for your efforts.
41655.progress: Don't falter. You are more than ready for this task, I am sure of it.
41655.completion: Marvelous, <name>. You've bested the dangers and braved them with courage and resolve. This token is proof of your conviction and willingness to tackle whatever struggle will come your way. I am certain, you will pave your future with the blessing of your ancestors, whom you've demonstrated your cunning today. Please, accept this as a boon for your achievement.

41656.title: Bounty on Dragonmaw
41656.description: A bounty is being offered to any brave and willing enough to combat the Dragonmaw Clan. Many of our brave brothers and sisters have died from this conflict. If something is not done to quell this aggression more of our own shall fall.

41657.title: Letter from Korlag Doomsong
41657.description:
A worn letter is discovered upon Zuluhed's Corpse. It appears to be addressed to him, and written in a coarse handwriting which reads:

<So you have finally returned? How long has it been since you disappeared to chase after your artifact while the rest of us fought tooth and nail for our survival? You abandoned the Dragonmaw Clan for your own foolish glory, and now, because you have returned, you expect all the chieftains to band together with no remorse or animosity?

Do not expect me to be as foolish as the others Zuluhed. You may hide in the underbelly of Grim Batol all you desire. I will lead our clan to a glorious, and great victory here on the soil of Grim Reaches, not cowering in caverns like Rend and his ilk. There are some of us that know the truth of the Blackrock, and do not desire to hide facts behind notions of a glorious 'Dark Horde'... Your order is declined, old friend.

Korlag Doomsong, Dragonmaw Clan.>
41657.progress: What is it that you bring?
41657.completion:
<Commander Aggnash takes his time, studying the letter with some interest>

It would appear that the Dragonmaw Clan is not as united as we once thought. This news is relieving to hear.

41658.title: Destruction of the Dragonmaw
41658.description:
This letter confirms some of the rumors that have been circulating, the Dragonmaw Clan was not fully united.

Now that Zuluhed has been slain there is only one that stands in contention for chieftain, Commander Korlag Doomsong. If we are to ever claim victory over the Dragonmaw we must first slay Korlag himself.

I must warn you, he is a dangerous foe, and should be treated with the utmost respect for his skill at arms. I would suggest bringing a band of warriors to assist with the battle to come.

You will find Korlag deep within Zarm'geth Stronghold to the northwest of here. Bring his head, and return in glory.
41658.progress: Preparation will be required if you desire success in the battle to come.
41658.completion:
<Commander Aggnash looks on with a slight gaze of disbelief>

You were successful?

<Commander Aggnash lets out a hearty laugh>

You have overcome your enemy, you have defeated Korlag! A mighty foe such as him was a dauntless task, and yet here you are, victorious. Be proud in your glory today, for you have done what very few could achieve.

Take this, as a thanks from the Horde itself!

41659.title: The Sal'Galaz Mines
41659.description: Far to the south lies the Sal'Galaz Mines, once occupied by the dwarves of Dun Kithas, now overrun by filthy, Bonesplitter Troggs. If the Horde is to ever lay claim to Grim Reaches, the infestation must be dealt with, and firmly. Your task is to slay the Bonesplitters, and clear their foul presence.
41659.completion: Excellent work, the Sal'Galaz Mines hold quite a considerable amount of iron ore that should aid our efforts handily. Take this, as a reward for your actions this day.

41660.title: Shadowforge Incursions
41660.description:
Some weeks ago a large group of Dark Iron made their way through the Grim Reaches, settling just north of Shatterblade at Groldan's Excavation. Already they probe our defenses, spies have been seen by our sentries on more than one occasion. They are planning something, and I am sure of it.

If we are to keep our safety we must strike the first blow, and thin the ranks of their kind to deter them from making any assaults. Head to Groldan's Excavation, and make them bleed for their trespass.
41660.progress: Have you returned with the signets?
41660.completion: Glory and honor to your name! You have defeated our foe, and brought victory to the Horde. I have prepared a few items, take one and let it help on your journey.

41661.title: Amberpaw Bounty
41661.description:
I often find myself staring—a bad habit for a guard, is it not? Yet I can't help it; my eyes drift to the trees. As the leaves fall, the breeze carries them into a whirlwind of battle, of dance—just as if the leaves themselves would duel.

<Gaspar smirks, looking past you to the unfolding scenery.>

Mh, I used to be a painter before I picked up arms. A necessary sacrifice in the days we live. My remote home, now abandoned, while I guard this tower day and night. And though my eyes behold beauty, my ears are tormented by that maniacal laughter.

I cannot leave my tower. Even with Stormwind so close, the Merchant's Highroad is still plagued by those dreadful gnolls. I ask you, please, dispatch some of their numbers for the peace of my mind.
41661.completion: I hope the poor merchant was simply robbed and not beaten for blood—or worse. Alas, you have done your part, and for that, I am more than thankful. There is little I can offer, but take this. It was the last painting I did.

41662.title: Leaf's Bounty
41662.description:
One might assume that traveling from Stormwind to Northwind would be a blissful endeavor, a mere walk in the park—anything but fleeing from a pack of bloodthirsty, drooling gnolls.$ Since the King embarked on his diplomatic mission, conditions have only worsened. It is inconceivable that we cannot rely upon our own guards! We were compelled to raise a militia from among the common folk. It is truly tragic.

Bah, yet those blasted, greedy swine from the House of Nobles still extend their hands to demand taxes. I—pardon my outburst. On my way here, my prized ring slipped from my finger as I fled from imminent peril!

My merchandise is lost, so be it. But I cannot, in good conscience, part with that ring; it is a treasured family heirloom. It must have fallen into one of the leaf piles on the Merchant's Highroad. Would you be so kind as to retrieve it for me?
41662.progress: Dirt and gnoll spittle–I must burn these clothes.
41662.completion: Where the guards falter, the people shall provide. You have my gratitude, adventurer. A few coins for your trouble.

41663.title: Among the Jousters
41663.description:
Words, rumors—a wingless flight they hold. And with them, the seeds of doubt and curiosity bloom in the minds of mere men. Who would even blame them? After all, the words of the many are always louder than the words of the few. Our community has been in disarray for months.

It has been long since the people of Northwind had to fear for tomorrow. Yet our betters ignore the imminent danger and play the role of their own fools. Imagine your home assaulted, and instead of seeking aid from other nobles or providing the people with means of defense, you call for a jousting tournament.

A jester, a fool—only one of these two would do such a thing. Unless we consider a third possibility. Some take to chaos as a means of reaching power, and I believe that might be the case this time as well. Report my concerns to Duke Sherwood at the Jousting Grounds. That man alone will rise to the occasion when others would not.
41663.completion: Mike, what a sly old fox. The man carries one of the most mediocre names I have ever heard, yet his mind could outwit any other intellect.

41664.title: A Dark Knight Rises
41664.description:
Somehow, the crafty old fox has guessed right once again. It is one of the most infuriating things I can think of today. Were it not already ridiculous enough that we must stoop so low as to portray this uncanny turn of events—namely, painting our entire region as "safe" for the whole of the human kingdoms to see, what remains of them anyway—while contending with gnolls, orcs, Defias, and Light knows what else, we are also burdened with this "Dark Knight."

<The Duke reaches for his forehead and sighs, his weary eyes regarding you with a hint of hope.>

This must be some cunning scheme, one to which I am stretched too thin to address. Aid me; the people of Northwind depend upon both you and me. I know you have little to gain from this, but I beseech you to act from the heart. I simply need you to sneak into the Dark Knight's tent and seek out anything... damning.
41664.completion: That utter, disgraceful dog. Bah, who would think that the laughingstock of children could be up to no good? Sir "Ambercheeks" is bold.

41665.title: In Amber Disgust
41665.description:
Poor Lord Amberwood, cursed to bear this burden —it is not the burden of leadership, but the burden of having such a brother. Alas, we do not have the luxury of choosing our family. Lord Amberwood is a forgiving man; too many times has he overlooked his brother's actions—yet, I doubt he will stand for this one.

I fear the outcome. Northwind is already broken—if our Lord's heart should also shatter, we may never recover. I pray to the Light that this information will strengthen his resolve rather than dull his mind. Yet, how can one's heart not ache when his own brother seeks his death?

The older brother seeks to rule, with the support of the House of Nobles to end his own brother—at the hands of this Dark Knight. To think they would continue their schemes even now.

The common folk are mere playthings to these “nobles”. Deliver this letter to Lord Amberwood, but mention nothing of what you know. I will gather what remains of the true nobility and tell him the truth myself.
41665.progress: Approach messenger, let me have what you carry.
41665.completion: Duke Sherwood is a close friend; many times he has denied the use of servants. It warms my heart to think he would find one in you. My armory is humble, and these are trying times—at most, for your service, I can reward you with this.

41666.title: Amberglaze Donuts
41666.description:
Are you here to try our vastly celebrated and highly sought-after Amberglaze Donuts? I couldn't be more pleased, but—sadly—we've run out. It seems they are a real hit! If only I had anticipated this. People want more, and here I am without any ingredients.

If you could assist me in procuring some of the ingredients, I would be proud to fry up some of my famous donuts for you. I will even provide some payment, to be honest. I am in need of flour, salt, sugar, and honey. The rest I can gather myself. I mention these ingredients specifically because they require a bit of travel to obtain.

I will provide you with a list, you should find them all here in Ambershire. I truly appreciate your help.
41666.progress: The people are literally rioting over the donuts...
41666.completion: Ah, there you are! Thank you, thank you. I believe they were going to dismantle my stall if you hadn't shown up when you did. As promised—a free pack of Amberglaze Donuts and an extra coin as a tip.

41667.title: In Need of Shoes
41667.description:
This tournament is a farce. How can we even hope to win? I bet they've enchanted their horseshoes. I know it, I just know it! I cannot allow Stromgarde to be defeated by a bookworm kingdom and a newly formed—eh, I wouldn't even call it a kingdom.

Theramore and Kul Tiras will be too preoccupied with each other, but the real threat is Dalaran. I don't like the sidelong glance that Modera woman is giving me; they have a trick up their sleeves—I know they do!

Listen, <race>, I'll pay you handsomely. Return to Stormwind, take the boat to Darkshore, and then travel to Alah'thalas. I've heard rumors of a man named Chaddus Suncarrier who can provide a pair of enchanted horseshoes. Retrieve them for me, and your service to Stromgarde will not be forgotten—and your pocket will be a bit heavier.
