41667.progress: I will wipe that smile off her face.
41667.completion: Hey <name>, is she still looking at me? Bah, that woman makes me so uncomfortable. Anyway, did you manage to get the horseshoes? Oh, thank the Light. Here, take this and be quick about it. And, just in case, don't show up during the tournament.

41668.title: Goody Bag
41668.description:
Are you perhaps willing to do a task for an old woman, adventurer? It has been so long since I last saw my grandchild, and I am unable to reach him. I was advised against leaving Northwind due to my old age, and he is not allowed to leave the Keep for safety reasons—or so I have been told.

I would like to send him a bag of goods. The poor child may not be eating well and may be overstressed by the foolish adults who follow him everywhere. Could you visit the Jousting Grounds to purchase an Amberglaze Donut Pack, then go to Marisa by the inn for a Bundle of Apples, and finally come by my house—next to the Town Hall—to retrieve the pie I baked this morning?

Please return them all to me while I prepare the rest of the pack. There are a few other things I need to add.
41668.completion: Hand them over; everything is ready. You may take an apple yourself for helping me out.

41669.title: Fit for a Prince!
41669.description:
With everything gathered, all you need to do is travel to Stormwind Keep and deliver this bag to Prince Anduin—but only to him, do you understand? Otherwise, those pesky noble flies will surround him and inspect it. Be as stubborn as a mule if you must. You need to present this bag to Anduin yourself, got it?

Here is a bit of coin for your trouble, along with the bag you must deliver and this stuffed toy. Keep it close; it might cost you your life. I am jesting, of course, but it belonged to my Tiffin. I know the child will be pleased to have something of hers. Go now, and tell him I love him as long as the leaves fall.
41669.progress: You should speak to Miss Katrana or Bolvar, I am unable to say much.
41669.completion:
Grandmother sent you, and she said that? Oh, I miss her dearly. I can't wait to try everything she sent me. I hear the donuts are very famous in Northwind. And I will treasure this toy from Mother forever. Thank you, adventurer. You have done me a great favor, and as Prince of Stormwind, I would reward you with something from our armory—if I could. Instead, I will give you this book I have from the Archbishop.

Do come and tell me of your adventures sometimes; this palace is dull and boring. I could use a friend.

41670.title: To Light the Afterlife
41670.description:
It is my duty to care for the final resting place of our loved ones. As grey a duty as it may be, tending the graveyard with these two hands brings pride to my heart and soul. For what better duty is there than caring for those who are no longer with us? Most citizens of Ambershire come here daily, flowers in hand. Remembering the dead has become a routine.

Yet, times have grown dim—dark even. It is customary to light a candle alongside the flowers placed at a loved one's tombstone. In this way, the flicker of the candle may guide the soul back to our world so it may receive the offerings. Few merchants still walk the road named after their profession, and thus the church has run out of candles.

Sniveling kobolds stole what few we had left one night, cowering away in their cave. To reach this cave, you must follow the road. Return to Lion's Watch, walk toward the Plump Pumpkin Inn, and after crossing Grimmen Lake, you will find the cave nearby. Return the candles to me.
41670.progress: No easy task, but a task all the same. May you walk with the Light.
41670.completion: Some would tell you there is no meaning in this—clinging to the dead, to the past, each day. Yet, these tombstones become mere decorations if the dead are forgotten. A grim fate, worse than death itself.

41671.title: Remember the Dead
41671.description:
The Light has tested the lands of our kingdom many times. For a handful of people, that was enough to dim their belief. A yearly gospel was held in our abbey, where we would remember all the dead of these lands, no matter how many hours it took. The abbot made it his duty to speak each name.

The somber, mournful music of the abbey was interrupted by the wailing of a flaming woman. "Fire—fire!" she screamed, her voice echoing through the abbey walls. Aflame, she collapsed to the floor, her tears dried by the heat, her skin scorched by the flames. Her wailing saved the lives of many, though the lives of a few were lost.

Some whispers say it was the gnolls who set the abbey ablaze; others believe it was the wrath of the Light. A few even think the poor nun accidentally started the fire herself. Who speaks the truth? Go east, to the ruins of the abbey. The stone walls still stand, and perhaps with them, our necrology as well. See it returned to me, so that we may honor the dead this year once more.
41671.progress: The fire was yet another test of faith.
41671.completion: With this returned, so too does hope return. During the gospel this year, we will reconnect with those whose faith has dimmed, for that is exactly what they need amidst the chaos enveloping these lands.

41672.title: Amberfin Bounty
41672.description:
Murlocs are exactly like roaches. The minute you kill one, two more hatch from their filthy spawning grounds. It's incredible how many of these disgusting creatures roam the world. It's as if wherever the world takes a breath of water, they are destined to appear. Hmph, a world to live in—while the world itself seems to be after your life.

It falls to adventurers like you to cull these depraved creatures. You may see arrogance behind my anger, but it's really self-pity. If I could deal with these creatures myself, I'd raise arms without hesitation. Yet I can't. No matter how many days I try, I will never be able to wield a sword. My skills are better used elsewhere.

Do this favor for me, and I will repay you as best I can. Cull their numbers—no matter how many, just do it. The fewer, the better.
41672.completion: You have my deepest thanks. There is little I can offer, despite all that big talk. With no visitors from outside Northwind, the inn barely gets a drunk or two. So, I offer you a warm meal, and you may choose any room upstairs and call it your own for as long as you are in Northwind.

41673.title: The Amber Pearl
41673.description:
Out to slay some murlocs, adventurer? Theresa and I were just enjoying a chat until a few seconds ago, when we heard noises coming from across Grimmen Lake. It was a giant murloc barking at the others at the lake shore! I say "bark" because we didn't really understand what it was saying. I think it's supposed to be their alpha or something—I don't know much about murlocs.

Anyway, Theresa noticed that it was carrying a huge amber pearl—the size of her head, she claims! If you venture into that cave and defeat it, could you bring the pearl back to me? I would like to offer it as a gift to her. She has been a great friend... and more to me, and I would like to show her that properly.
41673.progress: She seemed very excited at the sight of the pearl.
41673.completion: Whoa, it really is the size of her head! She will love it. Thank you; I will not forget this favor.

41674.title: Wine Avenger
41674.description:
My winery is lost to those savage grey oafs. Bah! Damn it all! To think we must face the orcs again and again and again. I am absolutely sick and tired of their pig-like faces. If only I were not this damn old, I would grab my pitchfork and leave none standing!

I wish my sons would share this feeling. There they are, moping like children still. I was too soft on them; they know no war, and this is what it has led to. All that our family has is in the hands of the blasted orcs. I tried to spy on them, and what I saw angered me so, so much. Not only were they feasting on my grapes and drinking all my wine, but they also defiled my home!

They must be brought to an end. Aid me, adventurer, and the heirloom of my family is yours. Please, I beg of you, do what I—and my sheepish sons—cannot!
41674.progress: I wish they would never experience a day of peace.
41674.completion: You have slain that many? Good! Their blood will nourish the soil, and the grapes that grow from it will bear the sweet taste of victory.

41675.title: Northwind Amber
41675.description:
That rambling old man I call a father has lost it entirely. Be it old age or his so-called disappointment that we are not willing to die a meaningless death against a horde of orcs, he has yet to stop huffing and puffing. It's not that I don't understand his frustration, but I am no soldier; I am a damn winemaker. How am I supposed to fight something ten times stronger than I?

Were I not already balding, I would tear out a handful of hair. I am barely in my late twenties, and this old man has stressed me so much that my hair is falling out. “We need a new recipe, Jerry—do this, Jerry, do that, Jerry.” He never stops rambling. Yet I love the old man; he is my father, after all. Truth be told, if I had to pick any man from a crowd to be my father, I would still choose him.

Which is why, before his veins give out from frustration, I want him to see the new recipe I made. You will find it on the upper floor of the winery; I hid it in my wardrobe before running away.
41675.completion: Jerry came up with this? Not a bad idea. I gave the kid a hard time; I should go talk to him. Thank you.

41676.title: Orcs by Our Borders
41676.description:
As mindless as these ashen orcs may seem, the reality is entirely different. I managed to have some people—hm, how do I put this? Some VERY skilled, sneaky people—gather intel for me. The information proved fruitful, yet there is not much we can do. While the people I mentioned before are very skilled at gathering intel, they will not do much in a fight.

This is why I believe a group of adventurers, led by none other than a seasoned one such as you, may be capable of putting an end to this orcish threat. There are three of them. You will find Overlord Throkk in a cave we have called the Blackrock Breach, Ozuk Doomspike outside barking orders from a ruined house, and Shuni Steeltooth has infiltrated our territory so deeply that she has taken over one of our watchtowers. You will find the tower resting on the hill that used to keep watch over our Altar of Heroes.

Put an end to them.
41676.completion: Without their leaders, the remaining orcs should return to their filthy lands.

41677.title: Darker than Iron
41677.description:
Were the orcs not enough of a threat themselves, we also have to deal with the Dark Irons, who have left their scorched lands to dig a quarry in ours. By the Light, I swear, for every Dark Iron in this world, there exists a quarry. It's as if some divine intervention wishes for dwarves and quarries to thrive all over the land.

Alas, comedy aside, I need someone capable and brave enough to sabotage them. We do not have the numbers, and frankly, we lack the patience to deal with dwarves right now; the orcs pose a greater threat. Thankfully, the Dark Irons brought powder kegs with them—an easy target for sabotage. Sneak in, or don't—I don't really care—just blow those kegs up!
41677.completion: I heard them blowing up from here. Great job, pick one of these.

41678.title: An Amber Light
41678.description:
I came here to spread the good word of the Light and have people join us on our crusade against the Scourge. Yet, as I look around me, I see nothing but plight and mistrust toward the Light. These people can barely help themselves; they think they are abandoned by it.

They are no true believers—that is all there is to it. Lordaeron fell to the Scourge entirely, yet our Scarlet Monastery still shines with the gloss of the Light. I almost pity these fools. Hmph. Truth be told, I have a task for you. The moment you retrieve the item I require, I will be going back to the monastery; I can't stand the sight of these wretches any longer.

Drowning in guilt and alcohol, they are. Regardless, the item I seek should still be in the burnt abbey—it is a chalice that the former abbot used to bless the waters. It still holds this power, and my people need it more than these scoundrels do. Return it to me, and I will pay you well.
41678.completion: Good, here is your prize. May the Light smite you should you falter from its path.

41679.title: Charred Bones
41679.description:
Wiggles, you good-for-nothing, twice-born idi—oh, that is not you, Wiggles, huh? Quite the predicament.

<Tirion blinks twice at you while fiddling with a flask.>

What are you standing there for? Shoo, be gone. I am busy here—conducting an experime—hm, want to be my lab rat? No? The nerve of some people. You should be proud I even asked, hmph. So, you are... what, an adventurer? Is that why you foolishly came all the way to the outskirts of a human kingdom, for adventure? Bah, fool.

Go beat up some of those bones near the burnt abbey—I am in need of charred bones. Don't ask why! It's for an adventure.

<He mumbles to himself.> Poor idiot.
41679.progress: I said charred bones, not coal.
41679.completion: What—reward? And here I was thinking you were here only for the thrill of adventure. Here, have some coin.

41680.title: Where is Wiggles?
41680.description:
My good-for-nothing assistant has yet to return, which angers me greatly. So, you will go find him. Quite the adventure, don't you think? Fine, fine, I'll stop pulling your leg. I really could use the help. I've sent Wiggles to Birkhaven—or what's left of it, or whatever you wish to call it.

He was supposed to kill an orcish spellcaster from these invading Blackrock orcs. I assume you've heard of a Pyremaster before? No? Long story short, it's some sort of orc—uh... with necromantic talents, but it also works with fire? I'm unsure, that's why I need it dead—so I can bring it back and learn its secrets.

Be on your way then. Find Wiggles. Oh, right, Wiggles has white—balding hair. You should be able to find him easily, don't worry about it.

41681.title: Wiggles Knows the Way
41681.description:
Wiggles smells master on fleshy–fleshy help Wiggles? Wiggles find smelly orc, uerk! UERGH! Very smelly orc.

Smelly orc hide under tent next to catapult. WOOSH–DONK–BONK! Big stone crash, destroy Wiggles. Wiggles sad. No more Wiggles if big stone crash! BONK BONK WIGGLES GONE!

Fleshy go, Wiggles stay?
41681.completion: Fleshy return with smelly orc. Wiggles carry back to master. Smelly lost this, fleshy keep. Bye fleshy.

41682.title: Vile Dwarven Pigs
41682.description:
Lok-tar, pup of the New Horde. I am Dul Wolfsnarl and I hail from Karfang Hold. While we have not been allies for long I judge you are trustworthy enough to become my company. There is no need for me to know what brought you to these lands, yet I hope you are here to cause a little chaos.

Our chieftain sent me to keep an eye on some of our kin that still bows to the Blackrock Mountain. Were those wretches not enough, the dark irons also infiltrated these lands to do what they do best–build a quarry. I do not understand this love for digging, alas, they are digging their own graves.

Carry this pouch to the Sherwood Quarry and blow up their powder kegs. None shall be left by morning.
41682.completion: You may keep that pouch, I no longer need it.

41683.title: Scum Should Stay Scum
41683.description:
Whenever our warleader decided to take a stand against the spawn of Blackhand, it left a wide, gaping hole in the ranks of Blackrock Mountain. Many of our people were honored warriors or respected elders—truth be told, we were the ones meant to attack this land. For better or worse, however, we have not.

Yet scum were appointed in our stead. A travesty, an insult to the might of Karfang. While I dispatch their numbers by other means, I urge you to find strength in numbers and slay those ingrates.

You will find Overlord Throkk in a cave called the Blackrock Breach, Ozuk Doomspike barking orders from a ruined house, and Shuni Steeltooth has infiltrated deep into human territory, so deep that she has taken over one of their watchtowers. You will find the tower resting on the hill that used to keep watch over the Altar of Heroes. Sever their heads and bring them back to me.
41683.completion: A job well done, and a reward well deserved.

41684.title: Shadow's Vision
41684.description:
<The Witch stirs the mushroom concoction, having it turn color from a light red to a vibrant blue. With a devious grin, she gulps the potion down, before entering a trance. Frozen in place, she whispers unintelligible words under her breath. After a short moment, her senses return.>

You are most fortunate, young one. I have seen who you seek - and they still remain here in Northwind. If you intend to capture them, make haste. My vision showed me the location of the young woman whose comb you brought. Ascend the hills past Amberwood Keep and follow its trails. Evil will await you there.
41684.progress: <name>? What brings you to me? You found the ones responsible?! Tell me!
41684.completion:
So orcs were responsible after all; but not the Blackrocks. The way you described them doesn't match with any recent encounters we had with any of the orc clans, at least not the ones I can recall by memory. We will take this to Stormwind and have the headquarters tackle this.

Regarding the girl... I will see to it to retrieve her body myself; I need to see this orc camp either way. Leave telling her mother to me, it is nothing that should fall to someone like you anyway.

41685.title: A Veiled Threat
41685.description:
I will be occupied here in Northwind for a while, which is why I need you to deliver this report in my stead. It contains all evidence we have collected, as well as the letter you have found on the orcs. I myself cannot decipher it, but my superior is versed in many languages, Orcish included. Bring this to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind's Old Town as soon as possible. Tell him in person what you have seen and experienced.

I wish you the best of luck. King's Honor, friend.
41685.progress: What purpose do you have with the SI:7?
41685.completion:
So Hawthorne deputized you as assistant for his investigations in Northwind. Let me see what results you have to show.

<Shaw takes a thorough look through Hawthorne's journal and an even more thorough read over the letter you have found at the orc camp. With a stern expression, he rolls the parchment and shows you the seal at the end of it.>

This is the seal of the Stormreaver Clan. This is an old orc clan we believed to have perished at the end of the Second War. I have read through this letter and what's inside matches with the kingdom's ailments: They issued the abductions of careless citizens, but turned their focus to Northwind for some unknown reason. Still, this is not the most alarming revelation about this whole ordeal. But first, a reward for your assistance.

41686.title: Into The Tortured Past
41686.description:
You have surely wondered to yourself where they might have taken the kidnapped people. Fortunately for us, this document tells us where they are operating from. As much as it plays into our hands, reading the name of the island sent shivers down my spine. The cursed, dread island of Balor, off the western coast of Stormwind Harbor. The kingdom has not set foot onto it for decades, for its legacy is one of demise and harrowing disaster.

We cannot wait much longer. If Balor truly is their base of operation, then the fate of the captured citizens is grim. I will send a task force posthaste, and I want you to accompany them. Prepare whatever you need for this forsaken island, do not take this lightly. Operative Simmons in Stormwind Harbor will make sure to set you on the right path to Balor. Once there, report to Verona Gillian, she will lead the operations.

Do your best, <class>.
41686.completion: External forces, I reckon? We're hard at work, so any new pair of hands is welcome.

41687.title: Misery At Sherwood Quarry
41687.description: These lightforsaken Dark Iron! How dare they fall into our beautiful vale?! As if their home turf of a mountain is not good enough, no! They just couldn't help themselves and seize control of my wonderful quarry I had governed so diligently. Oh, it makes me so furious just thinking about it! You! Grab your weapon, spells or whatever you use to kill things and go to Sherwood Quarry far to the northeast. I want you to remove every single pest you can find there and rain down the same agony they inflicted on my subordinates. They will not go unpunished!
41687.progress: Don't you dare return without being drenched in ash and blood.
41687.completion: Wonderful, just retribution for trespassing into my lands, raiding Birkhaven and ruining my mining schedules! They've got what they had coming for them! I must thank you. Here, choose something to your liking, someone of your caliber more than deserved it.

41688.title: To Look A Gift Horse In The Mouth
41688.description:
Greetings, <class>. Do you enjoy your stay at Amberwood Keep? My noble compatriots and I have more than enough issues to resolve, so I am afraid the minimum amount of hospitality is all we can afford at the moment. Still, you look like the lively type; interested in lending a hand? I promise, it will be worth your while.

My name is Josephine Mildenhall and I oversee the agricultural facilities of Northwind, mainly the Mildenhall Horse Farm and the Crawford Winery. The former has its hand tied by two things: the jousting tournament and a missing delivery of horse feed. They take care of all the contestants' steeds and need high quality horse feed directly ordered from Westfall to ensure optimal conditions can be met on the day of the competitions. To much of my dismay, this delivery was stolen by the delinquent gnolls roaming the Auburn Forest south of here, putting immense pressure on my subordinates. Please, reclaim the sacks and bring them to Horsekeeper Geringt at the horse farm.
41688.progress: Oh, Greetings. Apologies, but I can't really spend any time on chit chat. Many of the competitors need their horses ready for practice.
41688.completion: The horse feed! Lady Mildenhall informed me someone has been tasked in retrieving the lost sacks from the gnolls. Am I relieved to see it all safe and mostly undamaged. We were running short on our old supplies and just feeding these horses hay does not provide them enough energy for the taxing physical exercise they have to fulfill in the tournament. Thank you very much again! Lady Mildenhall gave me some coin for you once you've finished her task, so please take it.

41689.title: A Good Samaritan
41689.description: <The weakened duck is leaning against the cavern wall, huffing air out of its bill and making faint noises. Judging from the red stain on its wing, it has been in a skirmish, possibly escaping from the bloodthirsty murlocs living around Grimmen Lake. Trying to comfort the injured animal, you guide your hand to its little body. Still in shock, the waterfowl shrieks and flaps its wings in fright. spraying blood on the ground. Without calming it down first there is little chance at treating the wound. Perhaps you can befriend it by collecting some greens along the riverstream and the coast around Grimmen Lake.>
41689.progress: <The round button eyes stare at you.>
41689.completion: <You approach the poor thing with slow and careful movements. Greens in hand, you lay them gently in front of its bill, before witnessing it nibbling on the strands of grass. Distracting it with the strong aroma and flavour of the herbs, you have ample time to administer the bandage to its wing. Now that the wound is secured and the little one is strengthened by the greens, it keeps staring at you with an endearing look on its feathered face.>

41690.title: Still Not Enough
41690.description: <While the greens and bandage have certainly helped, the duck doesn't appear to be over the worst. Shaky and uncertain on its feet, it tumbles around while trying to exit the cave. You can't bring yourself to simply leave it to the world like that and decide to carry it to someone here in Northwind who can do more.>
41690.progress: Awfully busy today, wouldn't you agree?
41690.completion: You were lucky, given you did not know what you fed this poor thing. The plants you picked are called Noble's Pillow, infamous for their muscle numbing properties. They most assuredly helped ease its pain, yet there is still much to do if you want to save the little one.

41691.title: Some May Call It Quackery
41691.description: Northwind is home to many herbs and plants of various uses. The people of Stormwind learned to harness their properties long ago and have used them ever since. Watching them gain their knowledge through trial and error was amusing, truly. To help your quacking little friend here, I need you to pick a few strands of Winter's Kiss for me, a flower with a vibrant white bloom. A distant cousin of the Winter's Bite herb, it can quickly stop bleeding and infections if processed properly. The flower grows to the east of here, along the snowy ridges to the north. To create a potent salve, Ambersap is also needed. The resident bears delight in the sap of the auburn trees, some of it sticking to their fur. Gather this for me and the little one should be safe and sound.
41691.progress: Don't tarry too long, its condition won't hold up forever.
41691.completion:
<The old hag grinds up the herbs in a mortar before mixing in the gooey ambersap. Stirring the ointment, she applies it onto a new bandage. Carefully removing the old one, another batch is spread over the little ducks wound, much to its dismay. With quick but delicate movements the witch wraps the bandage around its left wing, securing it in place.>

There, darling; this will help it recover very quickly. Defenseless creatures like our friend here rarely have such luck at meeting a kind soul like you. And judging by its behaviour, it recognizes your efforts just as much. Your actions formed a formidable bond today. Make sure to foster it greatly, as power lies deeply rooted in such connections.

41692.title: Assessing The Situation
41692.description: Good to have more hands on deck. Shaw didn't exactly send a whole regiment on this accursed island, which means we have to deal with what we got. Our current main objective is scouting the area and finding out what the Stormreaver are doing and for what reason. We have yet to encounter any orcs in the area, meaning we're a bit dry on leads. Good thing we have you with us now.

41693.title: The Last Lines
41693.description: <The journal features dedicated listings of sightings, observations, shift schedules and oddities encountered during the few hours the corps was stationed on the plateau. Despite having seen several specters of past denizens, nothing purveyed anything related to the disappearances from Northwind. While smoke was seen emanating from the castle ruins across the ravines, no attempts for reconnaissance were made yet. Furthermore, it appears that a small force of Thrall's Horde has settled on one of the smaller islands. Whatever they are planning on this island remains a conundrum for now.

41694.title: To The Darkest Places
41694.description: My corps consisted of ten operatives, surveying the perimeter around the Croaking Plateau. From the few ones that survived I was the only one locked up in this inn. For what reason I don't know. What I could see, however, was three of my comrades - Flynn, Elroy and Cherys - being dragged past the battlefield to the south of here. Luckily I understood a few of the orcish words they spoke. ‘Cave', ‘hill' and ‘master' are what I could decipher from their speech. It may not be much, but it is better than nothing, I guess. Apologies, but I won't be of much help to you with these injuries; I will report back to Operative Gillian and tell her what happened, that much I should manage. I pray you can uncover more and return safely back to the outpost.
41694.progress: <name>, you've returned? Agent Deryl arrived here not long before you, his body strewn with grievous wounds. We've sent him back to Stormwind for recuperation. But tell me, is there anything you could find?
41694.completion: A pity, those were valuable agents we've lost today. I'll send missives to their families, their service to the Kingdom won't be forgotten. Now, regarding this scroll...

41695.title: Noppsy Spickerspan
41695.description: The SI:7 has many specialized forces within its organization: scouting agents, spies, explosives experts, field medics, archivists... Noppsy Spickerspan is one such archivist, his goal is to document everything that occurs during large-scale operations. As such he is versed in many talents, translating being one of them. You can imagine how useful it is to have someone at your disposal who can decipher enemy intel for you. Hand him the scroll and let us find out what those occult bastards are up to.
41695.progress: Hello, friend; how may I help you?
41695.completion:
I must say, it is thrilling to be on such a historical mission. The island of Balor is drenched in myths, legend and history. I can barely contain myself!

Operative Gillian is a bit uneasy ever since we landed here, understandable, really. Not the most hospitable place. Still, we have a duty to fulfill, our service to the Alliance cannot be hindered by some measly ghosts. Either way, I take it you have something for me?

41696.title: You May Call This Cheating...
41696.description:
<Noppsy opens the scroll and scans the surface of the old parchment. Furled brows indicate that this document may be tougher than expected.>

This one is quite the conundrum, it's not only in orcish, but also coded in a way that is atypical for orcish missives. It will take some time for me to crack the code and translate. Luckily you don't have to sit here, waiting for me to finish. I am certain this scroll isn't the only of its kind. There must be others, handed around between the Stormreaver orcs here on Balor. If I can get my hands on more of their correspondences, it would accelerate the translation process immensely!
41696.progress: Gel'ror? No, no, no... Galbor? No, that's not it, either...
41696.completion:
I see you are back, with writings in hand! Splendid, really. Having a few more phrases to compare and reference will make this whole ordeal all the more quicker. What I was able to find out is that their way of encoding their texts is very similar to historical documents we have from the Second War. Which leads me to believe that we are dealing with remnants and survivors of said war. Interesting, isn't it?

Regardless, please let me finish the translation, it should not take too long, friend.

41697.title: Demons Galore
41697.description:
My brother Noppsy is a bit of an oddball, even among us gnomes. His fanatical admiration with all things scholarly made him famous - or rather infamous - even back in Gnomeregan. I am not quite sure if I should endorse you fostering his obsession, but even I can't deny his skillset has helped us solve more operations than I'd like to admit.

I have a job for you, whilst you are out there scouring the island for the orcish writings. Our agents have located a cave on the opposite site of Balor, filled with a troubling variety of demons. As if the orcs weren't enough, they continue their habit of communion with demonic forces. I want you to infiltrate the cave, dispatch any possible figurehead and thin out their numbers. The less of them we have to deal with, the better.
41697.progress: It is important to neutralize any threats before they can realize their full potential. Being two steps ahead of your enemy is a doctrine engrained in every SI:7 member.
41697.completion: Mission accomplished. Well done, <class>. Sadly, I suspect we cannot ultimately cut off the demonic forces here with their warlocks still up and running. But we take any little victory we can get. Remember, this is a war against numbers, gotta use what you got to your advantage! Speaking of advantage, this tablet you brought with you has to contain crucial information about the demon's involvement in all of this. I just know it! I will bring it to Noppsy, he'll know what needs to be done.

41698.title: Explosives Make My Heart Go BOOM!
41698.description:
<Rufus opens a small tin box filled with black powder, before taking a deep, deep sniff with his big nose. A satisfied sigh escapes him.>

Don't let Gillian know I keep this stashed, otherwise I'll be on latrine duty again. What a mess, I'm telling you! I heard good ole Noppsy asked for your help? You don't mind me asking you for a favor as well? Believe it or not, but the SI:7 doesn't do only jobs of the silent kind. No, no. Infiltration and sabotage go hand in hand, and I'm the man if you want to see things go BOOM. The old fortifications of Balor are mostly decrepit and wide open, but they still offer a significant advantage to our enemies. Place these near the broken watchtower and their camps at the old battlefield. They'll be ready once the time is right!
41698.progress: Too bad I won't be able to see those beautiful explosions through all of this fog. I guess their sound will have to suffice for now.
41698.completion:
Ohoho, fine handiwork, friend. Those demon-hugging orcs will be in for a surprise once we press this detonator here and all the explosive goodness is just flying all around them!

<Rufus' eyes are full of glee, to the point where he appears like an overly joyous bearded child.>

Ho, this reminds me of that one time I almost blew up the Dwarven District in Stormwind. I'll share the story with you over an ale after we're done brooding over this blasted island. An honest dwarven promise!

41699.title: Harrowing News
41699.description:
<The gnome is lost in deep contemplation. His brows are furled and a determined expression is chiseled onto his face.>

Oh, <name>! Apologies, my rampant thoughts made me not realize you returned. I just finished decrypting both the scroll and the tablet you found in that demon cave. What I discovered is... well, horrifying, to put it lightly.

The scroll you found on that Stormreaver necrolyte speaks of aberrant experiments conducted on their captives. Many of them being ‘not suitable', resulting in - if I translated correctly - liquefaction. Equally alarming is the contents of the stone table my sister Nippsy handed me. The demon's plan is to aid the Stormreaver orcs in summoning a demon of insurmountable power - one they call Mergothid. I reckon they will need a vast amount of energy for that to be accomplished...

<name>, please hand this report to Operative Gillian. If my understanding of the situation is correct, and I am certain that it is, then we cannot wait much longer.
41699.progress: Has Noppsy finished his translation? What have you found out?
41699.completion:
<Verona is reading Noppsy's report without changing expressions. Her meticulous analysis of the report reminds you why she is the spearhead of this operation.>

<name>, ready yourself. We will launch an infiltration.

41700.title: The Gold Experience
41700.description:
Our helmsman Verix steered us over this island, not realizing we'd be flying directly into a hornet's nest of thunderstorms. I would be cursing him to the slums of Undermine, but if there is anyone to blame it would be me for allowing him to sway the course. That's exactly why it is my duty to get us all off this wretched island. Without my compass however, we have little chance of escaping this harsh weather and returning to Booty Bay!

The slimy snake Verix took it with him, practically holding us hostage. It seems he knows this island, as he blabbered about endless treasure sleeping in its ruins. Frankly, if our situation were not so dire, I would accompany him, but the survival of my crew is top priority. His journal says something about a crypt full of gold, go find him and bring me back my compass!
41700.progress: Verix' greed cost me my beautiful zeppelin, he has to answer for his crimes!
41700.completion: My compass! Does that mean Verix got what he deserved? Good riddance to him, if you ask me. One goblin's misery is another goblin's fortune, as we like to say. With my compass back in my possession, all that is left is to repair the Gullwing into workable shape. Thank you for your help, <class>. You can keep some of the coins that Verix looted. If you want to keep lending your hand, we won't say no.

41701.title: The Goblin Way Of Fishing
41701.description:
Let me ask you something: Have you ever seen a lobster twice your size devour a goblin alive? Or seen a land walking fish man gnaw on a poor fellow's head? If yes, then you'll surely share my seething hatred for these abyssal monsters. Murlocs, Makrura, Naga, you name it; I even lost a good business partner to a clam once in the reefs of Stranglethorn! As if fate is playing dirty tricks on our unfortunate crew, we've been stranded right between some turf war between the gurgling fish heads and their clackering neighbours. I'd say let them bash their noggins in if they got nothing better to do, but they are beginning to encroach on our camp and we are too tired from fixing the zeppelin to fend them off for much longer.

I see that fire in your eyes, friend. Go out and start cleaning up the place; there should be enough of them out in the ocean southeast of here.
41701.progress: Drench the seas red with their icky blood, but keep a watchful eye out for the roaming sharks around here.
41701.completion: Excellent work, <class>. These fiends may be horrors beyond our comprehension, but at least they have a delicious taste to them. We can survive a few more days cooking a fine gumbo with it. Either way, it seems we are not done dealing with them just yet.

41702.title: Tide-ying Up
41702.description:
While you were busy dealing with this minor inconvenience, Rikki returned from her routine scouting round. She noticed suspicious activities coming from just north of our tiny island. Ripples of water and rising waves, as well as turbulent vortices building themselves upon the ocean's surface. My best bet is that it must be a powerful magic-wielding makrura, perhaps even their leader. Coincidentally, something similar could be seen just coming from beyond the island east of here. Call me paranoid, but these are tell-tale signs of the murlocs and makrura playing it big in this turf war.

Whatever it may be, both of them pose a hazard to our escape. <name>, without someone stopping them, our chances of ever escaping this island are slim. You already proven yourself capable of dealing with the small fry; do you think you're up for more challenging foes?
41702.progress: The way they're behaving makes you think there'd be something for them here, but for the love of me, I cannot fathom just what it may be.
41702.completion: I have to admit, I'm impressed. The others and I were waging with how many limbs you'd return or if we'd have to fish your limp body out of the ocean. Guess I'll owe Rikki some gold when we're back in Booty Bay. Regardless, incredible display of skills by you. Yunie will be relieved to have one less issue holding us back. If you're ever bored of adventuring around the world, the Steamwheedle Headquarters in Undermine are always in need of capable bruisers. Think about it, you'd fit right in!

41703.title: Favor For Spare Parts
41703.description:
Repairs for our zeppelin are in full swing, as much as they can be with the makeshift materials we have at hand. I doubt we will come far with what we have right now, however. Call it bad luck or fortune, but there is a pirate ship just east of our small island. What they're here for, I don't know, but given that they are pirates, I can only assume it to be booty. Let's make the best of their presence. A ship like theirs looks chock full of supplies and necessities we could use to make our lives a lot better. While I'm certain they won't part with their belongings willingly, your demeanour is convincing enough for them to change their mind, don't you think?

<Kixqal is nudging you with an aggressive wink.>

While you're out and about, could you stop by Booty Bay and ask our contractor for a spare zeppelin motor? I'm certain it's in his best interest if we make it out of here and deliver his goods. Markel Smythe's the name, he should be around the city's town hall at the docks.
41703.progress: We can't spare too much time on the repairs, this humidity is not to be underestimated. I'd prefer if the zeppelins hull would not break halfway through Stranglethorn, so hurry up, yes?
41703.completion: Color me surprised, a whole treasure trove full of valuable materials. This alone should suffice for rebuilding the outer frame of the Gullwing. I have to say, I didn't expect you to be so successful. But that was to be expected for someone crazy enough to come to such a backwater island willingly, I suppose? Either way, we owe you one big time, friend. Goblin promise!

41704.title: Put Them To Rest
41704.description:
Unlike myself, my servants are not aware of their ghastly condition. Even my sister's mind is slowly escaping her grasp. The peasants and workers begin to aimlessly wander the island, clinging to whatever they did when still alive. An endless purgatory, incapable of passing on into the afterlife. As their lord, it is my obligation to relinquish them from that limbo, yet I am unable to.

A most humble request, kind traveler: Break their spectral bodies and allow their souls to join the Light. It pains me to see them suffer still.
41704.progress: Their wailing haunts my undeath, a cacophony lamenting my incompetence as their lord.
41704.completion: Silence, not quite, but almost. My ghostly heart eases at your mercy. A noble deed of yours, truly. Had it not been for your kindness, the unrelenting torrent of their cries would have torn me into a vortex of insanity, that I am certain of. Balor's curse may be perpetual, yet its effects are now ever so slightly diminished. You are in my debt, <class>.

41705.title: Poor Porcelain Doll
41705.description:
<The woman lies almost motionless before you. Her emaciated body is a horrid sight, accompanied by raspy and irregular breathing. Tightly clasped in her bony hand is a lump of clay, crudely formed into a human shape. Right next to it, primitive symbols are drawn into the thick layer of dust on the church ground. From what you can decipher, they depict two humanoids, one larger than the other. A line connects the figures to another drawing, an uneven circle on a curve; below it, many crosses frantically scattered in the dust. You remember a cave barely visible on the hill overlooking the desolate battlefield.

It is clear to you that she will not survive for long. Perhaps you can find something in that cave to soothe her last moments.>
41705.completion:
<You place the fragmented doll in front of the woman's face and with a burst of unexpected ecstasy, her eyes widen as much as her brittle body allows it. With the last of her strength, she grasps the doll, with its edges digging deep into her hand, yet producing no blood flow. A last pitiful wailing is uttered before she stops moving entirely.

Whether or not your last act made her death less painful, you can only guess. Atleast you can be certain that she is in agony no more.>

41706.title: Foul Essences
41706.description:
Nature be with you, traveler. How peculiar to find another like-minded soul here on this island. I premused only Olmir and I were anchored at these cliffs. Let me introduce myself: My name is Methendra Owltalon, I am a Druid of the Cenarion Circle on a mission for my Shan'do Staghelm. In his endless wisdom, he sensed a terrible darkness permeating from this isle, one he felt last during the Third War on Kalimdor. In our short time here I noticed suspicious behavior in the local wildlife. Regardless of the harsh living conditions, they portray an unusual amount of aggression and frequent clawing at their environment. Something is plaguing them, and it is up to us to find out why.

Put the aching animals out of their pain and retrieve the essences of their agony. Hopefully they will shine a light on what is happening to them.
41706.progress: Shan'do Staghelm possesses the knowledge to uncover this mystery. It is our duty to help him prevent this darkness from spreading.
41706.completion: How vile... just being near them fills me with a burdening lethargy. This foulness is akin to what haunts our forests on Kalimdor, very much so. Yet still distinct enough to not be the same... I cannot fathom how painful it must've been to live with such a shadow in one's body.

41707.title: Fungal Fever
41707.description:
Disease and maladies run rampant on this island. A melting pot of sicknesses, coupled with an unnatural mist of darkness emerging from the sickly ground. Our operatives begin to be affected by an ailment caused by these phenomena. High fever, irritated rashes and excruciating cramps in both organs and muscle alike. In my duty as the expedition's medic, I will eradicate their symptoms; and I wish you to assist me.

I have theorized that the progenitor stems from the tiny mushroom spores that permeate the island's atmosphere. I assume that over the years, a large cultivation of toxic mushrooms developed underneath the earth that now send their buds out for propagation. Some of them even came to life in the form of horrifying spore beasts, as our scouts report; in an abandoned mine, past the desolate battlefield. To counteract the symptoms, I need the most potent spores, which I believe can be found on them.
41707.progress: <Kinrial doesn't really pay attention to you.>
41707.completion:
<Inspecting the mycelia under her monocle, Kinrial's face is masked in a stern expression; you assume both concern and critical intrigue.>

Interesting, the mushroom strains continue seeking fertile ground to propagate in. Under normal circumstances they'd quickly die if not nestled in fitting soil, but not these. They writhe and firm around, actively looking for nutrients. A harrowing sight. For our operatives' sake, I will conceal this unsavory detail.

41708.title: Stinging Lullaby
41708.description: I respect Agent Gillian as our leader, just like anyone in this outpost. Her procedures are methodical and strike a fair balance between the security of her task force and the success of the mission. She is not afraid to take actions in her own hands, a fear reminiscent of my people on Kalimdor. She advised us to take advantage of Balor's unique environment and circumstances, an order I am more than happy to oblige with. When I scoured the island earlier, I bore witness to a fascinating scene. One of the fiendish orcs sought skirmish with the local arachnid population to the north. She fell victim to a bite, rapidly followed by sudden lethargy until she became easy prey. These spiders must possess a very potent venom with narcotic and paralyzing properties. Should we extract it, it could provide ample uses for our campaign on Balor. Bring me their venom sacs and thin out their numbers while you do so. They may be useful to us, but remain a hazard nonetheless.
41708.progress: You may think a medic indulging in poison distillation is uncommon, but this is a required expertise in the SI:7, regardless of designation. My knowledge over the body and anatomy in particular gives me certain insights others may lack.
41708.completion: An unusally biting odor. Extracting a functioning poison from them might take some time, but the result will be worth the effort tenfold. I must thank you, your assistance accelerates the success of this mission more than you'd think.

41709.title: Ceaseless Storms
41709.description:
The storms of Balor fascinate me. During my stay in Davenburg I was occasionally able to peer into the distance and see the heavy clouds loom over the island like a coat of misery and gloom. I convened with my fellow hydromancers and conjured a few theories on what the cause of this unnatural phenomenon could be. There never really was a chance for us to explore this island safely before, however with the expedition of the SI:7 venturing here, such an opportunity arose and I naturally volunteered to assist them.

Feeling the tempest up close made me realize that it was assuredly different from the gales we encountered out on the open sea in Kul Tiras. Furthermore I began observing the local murlocs, as they appear to wield some sort of tidal magic not unsimilar to us hydromancers. <name>, seek out the murloc tidecaller and see if they possess anything unusual. Our last reports say they congregated in the northwestern islands.
41709.progress: Kul Tiras and Balor share a history, were it not their ships to make trade with our fledgling nation many decades ago. As such I feel a distant connection and familiarity with this place, as faint as it may be.
41709.completion: This shine and texture...! Even in this small chip of it, I can feel the tides resonate within it. And you picked it up from an enormous pearl on an altar, crackling with energy? I'll be honest with you, that sounds most alarming.

41710.title: Piece Of A Bigger Picture
41710.description:
The pearl you found possesses tidal energy, meaning its mere presence controls the flow of the ocean and the temper of the sky. Seeing as it is damaged to a great amount, it would explain how the tempest is so unbound around here. How truly fascinating to see such a relic on this desolate island. Has it always been here? We can worry about this later, however. First and foremost we need to level the rampant energy within the pearl.

I can subside the pearl's unbridled power with a spell, but I require a few ingredients for that. A reflecting crystal, facetted and sharp. The Stone Maw basilisks near the northern river in the Stranglethorn Vale create these stones as they age. Bring me the biggest you can find. I also need my old spellbook, which I gifted to my good friend Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Tell him I sent you, and he will gladly return it to me. To complete everything, bring me also three greater astral essences.
41710.progress: From what we gathered I would assume the murlocs are collecting the shards of the broken pearl to complete it again. They do possess a degree of intelligence, more than enough to cast spells, yet even this is abnormal for what you'd expect from your regular murloc.
41710.completion: That old fool. He always had a knack for living on the edge, but he should really start caring more about his safety. Either way, I am glad he is still in good health. Now then, my book may be a bit waterlogged, but I can formulate the spell nevertheless.

41711.title: Calming The Tempest
41711.description:
<Finnigan places the reagents on the table in front of him. Reciting spells written in his old journal, you can feel the air crackling with faint energy around the crystal you recovered in Stranglethorn Vale. It begins to glow in various hues of blue, shifting between darkness and bright light. With one last movement of his hands, the hydromancer finishes the sorcery and the crystal lies now still, hummin in perfect harmony.>

It is done. Quickly, take the crystal and hold it near the shattered pearl, on the northwestern islands. The crystal's own harmonious energy should be enough to soothe the pearl's raging energy. Beware of what might happen; tidal magic is unpredictable and untamed.
41711.progress: All of this is more than puzzling, yet the situation calls for action, not speculation.
41711.completion:
Naga, you say?! This is truly bad news. If these slithering demons are behind this phenomenon, then I dare not think what their true intentions are. For now we have thwarted their ambitions. However, I do wonder, has this pearl been here all along? If so, was it always broken? And if not, why was it brought here; and by whom? The naga or the murlocs? Many unanswered questions still lie before us and none of them seem to be easily answered. Either way, I must thank you for your assistance. Our findings today helped me gain a better understanding of Balor's unending storm. Once I return to Davenburg, I will send notice to the Council of Tides in Boralus about the pearl, as well as the naga's involvement in all of this. With their ongoing incursions onto Kul Tiras, I am afraid this won't be the last we've seen of them.

Please, take this as humble compensation for your deeds.

41712.title: Letter Far From Home
41712.description: <Almost hidden in the attic of the stable you find the remains of a deceased person, its cracked bones telling you of its old age. Next to it, a piece of paper, equally as old, yet still readable enough to recognize its contents. Reading it, he must've taken it with him before fleeing into these stables. Perhaps you can be the one to deliver it after all these years.>
41712.progress: Can I help you with something?
41712.completion: <Griselda is reading the dusty letter carefully, so as not to rip its paper with an unmindful move. A bittersweet expression hushes across the face, her eyes showing mild shock, but not the kind brought upon by bad news. Instead, a smile whisks itself upon her lips.>

41713.title: Solutions To Arcane Resonance
41713.description:
Can you imagine a greater misery than being aware of your perpetual undeath? To be bound to this accursed tower till the end of time? I certainly can not. Forever doomed to research the mysteries of the Arcane, many of us have lost their mind already. Who can blame them? One would assume it to be an easy way out of this desolation. But I am not a man who gives in to the path of least resistance. Upon my pride as a scholar, I will break free from the magical tether of this spire; and you will assist me.

Search the library. The maddened master of the tower possesses a book with a striking title, a heavy tome I need you to find. ‘Solutions to Arcane Resonance', that is what I require. Bring it to me and we will finally be able to break free of this eternal shackle.
41713.progress: You will know which grimoire it is once you're near it. Its potent energies pour out of its pages even decades later.
41713.completion: Breathtaking. The mysteries that will unfurl before my eyes while reading this ancient tome will be the key to our freedom.

41714.title: The Solution Is Right Here
41714.description:
From what is standing here, an ample amount of arcane energy is needed to break the band binding us to this tower. With just the right combination of reagents, I can create a power source potent enough to break the eternal chains of mine.

Listen, I require your aid once more. Collect the following sources of energy and bring them to me. I will recite the incantation and hopefully will dissolve the tether once and for all.
41714.progress: Be quick, <name>. We cannot wait any longer. Freedom is just a conjuring away!
41714.completion:
<Ralwen grabs the reagents and places them in front of him. Quickly reciting the book's chants, they begin to move and converge violently, releasing a powerful shockwave. What is left behind is an immaculate crystal.>

Blasted magic, it did not work! I fear we need more energy for the chains to shatter. Do not fret, I am sure we will succeed eventually. As compensation for your deeds, please take the crystal we just created with you. I am certain it will prove to be useful in your journeys.

41715.title: Again Into the Great Ossuary
41715.completion:
Are you headed back into the Scholomance, <name>? You've already paid such a great price for the use of the Divination Scryer - perhaps you'd like to take another one with you. With it, you'd be able to face the perils of the Great Ossuary once more.

By all means, have it. You've certainly earned it.

41716.title: The Shatterblade Expedition
41716.description:
Our situation here at Shatterblade Post is a precarious one. We are far from home, and our supply lines are stretched extraordinarily thin. This is certainly not the ideal situation for any warrior, nor for any outpost.

My advisor Ranagg is more up to date with information. If you truly wish to help us here, speak with him, and he can fill you in.
41716.completion:
I saw you speaking with Commander Aggnash. What he speaks is the truth. We are under constant threat from a much more powerful enemy. The Dragonmaw have a grip over the region, and their power is unmatched. They outnumber even the dwarves of Dun Kithas by a significant margin.

If we want to truly make our place here, we will need to take action before action is taken upon us.

41717.title: The Dragonmaw Threat
41717.description:
Our greatest threat is that of the Dragonmaw Clan. Their numbers are vast, and their strength is ever present. Just recently they have attacked, and laid ruin to Baggoth's Rampart. One of the key defensive structures for the dwarves of Dun Kithas.

I fear that with this victory they will grow more bold in their actions.

We must discover their future plans. I require you to head to Baggoth's Rampart to the southwest, and find the Dragonmaw Orders from the attackers. I am certain one of them have it.

When you recover the orders, return to me.
41717.progress: Our security is in jeopardy every minute that you waste.
41717.completion:
You've recovered them?

<Advisor Ranagg snatches the orders from your hands, and quickly begins to read.>

These orders seem to contain plans for further invasions in the region.

41718.title: The Dragonmaw Orders
41718.description:
Detailed in these plans are further assaults upon Dun Kithas, but more importantly on Shatterblade Post. These plans seem to be coordinated by Geshgan Blackhollow, one of the Dragonmaw captains.

Bring this information to Commander Aggnash, he will decide our next course of action.
41718.completion: So, they do intend to target us.

41719.title: Death to Geshgan
41719.description:
Geshgan Blackhollow, that name is familiar to me.

When we first arrived in Grim Reaches, we conducted a series of investigations upon the Dragonmaw Clan. Geshgan is a loyal captain who commands his own retinue of skilled, and battle hardened warriors. It is time that we put an end to his plans.

Geshgan can be found lurking in the Ruins of Stolgaz Keep to the northwest. I advise you to bring allies, for that forgotten place is filled with Dragonmaw warriors. Kill him, and bring his head to me as proof.
41719.progress: Geshgan Blackhollow is a cunning foe, do not let your guard down.
41719.completion:
<Commander Aggnash lets out a hearty laugh>

You have done well this day, Geshgan was a brutal enemy, and now he has fallen. You have served us well.

41720.title: Stolgaz Documents
41720.description:
I hear you intend to brave Stolgaz Keep, if you do, I have a task that requires attention.

Some time ago, Stolgaz Keep was once the heart of the Grim Reaches. It projected power, and held many important documents.

It is these documents that I require, and I am certain I can find something useful amongst them. Travel to Stolgaz Keep to the northwest, and find a crate of these documents. Bring them to me, and I shall reward you.
41720.completion: You have done well, these have not been tampered by Dragonmaw hands... Go now, for I have research to do.

41721.title: Zarm'geth Stronghold
41721.description:
The time for battle is upon us, and the time for heroes is now. It is time to strike at the heart of our enemy, and crush them. Zarm'geth Stronghold to the northwest is the headquarters of the Dragonmaw Clan in Grim Reaches. It is there we shall secure our victory.

Travel there, and slay them in the name of the Horde! Let them know our fury, and return when they are culled.
41721.progress: Our victory is at hand, make your way to Zarm'geth Stronghold!
41721.completion:
The day of victory has come at last, your actions have paved the way for the Horde to claim this land for itself. Thrall's wisdom is clear in your actions.

You shall be rewarded for your work this day.

41722.title: Shatterblade Stew
41722.description:
Lok'tar friend! I am Bargolnak, and I am in charge of the cooking around here in town. If you know anything about being on the fringes, it's that things can get rather stale.

It's my job to offer some variety to those that are stationed here. You would be surprised what a change of meal can do to morale.

The only ration that I have available is meat and I'd like some variety.

You should be able to find plenty of Brown Recluse all around Grim Reaches, If you could gather six recluse legs it would go a long way to helping me out.
41722.progress: Have you had any luck in finding those juicy legs?
41722.completion:
Would you look at the proportions of these?! These recluse legs will make a fine addition to the stock of food I have available. You've done me a great service, and everyone here in town.

Take these coins, and go with honor friend.

41723.title: Bounty on Wild Maw
41723.description: The raging Wild Maw to the north of Shatterblade Post have grown to become a larger threat than once thought. Their hostility and location is posing a threat to our operations here within the region.

41724.title: The Betrayal of Rethkag
41724.description:
We once had a warlock here within Shatterblade Post, one that spoke of honor, of loyalty. In reality, his loyalties laid with the Dragonmaw clan.

This orc goes by the name Rethkag Mirefang. A truly vile, and spineless creature. I aided him in finding a family heirloom, helping him find peace. I even considered this worm a dear friend for many months.

His actions have hurt far more than any wound I have suffered, and now I demand his blood. You can find him, overlooking the region from his tower in Geth'kar just to the northwest of here. Kill him, and return to me.
41724.completion:
I am pleased. To think one would betray their oaths, friends, and loyalties for power sickens me to my core. You have done the Horde a service in rooting out such a vile traitor.

Take this, may it aid your cause even further.

41725.title: Dark Iron Components
41725.description:
Bah, the state of this place is almost beyond saving. I am tasked to be a siege engineer with no actual machinery or parts?

The only equipment that I have to work on is two captured Dragonmaw catapults. If I am to ever create or work on anything, I will need to improvise.

The nearby dwarven excavation to the south has recently been occupied by Dark Iron. If there is anything they know, its malevolent contraptions and engineering.

I want you to head into Groldan's Excavation to the south of here and find any Dark Iron Components they may have sitting around. They will make better use in my hands, than in our enemies.
41725.progress: Have you recovered the Dark Iron Components, or are you just stopping by to say hello?
41725.completion: Such excellent craftsmanship, these components will serve me well.

41726.title: Scavenging the Wrecks
41726.description:
Now that I've recovered some components I would like to get my hand on some more complicated parts. Some time ago many steam tanks were destroyed during the war between the dwarves of Dun Kithas, and the Dragonmaw. These once mighty machines sit idle in the countryside to the west and southwest, rotting away.

Such complicated engineering is not something I can replicate here in the field. Find me six of these intricate parts from the wrecks around the region and I will make sure you are rewarded handsomely.
41726.completion:
Such fine craftsmanship, you can tell goblin or gnomish hands touched such engineering.

With these parts I will be able to advance our efforts in Shatterblade Post even further.

I must commend you for your work. Without the components and parts you have recovered this basecamp would be left in the stone age.

Take one of these items, hopefully you will see use out of them.

41727.title: Entranced Magic
41727.description:
You there, <class>. I require assistance in a task vital to the Horde, one that could secure our place here within Grim Reaches. There is a latent power lingering within the region, and it is my desire to claim it for myself.

To harness such energies requires natural materials latent with magical vitality. I require you to gather the blood of the nearby entranced dragonkin. These creatures are under the control of the Dragonmaw clan, and can be found to the southwest of here. Gather their blood, and return it to me.
41727.progress: The blood is required for my rituals, has it been obtained <class>?
41727.completion: The power of the Demon Soul is infused within this blood, its power is undeniable.

41728.title: Natural Remedies
41728.description:
If I am to truly captivate the magic of the region I will require a series of natural materials to amplify my abilities. Our real work is yet to come, but we must prepare nonetheless.

I require some trace of fel energy from the demons of the burning legion, I do know they have a presence in Desolace, seek them out there.

Lastly, I will require the scale of a basilisk, Crystal Spine basilisks to be more specific. This rare breed can be found along the Savage Coast in Stranglethorn Vale, seek them out, and gather me one of their scales.
41728.progress: Have you gathered what I have asked for?
41728.completion: You have done well, now we can begin the more arduous tasks.

41729.title: Dark Essence
41729.description:
There is one final material that I require before our tasks is complete. To the south of the region lays a place called The Grim Hollow. It is a desolate, and corrupted land that has been twisted by a dark and unknown power.

This power is what I seek, and it can be claimed by the spirits of dwarves that now haunt the hollow itself. Slay them, and return to me a Dark Essence from their remains.
41729.completion: Such dark, and powerful energy, it shall serve me well.

41730.title: The Power of Uth'okk
41730.description:
All of the materials have been gathered, We have come to the culmination of our efforts. If we want to truly harness such energy we must first find a suitable conduit for which to contain it.

Long ago a great gemstone of immense power was brought to this world by Gul'dan and his minions. The Pendant of Uth'okk was left to Oronok Torn-Heart, one of Gul'dan's lieutenants It is this pendant that I seek. You can find him lurking within the depths of Stormwrought Ruins on the island of Balor. This will not be an easy task, but I desire you to kill him, and bring me the power of the Pendant of Uth'okk.

Do this, and you shall be rewarded.
41730.progress: Have you reclaimed the Pendant of Uth'okk for the Horde?
41730.completion:
<Far Seer Mothang lets out a deep, and sinister laugh.>

The Pendant of Uth'okk, in my hands...

41731.title: The Ritual of Uth'okk
41731.description: Now that you have recovered the Pendant of Uth'okk I can begin my spell, I ask of you to step back, and wait for me to finish my ritual.
41731.progress: <Far Seer Mothang is lost in harmony.>
41731.completion:
The power of the Uth'okk gemstone is flowing through my veins... Such power is euphoric!

I am reborn, and I have you to thank for doing all my work.

<Far Seer Mothang lets out a deep, and sinister laugh.>

The Pendant of Uth'okk has been sapped of its power, but I am sure you can make some use of it.

<Far Seer Mothang lets off a deep smirk.>

Farewell <class>.

41732.title: Damaged Relic Mechanism
41732.description: <A flawless and aged relic lays before your eyes. It contains intricate, and ancient mechanisms that elude your mind. This object looks to have been created with meticulous form and purpose. You should find someone who may be familiar with such an object.>
41732.completion:
Why what is this? Ancient technology from Grim Reaches you say? Such complex and intricate mechanisms...

<Tarwegg takes a moment to inspect the device>

I must say, this is an incredible find!

41733.title: Rebuilding the Relic
41733.description:
This relic that you have brought to me may possibly be related to technology that stems from Uldaman, and those that once built it. The fact that this comes from the Grim Reaches is astounding, and only leaves more questions.

If we want to rebuild this relic to function, we will require some of the magic that once powered this device. To my knowledge, the only place where such a power exists is in Uldaman itself.

I would suggest gathering a party, and delving deep. Bring me an Ancient Power Module from within Uldaman, and a Gold Power Core from an engineer. Once the items are acquired, I will restore this relic as best I can.
41733.progress: Have you gotten the required materials?
41733.completion:
I have done some studying while you were gone, and looked over the mechanism. I believe I may have figured out at the least how to power it, but in its state of decay I cannot guarantee this will work.

<Tarwegg takes the materials, and begins to power the Ancient Power Module within the mechanism itself. With a soft click, the machine begins to whirr into life, albeit, at a slow, and decrepit pace.>

Aha! I have done it, I thank you for bringing the relic to me to study and work on, may its power help you on your journey.

41734.title: Damaged Relic Mechanism
41734.description: <A flawless and aged relic lays before your eyes. It contains intricate, and ancient mechanisms that elude your mind. This object looks to have been created with meticulous form and purpose. You should find someone who may be familiar with such an object.>
41734.completion:
What is that you've brought, some sort of mechanical gizmo? I'd suggest you take that to a gnome, they know quite a lot more than the likes of me...

<Jarkal takes a moment to study the mechanism>

Why, this be some of that Uldaman technology, not some gnomish trinket. I've seen something like this before here in the Badlands.

41735.title: Stonehide Rations
41735.description:
You there, are you looking to head to Shatterblade Post? If so I have a good friend who resides there, and I am certain he could use a favor. Bargolnakk is in charge of the cooking as the outposts butcher, and he is always looking for a fresh supply of meat.

If you could do me a solid, and bring him eight Stonehide Flanks from the local Stonehide boars, I am sure it would mean a lot.

You can find Shatterblade Post to the east, gather the flanks, and bring them to Bargolnakk.
41735.completion:
Torlag sent you? Bah he is always sending whatever fool he can persuade into hunting me local game. It is supposed to be him that is doing it.

Here, take this silver. It was meant for Torlag, but since you are doing his work for him, you can take it instead.

41736.title: A Land in Peril
41736.description:
A few months ago I arrived with Mothang to study the elements here in Grim Reaches. As you can see I am now left alone in this task, for Mothang has lost himself in the pursuit of power...

<Yor'thegg lets out a sigh.>

The land itself cries for aid. I can sense the anguish of the elements here, and seek to answer them. If you wish to help, I require Reachroot, a local herb that grows across the region, gather eight bushels, and return to me.
41736.completion: You have done well, this is the first step on the path to healing this land.

41737.title: Signs of Corruption
41737.description: If we are to truly understand the magnitude of corruption within Grim Reaches, we must gather a sample of it. Manifestations of this foul energy has taken root in the shape of ooze's that plague the land. I ask of you to bring me six Lingering Corruption from the Repugnant Ooze of Grim Reaches. You can find a concentration of them at Brangar's Folly to the northeast of here.
41737.completion: Such foul, malignant energy... The corruption in this land is evident.

41738.title: Yor'thegg's Ritual
41738.description:
The situation is as I feared, the land is corrupt, and in a state of turmoil. I will need to commune with the elements at haste.

This ritual will require local, natural materials to conduct. First, I require five Ornate Feathers from the nearby thrashers. Three Binding Flame from the Dragonmaw Flamebinders to the northwest. And finally, I require a single pristine Stonehide Heart from the Elder Stonehide Boars. Gather all of these materials, and return to me.
41738.progress: The land yearns for peace, and it is our responsibility to comply.
41738.completion: The materials have been gathered. You have done your duty, now let me conduct mine...

41739.title: The Flame of Dagnoth
41739.description:
The Flame of Dagnoth? The elements have given us a very key piece of information, yet it is something that I do not know. There is only one name that comes to mind that may know about this mysterious fire. Dorthas Read

He is a human, traveling across Grim Reaches. Last I spoke with him, he seemed to know quite a bit about the region, I would suspect he knows a thing or two about this flame. Find him to the southwest, near the entrance to Grim Reaches, and inquire about the Flame of Dagnoth.
41739.completion: You inquire about the Flame of Dagnoth? You say Yor'thegg sent you? You're inquiring about dark and evil things, how do I know you're not some minion of evil telling me a great lie?

41740.title: The Deed for Dorthas
41740.description:
If there is one thing I have learned here on Azeroth, it is that everything comes at a cost. If you want information on the Flame of Dagnoth, I require some showing that you are on my side, and not some enemy agent in disguise.

That seems like a fair compromise, yes?

I require you to head to the Badlands to the southwest, and locate the presence of Black Dragonkin at Lethlor Ravine. I have heard rumors that their scales are enchanted with latent draconic energy. Bring me one such Ensorcelled Whelp Scale from the Scalding Whelps, and you shall have the information you request.
41740.completion: Well done, you have proven yourself a capable adventurer! You have done me a good deed, and for that I will offer you the information you seek.

41741.title: Return to Yor'thegg
41741.description:
The Flame of Dagnoth is an old, and almost ancient well of dwarven magic. This flame was started long ago, as a tradition to honor the spirits of the dead.

However, this once honorable flame has been twisted and corrupted.

The Flame of Dagnoth still burns today, deep within the heart of Grim Hollow, stirring the ancient spirits to wake once again.

Take this information back to Yor'thegg, perhaps he can think of a way to cleanse this evil.
41741.completion:
The Flame of Dagnoth is located in the Grim Hollow?

I should have guessed.

41742.title: Expelling Evil
41742.description:
Ready yourself, for the real challenge has come at last. If we are to bring peace to the elements than we must expel the evil bound to the Flame of Dagnoth. Its poison has lingered for far too long, and caused great havoc to all.

Find the Flame of Dagnoth, and throw this magic dust upon the fire. It should manifest the evil energy, allowing it to be destroyed once and for all, do this, for the good of the elements, and for the good of the land itself.
41742.progress: I implore you to bring allies, for this evil may be to great to handle alone.
41742.completion:
I can feel it, the flames corruption has been snuffed.

Your efforts here are monumental, and without your help I would have been left nearly helpless. In time, the land should heal, and the elements should rest. I shall remain to study this transformation.

As a thanks for your actions, I offer you a reward worthy of your effort. Go with honor friend.

41743.title: Gamemaster's Boons
41743.progress: Impressive, outright marvelous! It has been an awfully long time since I've been this challenged in the master's game. My heartfelt thanks to you for providing the opportunity for so much delight and fun. A victor should not go without spoils, so allow me to bestow you a fitting reward for proving the grandeur of your strategic capabilities. Favor of Fallwind
41743.completion: A splendid choice. Should you ever itch for another game again, I'd be thrilled to test your mettle once more. For now, however, let me rest for a while.

41744.title: Gamemaster's Treasures
41744.progress: Impressive, outright marvelous! It has been an awfully long time since I've been this challenged in the master's game. My heartfelt thanks to you for providing the opportunity for so much delight and fun. A victor should not go without spoils, so allow me to bestow you a fitting reward for proving the grandeur of your strategic capabilities. Favor of Fallwind
41744.completion: A splendid choice. Should you ever itch for another game again, I'd be thrilled to test your mettle once more. For now, however, let me rest for a while.

41745.title: The Power of the Goddess
41745.description:
Listen well, young <class>, for the wisdom I impart comes from the heart of the forests and the whispers of the wind. Take heed, for the Scythe of Elune is a potent artifact, its power intertwined with the fate of our world. Hold it with reverence and wield it with wisdom, for its influence transcends the realms of mortals. Guard it against the grasp of those who seek power for selfish ends, for in their hands, it could unleash untold calamity upon our lands.

Let us begin.
41745.completion:
Behold, a great power is now bestowed upon us. I never thought I would witness such a day when the sheer power of the goddess herself answered my call. The Scythe of Elune has been restored, and its power shall now lies within your hands to guard, and safekeep against the evils that encroach upon our world.

With such great power, shall come a great responsibility <class>. It is entrusted upon you to uphold this artifact, and enact the will of Elune herself upon those that would threaten our purpose.

41746.title: Arcane Emanations
41746.description:
Some weeks ago the Tower of Azora was conducting research into arcane properties on behalf of mages from the Kirin Tor. Sadly, this experiment ended with an overload of arcane energies which have now manifested into the nearby woods.

Have you noticed the wandering elementals that are now populating parts of the forest around this tower? If you can be of assistance, we require them to be destroyed. Bring their residue to us before this situation gets wildly out of control.
41746.progress: We are working to ensure such a situation does not manifest itself again. When you recover the residue we can begin to channel any lingering energy back to the tower itself.
41746.completion:
You've recovered the residue, nice work. I must say I was not so sure it was responsible sending some traveler to clean up our mess, but it seems to have worked out in the end.

Please, on behalf of us here, take these potions, they may be of use on your journey.

41747.title: The Tower of Azora
41747.description:
I was once a pupil to the mages of the Tower of Azora. It is there I learned much of my skills, and practiced my expertise in the arcane. I have maintained my relation with them over the years, and have often ran shipments of parchment to the tower. They seem to go through quite a lot of it with all of the spells, and incantations that they practice!

<Zaldimar lets out a soft laugh.>

I need someone to run the delivery of scrolls on my behalf, as my studies currently have me bound here in Goldshire. You can find the Tower of Azora to the east, just past Crystal Lake. The large tower should not be hard to miss.
41747.completion:
