The delivery of scrolls? Zaldimar must have sent you. I must admit, that I miss his presence at the tower, he was always such a skilled pupil.

These scrolls will be put to good use, I can assure you that. Please, take this, as a thanks from us at the Tower of Azora.

41748.title: The Master and the Student
41748.description:
Many years ago I took a student beneath my wing. To teach them the secrets of the arcane, and to harness their mind for greater things. Ralthas was a brilliant student, destined for a bright future. He could have mastered the arcane-arts, and potentially, one day ran the Tower of Azora.

It pains me to think that their mind has been poisoned by the useless folly of politics and rage. Now they run amok, teaching any thug and trickster our secrets to prey upon the weak and disturb the peace of Elwynn.

Ralthas must be stopped, and it would break my heart if I had to face him myself. I ask of you to defeat him. I have heard that he often lurks around the Stone Cairn Lake to the northeast of here. Bring me the necklace he wears so that I know his terror on Elwynn Forest has been put to rest, once and for all.
41748.progress: Ralthas has spread many secrets that are held dear to the Tower of Azora, he has aided the Defias Brotherhood... Such crimes cannot be left unanswered.
41748.completion:
A bright mind has been lost this day. In another world perhaps he could have truly been one of the great wizards of Azeroth.

<Theocritus lets out a deep, and long sigh.>

I doubt I will find another like him, and still, I must thank you for doing what must be done. Take this, as a personal thanks from me, to you.

41749.title: Stone Golem Salvage
41749.description:
Could I spare a moment with you? You look like the tough type ready to burst into action, seeking the thrill of adventure and the smell of gold and riches. As it stands, you are exactly the type of person I'm looking for. You see, any self-respecting goblin has many contacts when it comes to possible revenue; some more legal than others. Many of my contractors are of the latter and one particular group is interested in something you don't get your hands on everyday.

To the souththeast, just shy of the great falls coming from Loch Modan is an old mining facility, they call it the Dragonmaw Retreat nowadays. Inside, are equally ancient golems said to roam the unstable halls, still stuck in old protocols. If you're able to bring me a runestone they are powered by, I'll fetch you a fair price for it!
41749.progress: Don't leave me hanging, pal. You're the fifth adventurer I've been tasking to get this damn stone.
41749.completion: That's what I'm talking about! This beauty will pay a pretty sum of gold with those Shadowfo-... Oh, you're still here. Right! Your reward. Here, take this and some coin on top of it, you really made this goblin's day!

41750.title: Gowlfang's Defeat
41750.description:
<The gnoll is slobbering in unbridled rage, his fangs bared and the air coming out of his nuzzle is visible in the humid air of the swamp.>

Betrayer! Gowlfang big betrayer! Left with shaman Bogpaw. Is now leading the Mosshides, without us! Helped Gowlfang, were loyal. Now we here to die, all alone! Betrayer went with powerful green-skinned warriors. To the southeast, entered the mountains into a cave, a big cave! Grimbite wants the head of Betrayer! Follow them, into the home of green warriors who command fire-breathing lizards!
41750.progress: Where is the head?! Head of Betrayer?!
41750.completion:
<You don't have much time to react as you hand Grimbite the head of Gowlfang. With untamed wrath and hate, the gnoll tears the head out of your hand, before viciously biting into it, ravaging it into an unrecognizable state. After he is done, he tosses what is left into the near bog, letting it sink to the ground of the swamp. A yowling scream escapes Grimbite's jaw, the other gnolls follow suit. The howling persists for a few moments, echoing throughout all of the Wetlands.>

Gowlfang is dead! Mosshide now truly free! You member of Mosshide, forever. Take this, for killing Betrayer.

41751.title: The Dragonmaw Brood
41751.description:
Mortal, the plight of submission is once more cast upon my flight. Once again, the horrors of the past shroud the Dragon Queen's noble flight. The orcish Dragonmaw Clan continues to exert their heinous acts of subjugation upon my kind, forcing them to follow their bidding. While the Red Dragonflight is occupied with the everlasting vigil of safekeeping Grim Batol, it falls upon me to release my fallen brother Searistrasz and his brood.

I can hear his painful cries echoing from within the ancient dwarven mines to the south, those which the Dragonmaw now have laid claim upon. Mortal, venture into the Dragonmaw Retreat and absolve my brother and his children from this sin which was cast upon them.
41751.progress: Even years later, the foul shadow of the Demon Soul haunts our flight.
41751.completion: It is done. Life and death is a cycle that has to be maintained, and tainted life must be given the chance to bloom once more. The pain in my heart will continue to ache, yet I can be assured that Searistrasz is no longer in torment. Go in peace, mortal, and may your travels be without tragedy.

41752.title: Cavernweb Extract
41752.description:
I've been a weakling all my life, not born the warrior my mother had wished me to be. The great defenders of Hammerfall stand tall and unrelenting against our enemies, yet I chose a different path to tread. Hacking and slashing at your enemy may be glorious and fulfilling, but to see your enemy writhe in agonizing pain over just a small drop of poison is even more enthralling. Not many of my kind share the sentiment, and I cannot blame them, but I am not here to be useless. If I can be of use to the Horde in any way, no one will be able to dissuade me from serving my warchief.

In my pursuit of new and rich venoms, I've come across a piece of information most intriguing. The vile orcs of old, the Dragonmaw, have enslaved a brood of spiders in the mining shafts beneath Grim Batol. Using their dark arts, they've enhanced the spiders to unfathomable levels of power. These arachnids must possess an unparalleled poison within them, so bring me their broodmother's venom sac.
41752.progress: The Dragonmaw orcs are psychotic remnants, clinging to the fading and misguided glory of our past. Decimate the fools while you are in their despicable lair.
41752.completion: The acidic scent is overwhelming. There is no doubt that these spiders have been tampered with, magically enhanced by heinous rituals. You've done well in releasing them from their torment. Here, take this as a reward for the risk I've put you in. May you serve the warchief with pride and soul!

41753.title: A Blaze Unending
41753.description:
The Dark Lady's ambitions are numerous and intricate. On her path to revenge, she will use any tool available at her disposal, no matter the cost. As such, a number of powerful relics have drawn her attention; relics that will be instrumental for her machinations.

The orcs hold the secrets of their ancient magics well hidden, sheltering them from the eyes of those who can find better use in their primitive sorcery. One of them is the Eternal Flame, a source of potent energy, protected and nurtured by their pyremasters. The Dark Lady desires this artifact, and it will be you who will fulfill her request.

Far to the south, in the dwarven Wetlands of Khaz Modan, you will find the rat's nest called Dragonmaw Retreat. An abandoned mining facility of the cursed mountain of Grim Batol, it houses the maniacal remnants of the Dragonmaw Clan of old. Infiltrate their pitiful hiding place and deliver me the Eternal Flame, protected by their flamekeeper.
41753.progress: These simpletons cannot comprehend the power they are meddling with. Once within our grasp, it can finally develop its full potential.
41753.completion: You are a faithful and obedient servant, <class>. For your subservience, a reward awaits. Have this and be on your way, the Dark Lady does not appreciate needless loitering.

41754.title: The Redbrand Lie
41754.description: <The tablet you're holding in your hands shows runes and carvings you haven't seen anywhere before. Appearing almost like an ancient artwork, the text and lines chiseled into the stone make little sense to you. Considering its origin and the spectral remains of the dwarf before you, it has to be a long forgotten dwarven typography lost to time. Perhaps the great historians of Ironforge can find meaning in it?>
41754.progress: Welcome to our grand exhibition! Please, if you have any questions regarding our displays, don't hesitate to ask.
41754.completion: The markings are undoubtedly dwarven, reminiscent of the times before even the War of the Three Hammers! If you give me but a moment, I should be able to translate the message written upon this tablet…

41755.title: The Redbrand Lie
41755.description: <name>, it is only just for the Redbrands to handle this matter internally, as much as my curiosity drives me to share it with my colleagues. Here, take the tablet back into your possession and deliver it to the Redbrand Estate in the Mystic Ward just yonder. He made it his life's goal to complete his family's lineage, it is in his best interest to know about this part of dwarven history.
41755.progress: Greetings, what brings you to the esteemed Redbrand Estate?
41755.completion:
A tablet about the Redbrand's past?! Incredible; quickly, let me inspect it!

<Torwyn adjusts his lens and begins perusing his gaze across the tablet's stony surface. With each line he's deciphering and reading, he's becoming increasingly more red and sweaty, up until his hand is visibly shaking.>

Y-You…! WHERE DID YOU FIND THIS?! You will NEVER speak of this; never! No one is to know about this accursed tablet! Absolutely no one! Here, take this and your lips will remain sealed, am I clear?! Now begone!

41756.title: To Crush The Dragonmaw
41756.description:
The scattered Dragonmaw Clan proves to be a menace to our lands even years after their humiliating defeat at Grim Batol. While one group of their despicable warriors terrorizes the southern mountains, their main force is hiding in an old mining facility in the far east. Our reports tell of vicious orcs gathering in the decrepit halls, gaining in strength with each passing day. Most notably are their veterans, seasoned survivors of the Second War who stop at nothing to fulfill their maddened masters demands. They are the backbone of their army and must be eradicated if we want to have even a sliver of a chance against them.

Venture into the mining facility that we now call Dragonmaw Retreat and thin out their ranks. The sooner, the better.
41756.progress: Show 'em that the Alliance hasn't lost its bite.
41756.completion: Good job, soldier. The more dead orcs I know of, the better I can sleep at night. It won't be long before we've driven these mongrels out of the Wetlands for good. Keep fighting on, and you will always count on the aid of the sons of Khaz Modan.

41757.title: Blackheart's Demise
41757.description:
<name>, now that we've dealt with Nek'rosh and his division, we can focus our attention on the bigger threat. Nek'rosh was merely a chess piece in this game; a powerful piece, but a chess piece nonetheless. Our good men and women of the militia out there have been talking about a terrifying Dragonmaw orc, the leader of the vicious raiding parties that increased more and more in frequency in the last weeks. A true monster through and through, responsible for abducting and killing the poor citizens of Menethil Harbor. I want him dead, as quickly as possible. With the small time we've gained by removing Nek'rosh we can prepare a counter strike against their base of operation.

Infiltrate the Dragonmaw Retreat far off to the east, beneath the mountain of Grim Batol, and lop off the head of that despicable creature.
41757.progress: Don't underestimate him. Beasts like him don't survive by sheer luck.
41757.completion: Good riddance. We've dealt a serious blow to whatever Dragonmaw remained in Khaz Modan. Now it is up to us to clear up the mess and dispose of any remaining vermin skulking around in our lands. I salute to you, <name>. You're a true hero in my eyes.

41758.title: Tainted Brambleheart
41758.description:
The quilboar are a primitive and hostile race, their kind has been at odds with us for longer than I can remember. Wherever the quilboar go they are often weaving large and heavy brushes of thorn. It is this very magic itself that is twisting the natural order, and in turn bringing it closer to corruption. For some months I have been able to sense something strange, and foreign.

I seek proof of this natural corruption, and I am certain it lays within the heart of Razorfen Kraul. Find the living embodiment of this gnarled natural magic, and destroy it. When this task is complete, return to me.
41758.progress: The lair of Razorfen Kraul is a twisted mess of bramble and thorn. I advise you prepare for the journey to such a place.
41758.completion:
I sense something deep within the heart of this creature... It yearned for release, to combat a darkness that lurked.

<Kym Wildmane looks confused, and lets out a slight sigh.>

Perhaps my original assessment was incorrect. It was not the primitive dark magic of the quilboar that awakened this natural being and sent it into madness. No, it was something much darker, and sinister... I have more questions that I must research further. You have done well, regardless of my pondering. Please, take this, as a thanks from myself.

41759.title: The Gnarled Bramblehide
41759.description:
Greetings traveler, I am Calaran Windseeker, a druid from Darnassus. I have been studying the recent unrest deep within the home of the quilboar. I have heard stories of gnarled abominations of twisted thorns and natural energy. I am certain these creatures have manifested in anger to their quilboar masters and I seek to restore order to the natural world. These beings of nature must be put to rest, and I wish to gather their roots for study.

Venture deep within the Razorfen Kraul, find these monsters, and destroy them. You can find this accursed lair above the great lift to the east, once you ascend to the top, head west, and look for the quilboar. Gather me three of the twisted roots, and I shall reward you well.
41759.progress: When there are threats to the natural order we must do what we can to assist, and return balance.
41759.completion:
Such strange magic, I am unfamiliar with the lingering presence that drove these creatures.

Such energy is not of a natural origin. I must conduct further studies to find the truth. You have done well <name>. Please, take these coins, may they serve you well.

41760.title: Skull And Bones
41760.description:
The Balor family held sovereignty over this island for many years. Even after becoming a vessel state, Stormwind's king allowed the first Duke to govern the state he built under many hardships and tribulations. His scions continued his legacy, each one of them reigning over the merchant paradise with a watchful eye and merciful soul. Us Grahans acted as their advisors and protectors, and we held that position with pride. As such, the immense shame that still fills my very being for failing my lord all those years ago is all the more unbearable. I may not be able to rewrite the past, but I can yet honor the Balor family's legacy.

My ghost is tethered to this estate, so I implore you to accomplish this feat in my stead. Enter Stormwrought Castle and seek the remnants of my old friend. His bones may long have turned to ash within the cursed halls of his home, but his sigil ring may yet remain. Seek it, return the band to me, so that you may be within my ever-lasting debt.
41760.progress: The history of Balor continues to be written, where it will lead, I do not know. But this chapter of its past needs to be closed, that I am certain of.
41760.completion:
Frederik, old friend. Figments of your essence linger in this dull trinket, bare of any grandeur it once held. One day, when I may finally pass on and leave this realm, I will see you once more...

<name>, blessings upon you. This ring will find its way into oblivion, far away from the clutches of darkness, I will make sure of that. For your courageous act, take this from my remaining corporeal belongings. You deserve it well.

41761.title: Into The Hornet's Nest
41761.description:
From what I gathered from Spickerspan's findings, I don't believe we are simply dealing with the Stormreaver orcs and their demon friends alone at this point. An operation of this magnitude is too grand for a scattered clan from the Second War. There has to be more at play here. Who else has their grimy little fingers involved in this is our next step. Ascend the island, enter the yard of Stormwrought Castle and thin out their numbers. Search the area for crucial intel we might be missing. Dispatch any high ranking officer you come across, we must be swift and deadly. I myself will send notice to Master Shaw to rally as many agents as we can. Personally I do not expect the King to aid us in this tragedy.

Stay sharp, <class>, I expect sufficient results.
41761.progress: Do not venture alone. These beasts are unpredictable and will stop at nothing.
41761.completion:
I expected nothing less. For an external aid, you've proven yourself to be a valuable asset to our team. If the thrill of adventure ever subsides within you, the SI:7 has room for individuals like you.

Please, report your findings. Time is running out.

41762.title: A Deal Worth Taking
41762.description: Hey, psst, pal. Running dry on gold? Of course you are, I know that look. I got a job for you that'll be easier than changing the diaper on an ogre! Listen, really, no need to ask questions, I promise it'll be to your benefit. Down in the southwestern mountains, the Durotar Labor Union is operating large-scale oil pumping schemes. Kind of risky if you ask me; anyway, my clients are not entirely happy about them doing what they're doing, and you'll be the one to stop them. Here, take these overchargers and plant them on their pump stations. Watch out for their workers, they will surely be trying to stop you. Once you are done, return to me for your hard-earned reward!
41762.progress: Are you done yet? Don't keep me waiting, buster!
41762.completion:
Wonderful, wonderful! Once they start up the stations again, they will create a SPECTACULAR display of pyrodynamics! With this outta the way, all we gotta do is haul the barrels back to... -wait, you're still here? Oh, your reward, sure, just give me a second...

<The goblin is rummaging in a small satchel on his belt, before pulling out a gold coin.>

There you go, don't spend everything at once, bozo!

41763.title: Intricate Artwork
41763.description:
These Venture Co. rats are everywhere! Wherever they go, their filthy hands grab anything they can get. Be it in the Stonetalon Mountains, the Stranglethorn Vale or here, no one is safe from their thievery. Honest and morally grey exploitery work is just not possible with them having so much widespread influence. If you ask me, it's time they start getting the memo who's the new and upcoming star in the world of goblin economics.

But let's talk about the real tragedy; when I was working on the oil rig down at the beach, I had my cozy little... uhm, collection of invaluable paintings stashed in the warehouse nearby, it was very dear to my heart! It is a one of a kind series and cannot make it all the way to Undermine and be sold on a miserable black market auction. Get it back for me, I am certain one of those thugs picked up the key to my chest when I was running for my life!
41763.progress: If you find it, don't you dare open it! You are not ready for their... peculiar beauty.
41763.completion: Oh, my beloved, finally back in my arms. I cannot thank you enough, <name>. Now I have everything to enjoy my self-assigned vacation from the oil rig - thanks a bunch! Here, let's share a drink and toast on the occasion!

41764.title: Oil-Based Grievances
41764.description:
Problem upon problem upon problem! I can't believe I was so naive to believe nothing bad would happen to the Labor Union for once, but you know how it goes: you jinx it into existence the moment the words leave your mouth. Now I'm up to my chin in unresolved work; work that I have to fix on my own! The boss is a one of a kind genius, we owe her our exceptional quota big time, so it really irks me to be in such a pickle! We've lost control over our pump stations; whatever these Venture Co. devils did, the pumps went completely haywire and we had little chance to deactivate them to properly fix them with all the oil blobs ruining our day. But now that you're here, luck's back in our favor!

Down by the beach is our big oil rig, in the control room up top you will find my energy regulator. I had to leave it behind during their raid. With it, you will be able to shut off the four pump stations just outside of town! Once you are done, return to me.
41764.progress: How is it, any success with the pump stations yet?
41764.completion:
So the control panels were tampered with, hm? Not really a surprise, but a nuisance nonetheless. As much as I hate to admit it, our technicians will have to double proof them to ensure their original functionality is being restored. We wouldn't want all this liquid gold just to blow up, alongside us!

Either way, good work out there. Here, take these as compensation for the hassle; the Durotar Labor Union is in your favour!

41765.title: Venture Co. Hatred
41765.description:
Things are heating up in Undermine, kiddo. Not that it had ever been quiet there, but the Venture Co. has started to gain noticeable traction in all sorts of trades all around Azeroth. They've always been more... let's say, ‘unorthodox', in their business practices, but whatever they're planning doesn't look too rosey. All ya gotta do is go down the beach and see for yourself.

Ya see, I joined the Durotar Labor Union not long ago; Nert was quick to assign me a project on my own, considering what happened on Blackstone Island and my flawless track record regarding profit optimization back on Kezan. Once we got the ball rolling, it did not take long for the Venture Co. to creep up and do their thing. If ya ask me, it's time for some well-earned payback. Let us give them a taste of their own medicine, whaddya think?
41765.progress: Done with the pest control yet?
41765.completion: Must've been a breeze, eh? You are more competent than you look. Nert was right in allying with the Horde; not that he had much choice to begin with. Now that the fodder's outta the way, time to smoke out their head honcho.

41766.title: Shrillfluke's Early Retirement
41766.description:
Goblins don't really work that well without someone calling the shots, it's been tried time and time again. Without someone to put the blame on, all they do is tear eachother apart. So naturally, all these goons must have someone to commandeer them around. Must've been a hot shot from higher up in the Venture Co., considering the size of this sabotage. Not dissimilar to what happened on Blackstone Island, just much less subtle.

Return to the beach, find that weasel and bring them to justice. Nobody interferes with my business and gets away with it.
41766.progress: My workers are starting to enjoy their time-off a little too much. Let's put an end to this and get back on our quota.
41766.completion: Shrillfluke, eh? Certainly not the biggest fish, but his name was popping up occasionally in Undermine. From what I can read here, their genius plan was to overload the pump stations using some home cooked spell - which of course backfired, typical goblin fashion. Instead all it did was power up the oil itself, leaving us with these troublesome oil oozes sludging around. Annoying, to say the least. Well, let's put a bow on this thing, I don't wanna waste another minute thinking about the Mogul's cronies.

41767.title: Rise of the Venture Co.
41767.description:
Since ya helped us out big time, I guess I can share a little secret with ya. Many goblins have joined the Durotar Labor Union in the past, and many still do. Created a big stir in Undermine. A young and upcoming worker's union holding their own against the authoritarian Venture Co.? It was all over the newspapers! Rumours started spreading, one crazier than the next, so eventually my boss gave me a new job: join the Durotar Labor Union and see what's really happening. Didn't anticipate getting thrown into action THAT quickly.

And now we're here. I gotta say, both the Labor Union and the Horde exceeded my expectations. You're a strange bunch, but a strong bunch. Your handling of funds and general economics is disastrous, but you'll get there - eventually. Nert is a great asset, trust me. Speaking of, could you pass him this report? Poor guy must be pretty anxious waiting for it back in Sparkwater Port. Give him a good nudge from me when ya see him, gotcha?
41767.progress: Either good news or no news, pal. Another bad errand would be the death of me!
41767.completion:
You were in Tanaris and helped out Celdi? How wonderful, that woman is a true blessing! When she first flounced around Sparkwater Port my eyes almost flew out of my skull. A high administrator of the Bilgewater Cartel here, in our small town?! And she wants to join us?! It felt like I had just doubled all my lifesavings in a last effort try at the casino. After the disaster that was Blackstone Island, the Durotar Labor Union desperately needed an uplift in profit AND morale. The oil rig in Tanaris was an excellent idea, if I were to be so humble. With Slickwick at the helm, I just knew it'd be a success.

Despite that, the Venture Co.'s continued sabotage and intrusion worry me. I fear their patience runs dry, Razdunk never was one to remain calm when he doesn't get his way. Keep your ears and eyes sharp, <name>. The future won't be easy for us.

41768.title: The Messenger Of Northwind
41768.description: I have to admit, <class>, Northwind is in a miserable state. Birkhaven has been raided, we've lost control over Sherwood Quarry and I do not have enough men to protect my citizens. As much as it pains my pride as a noble and leader, I have my hands tied. Judging from your looks, I reckon you are of the traveling type? If so, perhaps you'd be interested in some important errand work for me? I cannot spare any more of my subjects, their numbers are cut slim.

41769.title: The Venomous Hatchling
41769.description:
To tame and ride the Ravasaur unprepared is a fool's errand. Their hide oozes venomous liquid, coating their skin with a lethal coat; just a mere touch could very well be your death sentence. It is however not impossible to bend the mighty Ravasaur to your will, if you wish to tread the arduous path of such a commitment. I can show you my people's ancient ways of subduing these poison-filled beasts.

Go out into the jungle and seek their nesting grounds. Search for an egg that is just about to hatch, any other will not be sufficient enough for our task. Return to me once you've been successful.
41769.progress: The beasts will defend their brood viciously. Lack of caution may cause your journey to end prematurely.
41769.completion:
<Just as you are handing Jama'nali the quivering egg, its shell starts cracking. Piece by piece, the tiny hatchling fights its way out of its prison, gasping for air. With a high-pitched screech, the little one looks at you before jumping back into your hand, desperately biting the air.>

Ravasaur hatchlings are quick to stand on their own two feet, and are just as quick to grow hungry. To properly raise your new fosterling, we need to feed him.

41770.title: Ride of the Ravasaur
41770.description:
As frail as it is now, the young one is harmless. Neither his bite nor his hide can harm you, since his venomhide has not developed yet. By spending time and raising the hatchling, your body will naturally attune itself to the growing venom inside it. Once it reaches adulthood, you will be resilient enough to ride it without consequences.

Scour the jungle for food, and feed the beastly meat to it. With each meal, his jaw, body and mind will grow and change. Show me your commitment to your fosterling by presenting me with its teeth, the teeth it will lose while maturing. Only then will I teach you the rites of Ravasaur riding.
41770.progress: It will be a long and arduous journey, but at the end the bond between the two of you will be stronger than ever.
41770.completion:
It is done. You've proven your determination to me. It is as clear as the sun how well you've been caring for your now adult Ravasaur. I am certain they think the same.

<Your little hatchling has grown splendidly and is now a proper and matured Ravasaur. Still affectionate to you, it's rubbing its jaw next to yours, causing no reaction from its venomous hide: you've successfully built a resistance to the lethal venom.>

Your bond has reached a depth few others rarely hold. Be proud of your achievement and show it to the world. Now then, let me share the secrets of riding the Ravasaur.

41771.title: Primordial Meat
41771.description:
The ancient beasts of Un'goro possess flesh of peculiar taste. The smell alone is enough for some to succumb to uncomfortable convulsions. Your hatchling, however, can't get enough of it. Ravasaur offspring develop quickly and as such require immense amounts of nourishment. Normally they'd follow their mother on the hunt, but this task now falls upon you.

Hunt the creatures of the crater and allow your fosterling to prosper.
41771.progress: Do not hunt the Ravasaur, feeding it their poisonous flesh so early would kill it!
41771.completion: A good hunt. This should satiate its hunger - for now. These ravenous younglings crave sustenance all day long, so do not wait too long before feeding it again.

41772.title: Stegodon Glands
41772.description:
Far to the west is a vale of stone pillars called Terror Run. Among these pillars, the powerful stegodon reside, demolishing anything in their vicinity. Towering over most of the crater's inhabitants, their massive size is thanks to the thick glands, increasing their muscle growth and strengths. To ensure the young Ravasaur is properly raised, we need these glands.

Travel to Terror Run and slay the stegodons. Beware, they are stronger than your average beast.
41772.progress: The glands produce strong growth hormones. Yet fear not. Our little friend will not be harmed by consuming them.
41772.completion: Thick and heavy, brimming with power. My people have customs of eating powerful organs to enhance our own bodies. You should try it yourself one day, it can feel… exhilarating.

41773.title: The Might of the Devilsaur
41773.description: Wandering the jungle of Un'goro, you've surely felt the earth rumble from time to time. Distant roars of terror and the breaking of trees and branches. The mighty devilsaur are the apex predators of Un'goro, no other beast can rival their unparalleled strength. Hunting one of them is a great feat in itself, but felling one shows exceptional capabilities. The powerful muscle that is their heart will be a fantastic source of nutrition for the hatchling.
41773.progress: Their terrifying roar and massive claws will shred any unsuspecting hunter with ease.
41773.completion: Bloodied and truly massive. These hearts will help the little one become a strong and robust adult when the time comes.

41774.title: Pedestal of Unity
41774.progress: <The Pedestal of Unity stands unbroken, and free from serious damage. It is weathered from age, and covered in dust. Upon its surface lay ancient dwarvish runes as well as two slots that hold some sort of square objects. From a first glance, it is easy to notice some ancient mechanism is requiring the positioning of a specific item to activate the magic within.> Fragment of AlgoronFragment of Dathronag
41774.completion: <The Pedestal of Unity begins to click, and whirr into motion. A humming of foreign magic begins emanate, and the surface of the stone begins to glow blue. From the base of the stone pedestal emerges a tray which contains a singular key.>

41775.title: The Forgotten Practices
41775.description:
<class>, come closer. Your contributions to the Athenaeum have been plentiful and many forlorn tomes have found their way back into our fold. The Shen'dralar are grateful for your actions so far, which is why I am beholden to ask a reliable <race> such as yourself for yet another favor.

While our treasury of knowledge grows evermore, we are still lacking one ancient and crucial grimoire that is infamous among our scholars. Written by the disgraced sorcerer princess Aszune, the book details the meticulous process of shattering and converging magical shards and crystals. It is paramount that it returns to the Athenaeum!

The magical energies radiating from the book are one of a kind, and I remember them well. Fortunately for us, they have not left Eldre'thalas. I detect its presence high above us, near the seat of the despicable ogre king. Certainly, his corpulent advisor is defiling it with his filthy hands. Retrieve it from him, but be careful! The book is ancient and gets damaged easily!
41775.progress: Princess Aszune was an infamous figure in Highborne society; a mighty sorceress, she dedicated her studies on the power drawn from the astral planes of the Twisting Nether, oftentimes utilizing hazardous methods even her fellow astronomers would not dare use. After the Sundering, all traces of her had been erased and not even us Shen'dralar know what became of her.
41775.completion: There it is; oh, how marvelous the binding is, so intricate and filigrane. Holding it in my hands is simply overwhelming, as if I am being cast between the tides of knowledge, tossed beneath the waves and drowning in Princess Aszune's discoveries. You have done more than well, <race>. As your reward, let me impart the wisdom of Aszune to you.

41776.title: Nexus Shattering
41776.progress:
Nexus crystals are the concentrated arcane essence of the Twisting Nether that seeped into the armaments and artifacts of Azeroth. They possess immense power and potential and are used in many magical enchantments that empower the recipient tremendously. Usually these crystals are so dense that not even the strongest spell or weapon can break them without releasing a volatile and lethal explosion. Aszune, however, managed to create a method of splitting a nexus crystal into two lesser magical shards, maintaining its stability and energy.

I would love to conduct experiments with the instructions found inside Aszune's manifesto. Bring me one such crystal and we will see how true her words will ring. Nexus Crystal
41776.completion:
<Lorekeeper Javon holds the crystal in one hand, the grimoire in the other. Reciting the incantations written on the pages, the nexus crystal begins to move, agitated by the swell of arcane power. Increasing in intensity, the rapid movements peak before breaking under vibrant purple sparks, leaving two golden shards in Javon's hand.>

Success! That was marvelous, truly! I am amazed how close to perfect Aszune's spells are. With a bit of practice and refinement, we will be able to quickly and more safely break apart nexus crystals with ease.

<name>, thank you for your cooperation. You can keep these shards as a reward for your assistance. Please, bring me any nexus crystal you can find, so that I may continue my experimentations.

41777.title: Nexus Convergence
41777.progress: In her dissertation, Aszune theorizes that arcane energy naturally coalesces after some time. This, however, could be accelerated in an albeit unnatural way. She wrote that if attuning two similarly inclined implements to the same wave of energy, they would eventually fuse, creating something wholly new. My desire to try this on my own is indescribable. Let us begin with something simple for now; who knows what kind of dangerous repercussions our actions may bring with them. Following these incantations, I will attempt to coagulate two brilliant shards, creating something magnificent. <name>, if you could deliver me these shards, it'd be much appreciated. Large Brilliant Shard(2)
41777.completion:
<Crackling energy shoots out from the magical shards, while Javon recites the spell. Heat begins to emanate from his hand and the pieces begin to form a liquid union, hovering slightly in the air. Shortly after, a burst of mana erupts - and in Javon's hand lies a nexus crystal.>

Splendid, seeing it unfold right before my eyes is something I will remember forever. To think what we've achieved today was only possible because of ten-thousand year old knowledge, wisdom my people treasured for millennia is a testament to our resilience. Don't fret, young <class>, without your aid, all of this would not have been possible. Please keep the crystal as your reward. I am adamant that we can refine the process even further, so I would be pleased if you'd gather the needed components once again.

41778.title: Libram of Voracity
41778.progress: The Athenaeum houses a near endless multitude of tomes and books, filled to the brim with millenia old knowledge. Naturally, this attracts shady individuals intent on pilfering our esteemed collection for their own personal gain. Much to our dismay, this has become a daily occurrence, and my fellow archivists are barely bothered by it. Please, if you find any of our lost librams inside and outside of Dire Maul, return them to me. Libram of Voracity
41778.completion: Ah, the Libram of Voracity. Have you browsed its pages? For the unkeen eye, it is merely a collection of disconnected images and cryptic words, but for the enlightened, unforeseen potential lies within. The Athenaeum is greatly indebted to your continued assistance.

41779.title: Libram of Constitution
41779.progress: The Athenaeum houses a near endless multitude of tomes and books, filled to the brim with millenia old knowledge. Naturally, this attracts shady individuals intent on pilfering our esteemed collection for their own personal gain. Much to our dismay, this has become a daily occurrence, and my fellow archivists are barely bothered by it. Please, if you find any of our lost librams inside and outside of Dire Maul, return them to me. Libram of Constitution
41779.completion: Ah, the Libram of Constitution. This heavy tome is infamous for harboring difficult incantations and invaluable arcane wisdom some would deem as perilous. The Athenaeum is greatly indebted to your continued assistance.

41780.title: Libram of Resilience
41780.progress: The Athenaeum houses a near endless multitude of tomes and books, filled to the brim with millenia old knowledge. Naturally, this attracts shady individuals intent on pilfering our esteemed collection for their own personal gain. Much to our dismay, this has become a daily occurrence, and my fellow archivists are barely bothered by it. Please, if you find any of our lost librams inside and outside of Dire Maul, return them to me. Libram of Resilience
41780.completion: Ah, the Libram of Resilience. A popular oeuvre among aspiring arcanists. But beware, should you lose yourself within its pages, there is no turning back. The Athenaeum is greatly indebted to your continued assistance.

41781.title: Libram of Rumination
41781.progress: The Athenaeum houses a near endless multitude of tomes and books, filled to the brim with millenia old knowledge. Naturally, this attracts shady individuals intent on pilfering our esteemed collection for their own personal gain. Much to our dismay, this has become a daily occurrence, and my fellow archivists are barely bothered by it. Please, if you find any of our lost librams inside and outside of Dire Maul, return them to me. Libram of Rumination
41781.completion: The Libram of Rumination. A nefarious grimoire. I'd best not disclose its contents, and for your sake, I wish you did not open its accursed pages. The Athenaeum is greatly indebted to your continued assistance.

41782.title: Libram of Tenacity
41782.progress: The Athenaeum houses a near endless multitude of tomes and books, filled to the brim with millenia old knowledge. Naturally, this attracts shady individuals intent on pilfering our esteemed collection for their own personal gain. Much to our dismay, this has become a daily occurrence, and my fellow archivists are barely bothered by it. Please, if you find any of our lost librams inside and outside of Dire Maul, return them to me. Libram of Tenacity
41782.completion: Ah, the Libram of Tenacity. If our statistics are to be trusted, this appears to be the book that has been stolen the most. I wonder why... The Athenaeum is greatly indebted to your continued assistance.

41783.title: Forgotten Stories
41783.description:
You may think an archivist doesn't have much to do on an expedition like this, but you couldn't be further from the truth with that assumption! Not accounting for many of my other talents like translation or my analytical prowess, many of the places the SI:7 gets stationed are filled to the brim with enriching history. This is especially true for a place as steeped in history as Balor. Infamous among the citizens of the kingdom, many stories and rumours around the long buried vessel state are told among the generations. While I have to perform my tasks here in an objective manner, there are still particular documents I wish to chronicle out of personal interest.

The logbook of the lighthouse keeper. The lighthouse can be seen north of here, just beyond the bay of Breezehaven.

The records of the Grahan family, the ruins of their estate are nestled in the western mountains.

The sermons of the church past the broken city gates.

Look for them on your ventures to the island.
41783.progress: Balor was a place of hardship, tribulations and tragedies. Born from the wish for independancy and wealth, it quickly became the haven for merchants across the kingdom, and even those beyond its borders.
41783.completion:
<Placing the books on Noppsy's table, the gnome marvels at the proportionally gigantic tomes.>

So beautiful and ancient! It will take some time to study these documents thoroughly. Thank you, <name>. You've done a great service to the kingdom today, preserving part of their history, as ugly and depressing as it may be. These stories tell us valuable lessons, so barring your eyes from them will only hurt you in the long run. Remember, knowledge is key to your survival.

41784.title: Kezan Fruitcake Imports
41784.description:
Hey, you there! You look like the brave adventurin' type! I bet you could use a treat that'll restore your appetite in record timing... Yeah yeah, I can see it on your face, you want it right now! Well, sorry bub, my Kezan Fruitcakes are a rarity, and one that needs a buy in. If you want to have the opportunity to buy my goods, you'll have to pay me for the luxury first.

How about, one hundred gold coins. My fruitcakes are only for well off clients after all, I'm not willing to give such a rare import to some lowly begger. You get the coins, and you come back to me, sound good kid?
41784.completion: So, maybe you do have the stuff. Well, if you're willing to hand the coin over, I'll open my secret vendors list for you, and all the others who have paid my fee. Trust me, you won't regret it.

41785.title: Yoke of the Dragon Queen
41785.description: <In your hands is the glimmering shard formerly held by Zuluhed, Chieftain of the Dragonmaw Clan. Looking at his lifeless body, you remember just what he was able to accomplish with the relic that is now in your possession: A piece of the Demon Soul, the legendary artifact used by Nekros Skullcrusher to enslave the Dragon Queen Alexstrasza, the Aspect of the Red Dragonflight. Still brimming with power bestowed upon it long ago, you contemplate on what to do with it. Perhaps you’ll be able to find a member of the Red Dragonflight willing to speak with you about this dangerous implement.>
41785.completion:
<Nydiszanz recoils and hisses in pain at the sight of the Demon Soul shard. Just being near it causes a visceral reaction by him.>

Impossible, you retrieved it and dare bring it to us?! I don’t know if you are reckless, cruel, gullible or all of the above. But... you being here... with it... It means the Dragonmaw are no more. Their warchief returned to the cycle, their machinations thwarted. And the Demon Soul returned to us. Even through all its taint, I can sense the Queen’s benevolence somewhere hidden within, reaching out...

<name>, hand me the shard and I will deliver it to our Queen. Only she is capable of destroying the last remnants from this dark hour of our past. For you, I present these. A just reward for your sacrifice in stopping the Dragonmaw and ending the terror of the Demon Soul. Use it well, mortal.

41786.title: Suspicions From Sea
41786.description: This island is playing tricks on me. Shrouded in thick fog all day long and if it isn't that for a few minutes, I'm seeing smoke clouds coming from out in the ocean. Yes, from the ocean! No land in sight, but smoke is rising up into the sky like it's the most logical thing. You're helping us in our operation, right? If you have the time, could you check the open sea northwest from here and give me the peace of mind I desperately need?
41786.completion: It was a matter of time till someone dares to venture here. Lower your weapons, I mean you no harm.

41787.title: Heart of Darkness
41787.description:
The Shadow Council. It seems Doomhammer's lap dogs were sloppy. If you are unfamiliar with them, the Shadow Council are - or rather were - Gul'dan's fanatical followers. A cabal of heretics and sinners, devoting their very being to their demon overlords. They were said to have been eradicated following their master's death during the Second War, yet their depravity still prevails. If this missive can be trusted, then the Stormreaver are led by a high ranking and powerful warlock of the Shadow Council, operating from within Stormwrought Castle.

<name>, there is little time for respite. Gather an elite force and storm the fallen castle. We need to put a stop to their leader from summoning that demon from beyond the Nether and rescue the remaining citizens still in their clutches. Do not take this lightly, prepare for any eventuality!
41787.progress: It may be too much to ask from you, but we don't have any luxuries left at this point.
41787.completion:
What travesties have transpired at this place...? Never have I witnessed such horrors in my life, the thought of such profanities even existing send shivers down my spine.

<name>, your bravery in descending this spiral of madness is a heroic feat rarely seen nowadays. Your service to the kingdom and all of the Alliance this day will be remembered by those present and cherished by those affected. These rewards do not match the magnitude of your deeds, but take them nevertheless.

You are dismissed.

41788.title: Ursan Heights
41788.description:
The Gnarlpine are not the only furbolg tribe dwelling upon Teldrassil’s boughs.

Far to the southwest, nestled among the mist-veiled heights, lies an elusive tribe — the Ursan. They have long shunned the paths of others, hiding from both our eyes and our voices.

Yet... I sense the same darkness stirring among them — the fel moss spreads, corrupting all it touches. We dispatched a druid, Drethanis, to seek the truth within their domain. But... the winds have carried no word of him since.

I fear for his fate.

Will you aid me? Seek him amidst the shadows of Ursan Heights — the path lies west of the Pools of Arlithrien.

Should he yet draw breath, it is there you shall find him.
41788.completion:
So... Kyra has finally deigned to remember I exist? How endearing.

<Drethanis regards you with a calm, unreadable gaze — no warmth, no gratitude.>

Very well. If nothing else, your presence may serve a purpose. The rot runs deeper than any of us feared.

41789.title: Ursan Tribe
41789.description:
Look around you. The Ursan tribe — once noble, for a lesser race — now raves with fel-induced madness. Their hearts are shattered, their minds lost.

They have defiled one of our sacred moonwells... and slain its guardian. Such transgression cannot go unanswered.

Were the times less dire, I would seek to mend their spirits. But you’ve seen it — what the fel moss does to these woods. Once it takes root, there is no redemption for their kind.

Cull them. As many as you can. Bring me their charms — pitiful relics, once crafted by their shamans to ward off evil spirits. A quaint belief.

<He smirks faintly, a bitter gleam in his eye.>

Clearly... they failed.
41789.progress: Time is of the essence — do not waste it.
41789.completion:
Their spirits now drift back to the Dream... to merge with Ursol, the Bear-God they worshipped with such fervor.

How ironic. For all their blind devotion, even Ursol could not shield them from corruption. Or perhaps... he chose not to.

41790.title: Reclaiming the Moonwell
41790.description:
The tribe is broken, their strength scattered to the winds. Now is the time to reclaim what is ours—the moonwell must not remain steeped in their stench.

Their so-called leader, Arkod the White, likely struts around the sacred waters even now, desecrating what remains of its guardians. Once, he was a devout servant of Ursol... one of the bear god’s most revered clerics.

Curious, isn’t it? To fall so far. One must wonder what blasphemy earned him Ursol’s silence.

End him. Sever the head of their corruption and bring it to me. Without him, the tribe will crumble—and I will cleanse the moonwell of their filth once and for all.
41790.progress: Be wary, <class>. He is a formidable enemy.
41790.completion:
So... it is done. A necessary task, and performed adequately.

<He pauses, gaze drifting toward the tainted moonwell, voice lowering with unease.>

And yet... a shadow lingers in my thoughts.

What if Ursol himself has fallen? What if the silence is not from disdain, but from madness... corruption?

<His tone grows cold, edged with quiet alarm.>

A dangerous thought. One I dare not entertain lightly. The Archdruid must hear of this.

You have my thanks for your... assistance. May the winds carry you far from this cursed place.

41791.title: The Shatterblade Outpost
41791.description:
Our expansion into the Eastern Kingdoms is everso successful. The founding of Kargath was a vital moment in cementing our presence on the outskirts of Khaz Modan. But that was merely one step in the Warchief's plan for the lands beyond the Great Sea.

To the northeast of the great pond of Loch Modan, a passageway leads into the Grim Reaches, unbound lands of the hill dwarves, riddled with the vile Dragonmaw orcs. Commander Aggnash established the Shatterblade Outpost on the northeastern outskirts, a stronghold built to neutralize the Dragonmaw aggression within these parts of the Eastern Kingdom. Venture there and aid him in fulfilling the Warchief's cause.
41791.completion: Stand tall, soldier. Belgrom did well in sending you here. Look around, there is much to be done here.

41792.title: Hog For Morkan
41792.description: My brother Morkan is stationed at Shatterblade Post in the Grim Reaches. A rugged land, east of Loch Modan and the Wetlands. The dwarves and Dragonmaw orcs have been fighting over control for a long time there, and our Warchief Thrall wishes to assess the situation for himself. The wild is treacherous and unrelenting, and my brother, while ambitious and disciplined, is still young and inexperienced. To bolster his spirit, I want him to have this cooked hog I prepared, it is his favourite. If you could bring this to him, I'd be very much in your debt, <class>.
41792.progress: Don't cause trouble around here, we've got our hands full already.
41792.completion: That smell...! It must be Slagg's famous hog steak! I could recognize that smell from anywhere. It's just like how our father used to cook it. Thank you very much, <name>. Being so far in enemy territory sometimes takes a toll on my morale. I appreciate you and Slagg reminding me what we are fighting for here.

41793.title: Scars of the Past
41793.description:
The Horde's past is riddled with guilt and mistakes. Our bygone alliances with various orc clans of old put a stain on our honor, a stain we need to scrape off if we wish to step into a new future. The Dragonmaw Clan, fanatical veterans responsible for the enslavement of the Red Dragonflight, rallied itself in the Grim Reaches, a cragged place to the east of Loch Modan. Their delusions make them cling like madmen to their olden ways, unable to see the foolishness of it all.

We dispatched a unit to the Grim Reaches on Warchief Thrall's behest through Loch Modan, past the tunnel at Farstrider Lodge southeast of the lake. I want you to follow and join them at Shatterblade Post. Make sure to aid them wherever you can. Bring honor to the horde, whelp!
41793.completion: Throm'ka, young one. Welcome to Shatterblade Post.

41794.title: The Storms of Balor
41794.description:
Mok'rah, young one. Yonder the Great Sea's bays to the north lies the forlorn island of Balor. Unnatural storms ravage its shores, and the sinister magic of Gul'dan's taint still lingers in its earth even decades after his destruction. My clan, the Bleeding Hollow, is stationed on one of eastern islands surrounding Balor, on behalf of our Warchief Thrall. Chieftain Kilrogg himself volunteered in leading this offensive against the resurfaced Stormreaver clan of old.

Could I ask you a favor? My clan mate Far Seer Sarno requires this potion for his divinations. If you could bring it to him, you'd do a great service to the Horde. Speak with Thysta the Wind Rider Master just over there and she will bring you to Balor posthaste.
41794.progress: Thrall hall, youngling. What brings you to Stormbreaker Point?
41794.completion: Mok'thardin did good in sending you here. This potion will prove to be vital in our endeavors on this island. While you are here, aid us. We could use any hand available.

41795.title: A Unknown Letter
41795.description:
A terrible darkness emerged from our past, young one. A darkness threatening not only the Horde, but all life on Azeroth. Not long ago, we received a mysterious letter from an unknown sender, written in pitch black ink. It warned us of a relic from the Second War, reborn to spread its seed of chaos throughout the world. The Stormreaver Clan, Gul'dan's puppet clan, returned and joined forces with its old allies, the Shadow Council. Their warlocks have committed innumerable atrocities in the past, and if we do not stop them, I fear we may be facing a new age of terror. I ordered one of my advisors and chieftain of the Bleeding Hollow Clan, Kilrogg Deadeye, to quell their uprising. He departed to the island of Balor, their former base of operation countless years ago.

<name>, I want you to follow suit and assist the Bleeding Hollow Clan. Take the zeppelin to Grom'gol Base Camp and speak to the local Wind Rider Master. She can bring you to the island west of Stormwind.
41795.completion: Whelpling, what we are facing is an abyss of unseen depth. Be absolutely sure your heart is steeled for what is to come. Lest you'll be devoured by the void festering on this island.

41796.title: Far From Home
41796.description:
Greetings, good <class>. Have you heard about the grand tournament in Northwind? The local nobles are holding a jousting tournament and invited various human nations to participate, Theramore included! Lady Proudmoore chose a handful of our guards as contestants, and my beautiful children were among them! I had barely time to say goodbye to them, they had to depart so quickly. Say, are you by chance traveling to Northwind? Would you be so kind and hand my boy Boris these scarves? See it as my way as their father to support them even here in Theramore.

I heard you can reach Northwind by traversing Stormwind Harbor. Good luck!
41796.progress: Anything I can help you with? I need to prepare for the tournament, our opponents won't be easy to defeat.
41796.completion: Scarves from our father? Oh my. Now this is a bit embarrassing. He's always been on the softer side of things, a dreamer, you could say. Don't get me wrong, though. I appreciate it very much. Alessa and I grew up in Stormwind. Since we were very little back then, we don't have many memories of the time, but it still feels weird for us to be back here. Having something familiar from home will help us with the situation, for sure. For that, you have my thanks.

41797.title: A Dear Friend
41797.description:
Duskwood grows more dangerous with each passing day. Either its the rabid worgen, wandering dead or thieving cutthroats - there is always something out for your life out here. In the end, one may wonder why we're all still here. The answer is simple: these woods are our home, and we're not letting these monstrosities take them from us.

Still, me being here weighs heavy on the hearts of my friends, on Barbara's more than others'. She is the fletcher of Lord Amberwood, the ruling noble of Northwind north of Stormwind. I haven't seen her in a long time, let alone written to her about my well-being. She must be worried sick about me, and it shames me deeply. If you have a moment to spare, could you deliver this letter to her? In it are things written I should've said to her a long time ago, so I'm entrusting you with a very important task. If you could do that for me, I'd be eternally grateful to you.

The quickest way to Northwind is by passing through the Stormwind Harbor.
41797.progress: How can I help you? Need to refill your quiver?
41797.completion:
A letter from Avette? How is she? I heard Duskwood is a treacherous place nowadays, not safe for any of the common folk.

<Barbara opens the letter and quickly glances over a few lines. While doing so, a chuckle escapes her.>

I see I have nothing to worry about, how relieving. It's been too long since I've heard from her and I was beginning to assume the worst. Once Northwind's troubles subside, I will pay her a visit. It is more than overdue. Here, take these few coins as thanks from me and Avette. Trust me, you did more than you think for the both of us. Stay safe on your travels, <name>.

41798.title: My Darling Wife
41798.description:
Good day to you, <class>. You look like the adventurous type to me. Have you braved many of the dangers that are omnipresent nowadays? No matter where you go, it seems crises are not far off. Certainly not a world we wish our children to grow up in. My wife does her best to make Azeroth a better place, but even in the organization she is in, it is a nigh impossible task for her to accomplish. Say, would you be interested in assisting her, as a mercenary? The operation she is assigned to this time is... particularly delicate, or so she told me. To be frank with you, I am worried about her well-being, this might be just too much even for her. I'd be forever in your debt if you could aid her.

If yes, then head to the harbor, just west of here. On one of the southern docks, you should find a colleague of hers - Simmons is his name, I think. Tell him Operative Gillian requested more external assistance, and he should bring you to her, to the island of Balor.
41798.progress: Ronald Gillian asked you to join his wife on Balor to assist in her work.
41798.completion: Oh Ronald, your heart is in the right place, but your naivete is just too cumbersome sometimes. Either way, now that you're here, you might as well assist us. My name is Operative Verona Gillian, and I welcome you to the hell that is Balor.

41799.title: A Hydromancer's Curiosity
41799.description:
That good-for-nothing Finnigan! I swear, someday one of his escapades will be the end of him. You see, not long ago a group of SI:7 agents gathered at the docks. Apparently, from what we could overhear, they were on their way to complete a dangerous mission on the island just off the coast of Westfall. Balor is its name. That island has been drenched in a never-ending thunderstorm even well before we settled here in Davenburg. Kul Tiras has been in contact with Balor and its people in the past, so the place is not unknown to us.

Be that as it may, Finnigan, our local hydromancer, actually volunteered in helping the SI:7 with their assignment on Balor and is now with them in their outpost. We need him back here in Davenburg as soon as possible, so as to not jeopardize our diplomatic mission. <class>, would you be willing to help him finish whatever he started, so that he can return to us? One of the agents stayed back at the southern docks, I am sure he can take you to the island.
41799.progress: Speak with Hydromancer Finnigan in the SI:7 Outpost on Balor.
41799.completion: Hornby sent you? That fool is too soft for his own good. I appreciate the sentiment, but what is happening here exceeds whatever I was assigned to in Davenburg by far. Out of the question. He is right in one thing, however. Should you aid me in my research, I'd be quicker to return to the mainland. So, what do you say?

41800.title: The Grim Hollow
41800.description:
This place has seen a lot—heroes rising and falling, battles that turned into legends, and losses folks would rather forget. Out here, where the wind hums through the rocks and the ground's soaked in the blood of old wars, you can feel the past hanging in the air.

Tucked away in the Grim Hollow to the south is the Tomb of Ancestors. It's an ancient resting place, old as Grim Batol itself. Dwarves laid their dead to rest there ages ago, carved their names in runestone and memory. We thought they were at peace.

Turns out, we were wrong.

Something's stirring in the dark. The dead aren't resting like they should. Spirits are drifting through the fog, restless. There's something foul buried beneath the marsh—something that doesn't belong.

So here's the deal: head into those misty bogs. Figure out what's messing with the tomb, and put an end to it. Let the dead sleep in peace again… and make sure whatever's causing this doesn't get any further.
41800.progress: Careful out there—Grim Hollow's not the kind of place you just stroll through. The mist hangs thick, and the shadows feel... off, like they're watching you. Plenty of brave folks have gone in thinking they'd be fine—most never came back. Would be a damn shame if you ended up buried with the Wildhammer dead instead of helping them.
41800.completion:
Let's hope you gave those restless spirits the peace they deserve. The dead should stay dead, especially ones who fought and bled for their kin.

Still… makes you wonder, doesn't it? What twisted thing got into that tomb and stirred everything up? There's something dark at work in those mists, and I've got a bad feeling this ain't the last we've seen of it.

41801.title: The Blue Dragonkin
41801.description:
There's someone who might know what's behind all this mess. Way deep in Grim Hollow, there's an old tree—a massive oak that's been standing since long before any dwarf laid eyes on these lands. No one really knows how old it is, but it's always been respected. Quiet. Steady. Part of the land, you know?

But now... we've had word from Wildhammer scouts that a blue dragonkin's made camp under its branches. No idea what he's doing there, but I've got a feeling it ain't random. With the way the land's been twisting lately, his arrival can't be a coincidence. Dragons don't usually stick their snouts into mortal troubles unless something big's going on.

If you're thinking of talking to him, tread carefully. Dragons aren't exactly known for their sunny tempers, and one wrong word could get you roasted. Still… if you can get him to talk, he might just have answers we're not gonna find anywhere else.
41801.progress: A mortal? Here? Speak your mind quickly.
41801.completion:
Who am I? Ah, you mortals and your curiosity. I have been known by many names across the ages, but you may address me as Sarthyss Scaleheart. It is not by mere chance that you have wandered into my domain—no, this meeting reeks of fate's design.

And as it happens, mortal, I find myself in need of assistance that only hands such as yours can provide. Strange times, indeed, when a dragon must turn to the fleeting for aid.

41802.title: Tomb of Ancestors
41802.description:
Only the blind could fail to see the corruption that has taken hold of these swamps, its foul tendrils seeping into every root and shadow. I was sent here to uncover the truth of what plagues the Grim Hollow, yet my task has been far from easy. The swamps are patrolled by red dragonkin, their minds ensnared by the same corruption that poisons this land.

We dragons share a bond, a sense of our kin, and they sense me as surely as I sense them. Each time I've sought to approach the Tomb of Ancestors, they have intercepted me, driven not by reason but by the darkness that clouds their minds. And so, I remain here, sheltered beneath this ancient oak, but unable to fulfill the purpose that brought me to this cursed place.

You, however, are unbound by the ties of dragonkind. You must venture into the depths of the Tomb of Ancestors and uncover the source of this corruption. I am certain it lies within, festering and spreading its taint. The fate of these lands may rest upon your mortal courage.
41802.progress: I cannot say what horrors await you in the depths of the Tomb of Ancestors. The corruption that festers there is ancient and powerful, far beyond the reckoning of most mortals. Prepare yourself well before you venture forth, and heed this warning—do not let foolish heroics guide your actions. Caution and wisdom will serve you far better than reckless bravery.
41802.completion:
A dark ritual? A cursed dwarven sorcerer? Mortal, you speak of things beyond your understanding. That is no mere dwarf—it is a skardyn, a twisted and vile abomination, once kin to dwarves but long since fallen into darkness.

And if the skardyn walk these lands once more, it can mean only one thing—the gates of Grim Batol have been opened again.

The noble draconic defenders who once stood vigil over that cursed place have succumbed to madness, their minds broken by the lingering corruption of Modgud. Her shadow stretches forth once more, reaching to taint the world anew. This is no mere threat, mortal—this is calamity given form.

41803.title: The Skardyn
41803.description: Now, mortal, listen well. If you are to grasp the gravity of what we face, you must first understand the skardyn and the vile origin that birthed them. Their story is one of betrayal, corruption, and a darkness that should have remained buried. Pay heed, for this knowledge is as dangerous as it is necessary.
41803.completion:
Now you see the truth, mortal—clear as the moon over the frozen peaks. This skardyn sorcerer must be struck down before his vile work can seep further into the heart of this land. His very presence here is no accident; it is the herald of greater darkness, the echo of a curse long thought buried beneath stone and time.

Whatever foul purpose brought him to Grim Hollow, it festers like a wound—and if left unchecked, its rot will spread. These swamps, already choked with corruption, are but the beginning. Mark my words: the magic he weaves will not stop here. It will slither beyond the Hollow... to Dun Kithas, and perhaps even farther, poisoning the land, the skies, the very soul of Khaz Modan.

41804.title: Memories of Dark Iron
41804.description:
Skardyn... beings of terrible might and shadowed fury. Far stronger than you, mortal—and stronger still than any common band of adventurers. To face them directly would be folly. Their flesh is shielded by scales steeped in foul sorcery, their forms protected by curses woven deep into their essence.

If we are to stand a chance, we'll need to forge a weapon—one imbued with the power to pierce their dark enchantments. But I must confess, mortal... even with all my knowledge, I know not what such a weapon would be. The secrets of their unmaking lie beyond my grasp.

Yet there may be another path. The skardyn were once Dark Iron dwarves—twisted by shadow, yes, but once kin to those who still walk the surface. Perhaps their descendants have kept records of what befell their cursed kin.

You must go to Angor Fortress in the Badlands. There, the Dark Irons still linger—reclusive, secretive, and dangerous. But if any among them remember the truth of what transpired beneath Grim Batol, it is there you'll find
41804.progress: While you seek their knowledge, I shall reach out to my dragonflight. Perhaps among our ancient scrolls and hidden memories, we can uncover some forgotten truth. But hurry. The shadows grow bold, and time is not our ally.
41804.completion:
Ahhh... Of course it would be the searing kiss of the Red Flight that could sunder such foul sorceries.

The Skardyn's wards are woven with the brittle cunning of earth and shadow—strong against conventional magic, yes... but against the raw, devouring fury of my crimson cousins?

I should have seen it sooner—fire has ever been the answer to vermin who burrow too deep.

41805.title: Bathed in Dragonfire
41805.description:
Now, listen mortal.

The Red kin who stalk these festering marshes... their minds are no longer their own. The Skardyn's filthy sorcery has wormed into their thoughts, twisting proud drakes into snarling puppets. A disgrace... but not without use.

Their fire glands—untouched by corruption—still burn hot. Harvest them. Let their last embers serve a purpose greater than madness. With these, we will scorch the Skardyn's defenses to ash.

Do not mistake this for mercy. It is necessity. Their suffering ends... and so will the Skardyn.

Now go. And do not waste their fire.
41805.progress: The whelps are no use to us- you must find the adult kin.
41805.completion:
Mmh... You have done what was necessary, mortal.

Their minds are finally still. No more Skardyn whispers. No more chains of twisted magic. Only silence... and the long sleep they were denied.

Do not mourn them. Their fire now fuels our purpose—their last act will burn brighter than their madness ever did.

41806.title: Dragonfire Bombs!
41806.description:
Fire glands alone will not suffice to breach the skardyn's defenses—no, not by far. Their twisted flesh has been hardened by shadow, warded against mere flame. What we require is a catalyst... a focused conduit through which the fury of dragonfire may be properly channeled.

There is a gnome, curious and cunning—Oglethorpe Obnoticus by name—residing in that chaotic cesspit the mortals call Booty Bay. In his younger years, he toiled with volatile flame in an attempt to cleanse the blight of Gnomeregan. His methods were... unorthodox, and not without controversy. The Tinkmaster himself opposed them.

Yet, if there exists a mind capable of forging a dragonfire device potent enough to break through the skardyn's shadow-wrought hide, it is his.

Seek him. Time is not on our side.
41806.progress: What is it? I'm rather busy!
41806.completion:
Dragonfire bombs? Ha-HA! Now you're speaking my language!

You've come to the right gnome, friend! Oglethorpe Obnoticus at your service—chemist, engineer, part-time arcanomechanical theorist, and full-time enthusiast of all things that go BOOM!

Buuut let's not get ahead of ourselves. Sure, I can whip up a dragonfire bomb—of course I can! But as it stands, I'm a bit... let's say, under-equipped. Supplies, reagents, blastproof goggles—the usual!

So! If you're ready to lend a hand, we just might make a little history together. A very explosive bit of history.

41807.title: I Am Become Death...
41807.description:
Aha! Hmm... well now, this isn't entirely a disaster. I've got—let's see—coil springs, flux regulators, containment gel... Yes! I've got most of what I need!

However! I am running a bit low on a few key components—namely, Solid Blasting Powder, Bronze Frameworks, and Whirring Bronze Gizmos. Nothing too exotic! Any halfway-competent engineer could whip those up with the right materials. No offense if you're only quarter-competent, of course!

Now, one thing might prove a bit trickier... the heat-resistant trigger. Not just any old trigger, mind you—this one's a specialty piece from Undermine. Built to withstand extreme temperatures. Last I heard, the latest shipment from Undermine got intercepted by those scoundrelly Bloodsail pirates.

If you're lucky—and still have all your limbs by the end—you might find one of those precious triggers stashed in the pirate camps to the southeast.

Off you go then! Bring me the goods, and I'll bring the boom!
41807.completion:
<Oglethorpe adjusts his goggles and inspects the materials with exaggerated precision>

Ooooh, yes! The powder's potent, the framework's solid, and the gizmo's got just the right amount of whirrrr. Excellent work! These will do nicely—no duds, no rust, no strange gooey residue. Always a good sign!

Now stand back, friend—way back—and prepare to witness engineering brilliance in action! I shall now craft... the BOMB OF THE AGES!

...Heh. Just, uh—quick question before I start the final assembly.

You're not planning to use this in town, are you? Or on, say... anyone I know? Or me?

41808.title: The Destroyer of Skardyn
41808.description:
<Oglethorpe eyes the finished bomb with a mix of pride and deep, mounting concern>

Well... upon some reflection—and maybe a teensy bit of hindsight—I'm not entirely convinced crafting that for you was the best idea I've ever had...

M-maybe I should hold onto it... just to, you know, keep the world intact for another day or two...

Okay, okay! No need for the death glare—yikes! Just... take the blasted thing! But do us all a favor and carry it as far away as possible! Avoid fire, goblins, sudden movements, loud noises, and especially me when you're holding it!

<He gingerly places the bomb into your hands>

Now go, go! Shoo! Be gone before I have second thoughts!

Ooooh—but wait! All this tinkering just gave me the most brilliant idea—EXPLOSIVE DUCKS!No one expects an explosive duck! Heehee! The waddling! The detonating! THE POSSIBILITIES!
41808.progress: You have finally returned, mortal. I hope you bear good tidings.
41808.completion:
In your absence, there has been much disturbance. Strange lights, flickering with unnatural hues, have danced from the depths of that cursed crypt. The air itself trembles with arcane dissonance. Whatever stirs beneath... it grows stronger.

It is good that you have returned. We are running out of time.

May the gnome's contraption—chaotic though it may be—combined with the sacred fire of my kin, be enough to quell the abomination that waits below. If it is not... then the consequences will echo far beyond these hills.

41809.title: Smell of Dragonfire
41809.description:
Enough waiting, mortal.

That Skardyn filth cowers below, his claws sunk deep into the earth's veins, poisoning all he touches. His wards may be strong—but not against the fire you now carry. Let my fallen kin's fury be the spark that burns his defenses to cinders.

Then take his head. Cleanly. Let his blood be the last corruption he spills.

But do not be a fool. Walk in alone, and you will be just another corpse in his collection. Bring warriors. Bring steel. Bring enough rage to match his treachery.

Now go. And do not disappoint me.
41809.completion:
At last... the taint lifts.

<His wings flex slightly as the oppressive weight of dark magic dissipates, the air itself seeming to sigh in relief. The swamp's murky waters ripple as if awakening from a long nightmare.>

Grim Hollow will mend. The earth remembers how to heal... given time.

Yet this victory is but one ember plucked from a wildfire. The Skardyn do not act alone—they are rats fleeing a sinking nest. Grim Batol has spat out more of their kind, scattered like rot across Khaz Modan.

And worst of all... they scurry with purpose. This was no mere exile. They serve something. Something old. Something hungry.

Mark my words, mortal—this is not over. Whatever they plan... we must find it before it finds us.

And next time... the fire we bring may not be enough.

41810.title: Verdant Rune
41810.progress: With the Runestones restored, we can utilize their Dream energy to aid us in this war against the Nightmare. In times immemorial, the keepers of the wild and their protectors used powerful runes, much like the Runestones you had just brought back to life. With them, they could attune their spirit to a point and travel there posthaste via the Emerald Dream. If you wish, I can carve such a rune into a small dream shard, so that you may heed our call for help wherever you may be on Azeroth. Small Dream Shard
41810.completion: It is done. This Verdant Rune is tethered to the essence of the World Tree in conjunction with the Runestones. Focus your mind on its potent magic, and your spirit will find itself anew here, at the foot of Nordrassil.

41811.title: The Farraki Ancient
41811.description:
<Zalsu seems lost in focus, as if he is attempting to listen to something far off. His attention is snapped from distant thoughts, only to look upon you with curiosity.>

I sense you are here for a purpose, can you hear it, trailing upon the sands, and rising from the dunes? Yes... Something evil has arisen, something foul. I have sensed it from deep within Zul'Farrak, and it has tainted the very dunes of Tanaris itself! The spirits be angered by the presence of an ancient evil, and I have no doubt it is the return of Zel'jeb.

He who was old when the world was young, one of the most venerable warlords of the Farraki, empowered by dark embalming, and foul magic. If there is to be peace in these lands, his soul must be brought to an end. Find him, deep within Zul'Farrak, and bring your most trusted allies, you will need them to defeat Zel'jeb.
41811.progress: Silence, you be interrupting the winds...
41811.completion: Finally, a silence I have not heard in some time, the dunes themselves are at peace, and so am I... My wandering has come to an end, and perhaps it may be time to find peace for myself. I thank you traveler, you have done this place a great service. I offer you what little I can, may it serve you well.

41812.title: The Moonshrine Ruins
41812.description:
Deep beneath our feet lays an ancient temple once dedicated to Elune, it is there that druids planted a magical tree of great power to reinvigorate nature itself.The beauty of this tree has only been seen by few, though I now fear it lays in the hands of evil.

I have heard rumors that satyrs now skulk these once sacred halls in the depths of Blackfathom Deeps. I task you to recover a seed from this tree, and bring it to me so my fellow druids may perhaps discover the power of the druids of old.
41812.progress: Travel carefully, the depths of Blackfathom are crawling with evil.
41812.completion: Such beauty- such magnificence. I wish I could have personally laid eyes upon the ancient tree, though I thank you for the efforts you have taken to recover this. I am within your debt. Please, on behalf of us druids, take this as thanks.

41813.title: Balor's Own Moonshine
41813.description:
The Explorers' League is not what it used to be, I tell you! I told them I would come here to discover history, heirlooms, something so grand that it would be placed in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers! But they mocked me and gave me no funds. How is this dwarf expected to afford his ale with no funding?
