But don't let your guard down yet—there's still Dragonmaw scum skulking in the hills, and we dwarves know better than to trust the peace of a mountain too soon. Stay sharp, and keep your axe ready.

41883.title: Letter from Korlag Doomsong
41883.description:
A worn letter is discovered upon Zuluhed's Corpse. It appears to be addressed to him, and written in a coarse handwriting which reads:

<So you have finally returned? How long has it been since you disappeared to chase after your artifact while the rest of us fought tooth and nail for our survival? You abandoned the Dragonmaw Clan for your own foolish glory, and now, because you have returned, you expect all the chieftains to band together with no remorse or animosity?

Do not expect me to be as foolish as the others Zuluhed. You may hide in the underbelly of Grim Batol all you desire. I will lead our clan to a glorious, and great victory here on the soil of Grim Reaches, not cowering in caverns like Rend and his ilk. There are some of us that know the truth of the Blackrock, and do not desire to hide facts behind notions of a glorious 'Dark Horde'... Your order is declined, old friend.

Korlag Doomsong, Dragonmaw Clan.>
41883.progress: What is it that you bring?
41883.completion:
<Magistrate Hurdam Toughhand inspects the letter with a careful gaze...>

It would appear that the Dragonmaw Clan is not as united as we once believed. This news is relieving to hear.

41884.title: Destruction of the Dragonmaw
41884.description:
This letter confirms some of the rumors that have been circulating, the Dragonmaw Clan was not fully united.

Now that Zuluhed has been slain there is only one that stands in contention for chieftain, Commander Korlag Doomsong. We dwarves have been at odds with the Dragonmaw for longer than we can remember, and now it is time to strike the final blow. Gather what allies you can, and travel northward into the depths of Zarm'geth Stronghold, it is there you will find Korlag Doomsong, and the last leader of the Dragonmaw. Kill him, and free us from this perpetual war!
41884.progress: Preparation will be required if you desire success in the battle to come.
41884.completion:
<Magistrate Hurdam Toughhand looks on with a slight gaze of disbelief>

You were successful? By my beard, I cannot believe it!

Many long and hard fought battles will have been avoided thanks to your hard work. The dwarves of Dun Kithas are forever in your favor! Please, take one of these items, as a reward from all of us here.

41885.title: Chompers in the Water
41885.description:
<The dwarf stares at the lake, mumbling to himself. He smells strongly of fish and pipe smoke.>

They're out there… waiting. Teeth like daggers, eyes like cursed pearls! You think it's safe to fish in Lake Kithas? You'd be wrong! Dead wrong!

Those blasted razortooth crocolisks keep snapping at me lines—nearly took me hand off last week! They ain't just fishing hazards, they're monsters, I tell ye!

You've got a weapon, haven't ye? Go into that cursed lake and take down a few of them. Eight should make the rest think twice before messing with Nudrew again.

I'll make it worth your while, promise! And if I don't—well, the crocs will get me before the guilt does!
41885.progress: You still alive? Or did the crocs drag you under too?
41885.completion:
Ha! Look at ye, not even half-chewed! That's a fine bit of croc-clearing you've done, friend.

Maybe now I can cast a line without losing a toe. Or a whole leg. Or me sanity!

…Actually, forget that last one.

41886.title: Creeping Trouble
41886.description:
Listen, I don't scare easy… but there's something wrong with Grim Hollow. The air's thick, the trees creak even when there's no wind, and I swear the shadows move when you're not looking.

And the spiders—by the Stone, the spiders. Not your usual cave-crawlers, mind you. These are big, and they've got a hunger in their eyes. Greater Brown Recluses, they're called, and they're swarming the swamp trails like they own the place.

If we don't thin their numbers, we'll be webbed up in our sleep. You look like you've got some steel in you—go out there and take care of at least twelve of the beasts. I'll be here… keeping an eye on the perimeter.
41886.progress: Still alive? I mean—ah, back already? No? Then keep your eyes open, and your boots dry...
41886.completion:
You actually did it? Thank the ancestors. That should make things safer for now—though I still don't trust the quiet out here.

Appreciate your help. Not many brave enough to walk into those webs and walk back out again.

41887.title: The Recipe of Concoction of the Emerald Mongoose
41887.description:
If you are seeking to gain knowledge of our most vital and rare elixirs then you have come to the right place. For your efforts upon Hyjal, I could bestow upon you the knowledge of my forebearers. Concoction of the Emerald Mongoose is a rather potent and powerful alchemical mixture.

It could be used to turn the tide of a conflict in your favor.
41887.progress: So, have you made your choice?
41887.completion:
I must warn you, use this recipe wisely. A misuse of the materials can create the exact opposite of the Concoction of the Emerald Mongoose.

I suggest you follow this recipe closely.

41888.title: Call to Arms: Cleansing the Corruption
41888.description:
Our scouts have reported increased movement within enemy strongholds - Lower Karazhan Halls, Zul'Gurub, and Ahn'Qiraj.

We need proven champions to cut through these nests of corruption and return with proof of their deeds. Bring me Crests of Heroism, earned only through triumph over these formidable enemies.
41888.progress: Hold nothing back. Return with the crests — our allies are counting on you.
41888.completion:
You've returned — and with the Crests of Heroism no less. Your efforts in these treacherous places haven't gone unnoticed. With each victory, our foothold grows stronger.

The Alliance thanks you for your bravery.

41889.title: Call to Arms: Molten Assault
41889.description:
The very earth below us trembles with rage. Deep within the Molten Core, ancient enemies stir once more. New lieutenants of flame rise in Ragnaros's name, threatening to ignite another age of fire.

We cannot allow them to strengthen his forces. Hunt them down. Bring me the proof of their destruction: a molten scale from Incindis, and the signet ring torn from the hand of the Sorcerer-Thane himself. Let all who serve the Firelord know: the Alliance does not burn.
41889.progress: The flames are rising. Don't return empty-handed. Not unless you want to be turned to ash along with them.
41889.completion:
These relics speak for themselves. Incindis is no more, and the Sorcerer-Thane's hand lies still.

The Firelord will feel this blow and know the Alliance stands ready to snuff out his flames again, if need be. Take this cache, and remain prepared. There may be more lurking in the depths.

41890.title: Call to Arms: Dungeon Delving
41890.description:
The threat beyond the gates only grows bolder. Our scouts report increased aggression and coordination among enemy commanders within their most fortified dungeons.

We strike now, while they remain overconfident. Bring me the Crests of Valor taken from their fallen leaders. Show them that the Horde does not hesitate — we crush those who stand against us.
41890.progress: Every moment you delay, our enemies grow more daring. Prove to me the Horde still commands fear. Bring me the crests.
41890.completion:
These crests will send a message, loud and clear. You've proven your strength once again. We'll push further with this momentum.

Take your reward, champion. Stay sharp. The war does not rest - and neither do we.

41891.title: Call to Arms: Cleansing the Corruption
41891.description:
Our scouts have reported increased movement within enemy strongholds - Lower Karazhan Halls, Zul'Gurub, and Ahn'Qiraj.

These places seethe with dark magic and ancient threats. We need proven champions to strike deep, cleanse the corruption, and return with trophies of conquest. Bring me Crests of Heroism, earned only through triumph over these formidable enemies.
41891.progress: The Horde expects results, not excuses. Tear through the corruption, bring me the crests, and remind our enemies why they fear us.
41891.completion:
You return bearing the crests of victory. Good. These show the enemy that their darkness cannot withstand our strength. With each blow you strike, you carve the path forward for the Horde.

Your loyalty will not be forgotten.

41892.title: Call to Arms: Molten Assault
41892.description:
The very earth below us trembles with rage. Deep within the Molten Core, ancient enemies stir once more. New lieutenants of flame rise in Ragnaros's name, threatening to ignite another age of fire.

We cannot allow them to strengthen his forces. Hunt them down. Bring me the proof of their destruction: a molten scale from Incindis, and the signet ring torn from the hand of the Sorcerer-Thane himself. Let all who serve the Firelord know: the Horde does not burn.
41892.progress: The flames are rising. Don't return empty-handed. Not unless you want to be turned to ash along with them.
41892.completion:
These relics speak for themselves. Incindis is no more, and the Sorcerer-Thane's hand lies still.

The Firelord will feel this blow and know the Horde stands ready to snuff out his flames again, if need be. Take this cache, and remain prepared. There may be more lurking in the depths.

41893.title: The Ancient Wildhammer Tome
41893.description: <The old, withered book before you appears to account the creation of the lower reserve mine itself, as well as the many notable Wildhammer dwarves that oversaw its construction. Many mentions to Dun Kithas within the Grim Reaches can be seen within its pages as a pivotal, and key source for the mining achievements of the mine itself. There must be someone that may find this text valueable.>
41893.progress: What is it that you bring?
41893.completion: <Sorgan Trustgrip takes his time to inspect the tome, giving it a mighty blow which sends dust about the library haphazardly.>

41894.title: The Chromatic Servo-Motor
41894.description:
You there, looking to help an aspiring exiled downtrodden goblin regain some of his lost riches and make his way back properly into the DLU?

Well, it looks like you may have stumbled into the right place. I've been assigned to this backwater as a punishment for mucking up some of the operations on Blackstone Island...

That's the last thing I want to get into- look, I need you to pull a heist for me. Down to the southwest and across the river is the main Wildhammer town of Dun Kithas. Overlooking its eastern cliff-face is a small workshop dedicated to repairing broken steamtanks. I need you to get in, recover a 'Chromatic Servo-Motor' and bring it to me. My source says there should be one lying around somewhere.
41894.progress: What can I do for you <class>?
41894.completion:
Would you look at this baby? Chromatic powered turbo charged goodness! This thing will do wonders in getting me back on my feet.

I scrounged up what I could as a reward, it isn't much, but I hope it'll work as payment. Now, get lost, I got some tinkerin' to do.

41895.title: Forest Ichor Exchange
41895.description:
The local Forest Spiders have been seen creeping around Elwynn for what seems like an eternity. Their ichor has always fetched a pretty penny and I know someone who is looking for some. You can find them all around Goldshire itself, lurking both to the south, and to the west.

Bring me 3 Forest Ichor, and I shall reward you with a handsome price!...a handsome price.
41895.progress: Psst! You got that ichor?...that ichor?
41895.completion: Why look at this, such potent ichor! This will surely go a long way to making a few coins. Here, take this cut...this cut.

41896.title: The Shadowed Hollow
41896.description:
I be hearing of a dark and magical corruption gripping the far away lands of the Grim Reaches on the far edges of the Eastern Kingdoms. A murloc tribe going by the name 'Miregill' has been corrupted by the intense dark magic that has been rotting the land itself...

I be seeking to harness this magic, and use it as a ward to protect myself from the shadow. Travel there, and gather from the murlocs of the corrupted swamps their fins, once they are collected, bring them to me.
41896.progress: Have you returned bearing good news, or bad news?
41896.completion: Such magic, foul and intense! This be right what I was lookin' for. You've done well and traveled far. I offer you protection from the shadow, use it wisely and wander safely.

41897.title: Call to Arms: Dungeon Delving
41897.description:
The threat beyond the gates only grows bolder. Our scouts report intensified activity among the commanders of the enemy forces. We must take the fight to them.

Strike down their leaders, recover their crests, and bring them back to me. Show them that we do not falter. Show them the might of the Alliance.
41897.progress: We don't have the luxury of time. Each moment those monsters draw breath, they grow stronger. Show me you've stood against them.
41897.completion:
Excellent work. These crests are proof that you've broken their lines and shattered their resolve. We'll use this momentum to press further into their strongholds.

Take this cache and be ready. We may need you again soon.

41898.title: Twisted Relations
41898.description:
These verdant hills were once a friendly place where the Timbermaw and our allies the Blackroot conducted trade, and held great ceremonies.

Ever since the Burning Legion returned to Azeroth, our former allies have been driven into madness, and now stalk the hills and fields. They have lost themselves to madness and can no longer be reasoned with.

I must ask you to do what is necessary for our kind to continue, to cull the corruption that lingers here to keep safe the Timbermaw. Find their leader Grawlsh and slay him, as well as his twisted kin.
41898.progress: Has the corruption been rooted out?
41898.completion: It pains me to ask of such things... The Blackroot were once our friends and dearest allies. As much as it hurts to look upon familiar faces and see friends, it is good to know they are now free from the evil that gripped their hearts. You have done the Timbermaw proud, and for that, you shall be rewarded friend.

41899.title: Blackroot Totems
41899.description: I am here to give you quest, me big quest giver, me furbolg.
41899.progress: There can be no peace with the Blackroot, they have sought our destruction ever since they have turned to madness. If you wish to get into the good graces of the Timbermaw, perhaps you can fight them on our behalf. Gather ten of the totems they hold sacred, it is how I will track your deeds.
41899.completion: More of the corruption has been cleansed. Each Blackroot that is slain is another step closer to having our race be pure of the vile taint that has cursed us so gravely. The Timbermaw is thankful for your efforts.

41900.title: Sapta of Tranquility
41900.description: Our most sacred Sapta's lie in my hands, and I am the only one who knows how to make them. If you desire one of my Sapta, bring me the required materials, and it shall be yours!
41900.progress: You have proven yourself worthy of my attention, and for that, I shall grant you access to my most cherished recipes. Bring me the required materials, and I shall reward you accordingly.
41900.completion:
Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Tranquility. Able to guide ones movements with speed and grace. The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.

Your efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.

41901.title: Sapta of Communion
41901.description: Our most sacred Sapta's lie in my hands, and I am the only one who knows how to make them. If you desire one of my Sapta, bring me the required materials, and it shall be yours!
41901.progress: You have proven yourself worthy of my attention, and for that, I shall grant you access to my most cherished recipes. Bring me the required materials, and I shall reward you accordingly.
41901.completion:
Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Communion. It can empower ones resistance to the natural world in order to seek guidance. The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.

Your efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.

41902.title: Sapta of Harmony
41902.description: Our most sacred Sapta's lie in my hands, and I am the only one who knows how to make them. If you desire one of my Sapta, bring me the required materials, and it shall be yours!
41902.progress: You have proven yourself worthy of my attention, and for that, I shall grant you access to my most cherished recipes. Bring me the required materials, and I shall reward you accordingly.
41902.completion:
Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Harmony. It can empower and embolden the roots of nature itself. The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.

Your efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.

41903.title: Sapta of Kinship
41903.description: Our most sacred Sapta's lie in my hands, and I am the only one who knows how to make them. If you desire one of my Sapta, bring me the required materials, and it shall be yours!
41903.progress: You have proven yourself worthy of my attention, and for that, I shall grant you access to my most cherished recipes. Bring me the required materials, and I shall reward you accordingly.
41903.completion:
Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Kinship. It can revitalize the most broken of spirits, and raise morale. The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.

Your efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.

41904.title: Sapta of Reslilence
41904.description: Our most sacred Sapta's lie in my hands, and I am the only one who knows how to make them. If you desire one of my Sapta, bring me the required materials, and it shall be yours!
41904.progress: You have proven yourself worthy of my attention, and for that, I shall grant you access to my most cherished recipes. Bring me the required materials, and I shall reward you accordingly.
41904.completion:
Behold, the creation of my people, the great Sapta of Resilience. It can offer protection against the corruption and poison that dwells deep in the forests. The very essence of the Timbermaw Sap has been imbued with our strength and given us the boons we have in this world.

Your efforts in helping our tribe have earned you the right to our most traditional Sapta.

41905.title: Dark Iron Aggression
41905.description:
While most of the caravans already departed to Stormwind, and eventually to Alah'thalas, there are still many refugees who either wish to aid us here in the Farstrider Lodge or are still preparing for their journey.

I wish I could say the same about the Dark Iron that roam the surrounding mountain ranges. Their horrible actions during the High Elves' arrival in Loch Modan still continue to this day. Just recently they raided the last convoy on its way to Ironforge, stealing valuable supplies from those needing them most. <name>, I appeal to your good heart to return what has been stolen to their rightful owners.

The Dark Iron set up camp in the southwest, be wary of their insidious tricks. They cannot be trusted under any circumstance.
41905.progress: The Bronzebeard's hatred towards the Dark Iron is something I couldn't understand beforehand. Yet witnessing their disregard for morality and life firsthand made me realize where that disdain stems from.
41905.completion: You did it! I am relieved to see you safe and sound, as well. With these returned, the group may continue their journey to their new home once more.

41906.title: No Mercy For The Wicked
41906.description:
They are no different than the wild beasts we hunt. The Dark Iron violate the peace of my people by refusing them to find a new home after everything they endured. Not only are they ambushing our caravans to Ironforge, but just recently they began abducting innocents.

<name>, will you assist us in rescuing these poor souls? I dare not think about what the dwarves intend to do with them, given that even a child is among the captives. Will they be put into slave labour in the deep mines of the Blackrock Mountain, like the mountaineers tell us? They will not survive it, should it come to pass.

Please, ensure they have their chance on a brighter future after the horrors of Menethil's crusade. Release them from their prison, I am certain one of the Dark Iron has the key for it on him.

They've been taken to their camp in the southwest.
41906.progress: This fate was not what we promised them.
41906.completion:
<name>! You're here! As soon as I saw them return to the lodge, I knew you were successful, yet I still feared for your safety. You have my deepest gratitude. Not only did you risk your life for the innocent, but also braved dangers beyond what the usual adventurer faces.

Please, have one of these as a token of the good deeds you fulfilled this day.<name>!

41907.title: Riverhorn Village
41907.description:
You there, traveler!

I must beset you for your aid. A few weeks ago the entirety of Riverhorn Village was put to the flame and now it has been left to be pillaged, and ransacked by the fallen draenei who prowl the countryside. My fellow tribe has been scattered, and now much of the heirlooms of our people lie amongst the destruction.

If you could seek it in your heart, recover some of the heirlooms of my tribe, and bring them to me. You can find them to the north, amongst the ruins of Riverhorn Village.
41907.progress: The legacy of my people must be maintained, even if their spirits now walk with the ancestors. Our history can not be lost.
41907.completion: Ah yes, these trinkets have faired well, spared from the flame. I must thank you for all that you have done outsider. Without your help, these surely would have been destroyed. I can only offer you a paltry reward, I just hope it is enough to convey my thanks.

41908.title: Raw Draenethyst Formation
41908.progress:
Our demand for draenethyst remains high. My tribe retains much of its spirituality from Draenor, something we take great pride in. This, however, has its cost. The draenethyst needed for our ancient rituals is scarce and we can barely leave the village without taking heavy risks. It may sound selfish and unsustainable to you, but what are we without our traditions?

<name>, the creatures of the coast are drawn to the foreign crystals, not unlike us. Their power is alluring, so like moths drawn to a flame, they gravitate to this tempting energy. For every piece of draenethyst you find, I will tell my people of your deeds, you have my word. Raw Draenethyst Formation
41908.completion: Unrefined and primitive, but undoubtedly potent. <name>, your selfless actions of today will not be forgotten. The villagers will hear from this, that I will make sure. Should you find more, do not hesitate to bring them to me.

41909.title: Glowing Draenethyst Cluster
41909.progress:
Large crystal formations are strewn across the coast. Most of their power has already been drained, turning them to nothing more than a beautiful mirror glistening in the rising sun. Yet still, Draenethyst begins to form, in small, glowing clusters all throughout Moonwhisper. They are a rare sight, but all the more powerful in turn.

If by some miracle you should stumble across these formations and bring them to the village, our people would be immensly indebted to you. Glowing Draenethyst Cluster
41909.completion:
<Heghala's beady eyes widen, if not by much. His agape mouth looks almost terrifying, as he bares his two rows of teeth.>

Poresh Toralar! Blessed be the Twisting Nether! What you have brought us is breathtaking, the proper words to show our gratitude escape me. <name>, your name shall be known by every Moro'gai, from this day forward till the end of time.

41910.title: Ar'lia of the Moro'gai
41910.description:
My tribe sees me in high regard, have we not lived humble but resplendent lives up until just a few moons ago. Now the Moro'gai are sundered, torn apart, leaving us weak and isolated on this island. All the while our fallen brethren are wreaking havoc across the coast, jeapordizing the bonds we had formed with the other inhabitants of this land.

Apologies, Parash'ka. Here you stand before me, with a mission on your own, yet all that leaves my heart are laments of my own; no words of wisdom as befit for a chieftain. The hostile draenei you encountered so far are the Fallen Ones, heretic followers of my most trusted advisor - and dearest friend - Elder Bhu'robi. We've been under relentless attacks for quite a while now, their aggression increasing with each passing day. In light of our dire situation, my son Ar'lia volunteered to resolve this crisis. Speak to him and learn what he has uncovered so far. You'll find him outside on the marketplace.
41910.progress: Welcome to Moro'gai Village, how can I aid you?
41910.completion: Father sent you? How unlikely of him to relegate a foreigner to me, but truth be told he hasn't been exactly himself lately. The betrayal is deeply seated, the Elder was a well-loved figure within the tribe, second only to my father. Which is exactly what makes his actions all the more despicable.

41911.title: Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
41911.description:
We have watched the Fallen Ones' movement closely ever since they had locked us up in our village. While some roam the outskirts along Shimmerstar Lake, the majority of their forces assault us from the north. Sadly, their aggressions are not limited to us. They've begun ambushing the local Tauren and even raided one of their villages, as you may know already. This begs the question: Just what is their goal?

What we need first is information. Nar'lan, one of our hunters and close friend of mine, volunteered in infiltrating the outpost they erected, east of Riverhorn Village. Acting as a defector of our tribe, he already reported valuable details back to us. His last report spoke of him pursuing a dangerous lead, and we haven't heard of him since. In my mind I accepted the possible outcome, yet my heart yearns for it to be false. Venture to the Fallen Ones' outpost and search for Nar'lan. And if necessary, finish what he started.
41911.progress: We don't know their motives, and from what Father had told me about their reasons, something isn't adding up. If they were simply discontent with our way of living, they would not resort to such violence.
41911.completion:
How barbaric. Tooru, how could you?! He was an aspiring hunter, his heart full of noble aspirations. To Nar'lan, he was like a younger brother…

I had thought after escaping from our dying homeworld, we'd be safe from dangers, atleast for a while. How naive of me, you might say, and you may even be right. Nar'lan knew the risks he'd had to face, as he told me the night he left the village. His resolve was admirable. Today, the Moro'gai have lost a great hunter and an even greater friend.

41912.title: An Ill Omen
41912.description:
So this is the crystal you have found on Nar'lan? The item that he paid with his life for? Its surface is crude and surprisingly hot, almost scalding. Even so, there is an air of familiarity about it… Could it be that…?

<name>, I have a suspicion on what this crystal might be, but we need confirmation. Please talk to my mentor Riftmaster Ral'pekta outside the chieftain's hut. A man as knowledgeable as him can shine light upon this mystery.
41912.progress: What is it, Parash'ka? Don't waste my precious time with your infantile curiosity.
41912.completion: This is sacrilegious! What have they done to this crystal?!

41913.title: Draenei Divination
41913.description:
The mere thought of some… some creature meddling with our sacred draenethyst…! Preposterous, this act cannot go unpunished. Bhu'robi and his Fallen Ones have broken our hallowed traditions and must be held responsible for it. We will find the crystal's foul origin and rid them of this world. Through the art of divination I shall locate from whence it came, but for that I need your assistance. I require specific ingredients and you will bring them to me.

Bring me everything noted on this scroll and the truth will soon be revealed.
41913.progress: Make haste, young fool. The solution to this enigma cannot be postponed.
41913.completion: These will suffice, you have proven your usefulness even as a Parash'ka. The chieftain's trust in you is more than peculiar, yet I trust his decision nonetheless. Now then, let us uncover what dark magic was cast upon this crystal.

41914.title: Hooves and Horns, Clad in Red
41914.description:
<Ral'pekta has a stern expression on his face, a bead of sweat runs down his wrinkled olive skin.>

I have peered through the Nether and seen the root of the red crystal. As I focused on the divination, dreadful images rushed past my mind. Tall creatures with hooves and sharp claws walking a bloodred canyon, among them draenei, carrying our sacred draenethyst. These hooved fiends… Their horns and fur remind me of the demons of the Twisting Nether, horrors which have enthralled the orcs years ago on Draenor. Parash'ka, venture north, past Riverhorn Village. There, beyond the mountain range you should find what I have gazed at. Whatever you will find there will not be friendly.

Young Ar'lia was correct in sending you to me. He took the teachings of his father to heart, even if he himself can't see it. As his tutor, I know he still has much to learn. Once you have found the perpetrators of this heresy, bring proof of their demise to Ar'lia. He should await you on the marketplace.
41914.progress: You've been gone for a long time. What could Master Ral'pekta uncover?
41914.completion: The Fallen Ones were enslaved… no, they cooperated with the horned fiends you call Satyr? Unbelievable, after all that happened to our people on Draenor, how could Bhu'robi spit on our traditions like that? The elder I know would've never let the Draenethyst be defiled by foreign sorcerers. And if what is written in this letter is true… then my Father knows more than he dares to admit.

41915.title: Answers from Father
41915.description:
This new god Bhu'robi talks about in the letter… us draenei have never prayed to any god, but instead worshipped the grandeur of the Draenethyst, symbol of the lifeblood of our homeworld. To even think a draenei would devote itself to a singular entity is bewildering, to put it bluntly.

Father must've known that the Elder had forsaken his faith in the Draenethyst, he must've. <name>, we should confront him about what we have learned. Perhaps we can convince him to tell us the truth. Go ahead, I will follow shortly.
41915.progress: <The chieftain gazes into the horizon with a melancholic expression.>
41915.completion:
My son has matured a lot in these past years, it seems. Another regrettable thing I have failed to notice. He is becoming a man far sooner than I had given him credit for.

Ar’lia is right. The time of lamentation and idleness is over. We have not survived one genocide to succumb to another conducted by our own kin. Raise your arms, <name>. We will silence this false prophet.

41916.title: The Elder's End
41916.description:
The day Bhu'robi left, he and his followers ventured north. The outpost east of Riverhorn Village is still young, meaning they must have settled even further north. <class>, us Draenei are used to settling near bodies of water; even if Bhu'robi forsake our traditions, I am certain he still chose to follow that intuition. In the northern plains of this coast is a shallow lake, it is likely that you will find them there, preaching to their untrue god.

When you find their sanctuary, seek Bhu'robi and end his terror. I fear there is no way to save him anymore. Regarding his followers, please spare as many as you can. I won't ask you to not defend yourself, but they are misled by false hope. In time, they will find their way back to us, the Elders and I will make sure of that.
41916.progress: The shadow of fear that Bhu'robi has cast upon our people must stop or else he will be no different than the orcish horde of Draenor.
41916.completion: I feel an aura of solemnity coming from you. Has it been done? Has this mistake of mine been corrected at last? <class>, you have done a great deed for our people. Not only did you save us from damnation, but also showed us that the path we treaded for centuries is one the Moro'gai shouldn't follow any longer. In a way, Bhu'robi was right, the Draenei need to adapt, to ensure a new future for our people. One free of fear and instead filled with perseverance. If only he hadn't twisted the meaning of his own belief.

41917.title: A Student's Determination
41917.description:
<name> was your name? You earned a place among the Moro'gai. With your aid, we were able to avert a grim fate for our people and have been given the opportunity to once more carve a path for a brighter future. Your arrival must've been preordained by the winds of the Twisting Nether, and for that I am grateful. Thanks to you, my son got the courage to confront me, so that I was able to escape my melancholy. He has grown past the little boy I had known him for.

Ar'lia is waiting at the marketplace, as usual. He will appreciate you telling him what happened. Go with my blessing, <name>. Enkil Toralar - may the winds of the Twisting Nether be in your favor.
41917.completion:
Bhu'robi might've been stopped, but this ordeal is far from over. Like Father said, there are still many of the Fallon Ones out there that are now lost and it is our duty to bring them back into our fold. It is a grueling task and I fear this will not be the last day we lose loved ones, but that is exactly why we have to do everything we can to prevent that from happening. While I am yet inexperienced and in training still, I will support my father and the elders as much as possible.

I have thought long about it, and while I still have much to accomplish here, your actions have instilled a fire in me that I haven't felt before. For all this time we have secluded ourselves at this coast, we held ourselves back and remained hidden as best we could. But this is not how I wish my life to go. But until I have ensured the security of the village, I cannot leave. So please take this crystal. Should you be in peril, hold it to the sky and I will aid you in battle. You can count on me, <name>.

41918.title: Silken Song
41918.description:
A foreigner? Excuse me, this must sound quite ironic to you, does it not? Is it not me who is alien to your world after all. Nevertheless, am I correct in assuming you are of the travelling sort? That might be most opportune for me. My name is Hara'ne of the Moro'gai. My people settled not far from here on the islands in Shimmerstar Lake. As we speak, renegade members of our own tribe are laying siege to our village, causing many of my kin to suffer grievous injuries. While under blockade, we lack many of the bare necessities, which is why I traveled here. The moths inside Moonsilk Hollow produce powerful silk full of potent energy, with which we can accelerate the healing of our wounded friends.

Would you be willing to aid me in my cause? Then collect enough spools of silk from the moths and deliver them to Elder Sage Azh'okar , he will know how to proceed with them.
41918.progress: Hara'ne has been gone for far too long. Just what is this reckless woman doing?
41918.completion:
Ah, the silk I've been desperately waiting for. Now that they are in my possession, I can weave them together with these bandages and infuse them with a speck of arcane magic. Our defenders will recover much more quickly now. Has Hara'ne tasked you in retrieving this in her stead? That sly vixen. Don't get me wrong, she is not unreliable, but more so… resourceful. An unusual free spirit among us draenei, her wits and ingenuity are always refreshing and even more surprising at times. I was glad it was her who volunteered to gather the silk for our wounded.

Should you ever return to the southern woods, please stop by her camp. I'd rest more easily knowing someone would check for her well-being from time to time.

41919.title: More Silk for the Wounded
41919.description: What a pleasure to see you again. I take it you have brought Elder the silken spools? Splendid! This may be a good start, but I'm afraid what we gathered so far won't be sufficient for long. To ensure the continued safety of our people, it is necessary for us to create a steady flow of materials for the elder to process. If you could be so kind and gather further silken spools from the moths in Moonsilk Hollow? The Moro'gai will be in your debt, that much is certain.
41919.progress: You again? What brings you to me?
41919.completion: Hara'ne is a thorough worker. When we still lived on Draenor, she brought all sorts of curious animals and plants to the village, many from which we developed either tasty meals, powerful cures or spiritual incense. I wouldn't be surprised if she used you as an excuse to explore the woods of this new and strange world and satiate her own curiosity. Please try not to feel disheartened by it.

41920.title: Fallen One Cargo
41920.description:
One tragedy after another! First I had to take a detour due to these wretched Fallen Ones roaming around the woods, and now my cart broke down, leaving me little choice but to repair it here, out in the open. Not to mention the important cargo I had stashed on the cart being lost in the forest to the east.

A strong adventurer like you could just be the person to help me out of my misery. Please venture east and locate the crate that fell off my cart when I escaped the Fallen Ones. They are brigands, ruthless draenei that abandoned our tribe and I don't doubt they will attack you as well. If we're unfortunate, then they have seized it already. Should you find it, deliver it to P'li in our village at Shimmerstar Lake to the north. Tell him Maghan sent you and that I will return soon.
41920.progress: Greetings, Parash'ka. You look tired from your journeys. This coast is far out in the wilderness, barely do we get visitors besides our local tauren neighbours.
41920.completion:
Is that Maghan's cargo? How relieved I am to know he is safe and sound. I hadn't heard from him in hours and grew concerned about his health and safety. It is shameful to say, but the tribe is not united anymore, and many of our deserted kin have begun acting violently. While we have to protect our lives, they are still old friends and loved ones we had survived the exodus of Draenor with. This whole disaster is just too much to bear and I wish for it to end as soon as possible.

Excuse me, that was uncalled for. Thank you for helping Maghan; and please, make yourself at home.

41921.title: A Familiar Disturbance
41921.description:
Now that I regained my strength, my senses are sharp once more, and I can feel the magic of your world far better than before. What I felt, however, was surprising, a sensation that had an aura of familiarity to it. It came from the north, a whirlwind of conflicting energy. Ideals clashing, emotions uncertain and a great change abound. You may have seen it already, beyond the cliffs to the north is a land clad in blue, its cerulean hue draping the coast in serene midnight. In my mind I have the image of a great shimmering lake, there I had felt the sensation the strongest.

<name>, once we have secured the safety of my people, would you travel to the lands north of here and search for this peculiarity I sensed? My heart tells me it is of great importance.
41921.completion: What are you saying? You have been sent here by another draenei, a riftwalker no less?!

41922.title: Homecoming
41922.description:
I could have never imagined it. For so long we have lived with the thought of us being the only draenei to have survived the breaking of our homeworld. To think that another tribe has managed to escape to your world as well…

<class>, we must get in contact with them. You may be a stranger to the Moro'gai, but you are acquainted with another draenei tribe, so I place my trust in you. Take this crystal and bring it to their chieftain. It is a projection crystal in which I have stored my image into. Tell them that, and they will know how to proceed.
41922.progress: <name>, it is good to see you again in the Harborage. How can I assist you?
41922.completion: A projection crystal... from another draenei?! Please, hand it to me quickly!

41923.title: Stone of Dreams, Ashenvale
41923.progress: <The stone resonates with the idol in your possession. It yearns to be attuned to it, but cannot do so on its own. The closer you come to the mosscovered stone, the clearer are the words that it tries to imprint into your mind: LETHON. Perhaps some dream energy can offer the necessary potency needed.> Wail of YseraBright Dream Shard(10)
41923.completion: <A soothing hum emanates from the stone and idol, now synchronized. From high up the ramp, the Dream Portal sends out a wave of energy, followed by a dragon’s roar. Whatever you called has now arrived…>

41924.title: Stone of Dreams, Feralas
41924.progress: <The stone resonates with the idol in your possession. It yearns to be attuned to it, but cannot do so on its own. The closer you come to the mosscovered stone, the clearer are the words that it tries to imprint into your mind: YSONDRE. Perhaps some dream energy can offer the necessary potency needed.> Wail of YseraBright Dream Shard(10)
41924.completion: <A soothing hum emanates from the stone and idol, now synchronized. From high up the ramp, the Dream Portal sends out a wave of energy, followed by a dragon’s roar. Whatever you called has now arrived…>

41925.title: Stone of Dreams, Duskwood
41925.progress: <The stone resonates with the idol in your possession. It yearns to be attuned to it, but cannot do so on its own. The closer you come to the mosscovered stone, the clearer are the words that it tries to imprint into your mind: TAERAR. Perhaps some dream energy can offer the necessary potency needed.> Wail of YseraBright Dream Shard(10)
41925.completion: <A soothing hum emanates from the stone and idol, now synchronized. From high up the ramp, the Dream Portal sends out a wave of energy, followed by a dragon’s roar. Whatever you called has now arrived…>

41926.title: Stone of Dreams, Hinterlands
41926.progress: <The stone resonates with the idol in your possession. It yearns to be attuned to it, but cannot do so on its own. The closer you come to the mosscovered stone, the clearer are the words that it tries to imprint into your mind: EMERISS. Perhaps some dream energy can offer the necessary potency needed.> Wail of YseraBright Dream Shard(10)
41926.completion: <A soothing hum emanates from the stone and idol, now synchronized. From high up the ramp, the Dream Portal sends out a wave of energy, followed by a dragon’s roar. Whatever you called has now arrived…>

41927.title: Lord Blackwald II’s Riding Whistle
41927.description: <In your hands is the riding whistle of Lord Blackwald II, leader of Medivh’s relic hunters. The darkness coming from the object is still strong and potent, and you don’t see a way to dispel it. Maybe the ghostly residents of Morgan’s Plot can assist you.>
41927.progress: A riding whistle from Lord Blackwald? So their tyranny has ended. The Dark Riders were once merchants, cursed by Medivh to hunt relics for him till time’s end. It relieves me to see their leader to have been struck down; however, we cannot be sure there are not more of them out in the world, terrorizing the innocent. For now, I can break apart this whistle, but I require additional help for that. Bring me the essences from the undead of this world, and I may be able to crush this foul thing.
41927.completion: I see you have returned. It is time for this chapter of Karazhan to be closed. The Dark Riders haven taken enough lives during their horrid reign; this will now end. With the whistle destroyed, none may take Lord Blackwald’s place as their next, ultimately dispersing their presence into the winds. Be prepared, <name>, I do not know what may happen once I shatter this effigy of malice.

41928.title: Crypt Lord’s Beckoning
41928.description: <The Crypt Lord lies dead to your feet. The fiend from the icy depths of Northrend will no longer spread terror among the living. What you hold in your hands, however, does not bode well to your experienced adventurer senses. The stone tablet is freezing to the touch and hushed whispers can be heard from within. Alone you are unable to shatter it and diffuse its evil aura. A mighty wielder of the Light may help you in your time of need.>
41928.progress:
By the Light! What is that decrepit miasma coming from you? <class>, whatever you have on you, hand it over, quickly!

<The tablet is given to Tirion, who promptly casts a holy spell on the cobweb-ridden surface.>

It is as I feared, the protective curse upon this tablet is too strong to be broken. We need to consecrate it with holy might. For that, sacred crosses from the fanatical Scarlet Crusade should be sufficient. These holy relics are not suitable for their sullied hands regardless. <name>, deliver them to me as soon as possible!
41928.completion:
The crosses, you have them! Their holy radiance can be felt even from here. <class>, it is imperative for us to cleanse this tablet. You may not know it, but these are used by the vile Crypt Lords of the Scourge to command their Nerubian hordes under a tantalizing spell, enhancing their abilities. It must be rid of this world, immediately. Regardless, stay alert. I am certain they will retaliate, as we are destroying one of their precious relics.

Brace yourselves!

41929.title: Bursting Mana Shard
41929.description: <The piece of obsidian you hold in your hand is hot to the touch. Light violet strands of energy exude from the cracks where it broke from the creature lying in front of you. This crystal is bursting at the seams with potent arcane power. The endless possibilities of what you could achieve with this item rush through your mind, before a faint whispering voice enters your mind. Unintelligible at first, its volume increases the closer you hold it to your head. Now able to recognize the voice it repeats one word over and over again: Desolace.>
41929.progress: <The book you find on the altar has numerous rituals and incantations. One of them, presumably the spell the cultists were currently practicing, speaks of a summoning - the summoning of a dark entity from beyond the Twisting Nether. What is needed is a conduit of great magical properties, as well as some implements. Your thoughts race back to the mana shard. Perhaps this is its true purpose?>
41929.completion: <You lay everything atop the altar and recite the spell from the grimoire. With each passing word, the air grows heavier and lightning strikes the sky. The mana shard breaks, releasing a strong shockwave. Moments later, a rift opens above it and - out of its boundaries - a terrifying nether creature emerges!>

41930.title: Proof of Conviction
41930.description:
You stand before Narkogg the Dark, speaker of the remaining Timbermaw of Ursolan. My brethren and I are splintered and on the brink of extinction. Darkness has befallen Timbermaw Hold and we are powerless in front of the wave of corruption seeping out of its gates. If we ever wish to rid it off its muck, then allies are what we desperately need. Will you and your kind be the ones to aid us in our endeavour? For that I need proof.

Enter the tunnels of our old home and break through the gateway. Slay Karrsh the Sentinel; once a proud defender, now a maddened savage seeking nothing but blood. His rampage needs to be stopped.
41930.progress: It may not have been long since we escaped Timbermaw Hold, but the horrors inside evolve with rapid speed. Who knows what abhorrent creatures you will face inside?
41930.completion: You have returned, with Karrsh’s pendant. His death is regrettable and saddens me deeply. To see a beacon of resilience and strength rot away in such a short amount of time is terrible. Thank you for releasing him of his pain.

41931.title: The Corruption of Timbermaw Hold
41931.description:
Our vigil over the Wilds was always ancient, but ever since the second invasion of the Burning Legion, a foul sickness has been germinating within our most hallowed sanctum. Our tribesmen succumbed to the vile influence, one after another. Now only we remain and it falls to us to liberate Timbermaw Hold from the clutches of evil. Before we can cleanse our home for good, we first need to understand what we are dealing with. Studying it inside the caverns is far too dangerous, so we need a substitute instead.

Return to Timbermaw Hold and gather the totems of the misguided shaman, with them we can find a way to battle the ailment plaguing my people.
41931.progress: Unforeseen strength gathered within the Withermaw; their newfound power being too much for their bodies, causing them to tear apart.
41931.completion: These totems are worse than I expected. The fumes they release are unbearable and simply touching them leaves burning marks upon my paws. I will have to seal them away before we can deal with them properly.

41932.title: Ancient Furbolg Remedies
41932.description:
Over the millennia that we have lived on Kalimdor, my people developed countless concoctions and salves for medicinal and spiritual healing. However, to cleanse these wicked totems, a wholly new mixture has to be created.

In the lands blessed by the wilds, the place your kind calls Un’goro Crater, a beast by the name of Nemasra, laden with natural energies and powerful dew, resides. Rumor has it the river’s end in the northwest is its home. Bring me its dewladen heart.

On the southern shores of the Isle of Dread in Feralas you will find a primordial being, a sea giant from olden times. He held watch over the tides of the Veiled Sea, but has reached a point where his mind can’t discern between friend or foe anymore. Lay him to rest and deliver me his tongue.

The Vials of Purification lay with Tidelord Rrurgaz. Once a relic of the night elves on ancient Kalimdor, it fell into the hands of the Shahraz naga who scheme on Alcaz Island, northeast of the shores of Dustwallow Marsh.
41932.progress: My seal will not hold for long, <name>. Please hasten your efforts.
41932.completion: I am in awe at the power of these items. With the beast’s heart, we will break the foul barrier around the totems. Grammon’s tongue will let them speak true and the waters of purification will wash away all impurities.

41933.title: Unbridled Darkness
41933.description:
It seems I underestimated the Withermaw. Whatever has taken hold in these totems is not only of demonic origin. I fear what we have is not enough to break the curse put on them.

<name>, if we want to succeed, we need to venture into Timbermaw Hold once more. Deep within Timbermaw Village, the Grotto of Dreams lies. Formerly used by our spiritualists for communion with the Emerald Dream, it now houses a sinister miasma. When we fled our old home, I abandonded my medicine pouch there. I need the implement found within to conjure a more fitting spell. Furthermore, a sample of the defilement found within Timbermaw Hold. Mixed into the salve, it will act as an antidote to the malediction inside the totems, if you will. Certainly you will find such a sample inside the many crevices found along the waterways inside.
41933.progress: Timbermaw Village will be heavily guarded. Be best prepared, for the Withermaw have abandoned all morality.
41933.completion:
What a hideous creation. Further proof that the life inside our great sanctum is rotting by the minute. Yet still, it serves a purpose. It shall pave the way for the Timbermaw to reclaim what has been torn from us by cruel malefactors. Now I can concoct a salve powerful enough to cleanse our sacred totems.

<name>, this humble coven expresses its gratitude towards you. Through your courage, we have made the first step in purifying Timbermaw Hold. Take this essence and use it on your delves into this den of evil. With enough of it, you may break the barrier inside and finally come to the root of it all.

41934.title: What Remains
41934.description:
<name>, your loyalty and determination to our cause knows no bounds. With remarkable bravery have you faced the twisted Withermaw and stopped their machinations. The strength and willpower you and your allies displayed is exactly why it is you that I will ask of the impossible.

As I explained to you before, Timbermaw Hold is a sacred site for all Furbolgs. It is where we venerate the remains of the Wild God Ursol, which we have guarded for millenia since his fall at the hands of the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancient. I was not present at his resting place when the Withermaw took over, yet I fear the body of the ancient guardian fell victim to the corruption.

Courageous ally of ours, please return to Timbermaw Hold and see what has become of our great god. Should the foulness have taken control of his carcass, then… Gather your might and let him return to the Emerald Dream once more.
41934.progress: <Narkogg is stuck in a praying position. Through the rough whispers of his maw you can deduce him singing a ritualistic song.>
41934.completion:
In our ancient teachings, there is a legend that connects all furbolg tribes. It speaks of our creation, as it is said the twin gods have brought us into the world as it was still young. As juvenile cubs they frolicked through the untouched wilds of Kalimdor, rolling around in the dewladen grass of the early mornings. Laughter filled the air and their unbound energy floated all around them. Bursting with their power, the droplets of the wet grass fell onto the roots of gigantic trees, seeping through the bark and becoming one with the land. Over time, these droplets grew and took the semblance of the young ursine gods.

To us furbolgs there is nothing more important than aiding our progenitors in protecting the wild. Seeing Ursol die for a second time fills my heart with anguish and pain, a being as noble as him did not deserve this fate. <name>, the Timbermaw are forever in your debt. Please take this powerful salve and cleanse the remaining corruption in Timbermaw Hold.

41935.title: Rite of Resurrection
41935.description:
The tablet you find emanates with ancient power. Drenched in an imposing aura, you surmise it must be a relic from bygone times that somehow found its way into the clutches of Majordomo Executus. Reading its contents, runes and markings can be found describing a powerful resurrection spell for ageless beings. All that is needed is the recital of its lines and the essence of whatever being you wish to anchor once more into the mortal world.

Still driven by the thrill of adventure and pillaging, you wonder if you could use this artifact for your own personal gains…
41935.progress:
What is it, mortal? What desire drives you to pester me in my ghostly state, peacefully roaming these lands? Spare it, I know the answer already; riches and baubles are the fool’s only errand. You are too late then, I can and will not assist you in your absurd quest for treasure. How is a ghost supposed to do that, idiot?

<You tell the dragon spirit about the relic you possess.>

Oh, a relic of resurrection, you say? Perhaps you aren’t such a simpleton after all. Listen carefully, mortal! I won’t repeat myself twice. I am offering you a deal: Resurrect me with that artifact and the riches you so desperately seek shall be yours. Gather the essence of my lesser brethren, the greater good demands their noble sacrifice. It may be grand, but it is a sacrifice I am willing to make. Only then will you be able to invoke the scroll’s latent power.
41935.completion:
<With the essences at hand, you read the runes out aloud. Benevolent rays of warmth encompass the spirit of Azuregos, before his corporeal body begins manifesting on the leaf laced ground. After finishing the incantation, the mighty dragon bellows a mighty roar.>

What a gullible fool you are. Did you really expect me to hand a mere mortal the powerful treasures of my flight? Ridiculous! My treasures are mine and mine alone. As reward for your naivete, let me demonstrate how hospitable the Blue Dragonflight can be!

41936.title: Twisting Rift Crystal
41936.description: The crystal humms in an ominous rhythm. Peering through its flawless surface, it's as if a vortex of swirling energies reside inside the gemstone. Icecold to the touch and surprisingly heavy, you can feel a dark and terrifying power beckoning from beyond wherever this endless void is leading. Enthralled and shocked at the same time, you decide to bring it to a powerful warlock who might be able to help you with it.
41936.progress:
What brings you here, <race>? I see… The aura you exude paints a clear picture. You possess something extraordinary, do you not?

<You present the crystal with Daio. His eyes widen at the sight of it.>

By the Great Beyond! Never have I laid my eyes upon such an immaculate rift crystal before. <name>, can you even fathom what you are holding in the palm of your hand? With a rift crystal of such magnitude, who knows what powerful demon I could summon… <class>, listen closely, the blood of mighty demons is drenched in nether energy. Bring me ten vials of their blood. The strongest fiends roaming the Tainted Scar, the Darkwhisper Gorge and the mountaintops of Hyjal are ladden with such energies. With it, we may open a rift powerful enough to lure in a demon beaming with power for the taking!
41936.completion: This fragrance… Pure, unadulterated energy lies within these vials. Whatever will be brought into this world through the crystal's rift will be, without a doubt, a demon of insurmountable power. <name>, ready your allies and yourself; this will not be an easy task. Brace yourself!

41937.title: Nightmare’s End
41937.description:
The demigod Ursol has been slain, the pendant in your hand acting as proof of your and your allies’ deed. Curious enough, there seems to be no trace of the Nightmare’s influence on the pristine jade stone you’ve found on the wild god’s body.

Losing yourself in the stone’s hum, you see a bear’s silhouette in the woods of the tranquil Moonglade before you.
41937.progress: <The great spirit looks at you with a venerable gaze.>
41937.completion:
<Presenting the honorable spirit with the pendant, a shiver of awe travels down your spine. Silence falls over Moonglade and your surroundings dim as your focus on the ursine figure before you grows stronger. In that moment, a familiar voice rings inside your head:

Thank you for saving my brother. The elders of the wild offer you this in return.

At the paws of the great spirit lay trinkets, presumingly the reward for releasing Ursol from his pain. Choose wisely.>

41938.title: Windtorn Crest Stone
41938.description: The stone has writings on its surface that you cannot decipher. Perhaps someone from the Earthen Ring proficient in this language can assist you.
41938.progress: What can I help you with?
41938.completion: This writing is in Kalimag, the language of the elements. Not many know of this language, let alone speak or read it. It is good you came to me, as I can indeed read a few words on it.

41939.title: Vortalus’ Edict
41939.description:
Apologies, I said I could read a few passages, but even then it is fairly cryptic. It speaks of an order, the order to attack the meddling mortals. You found this on one of the invading air elementals? Greka told me about what had happened while most of our members were gone. It appears this was no mere coincidence, but a coordinated attack utilizing a moment of weakness in our defenses. Further down, it states the following:

”I will wait for your return in the windswept canyon of the countless spires. Our horned allies expect nothing but success.”

<name>, this paints a grim picture. There are more forces at hand plotting against the Earthen Ring and I fear I might as well know who these “horned allies” are. Deep in the Thousand Needles, there is Windhorn Canyon, an ancient stone fortress that gave many tauren tribes shelter in the past. Right now, it is occupied by the Blackwind tribe, and most likely their elemental conspirators. We must stop their alliance at once.
41939.progress: Our Far Seers and speakers are concerned about the elemental unrest boiling all around us. Even the trainees and initiates feel that uneasiness. All the more reason to get to the bottom of this.
41939.completion:
Vortalus, you say? Worrisome to see elementals making a pact in such large numbers with the mortal races. Especially after what had happened here, at the Earthen Ring. This begs another question, however. What do the elements expect of such a coalition? Were they servants of the Blackwind tribe or was it the other way around? If the wind lords are bringing other forces under their fold, then they must be preparing for something greater.

<name>, thank you for your courage. You’ve done something incredible today and shown your potential as an aspiring shaman of our order. The others are surely expecting more great things from you.

41940.title: Elemental Cores
41940.description:
May the spirits be with you, friend. I am Grakk Windtamer, a member of the Earthen Ring. It is our duty to ensure the elemental balance of our world is not disturbed. For that, us shamans of the Earthen Ring go on pilgrimages all across Azeroth to assess said balance. The spirits have led me to the plains of the Arathi Highlands, a land ripe with ancient history of the humans, but also full of primal elemental magic. Turmoil brews beneath the surface and the guardians of the binding circles are restless. In their vigilant guard over this prison, they have lost sight of their true nature - and ravage the sacred sites of the highlands.

<class>, aid me in returning them to their tranquility. Break their physical form and bring me their intact cores, so that I may soothe the raging torrents within them.
41940.progress: The brute force of the elements can be overwhelming. Stay concentrated and focused on your spirit within, then you'll have nothing to fear.
41940.completion: Great work, young one. My intuition proved correct - these cores harbor sinister energy within, bubbling and brewing with anger. With their essence still bound to the core, I can calm their minds and release them from their pain. They will return to their elemental planes and, given time, awaken once more in Azeroth. With a renewed purpose and cleansed spirit. Take one of these gifts as compensation for your selfless act to nature. Please, don’t hesitate.

41941.title: Duality of Flame
41941.description:
Nature is chaotic, <name>. It follows no rules, no set path, no certain future. Within that chaos, life springs forth, nurtured by the elements. With earth as its sustenance, air as its breath and water as its direction, fire is both its upbringing and downfall. A blaze can be comforting, inviting, even smothering in its gentle embrace of warmth. On the other hand, the boundless flame is relentless, searching endlessly for more and more life to consume into it.

The element of fire is heavily woven into the cycle of life and death, the rebirth of the old is only possible through the destructive force and nurturing kindling a flare retains. In the crater of Un'goro, deep in southern Kalimdor, such a union can be witnessed at Fire Plume Ridge. The volcano rages and destroys, while the soil finds newfound strength in everything burned. Gather samples of this volcanic soil and bring them to Rimblat Earthshatter in the Eastern Plaguelands. He will know what to do with them.
41941.progress: Greetings, brave traveler. What brings you to these ailed lands?
41941.completion: The fragrance of life courses through this earth. With it, an abundance of life can be fostered, perhaps even restore what was thought of to be lost forever. Bewali did well in tasking you with recovering this soil.

41942.title: The Plaguewood
41942.description:
While many pilgrims returned to the Earthen Ring not long ago, I remained here. To further my research into the Plague of Undeath. Far Seer Earthfury once saw potential for a cure in our Forsaken allies, so I have made it my mission to assist him in ridding them of their rotting curse. Rayne and I already made great strides in healing the dead earth of these lands. She is a remarkable ally, and we are certain we can achieve a breakthrough in our endeavour - in many parts thanks to the soil you brought.

Before we continue, however, we are in need of two key components. First, spore samples of the mushrooms growing in the Plaguewood. I am certain the undead roaming the ruins carry these on their bones. Furthermore, the sapling of a twisted tree, found in Zul'mashar. The troll city is nestled in the northern mountains. But beware, the resident trolls have also succumbed to the Plague of Undeath. Please, stay cautious out there.
41942.progress: Once we have the missing items, Rayne and I will have all we need to conduct our research on a more practical level.
41942.completion:
Although there is no life left within these bones, the spores keep trying to search for nutrients, like a writhing parasite searching for prey. This is not a natural occurrence, yet it is not purely magical either. At this point it is a wholly new amalgamation of forces, and it won’t be easy to eradicate it.

The plan we have come up with is simple in concept. We will plant this tree sapling in the enriched earth you have brought us. Afterwards, we will apply the spores to the tree and observe what will happen. In our previous observations with saplings planted in plagued earth, they withered away in minutes, leaving a mutated husk behind. We assume the elementally enriched earth will protect the tree against the aggressors and allow it to grow freely. It will take a while, so if you ever come by again, maybe you are lucky enough to witness it.

Either way, I must give my thanks to you, and Bewali as well. Every step taken brings us closer to healing these lands for good.

41943.title: Foul Waters
41943.description:
Not far from here, in the crag desert of Desolace lie the halls of Maraudon. It is said to be the birthplace of the baneful Centaur, a hallowed place for their people and ancestors. These halls have been defiled, twisted into a noxious lair of disease and putridity. Rotting the earth and befouling the water, this sickness has taken deep roots in the cavern system underneath and caused a tremendous amount of pain to the spirits and nature.

<name>, I want you to enter Maraudon and destroy the corruption’s amalgamation, named Noxxion. Once it has been dealt with, vanquish the source of the misery, the baleful satyr Lord Vyletongue. As long as his reign is undeterred, balance cannot return to the elements inside Maraudon.
41943.progress: The Satyrs are a plague upon Azeroth. Their machinations for their dark lords have disrupted the balance numerous times.
41943.completion:
The elements have spoken of your return, <name>. It will take time before the waters are pure again. But with no further corruption being funneled into Maraudon anymore, nature can do so in serenity and peace.

Take this for your deeds in restoring balance to Azeroth.

41944.title: The Long Hunt
41944.description:
We are isolated on this island, the Fallen Ones lurking in the thicket of the woods, ready to strike at our unsuspecting hunters. Only the veteran hunters were successful in securing game, while the less experienced returned with griveous wounds. Still, it is not enough. The people starve, as we cannot survive from the little fruit and fish we have.

If you have a good heart and wish to help us, our cook Rem'sai would appreciate new supplies of meat from the animals of this coast. You can find him in his hut near the market place.
41944.progress: Denphar struggles with his farm and F'eesh couldn't reel in a fish for two days now! If this continues, we won’t be able to defend ourselves anymore...
41944.completion: Meat! And heaps of it, too! Parash’ka, who set you up for this? Or did you do it on your own volition? Either way, it hardly matters to me. With a supply like this, our defenders will have the strength to repel those heretics for days to come! A reward is needed for your actions. Here, a traditional draeneic recipe, altered to fit the cuisine of this new world.

41945.title: Respect the Elderly
41945.description:
All this riffraff! To think an imbecile like Bhu’robi is the cause for all this chaos. He was always a nuisance, radical ideas and delusional aspirations walked hand in hand with this fool of a man! You would assume our chieftain would have realized this sooner, but he got blinded by his feelings of compassion to his ‘old friend’. Pah, to the nether with it I say. Bhu’robi is no longer a Draenei in my eyes, let alone a Moro’gai.

Parash’ka! You made me ramble on about this again! Now my blood is boiling and my head is ready to burst. I will have you remedy this, scoundrel! Go to the Lunarclaw Den east of the village and bring me some brains of the featherfolk around there. I want only the gooiest you can find!
41945.progress: What are you gawking at me like that? Move!
41945.completion:
Hm, I am surprised. You listened well and brought exemplary brains. The way their juices are dripping on the floor…

<Fena Ma’dar is salivating at the sight of the grey matter inside your hands. With a swift movement, she snatches them out of your hand and starts chomping on them. Liquid, blood and bits fall to the floor.>

I can’t get enough of this savoury taste, the slick surface, the gooey texture! It is simply wonderful! You remedied your mistake, young one. Atleast you are responsible when it comes to consequences caused by your actions. Either way, don’t cause any more ruckus around here!

41946.title: Farm Raiders
41946.description: Everything is broken! Everything is trampled! These treacherous Fallen Ones keep pillaging the only farm we have, and I am all alone out here. Barely could I escape with my life during the last raid, but with the injury to my leg, I doubt I will be that lucky again. Parash’ka, I fear they might come back again soon and without help, my farm and I will perish at their hands! Please, help me!
41946.completion: That was a close one. Let us hope this will teach them to not come here again. I thank you endlessly for saving my life and my dear farm. You see, the earth on this coast has unique properties that make it difficult to grow crops. On top of it, the flora of your world is still difficult for me to fully grasp, even after all the time we have been here. Still, I want to reward you for your good deed. Take it, they are homegrown!

41947.title: Wanted: Tama’an the Ruthless
41947.description:
Wanted: Tama’an the Ruthless

A bounty has been set on Tama’an, a vile brute of the Fallen Ones that slaughtered many of his own kin without mercy. He was last seen pillaging a well of the Tauren people in the fields to the northwest. End his terror and bring his necklace to Chief Defender Hamaam as proof.
41947.progress: I have to coordinate the defenders, so be quick about your business.
41947.completion: So the wretch has met its end? Excellent. Twenty three of our people did this monster maul during his last rampage. With him gone, we can rest a bit more easily now.

41948.title: Wanted: Growlpaw
41948.description:
Wanted: Growlpaw

A bounty has been set on Growlpaw, one of the bearfolk to the south. Growlpaw has been coordinating attacks on our supply carts and terrorizing the roads south of the village. Maghan has seen him transporting the loot to their village in the far south. Recover the wares and deliver his paw as proof of his demise to Chief Defender Hamaam.
41948.completion: Ah, the nuisance of the south has been dealt with. These bearfolk elude me. Not long ago, they kept to themselves, barely engaging with the village, until they started acting violent and aggressive. It happened roughly around the same time that traitor Bhu’robi left the village. I hope there is no connection between the two…

41949.title: Horns of their Allies
41949.description: Moro’gai K’la informed me of the developments concerning the fiendish Fallen Ones. Revolting to think they’d ally themselves with these demon-looking beasts against their own kind! Parash’ka, the time for retribution has come. My chieftain may have found his original vigor, but he is still all too forgiving. Fortunately for him and the tribe, I am the cruel hand that he needs. Seek out the demonic Foulheart hiding in these lands and bring me their horns as proof. The Moro’gai will instill fear in their rotten hearts, for their death will be painful.
41949.progress: I want their blood to paint this coast dark red.
41949.completion: Excellent display, Parash’ka. You are a true ally to the draenei, the real draenei. Don’t celebrate too soon, however. There is still much to be done.

41950.title: Parcel to Nowhere
41950.description: The crate you’ve found on the satyr is heavy and resonates with a droning noise. Opening the lid exposes numerous of the dark red crystals you’ve seen around the grotto, tainted draenethyst shards filled with an unsettling energy. Riftmaster Ral’pekta should see this.
41950.progress: You are back, did you find something in that red canyon?
41950.completion: More of those despicable crystals. I feel such anger inside me laying eyes upon this defilement of our sacred draenethyst. Tainted, broken and sullied. Whatever they’ve done with it is unforgivable!

41951.title: Merchant’s Knowledge
41951.description:
Excuse my outburst. I’ve tended to the crystals throughout all of my five hundred and twenty-seven years, my connection to them is deeper than most draenei out there. Nevertheless, there is a most peculiar thing about these crystals. They are packed inside a crate, a situation that appears strange given the fact the tained draenethyst was all around the demonic fiends inside that canyon. Which leads me to believe that these crystals were destined to be delivered somewhere.

Here, take the crate and talk to Maghan, our resident merchant. I am sure he will know more about the crate. He traveled south of the village, just follow along the road and I am sure you will find him eventually.
41951.progress: It is not safe out here. If you’re not familiar with these woods, I suggest you seek shelter at our village to the north.
41951.completion: It is true that I know a bit more about these crates, but it has been quite some time since I last saw them in person.

41952.title: Out of the Moonlight
41952.description: The crates belong to the bearfolk just across the road, the way the wood of the crate is bent is typical for them. When we were still actively trading I inspected the crates regularly, so I am sure it has to be theirs. Trade between us may have stopped now, but there is still activity coming from their fortifications over there. Whenever I traverse these roads, I sometimes get a glimpse of a burly bearfolk going further south and towards that cave up the hill. If you want to get to the bottom of this, your best chance would be to see what they’re carrying.
41952.progress: If there are more than two parties involved in Bhu’robi’s scheme, then what does that tell us about his allegiances - and moreover, his aspirations?
41952.completion: So it was the bearfolk who were acting as laymen between the hoofed fiends and the Fallen Ones. You are saying they tried delivering the crystals to the large cave up the hills towards the auburn cliffs? I have heard the network of tunnels beneath the mountain is their sacred hideout. A foreboding prospect.

41953.title: Draenethyst Recovery
41953.description:
Whatever the bearfolk intend on accomplishing with the tainted draenethyst, we cannot let it happen. It shall not be misused for nefarious reasons, and as Draenei, it is our duty to ensure it stays that way.

<name>, we need your aid once more. Gather brave allies and storm the bearfolk’s sanctuary. Beware: It is very likely for them to conduct sinister rituals with our crystals, from which they mayhaps acquired unforeseen strength. Once you have found the whereabouts of the defiled crystals, punish the perpetrators and return with the remaining draenethyst back to the village. I will prepare a method to cleanse them of their impurities.
41953.progress: We know little about the bearfolk, they kept to themselves most of the time. For what reason we can only speculate. Was it always their goal to conspire against the Moro’gai? Is the Draenethyst’s power really all they are after?
41953.completion:
The horned fiend; this satyr Selenaxx, you say? He absorbed the energy from the geode and infused his body with it, becoming one with the draenethyst?! To witness such blasphemy even in this new world. <class>, the power of draenethyst is deeply alluring and requires immense willpower to not succumb to once tapped into its pulsing energy. There are… stories of Draenei falling victim to their draenethyst addiction and eventually crystalizing, ultimately becoming draenethyst themselves. Thus they return to Draenor and enter the cycle of its lifeblood.

For now, I will have to prepare the cleansing ritual for the geode shards you brought. It will take time and effort, but I and moreover the Moro’gai are deeply indebted to you. Your continued support to our tribe’s survival shall not go unrewarded. Please choose one of these bracelets, so that they may protect you against the evils yet to come.

41954.title: Skills of an Unknown World
41954.description:
I have heard a lot about the craftsmen of your world. They bend stone, smelt ores and weave fabric imbued by the moon’s light to create powerful armor and weaponry. Still, they are but a child’s first attempt at crafting when compared to the legacy of Draenei craftsmanship. Centuries of wisdom passed down through generations, guarded by the best of the best in their field.

If you are eager, interested and brave enough to wish to learn from me, display to me your finest works and I shall judge your potential.
41954.progress: Show me what wonders your kin is capable of.
41954.completion: Fine pieces indeed. The elements of this world saturate the leather, their surface brimming with vibrant energy, elevating those who wear them into combat. Your expertise in the art of leatherworking proved to me that you are worthy of my teachings. Beforehand, a lecture and second trial await you.

41955.title: Tricolored Hide-ra
41955.description:
In this world live three-headed beasts called Hydra, creatures you surely have encountered plentiful on your journey. Their hide possesses innate magical quantities; magic we can foster and heighten with our ancient draenei technique. I will share with you on how to craft a powerful set of armor with these hides after you bring me leather from those beasts and the hides of three legendary hydra hiding in your world.
