No one else uses the kind of oil that burns that long! That's Undermine stuff, kid. There ain't no way a gnome could get their hands on it. I don't know what's goin' on in this site, but I don't like it.

Go out there and bring back some of that oil. Maybe you'll find some clues about what happened before we got here. If not, at least we'll have topped off our own oil supplies!
80103.progress: This stuff will burn for years if you let it. There's a reason it's a goblin trade secret. But there's no profit in burning down a whole forest!
80103.completion:
This doesn't make any sense. Why would they leave such valuable stuff behind?

Where the heck did everybody go?

80104.title: The Other White Mech
80104.description:
If there's one thing I like better than crackin' skulls for profit, it's cookin' up brand-new mechanical marvels. There's a whole butcher's shop of parts out there in those burnt woods, and buddy, my mouth is waterin' for a big old mechanical feast!

I don't know why the other expedition would leave so much behind and I don't care - bring me some of those parts!
80104.progress:
Well, what are you waiting for?

You're supposed to be some kind of big tough enforcer now, right? Go get me some parts!
80104.completion:
You know, sometimes farmers tell me their chickens are better than mine because their chickens don't blow up.

Personally, I think my chickens are better - for the exact same reason. Anyways, thanks for picking me up some parts.

Hopefully I can whip something up that might be helpful against... whatever is going on in this valley.

80105.title: Ventured Too Far
80105.description:
<Among the remains of the elemental, you find a note soaked in oil and scorched at the edges. Most of the writing is barely legible, but you can decipher one critical excerpt.>

... stupid boss didn't tell us anythin' about this place. Not a norm ... tomb. Somethin' bad buried ... center of the forest ...

<This seems worth reporting back to the foreman.>
80105.progress: Why are you bringin' me a piece of paper, kid? Do I look like your teacher?
80105.completion:
<Nert looks over the note.>

Well... That probably ain't good. But we didn't come this far just to quit because something scared off the last crew. Can't go back to the boss empty-handed, right?

<Nert looks troubled as he waves you off, perhaps trying to convince himself more than you that all is well.>

80106.title: The Grumbling Grove
80106.description:
Okay, look. A treasure hunter is gonna find some haunted forests from time to time, see? And we can't go back to the boss empty-handed. I mean CAN'T. Like he'll have us shipped off to the mines, can't.

So here's what we're gonna do, yeah? We're gonna try and grab the loot and get outta here quick-like. You've done good work so far, kid, so I'm counting on you for this job.

There looks to be more of the last crew's mechs further in this valley and, uh... some vultures that don't look real natural. Clear 'em out, and we'll see what's in there.
80106.progress: I don't like the look of ‘em any more than you do, kid. But what choice we got?
80106.completion: This place gives me the willies. The sooner we're out of here, the better, right kid?

80107.title: Shadow On The Plateau
80107.description:
I don't envy you right now, kid. See, those weird vultures aren't the worst thing in the woods. Some of the other bruisers were havin' a look around, and they found a tomb that looks like it's from Uldaman for how old it is.

Tried to get close, but they heard some kind of unholy sound coming from inside. These guys have been around for some of the boss's "persuasive" interviews before, and they've never heard sounds like that. Said it echoed around the hills all unnatural-like, as if it was bouncin' off trees that weren't there.

I'll fight elves. I'll fight plant monsters. I'll fight our own blasted tanks! But I am not messing with some ancient cursed tomb. I want you to go down there, find out what's behind those doors, and deal with it. Do that for me, and you and me are chums for life. There may even be a promotion in your future.
80107.progress: This place gives me the heebie-jeebies.
80107.completion: The first of many? Nope, nope, nope. I don't care what the boss says, I am not gettin' cursed by some angry ghost. We gotta get outta here, kid.

80108.title: Me Not Any Kind Of Orc
80108.description:
We're in a tough spot. The boss is scary, but he ain't worth fighting hordes of ghosts or some ancient curse. When he finds out we bailed on this gig, he'll have us hunted to the ends of Azeroth.

As much as it pains me to say, we're gonna have to cower and hide behind some real muscle if we don't all want to end up six feet under.

There's only one force in Azeroth that even the boss wouldn't cross: The Horde. Sure, they don't like us, but we've got better odds with the Horde than with the boss!

We ain't got many choices. No one else would take a bunch of deadbeat Venture Co. refugees. If there's even a chance we can win them over, we've at least gotta try.

It's that or spend the rest of our lives on the run. Time for us to go straight, <name>.
80108.progress:
Alright, we made it to Durotar.

Step 1 complete. Now for Step 2 of my master plan. That I just now made up...
80108.completion:
Alright, we made it to Durotar. Step 1 complete.

Now for Step 2 of my master plan... That I just made up.

80109.title: Zug-zug Or Somethin'
80109.description:
Our situation ain't good. If the Horde won't help us, I don't know where else we could go. But I've got a plan, see?

An old friend of mine is the cook at Razor Hill, the orc town just below that guard tower. Torka and I write now and then, and he ain't above bragging about his cooking.

He went so far as to say his boar ribs could bring the commander there to his knees. We're counting on that.

Hunt some of these boars and bring their meat to Torka. We'll have him cook 'em up and put in a good word for us, yeah? Any goblin will tell you one good word can take you all the way to the top!
80109.progress: Hail, goblin. Are you with the caravan from Ratchet we're expecting?
80109.completion:
What is this? Boar meat? You present this to me like an offering rather than delivering supplies...

You say Nert sent you? Nert Blastentom?

80110.title: Green Goes Red
80110.description:
Nert is a good friend, and despite his choice of employment, I don't think he's a bad person. Convincing Gar'Thok of the same, though... And getting you all into the Horde? That's a tall order!

Gar'Thok may love my boar ribs, but I'd like to think he's got a better head on his shoulders than to recruit former Venture Co. crew in exchange for a meal.

I'll cook these up for you at least. If you're set on this plan, take my advice: Tell Gar'Thok your lot are refugees willing to serve. Do not mention the Venture Co. at all.

Give Nert my regards.
80110.progress:
You don't look like the caravan from Ratchet. What business do you have in Razor Hill?

<Gar'Thok sniffs the air and starts to salivate.>

Is that Torka's cooking I smell? What I wouldn't give for some of his boar ribs...
80110.completion:
A gift on behalf of you and your goblin refugee companions? You wish to join the Horde?! Listen, goblin...

<You offer the boar ribs in an enticing manner, and after a moment of hesitation, Gar'Thok hungrily grabs the ribs. He devours the food with relish, making a mess but looking satisfied.>

A goblin giving food freely. Hmm, I will see what I can do... First, formalities.

Are you prepared to fight with honor among the ranks of the Warchief's army? To be his blade and shield in lands unknown?

80115.title: Grease-stained Letter
80115.description:
Hey, <name>! Employee of the day! How's about an unpaid break?

While you were busy doing my... I mean YOUR job, Grizzie the Enforcer came around looking for you. Said something about him owing you a favor?

Here, he mentions it in this letter... which I may or may not have dropped into my buzzard wings.

Don't take too long, though. Your break is already half over!
80115.progress: <name>, pal, great to see ya. Let's have a quick chat.
80115.completion:
If it isn't my old buddy, <name>! Man, we've made some good memories together, yeah?

I ain't giving out no discounts, though. You know how it is.

80116.title: Ooze-covered Letter
80116.description:
Glad you're back, <name>. You know I love me some gossip, and I bet you do, too. Maybe you'd care to shed a little light on why your name is on the lips of such bad news?

I hear you owe Leyti Quicktongue some money. Did you gamble all of your savings back home or what?

Is she your loan shark? Do I have to pay for your health insurance? That's not gonna happen, pal.

Look, just take this letter she left for you. I don't want to hold this thing anymore, especially with that nasty looking green stuff dripping off the corner. Probably acid or poison or something.

Short break, and I mean short!
80116.progress:
If it ain't <name>. You thieving scoundrel.

What do you mean it was your gig?
80116.completion:
So peach, you got my money? No? What do you mean no?!

Tsk, I guess you're still a low grade thief. In that case, I guess I could teach you the ropes.

It's not like I like you or anything... You still gotta pay me back!

80117.title: Leather-covered Letter
80117.description:
Back for more work, <name>? I appreciate your dedication to all this scut work, but Mayten Boomrifle is looking for you. Gave me this letter for you and everything, said something about teaching you some proper shootin'!

Heh, like you need some so-called expert to teach you how to launch metal projectiles or harness explosions. We're goblins!

Whatever... Here, take this letter and go pay him a visit. Hurry it up. No stalling, or no meals for you today!
80117.progress: Shhhh, <name>. Not so loud. I'm trying to take that buzzard out of the sky.
80117.completion:
You got my letter, <name>?

Good, good. Let's do something about your shoddy aim. Before you know it, you'll be putting holes in gold pieces from a hundred yards away.

What? No, no, no! It was a figure of speech! Don't go wasting perfectly good coin.

80118.title: Fancy Letter
80118.description: Great work so far, <name>. I knew having a mage in our labor force would come in handy. Speaking of handy, how's about conjuring up some water for your poor parched foreman?

80119.title: Awful-looking Letter
80119.description:
<name>, pal! Back so soon? W-we're pals, right? Heh heh...

Being honest, you kinda give me the creeps, not unlike Amri Demondeal. She came looking for you, and boy I hope I never have to speak to her again.

You, uh, do all that freaky demon stuff, too? With the green fire and blood circles and such?

Look, I didn't see nothin'! J-just take this letter Amri left and go do your business. Take as long as you want!
80119.progress: <name>! Welcome, welcome. The dark arts await, friend.
80119.completion: Ooh, just in time! Ready to embrace the shadows?

80120.title: Garbage Man
80120.description:
Hey, you! Yeah, I'm talkin' to you, pal!

I've been picking up our crew's trash all day long and I could really use a break.

Say, hows about you clean up for a while?

I'll be over here in the shade takin' a quick snooze. When I wake up, I expect this place to be spotless.

Now get to work!
80120.completion:
Good job!

Don't tell the boss I was taking a break.

80121.title: [DEPRECATED] This Is In My Contract
80121.description:
Nert might be afraid of a little shadow magic, but you and I know what we're doing, yeah?

It's time for you to learn how to summon your first demon! Yeah, I know we're in the middle of a crisis, but what better time to have a demon's aid?

Besides, we're warlocks. Crises are what we're about! That and I'm contractually obligated to arm you to "enforce".

While you're out on Nert's task, I want you to look for something that radiates darkness. That energy condenses into these purple crystals, see? Try to pinch one of those without getting yourself killed.

Bring me back one of those crystals, and I'll teach ya how to summon an imp. Fair trade, yeah?
80121.progress: Was I not crystal clear? I need a crystal full of shadow magic for the summoning spell.
80121.completion:
Beautiful! This will do nicely.

Now watch and learn, kid - You only get to forcibly rip a demon from the void for the first time once in your life.

80200.title: [DEPRECATED] Farstrider Lodge
80200.description:
At last, <name>, you are awake. It would seem that we survived the perilous journey south from the remnants of Lordaeron. We will have to make the best of our situation and work to make this our new home.

There is much to be done if we are to make this more than a temporary settlement for our people, <name>. This lodge has only had to accommodate a handful of hunters and hasn't seen much traffic since the Second War, thus why its maintenance is questionable at best.

Vyrin Swiftwind resides in the lodge and has held station here much longer than any of us. If we are to make a home for ourselves here, then we should seek her counsel and ask where to focus our efforts.
80200.completion:
You wish to assist?

Well, your offer is welcome, <class>. I have been the lone ranger at this lodge for years, so you can imagine my shock at seeing so many of my kind arriving with news that my homeland has fallen. Now, I have to contend with a hundred refugees.

We have much work to do, friend, but the burden will be lessened with the refugees assisting. We Quel'dorei must stand united now more than ever; we only have each other now.

80201.title: Stocking Up on Wood
80201.description:
Wagons full of refugees have arrived from the north, and more are surely on the way.

Because this was used as a dwarven hunting lodge, the larders are fully stocked with meat. Unfortunately, most of the meat was in the process of being salted and the lodge does not have ample firewood. Some of the refugees have already begun chopping wood for the lumber supply.

Go out and collect some of the bundles of wood they've prepared. You'll find them near the trees growing around the lodge, but be careful not to venture too far out into the valley: The creatures of Loch Modan are too dangerous for a young <class> such as yourself.
80201.completion: Thank you, <name>. With this, we should have more than enough wood to keep our people warm and bellies full.

80203.title: Clearing Out Vermin
80203.description:
Excuse me, <race>, can I have your attention for a moment?

I am Kathy Wake. I am a part of a branch of the Alliance military responsible for ensuring the safety and prosperity of Alliance lands. We've recently been sent here with a large contingent of men. Although I personally believe we are needed more back home, it is not my place to question orders.

Our mission has been to ensure your people arrived safely to the lodge, and also to get you settled in. However, it is not easy to keep everyone safe from the dangers out here. While my men have been dealing with the larger problematic elements in the region, smaller ones have been left unattended for too long, and now they have been allowed to run rampant.

The refugee caravans could be in danger if something is not done quickly. I take it you can fight? If so, please go out there and take care of the troggs that have been infesting the area around the lodge!
80203.progress: Well, <race>, has the deed been done?
80203.completion:
Well done, <name>. This is only the beginning, but removing those vermin will ensure the refugees remain safe for now.

We have more work to do, though. The more assistance we get from you, the more help we can provide your people.

80204.title: [DEPRECATED] Gathering Intel
80204.description:
You're less wet behind the ears, now, which is good.

The vermin you've defeated are only a nuisance compared to other things that lurk in this valley. Some of the recent refugees who arrived last night reported seeing a short-statured figure with glowing red eyes in the woods as it stalked the area.

Some brushed it off as fatigue from the long travel, but I believe it may be the forward scout of a Shadowforge raiding party.

The Shadowforge are one of the Dark Iron clans. They are corrupted red-eyed dwarves who are at odds with the kingdom of Ironforge. Investigate the area to the west where the sighting happened, but do not stray too close to the digsite. It is infested with troggs far stronger than those vermin that you fought earlier.

Remember: do not engage. If you find something, confirm your sighting and immediately return here.
80204.progress: Have you spotted the Shadowforge scout?
80204.completion: A whole armed camp? Damn, this is a problem. We'll need to devote resources into dealing with it that we don't have. Thank you for your help, <name>! We may call upon you again once we figure out how to handle this.

80205.title: Slaking Their Thirst
80205.description:
Hello again, <name>.

The wood you gathered helped feed many refugees. However, the situation is far from resolved.

The drinking water stores are running low. Soon, we will not be able to care for the refugees, but luckily there is a well to the north near the border of this valley. Go there, and fill this barrel with water.

There are volunteers trying to dig a new well here, but that will take time.

Please, <name>, I know I can count on you!
80205.progress: Did you get it? The children are thirsty.
80205.completion:
You got the water?

Thank you, <name>. At least that's one less problem we have to deal with.

The children will have water, and the progress on the well is going wonderfully!

80206.title: Burnt Wheels
80206.description:
<Vyrin appears distressed as she looks in your direction.>

We found a wagon burned down with the corpses of the accompanying escorts nearby and no sign of the refugees. It's... terrible, <name>, it's absolutely terrible!

Please speak to your companion, Malvinah, was it? I am trying to keep people calm as we figure this out, but she is very disturbed. She's spreading panic and confusion among the refugees.
80206.progress: What is it, <name>? Now is not the time.
80206.completion:
So, you know about it, then? My scouts have confirmed it.

It's that damned Shadowforge raiding party you found. We should have struck right away, but instead I wanted to prepare... damn it!

It's as if they knew we were onto them. You didn't attack any of them, did you?

Well, no matter. There is no time for regret. It is time to act!

The refugees have been put in cages, and the Dark Irons are preparing to ritually sacrifice them to their god, the Firelord Ragnaros.

We can't allow it, <name>! I'm going to need your help with this!

80207.title: Dark Iron Scrapping
80207.description:
Alright, <name>, here is the plan. We have established a perimeter around the Dark Iron camp, but we believe that if we move in force, then they will execute the refugees. We have been ordered to stand down.

However, if we do not act now, the refugees will be killed. We need an outsider to sneak into their camp, kill the fire cleric, acquire the key to the cells, and free the refugees.

I can think of no one more worthy of this task than you. You have proven yourself to be strong and resourceful in the short time we've known each other.

I believe in you, <name>! Now go and save those people!
80207.progress: Time is of the essence, <name>. Do not delay!
80207.completion:
They are all safe. I can't believe it, we averted a disaster! I can't thank you enough, <name>! We take our duty very seriously, and losing those people would have been terrible.

Now, we need to take care of that raiding party. There is someone who wants to speak with you about that. Go see Vyrin.

80208.title: Sunblade Reunion
80208.description:
You're the hero of the hour, <name>! All the refugees are speaking your name!

I believe there is a friend of yours who is particularly grateful. Why not go and speak with Malvinah Sunblade?
80208.progress: The hero of the hour returns, huh?
80208.completion:
You did well, <name>. You deserve all the praise you're getting.

It may not seem like much to save a few refugees, but consider that this is just the start of your journey. You exhibited great courage, too.

I can safely say that I am proud to have met you. However, there is another matter we must talk about.

Several of the refugee caravans have decided to move on to Stormwind. We can escort them part of the way there, but eventually they will arrive in a region beset by strife.

Bandits and beasts run amok while we are ordered to outlying areas such as this lodge.

We can't go against our orders, but adventurers like you can make a difference back home.

Think about it and talk to me again.

80209.title: Porting to Goldshire
80209.description:
You've decided to assist, then? I am grateful, <name>!

The situation back home is dire and we cannot return to help at the moment. I do not know what kind of affliction ails the Stormwind nobles, but ever since King Varian disappeared, the Kingdom has been run into the ground!

Alas, while we can't control the nobles, we can deal with the problems in the kingdom's provinces! Elwynn Forest is a good place to start. The capital is located in this region, and it has been surrounded by issues. Kobolds rule the mines, gnolls raid the towns, and bandits seize the roads.

My friend Marshal Dugan is stationed in Goldshire, and he can put you to good use. I believe the Magistrix here can teleport you to Goldshire.
80209.progress: A high elf here? What can I do for you, stranger?
80209.completion:
Kathy Wake sent you?! You've certainly made connections if an SI... I mean, if a member of the Alliance military sent you!

If you're here to assist, I can assure you that we'll need the help. I have requested for reinforcements from the capital several times, but received nothing.

If Kathy vouches for you, then that's good enough for me. I believe I have your first assignment in mind!

Oh, and don't forget to visit the inn. You may want to attune your hearthstone there.

80210.title: Providing a Balanced Diet
80210.description:
Greetings, <name>! You've made amazing progress so far, but there is still so much to do.

While the lodge is stocked with an abundance of grain and meat, we're lacking other types of nourishment like fruits and vegetables.

Luckily, the area around the lodge has an abundance of pumpkins and berries this time of the year. Can I count on you to search the area for berries and pumpkins?

Our peoples' welfare depends on it!
80210.progress: Did you get the pumpkins and berries?
80210.completion:
Wonderful! This will last a while until we can acquire supplies from the Alliance.

We can also use the seeds from the pumpkins to plan our own pumpkin patch.

80211.title: Ranger's Letter
80211.description:
<name>, the fall of our homeland has affected us all. But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
80211.completion:
So you've chosen to begin your training? I am pleased, <name>. Very pleased. Talk to me again and I will do my best to guide you with my knowledge.

In time, I believe you will grow to become someone all rangers can be proud of calling a comrade!

My bearded friend, Claude Erksine, can also assist you with beast-related training once you are ready.

80212.title: Paladin's Letter
80212.description:
<name>, the fall of our homeland has affected us all. But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
80212.completion:
Light be with you, <name>!

It honors and brings me endless joy to see you take the first step on the path of becoming a paladin.

Know that I shall do my utmost to guide you through the tenets and through your training.

Talk to me again whenever you wish to seek my counsel.

80213.title: Priest's Letter
80213.description:
<name>, the fall of our homeland has affected us all. But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
80213.progress: May the Sun's Light shine upon you.
80213.completion:
By the Sun, you've come!

Many of our people have lost their faith in the Light of the Sun as they wander like sheep lost in the dark. Together, we can be the beacon guiding them to salvation and to the warmth of the Sun!

I shall do my best to be your beacon, <name>. Ask and I will teach you what I can.

80214.title: Magister's Letter
80214.description:
<name>, the fall of our homeland has affected us all. But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
80214.progress: The Magisterium is the most prestigious group that a mage can be a part of.
80214.completion:
Ah, <name>, I take it you're here to become my apprentice?

If so, then know that I will not coddle you. You will be serving under a proud member of the Magisterium.

As such, you will be taught what I deem necessary for your progress. Continue to perform adequately and I shall continue to guide you.

Eventually, you will be fit enough for the Magisterium.

Talk to me again once you are prepared.

80215.title: Shady Letter
80215.description:
<name>, the fall of our homeland has affected us all. But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
80215.completion:
So, you really came, huh?

Amusing. Well, you've completed your first test, but don't think that it's your last.

Let's see how well you fare under my training. Talk to me again when you're ready and I'll teach you some tricks. If you continue to show potential, then expect me to continue teaching you.

80216.title: Swordsman's Letter
80216.description:
<name>, the fall of our homeland has affected us all. But, even if our education down this path was cut short, there are still ways to learn.

Recently, someone left a letter on the desk and it was addressed to you.

Perhaps you should read it and see what it says?
80216.progress: Wielding the sword is just as majestic as it is powerful.
80216.completion:
I must say that your appearance gives me hope.

Few of our people take on the path of the sword. It is a long and arduous journey, but I have faith that you can overcome it with my training.

It doesn't matter how many rangers or mages you have. In the end, you need someone on the frontlines to win battles.

When you're ready to take up that mantle, talk to me again.

80217.title: [DEPRECATED] Pelts and Tusks
80217.description:
To prove yourself to me, <name>, I will have you go around the lodge and search for the many piglets and cubs that made their home close to here.

Your kin will also need clothes and armor made from their hides. While I am not the best leatherworker, I could still make a few pieces of gear.

Five pelts of the bear cubs and five chunks of meat from the piglets will be enough to prove your worth.

Come back when you have everything.
80217.progress: Are you done yet, <name>? We need the supplies.
80217.completion: Ah, yes. While these clearly weren't harvested by an expert, you did a pretty good job. Very well, <name>, you've proven to be a capable <race>. You know, some might not see them as very dangerous, but indeed they are. Here, some coin for your troubles, and I made you a cape from the remaining pelts.

80219.title: KABOOM!
80219.progress:
If there's one thing a goblin is always in need of, it's dynamite!

Whether it's used to excavate, blow up enemies, or just to watch things go KABOOM!

Anyways, bring me 20 heavy dynamite and I'll be sure to put in a good word for you. Be sure to bring me quality dynamite too.

I don't care where you find it either, unless you were to find it off the corpse of a gnome. In that case, be sure to wipe it down with disinfectant before you bring it to me.

Gnomes have a characteristically unpleasant odor that I find, quite frankly, to be repulsive. Heavy Dynamite(20)
80219.completion: Nice job, <name>. I'll be sure to tell the others of your help.

80220.title: A New Place in Stormwind
80220.description:
You're a <race> right?

You aren't the first I've seen around here recently. A lot of your people have arrived and have settled up in Stormwind.

In the outer section of the Dwarven district bordering the canal, there is an entrance with the banner of your people, go there and you can meet them should you wish to greet your own folk.
80220.progress: Yes? What can I do for you?
80220.completion:
Ah have you arrived from Alah'Thalas? It's good to hear our people are settling in safely. I am Illyanah Dawnstar, Quel'dorei representative.

The House of Nobles have granted us this street as a place to live and house our refugees for now. Of course you're welcome to stay as well, we have lodgings, although our permanent housing building is filled to the brim, the Inn can spare a bed for a few nights. Rest assured that plans are in motion to improve the situation of our people... permanently. Alas I must return to my book keeping, stay safe friend!

80250.title: [DEPRECATED] Assisting the Children of the Sun
80250.description:
Bal'a dash, malanore, <race>! I represent a group of my people who seek to restore our former glory.

We seek to settle a new home for us and your assistance would be more than welcome.

When you have the time, journey to Stormwind and speak to Caledra Dawnbreeze in the Stormwind Keep.

Trust that you will be well compensated for your aid!
80250.progress: Yes? What can I do for you, stranger?
80250.completion:
Ahh, so you seek to assist us in our effort?

Wonderful…

Our people have set up a new settlement called Alah'thalas on the coast north of Stratholme, bordering Quel'thalas. However, setting up a new home is difficult and we have run into our share of issues.

Your help will definitely be appreciated! I shall sum up our situation for you.

80251.title: [DEPRECATED] To Alah'Thalas!
80251.description:
Now that you know what we're dealing with and our history...

The time has come to act. If you're truly interested in helping us, then this is the way.

One of our most talented mages has established a leyline connection to Alah'thalas.

Go to the Mage Tower in the Mage District, and speak to Elsharin. She will be able to take you there, once you arrive I am sure someone will tend to you.
80251.progress: Oh my! What can I do for you, <race>?
80251.completion:
Oh you've come to assist Alah'thalas!

I'm quite happy I must say, I knew Caledra could find nice people! I'm surprised she found a <class> as capable as you!

The loss of Quel'thalas has grieved me greatly, but now I see hope, hope that our people can have a future again!

Talk to me when you are ready and I will send you to Alah'thalas!

80252.title: [DEPRECATED] A Crystal Clear Task
80252.description:
Greetings, <race>. Since you're here this means you've come to help so listen up. We have a situation here... You might be aware that our buildings use arcane magic to operate.

While our central crystal is the main power source, we use smaller crystals to effectively channel the arcane energy from the nexus to the outlying ley points of the structure.

The downside is that these crystals break down overtime, if we had found this outpost a decade later the entire Academy could have collapsed.

Fortunately, our predecessors built this site on a location with arcane crystal deposits. While the automated constructs have long since stopped working or malfunctioned, the mine remains full of intact crystals.

I need you to head down there and bring me some crystals. Eight should do for now.

Are you still here? Get moving.
80252.progress:
Have you gotten the crystals yet?

I don't care what you have to deal with...Rats or whatever's down there, I expect this task to be done!
80252.completion:
Oh? That's a nice haul... Good to see that you can be counted on, <race>!

Alright, time to calibrate these crystals so they can be integrated into the network...

You are still here?... Oh right, you want a reward, yes, yes. Now move along.

80253.title: [DEPRECATED] Relics in Feralas
80253.description:
Well well... So far you've proven useful so perhaps I can give you a more important task than fetching crystals.

My people descend from the Highborne, we were once the pinnacle of Kaldorei society, ruling a great empire… While few traces remain of that here in the Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor is filled to the brim with ruins, ruins that have not been looted!

I need you to travel to the jungle of Feralas, once home to the city state of Eldre'thalas. In the area just south of Eldre'thalas there should be some ruins...

I believe the locals call it the High Wilderness. Our scouts have reported that the Ogres holding the ruins have inadvertently dug up some valuable Arcane artifacts. I want you to go down there and get me those artifacts...

Before those big oafs crush them with their feet! Now get going, quickly!
80253.progress:
What are you waiting for?

Every moment you delay some fat Ogre can crush an irreplaceable relic!

Get going! We're counting on you.
80253.completion:
What's that you got there?...

By the Sunwell! These are perfect! Yes yes, I'm sure some of these will assist our cause! You have my thanks <race>, you have my thanks indeed...

Here is your little trinket, now get going!

I have research to do.

80254.title: [DEPRECATED] Smashing Zul'Mashar
80254.description:
Greetings, <name>! I see that you have done quite a lot of work for Anu'delen, but now the time has come for something more serious than fetching artifacts.

Alah'thalas is not far from the Scourge or the Amani, after the fall of Quel'thalas our people can no longer keep the rampaging Forest Trolls in check.

Our scouts have reported that the Troll population of Zul'mashar in the Eastern Plaguelands is being converted to the Undead at a rapid pace.

We cannot have this, Forest Trolls are bad enough, we don't need to deal with an Undead version.

Go there, exterminate both the living and the dead, we can't allow those beasts to go out of control.
80254.progress: Well then? Is the deed done?
80254.completion:
Well done friend, well done indeed… Keep this up and we will continue the work started by our ancestors.

The vile Forest Trolls and the Scourge cannot be allowed to grow in numbers, it is our duty to keep them both down and eventually exterminate them.

80256.title: [DEPRECATED] Welcome to Alah'Thalas
80256.description:
I am Tanilaeh Sunkiss, Ley-technician and operator of the Portal connecting Alah'thalas to the Stormwind Mage tower, when you need to return to Stormwind, I am the one you should speak to.

This place is the Golden Dawn Institute, here we house lodgings and welcome new travelers. In front of me is the Orb of Translocation, you can use that to go down to Alah'thalas proper.

Arcanist Anu'delen in the tower below us has requested help with a problem in the mine. There is also innkeeper Joalar in the institute should you wish for a meal or to attune your hearthstone here.

The large floating structure is known as the Citadel of the Sun. It houses the new Magistry, the headquarters of the Rangers, and the seat of the Council.

Anyway I shouldn't keep you anymore, go speak to the Arcanist!
80256.completion: You wish to assist me?... I suppose I can spare a moment to explain what you must do.

80258.title: [DEPRECATED] Tears of the Poppy
80258.description:
Sinu a'manore, <class>.

You have answered our call for aid, for which we are truly grateful.

With the fall of Quel'Thalas we, the Quel'dorei, have been left without a home. It is here where we shall focus our wits and strengthen our will. This is the beginning of our quest for vengeance, and you shall be part of it, among others.

You see, as we prepare for a war against death itself we need to have as less casualties as possible but we can only prevent so many.

Where there is a battle there shall be dead and wounded. I ask of you on this day and many to come to aid us in our effort to supply our numbers with a means to mend and heal. There is a small and not so elegant flower growing in Redrige Mountains. We call it poppy. I shall not bore you with the alchemical details, you only need to know that the concoction will ease the pain of the wounded. I know it's a simple task but it is not meaningless.

Return to me when you have a handful of them.
80258.progress: This will make a difference in the battle to come, please do not take it lightly.
80258.completion:
These will do just fine. Not all of them are of the highest quality but they will be useful. Thank you <class>.

Ah yes, here is your reward.

Return soon, <class>.

Selama Ashal'anore!

80260.title: [DEPRECATED] Help With a Compassionate Matter
80260.description:
I have a... troubling matter to discuss with you.

A child was sent from Stormwind, and she won't stop babbling.

Quite frankly, she is interfering with my work. I was APPARENTLY the most qualified to take care of her, but I'd appreciate it if you helped her out with her pleading because of your proclivity for being a “hero”.

Yes, yes! I will pay you, too, if those are part of your terms.

<Anu'delen pinches the bridge of his nose while veins on the side of his neck flare into view.>
80260.completion:
Thank the Sunwell! You have no idea how much this means to me.

Peace and quiet is crucial while doing such vital work.

Use this whistle to call the girl, and then you can listen to all of her problems instead of me.

80261.title: [DEPRECATED] Teslinah's Search I
80261.description:
Oh, great adventurer! My name is Teslinah. Please, I need your help!

My mommy and I were in the Farstrider Lodge after fleeing from all the bad stuff up north, but when we were in Stormwind, we got separated! Miss Elsharin found me and took me here because she thought my mommy would be here, too, but she's not! The grumpy man over there only told me to sit in a corner and be silent. You'll help me, right?
80261.progress:
Please, will you help me?

Pretty please?
80261.completion: She's not in the Mage District. But we can't give up!

80262.title: [DEPRECATED] Teslinah's Search II
80262.description: Let's try the dwarven area, then the park, and then my peoples' district!
80262.progress: I'm going to cry really hard if we can't find her!
80262.completion: She's not here either... Mommy, where are you?!

80263.title: [DEPRECATED] Teslinah's Search III
80263.description: Let's try the big castle next! I hear the king's son is really nice. We can also try the old part of town. I think it has a tavern too. Oh, and let's look at that Gnomish tram I've heard about! Maybe she's waiting there.
80263.progress: We cannot give up! We have to find her. I don't know what I'd ever do without her.
80263.completion: Mommy is out there somewhere. Let's continue please!

80264.title: [DEPRECATED] Teslinah's Search IV
80264.description: We could try the barracks in the Old Town. Oh, and that giant Cathedral place! Maybe she went to look for me there. I heard there's a place for lost children nearby in a pretty big building!
80264.progress: Please, keep helping me. She can't be far!
80264.completion: Mommy... N-No, I am sure we can find her, right?

80265.title: [DEPRECATED] Teslinah's Search V
80265.description: I don't think there's many other places left. Let's look everywhere we've missed. There's more to the Cathedral, and we can look in the Trade place!
80265.progress: Yes? What can I do for you, <race>?
80265.completion:
Her mom is missing, you say? Give me a moment to look her up in our extensive collection of documents.

The girl's name is Teslinah? We do have records of her and her mother's arrival in Stormwind with the other refugees, but the two of them never showed up at the City hall for their registration.

This is a troubling discovery. We can't have people going missing in Stormwind. I will investigate, but until my investigation is completed, can I count on you to care for the girl?

Since she was registered here in Stormwind, I will issue some bonds to feed her properly.

80289.title: The First Settlement
80289.description:
Ah, there you are, <name>. You have proven to be of some use in the past. I have observed that you have an uncanny knack for running errands. My ancestors were exiled from Kalimdor seven thousand years ago, but you're mistaken if you think they created Quel'thalas right away.

They landed in what is today known as the Tirisfal Glades. According to records left behind in Alah'thalas, the first settlement was known as Ishnu'danil. Naturally, this is something we consider worthy of exploring further, which is why I have sent my subordinate Thas'alah to investigate this ancient location.

However, I have not heard a word from him since, and to make matters worse, the records we found mention a curse of some kind that affected the minds of our ancestors who lived there. I need you to go there and find out what became of Thas'alah.
80289.completion:
Arcanist Anu'delen sent you? Finally, some good news, this damned expedition has just been one disaster after another. We made progress at first but not long after, everything went downhill.

Our equipment broke, people thought the place was haunted, and some even claimed that they heard voices talking to them. But that last one is nonsense, I assure you.

80290.title: The Lost Tablets
80290.description:
With all that has been going around here, I could use help from an adventurer like you. You see, our people used magic to shape the land and create buildings like this, but this one appears to have been only partially complete and abandoned.

I tried venturing inside myself but was immediately filled with dread and horror. It felt like it was consuming me, so I fled outside. But you, on the other hand, seem like someone who is not easily frightened. Before I... left. I noticed a Stone Tablet etched into the cliff.

Perhaps it can provide some clue as to what might've happened here. Could you be so kind as to retrieve it for me?
80290.completion:
So it was haunted, after all? It's a shame we could not talk to the spirit, but I guess it's for the best. Anyways, let's see that tablet. Ah, it's written in Thalassian, that makes things a bit easier. It details the establishment of Ishnu'danil as the new home of the Highborne and Alah'aran.

But look at this part. It's a verse about a well, to be precise, a well of power. And what is this? Look here at the bottom. There's a message inscribed here, but this does not match the writing style from before. It states:

<Avoid the Shalla'aran. Avoid the Ishnu'danil. There is only darkness here>.

Ishnu'danil translates to Fortune's Peak, but Shalla'aran means the Shadow Well. If something that powerful lies somewhere around here, we must find out more about it!

80291.title: The Shadow Well
80291.description: I have already sent my serv... assistant Thalo down there, but he has yet to return. It could prove valuable to know more about it if this Shadow Well is as powerful and dangerous as this text claims.
80291.progress: You are back!? That is... good. Tell me, what did you find down there?
80291.completion:
If you didn't find Thalo, it must mean that the skeleton was his. Oh well. And what is this about black slimes emerging from the well's waters? So they were right, most intriguing.

Anyways, your help here is appreciated, but I think it's high time for you to leave. I still have research to do here, and you should inform Arcanist about our findings here, should you not?

80292.title: A Lone Homecoming
80292.description:
Don't worry about me. I will not be alone here. I have my... guards with me. And you must agree that this place is too important to leave unattended.

Oh, and if you could avoid mentioning the stuff about hearing voices, that would be wonderful. I don't want to scare the potential helpers, which Anu'delen might send my way.
80292.progress: Took you long enough, <name>. You're alone. Where is Scryer Thas'alah?
80292.completion:
Most of his expedition is dead, and he decided to remain there? Has he lost his mind!? A haunted place with talks of dark whispers and monsters coming out of the corrupted well is certainly not what I was hoping for us to find there.

Nevertheless, the information you brought may prove valuable to us. This is a lot to take in, and it's a damn shame that such a powerful well ended up being corrupted. And this is where your work ends, and mine begins. Oh, and I almost forgot, here is little something for your valiant efforts.

80300.title: A Tusken Affair
80300.description: Hello mon! I be representing a clutch of the Revantusk Trolls that have left the shores of our home in order to forge a bond and more promising relations with the Horde.

80301.title: Lighting the Pyres
80301.description:
When we first got here, it was important for us to raise structures to make a home for ourselves. While tidying the place up, we breached the entrance of the temple, clearing away all the collapsed rubble.

Many loa used to be worshipped there, especially the Loa of Death. We must have disturbed the spirits inside the tomb, because the trolls of the past have arisen to haunt the temple. These vengeful undead attack anyone who tries to walk their halls, even peaceful worshippers.

Ya duty is to set fire to the pyres in the tomb, to soothe the troubled spirits and purify the temple. If the undead be in ya way, send them back to the afterlife.
80301.progress: Is it done? Have the spirits been put to rest?
80301.completion:
The foul stench be starting to clear. Ya did good mon. Ya deserve a reward for ya efforts.

Know that in time, this place will not only be an asset to the Revantusk, but the Horde as a whole.

80302.title: To Amani'Alor!
80302.description:
I be toiling with diplomacy here, so me hands are tied on proper greetings. If ya truly wanna help the Revantusk Tribe, we be appreciating it.

The time has come for the Revantusk to pull their weight in the Horde for all the aid they been giving us in the Hinterlands, and set a course for the future. Deino of the Darkspear Tribe has been kind enough to open portals for us to and from Amani'Alor.

Ya can find her in the Valley of Spirits. As soon as ya get to Amani'Alor, seek out Mystic Guya'jin and ask how ya can help the Revantusk cause.
80302.completion:
Ya looking to help the Revantusk, too? Well ain'tcha a fine diplomat of the Horde.

They be the last sane forest tribe and our cousins, so it be me pleasure to help them. Trolls around Azeroth been at odds for many many years, so it fill me with hope seeing tribes uniting under the Horde.

If ya ever wish to travel to Amani'Alor, just speak to me.

80303.title: Raiding Quel'Lithien Lodge
80303.description: It's good to see you again, <class>. Our scouts have reported increased activity from our ancient enemy in the Eastern Plaguelands.

80304.title: The Means To Heal
80304.description:
The trolls be blessed by the loa with great regeneration, mon. Be it just a scratch or an entire limb, we be able to heal. Still, there be times when the regeneration takes much too long, and there be no shame in being prepared for those times.

Our allies at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale recently discovered a little voodoo solution without even realizing. There be toads roaming the Mystral Lake at the edge of the forest, near Talondeep Path. They be covered with a slippery oil that can be brewed into a powerful salve.

Won'tcha be a friend and go squeeze them toads for me, mon? Bring me their oil, and I'll see ya be rewarded for your time.
80304.completion: Spirits be with ya, <race>. Ya efforts will keep us trolls healing up nicely. The Horde been nothing but kind to us, and we'll see to it ya be repaid in kind.

80305.title: Quark's Shack
80305.description:
Hey kid, enjoying yourself?

Nah, you're really not. I can see it on your face. This place is pretty run-down and boring with no real stuff to do, eh?

Well, if you're looking for some action, coin-action, mind you, then I got something for ya! But, you know, info doesn't come cheap, now does it?

How about a silver coin to loosen up my tongue?

<The goblin waits with an open hand while grinning at you.>

Well, now that we are friends, I suppose I can let you in on this little something. Something that I've heard around town. See, there's this bar that just opened up in the Valley of Honor. Quite ironic, don't you think?

I heard a goblin named Quark opened up a shop, but it's supposed to be a membership-only enterprise.

I wouldn't bother going there myself, but I heard there's good money to be made!

Now, that'll be fifty copper for the intel. Have a nice day, pal.
80305.progress:
Why are you still here, <name>?

If you wanted to buy me a drink, I'm sorry, but I you're not my type. Unless, of course, you've got enough coin. Then, maybe something can be arranged.
80305.completion:
Yeah, yeah, pal, in a minute!

What's the rush?

80306.title: What's Yours is Ours
80306.description:
Hey pal, watch it!

Oh, what's this? A proper customer, eh?

Welcome to Quark's Shack. You here for business or pleasure?

You see, this here is a bar of mine made for coin connoisseurs, so if you're here, then it's time to grab some quick coin and also have some fun you're at it.

If you're looking to gamble, then speak to Agne. She handles the bones. What, you never rolled the dice before? Nah, no need to worry about your coins, pal. You'll make back your losses in no time! Now, if you need anything to widen your eyes and numb your thoughts, come back and see me.
80306.progress: Hey there, sweetie. Wanna play a quick game of chance with your local beauty, Agne?
80306.completion: The early investor reaps the most interest.

80307.title: Yet Another Smoke Cloud Above Orgrimmar
80307.description:
Enjoying yourself, boss?

Good, good. Now, you see, that was a free trial. Doesn't really matter to me if you won or not, but I did say ‘coin connoisseurs', so you really gotta pay a membership fee.

Hey, hey, where're you goin' man? Come on, don't be like that. I might be willing to give you a membership card if you repay me with some favors.

See, I ordered some new goods from the Undermine for our hookahs. This cargo is very important and valuable. I will throw in some coins, too, which you are more than welcome to keep spending in my bar, if you go and fetch my goods for me. Now, the cargo should arrive at Ratchet right around today, so if you'd get a move on, I'd really appreciate it.
80307.progress: I'm running really low on my supplies, here, <name>. Could seriously use that cargo right about now!
80307.completion:
Quark's tobacco?

We might have a problem.

Wait! No reason to be aggressive. Listen.

<Wiley throws in a few coins to dissuade you from violence with quivering little hands.>

80308.title: Tobacco Thieves
80308.description:
So... we may have a slight pirate “infestation” problem. While cargo was being delivered from the Undermine, these damn pirates raided the boat and looted it. The crew escaped safely, but more importantly, the cargo was all gone!

It's a lot of wasted coin. Quark is expecting a big shipment, but a lot of it has either been smoked or lost to the sea. Just try to get whatever you can back and I might be able to fudge some numbers.

You'll find the pirates to the south, down the coastline.

Quark's waiting for that cargo, so you'd better hurry. Something's better than nothing.
80308.progress: There's gonna be a big problem if I can't get my missing cargo shipments.
80308.completion:
What, pirates?! Pirates?!

Screw pirates, sweet mother of goblins!

For crying out loud, argh, gnomish bastards!

I guess these crates will do. I owe you one, <name>. Er—actually, I don't. Here, just take this membership card instead. You've earned it. You're officially a member of Quark's Shack, now. Gamble your heart away, pal.

80309.title: Odo's Gut Feeling
80309.description: 'Ey, mon, come 'ere real quick, Odo's got sum words fo' ya. I see ya be crawlin' 'round Quark's gamblin' bar and I be havin' this feelin' in me gut that be tellin' me somethin' be at work 'ere.I be thinkin', he be doin' sumthin' under tha' table, mon. A goblin ya can trust be as rare as a beautiful troll woman, and let me tell ya, they do be pretty ugly.So, would ya keep an eye open for ol' Odo?This be official business, and I be payin' ya. Jus' go check tha' cargo and maybe sum paperwork, and keep an eye on tha' mon called Sturk. He be an associate of Quark. If anythin', I think he be the one smugglin' stuff.
80309.progress: I tell ya, mon, my gut be fo' real! Get th' criminal.
80309.completion: So Odo be right again. Never doubted my gut feelin'. We should go speak to Quark and confront Sturk to arrest 'im.

80310.title: Quark's Justice
80310.description:
That damn rat. He stole from me, did he now? I'm handing him over, but before that, I want you to stare that mongrel in the eyes and tell him that he got caught. Beat him to a pulp, and then hand him over to Odo.

After you're done, speak to The Rov. I want you to tell him to keep watch and tighten up the security around here. Can't just go around having thieves in my own shack, ya know? When you're all done, come back to me and there'll be a reward in it for ya.
80310.progress: Just get him out of my sight before I give him a good smackdown!
80310.completion: Now, with that done, I have to figure out a way to recover the money I lost. Thanks for the help, pal. Stick around. You're a valuable member, now. Also, here! Can't give ya loads of cash, but drinks are on me today.

80311.title: Mastering the Arcane
80311.description:
<Ureda glances at you with dismay.>

Your skills still require some honing, and your posture betrays your arrogance. Typical of any new apprentice who bears overconfidence before his own wits. Not that it matters to me. It's your own problem.

Any aspiring mage should have his spells ready at all times and think two steps ahead. That's why your lack of awareness should be compensated with at least something you could procure by yourself.

There is a… “mage” who resides on the bank of Southfury River, not far from Thunder Ridge. The task you will receive from this mage might be arduous at first glance, yet it most likely will bear fruit if you put your brain into it.
80311.progress:
Hrrm? Yes, what, huh?

Chok'Garok. Yes, it's us! Yes, two heads!
80311.completion:
Another one with thirst for knowledge? Good, good! I know what you need. I know what you want!

Yes, we know what you crave for!

80312.title: Arcane Arms
80312.description:
Ureda sends only worthy mages! Ureda is the worst!

<The two heads stare at each other with a surprised look.>

We know what you really need as a mage, and we know where to get parts. You bring us parts, and essence too, and we will make you a weapon, yes!

Where you get parts? It's in the cave. Barrens! Yes, yes. Wailing Caverns, they call it. Caverns with druids and snakes! Yes. You find us Moontouched Wood, a Crystal of the Serpent, and Everchanging Essence. Yes, the essence!

You bring it all to us, and we make it a worthy weapon! Yes, you'll be thankful!
80312.progress: You have the parts yet? Yes, yes, bring the parts!
80312.completion:
Yes, yes! That's what we need! The arcane is strong to weave on with this one! Yes, powerful casting!

You take this weapon now, go be proud and strong. Yes, yes.

Chok'Garok powerful, yes!

80313.title: Welcome to Amani'Alor
80313.description:
Oho, Deino send more help? Guya'jin be pleased.

I be Guya'jin, Witch Doctor of the Revantusk Tribe and the spiritual leader of our people. I keep this portal to Orgrimmar stable, so if ya want to return to the Valley of Spirits at any time, ya come see Guya'jin.

Amani'Alor be a blessing for our tribe, an ancient Zandalari temple with a deep connection to the loa. We be far away from our temples mon, but here, we can appeal to the local loa and maintain a connection with our loa back home.

Ya look a little green still, mon. Why don'tcha look around and get your bearings? Speak to me when ya be ready for ya first task. There be a lot of work to do round here.
80313.completion: Good, good. We be having much to do, so don't go scurrying yet mon.

80314.title: Scratching Each Other's Back
80314.description:
The aid of the Darkspear has been a welcome surprise. In a time when a troll would rather take ya eyes than see eye to eye with another tribe, this unity be a true miracle.

As a show of good will, Zol'majin will be sending ya to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. Offer this doll to him. It be an old troll custom, one he will understand.
80314.progress: Ya mon? Ya say ya got something for me?
80314.completion:
I haven't gotten one of these in years, mon. Do ya understand the meaning of this gesture?

This be a voodoo doll of Warleader Zol'majin himself, given in confidence to another troll. This doll will eventually reach Vol'jin, so Zol'majin be putting his life in the hands of the Darkspear.

This be a symbol of great trust between the tribes. This gesture may be returned in kind with time.

80315.title: Apple a Day
80315.description: I've only experienced a few blooms in my time, but this season, things are different. At the ends of my leaves, there are usually pink petals sprouting by now, but instead, my branches are barren! I don't think this is normal. Maybe a druid might know what's wrong with me? They're much older and wiser anyhow.
80315.progress: Please hurry, <race>. I don't know how much longer my leaves have before they completely fall away.
80315.completion: I can feel the life flowing back into my leaves, <race>. That druid really worked some magic with that salve. I wonder what's inside? I'll study it closely until I find out so that other trees like me don't get sick, too!

80320.title: [Deprecated] Burning Bridges
80320.description:
Hey <class>! I've got a business proposition for you. My boss sent me to track down defectors from the cartel that joined up with the Burning Blade and I've found out that Fizzle isn't the only goblin playing with demon fire around here.

Knobby Tinfault's hiding in Dustwind Cave on top of the Drygulch Canyon. Find him and bring me anything he's carrying that has so much as a strange mark on it. We need to get any info back to Gazlowe so we can find out if there's more to their schemes.
80320.progress: Is it done? Did you find anything?
80320.completion: A belt, huh? Clever and crafty, but we best not go poking around in any secret compartments in it. I'll get this back to Ratchet so it can be safely investigated. You've been a big help! Thanks!

80321.title: [Deprecated] The Lies that Bind Us
80321.description:
You're the one that helped Miley find this, yeah?

<Gazlowe holds up the belt you found in Dustwind Cave.>

I've had a bit of diggin' done and I know who made it. Name's Kiro in Orgrimmar. Nice enough gal, even if she's a tad aggressive.

I'm sure it's a long shot, but I need you to check with her and find out if she knows anything about this inscription. I've already had it deciphered, but Kiro might know more.
80321.completion: Yes, <class>, I made this. What of it?

80322.title: [Deprecated] The Lies That Bind Us
80322.description:
Hah! No leatherworker made these marks.

This is fel magic. There's an outcast located in the Barrens. It's a blacksmith from our world. He has a gift when it comes to fel magic; he can sense the origin.

You'll need payment if you seek him out, and you'll need luck on your side.

Some of us don't like reliving our past. The taint that was in our blood haunts him still, as it does for many of us. Leave me be, now.

Seek Vrang west of the road along the Barrens' northern foothills.
80322.progress: A customer! Greetings, <class>. Take a look at what I have to offer.
80322.completion:
Kiro sent you, no doubt. I didn't tell that cursed woman about my ability for her to send me customers!

If she has an urgent enough reason, then just give me the coin and show me the mark of fel. But I don't promise you'll like the answer I have to give about its source.

80323.title: [Deprecated] The Lies That Bind Us
80323.description: The magic that etched this belt came from Neeru Fireblade. I still cannot read the inscription, but with Neeru's hand in this, I can assure you that it is powerful. Go on your way now, <class>. I don't need the wrath of Neeru or his minions targeting me.
80323.progress: Welcome back, <name>. You still have the belt?
80323.completion:
Interesting.

<Gazlowe turns the belt over in his hands.>

Neeru Fireblade, eh? I wonder what Neeru is trying to pull right under Thrall's nose?

Go on, now, <name>. I've got a few contacts to reach out to. I'll get in touch with you when the next step is to be taken.

80330.title: The Hunter's Path
80330.description: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.

80331.title: [DEPRECATED] Taming the Beast
80331.description:
Whoa, whoa, easy there, champ! I can see you're chomping at the bit to tame a wild beast, but there's a catch. Us goblins don't exactly get along with nature, know what I mean?

<Viz grins wryly.>

Let me show you how it's done, the goblin way. See this rod? It comes with a special collar that I call the "Friend Request". You put this around any wild animal's neck and that beastie becomes your bestie, get me?

Probably oughta start you on something easy. A Dire Mottled Boar should be simple. You'll find them wandering around just outside of Razor Hill.

Even a kid like you should be able to do that much. So don't waste my time by coming back here without one!
80331.progress: Go on, then. Show ‘em who's boss.
80331.completion: So you're not completely incompetent. Alright then, let's really test your beast-wranglin' skills!

80332.title: [DEPRECATED] Taming the Beast
80332.description:
You see kid, every time you add a pet to your collection you become stronger. Your pet is like an extension of you. We goblins may not be the strongest, but we got the biggest brains. Let the animal be your strength while you make with the plans!

That goes double for showing 'em who's boss, feel me? Why wrestle a beast into submission when you can outsmart 'em?

Let's turn things up a notch. You're gonna have to get your boots wet for this next critter. This one really likes the sea, particularly past that Troll village down south.

You know the one... Sen'jin Village? Down near the Echo Isles. Keep your eyes peeled for a Surf Crawler, slap the ol' "Friend Request" on 'em, and bring it back to me.
80332.progress: Well? C'mon, kid! If you can't even tame a crab, you can kiss your dreams of taming a crocolisk goodbye!
80332.completion:
You made that look easy! You got a bright future in this hunter business, pal. You'll be bagging dragons in no time.

You can take that to the bank. I got a good intuition about these sorta things.

80333.title: [DEPRECATED] Taming the Beast
80333.description:
Time for your final exam, champ. You better be ready, 'cause otherwise you ain't coming back breathing. Our Orc friends call these babies Armored Scorpids.

They're quick on their tiny legs, and their carapace is light yet durable. Kinda goes with the whole "armored" thing. They got a deadly sting to boot, so if you get your hands on one, ain't no one gonna push you around no more, ever.

When you get back, I'm gonna show you something real nice. Let me tell you, pal, these skills are beyond mad! You'll be able to tame whatever beast you want, and call 'em and dismiss 'em at your leisure.
80333.progress: Move it, kid. You want to miss your chance to be a legendary beast-tamer? I mean, same goes for dying to scorpid venom, so... Don't take that big a chance.
80333.completion:
Look at you, kid! You grew up so fast. It's enough to make this old goblin tear up. Almost. Thanks for the merchandise. These are some great specimens. Now, you're gonna have to choose one of your own.

I've taught you all I know and given you my spare collar. It's pretty much unbreakable, but try to be careful with it anyway, alright?

You can summon and dismiss a pet whenever you want from now on. Flex that confidence you been building up with this training and all the critters in the land will call you master before long.

In no time at all, you and your pet will make an unstoppable duo! Payment due for these lessons when that day comes, by the way.

80334.title: [DEPRECATED] Taming the Beast
80334.description:
One last tip, kid! For a small addition to your tab, of course. There's an orc in Orgrimmar who goes by the name Ormak Grimshot. He can teach you how to train the beasts you tame.

What? You thought you were gonna become a big-shot hunter with a pet who can't learn some fancy tricks? I like you, kid: you're a laugh!

You can find Ormak in the Valley of Honor, as the orcs call it. Now hit the road! Next time we meet, it'll be when I'm on your doorstep to collect my payment.
80334.completion:
A young <class>, I see. Yes, I will grant you the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Now, go, <class>. We will speak again, at a later date.

80339.title: The Hunter's Path
80339.description: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.

80340.title: Taming the Beast
80340.description:
I am Clover Spinpistol, Mountaineer and Sniper. We may be good shots, but unfortunately us little folk aren't too suited for close combat. No worries, though! You just need to have a beast take the hits for you!

Tinker Town's best and brightest recently made an amazing scientific breakthrough to address our less than stellar record with large animals who find us appetizing and bite-sized.

You seem like a promising marksman. Just the talent we need in our efforts to retake Gnomeregan! To that end, I'll teach you how to use the patented G.N.O.E.M.R. Taming Rod.

Take this and try to use it on a Large Crag Boar. Make sure it's large!
80340.progress: Did you tame it yet? Did it work? Don't worry, you can tame another one if you don't like the attitude of this particular boar.
80340.completion: Oh, my! Well done. This rod definitely requires further testing, and you can get a better choice of companion in the process.

80341.title: Taming the Beast
80341.description:
Haha! My, that boar sure is a BIG one, isn't it? I bet you'd like something more suited to a gnome, though. How about a quick-thinking, majestic Snow Leopard?

You can find them to both the south and east of here. I've recharged your G.N.O.E.M.R. Taming Rod, so you're ready to go out there and catch a cat!

Watch out, though. They're far more feisty than that boar! Don't underestimate them or you might end up as kitty kibble!
80341.progress: Snow leopards are white and spotted to blend into the snow. They might be hard to find.
80341.completion: Wonderful! Now that's a pretty feline! Of course, in the end, I'll leave it up to you what beast you would like to tame.

80342.title: Taming the Beast
80342.description:
One thing I should mention is both the boar and the leopard are fierce offensive pets, but they leave a bit to be desired in defensive capabilities. Since our ranged weapons can pop ANY enemy with ease, what we need is something to keep them busy.

Hmm... I've got it! The Ice Claw Bear is sturdy and tenacious. When facing an angry bear, who would choose to go after a tiny gnome?

Ice Claw Bears can be found east of Kharanos. You have enough experience and skill under your belt now, so you should be able to handle one.

Once you're done, I'll give you access to the finalized Taming Rod so you can tame your own pet at will!
80342.progress: Did you get an Ice Claw Bear yet?
80342.completion:
Well done, <name>! Marvelous! Together we've proven to those snooty dwarves that we gnomes are just as capable Mountaineers as they are! Your brilliant success is more than enough to stifle any further snickering and teasing.

For that, I thank you, <name>. As promised, here's the schematic and instructions for the G.N.O.E.M.R. Taming Rod!

Now get out there, find yourself a companion, and show the world Gnomeregan's best!

80343.title: Training the Beast
80343.description:
Now that you've got your rod and all, <name>, you can tame companions of your own to help advance the cause of all gnomekind!

However, taming them isn't enough on its own. They also need training, and sadly, I don't have that knowledge to share. Even though you've done well under my tutelage, I can't mentor your pet! For that, you'll need to find someone else.

I know just the person for the job, too! If you're ever in Ironforge, there's a dwarf named Belia Thundergranite in the Hall of Arms. She should be able to help you out. Be sure to tell her I sent you!

Good luck!
80343.completion:
Spinpistol sent you? That must mean her hairbrained scheme panned out after all. That wee lass you trained with actually managed to accomplish her crazy scheme of taming beasts, then? I'll be... And you helped her? You're clearly more than meets the eye, already on your way to becoming a great <class>, I see.

Very well. I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, but you will also be able to feed your pet as well as revive it if it falls in battle.

Remember that the key to getting the most from your new pet is to respect it and treat it well. In turn, your pet will be your most loyal friend.

80350.title: Etched Rune
80350.description: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the hunter trainer Thorgas. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
80350.progress:
Ya made it! Good to hear! Betcha didn't have to track me to find the place either. Haha!

Our profession is pretty steeped in tradition, <name>. Learning the ways of the land. Learning to track a bear through the mountains. Even just surviving on wits alone takes a great deal of courage and cunning. Think you're capable?

Can't say I'm sure ye've got what it takes. A gnome hunter, eh? I can see you're determined to succeed and put your own twist on the profession, though, so who am I to stop ye?
80350.completion:
One thing you should always remember is that you gotta respect the world you're livin' in. The beasts that choose to fight along side you; the shine of your weapon; the weight of your ammo; the bite of a bitter wind; all these things you need to know intimately.

Fixated as the gnomes may be on technology and machinery, never forget that respect for nature it essential to a hunter. I'll do what I can to help you, but most of the work's up to you. Anytime you think you're ready, come back and talk to me. I'll train you when I can.

80352.title: Money Down The Drain
80352.description:
They had one job, <name>, one!

I asked those fools to be careful while transporting the oil and look at what they did. They probably had the mindless ogre on the ship's wheel.

Please sweety, do me a favour will you?

Get as much oil as you can from the barrels, we need it for our machinery to work. This swamp isn't at all forgiving, we need to defend ourselves, you know.

Anyway good luck comes with good coin so as soon as you have it come back.
80352.completion:
<name>, you're a doll! This is great, I can't thank you enough.

If you get any more you know where to find me.

80353.title: Unclear Instructions
80353.description:
Who would have imagined that asking an ogre to chop some wood, would have ultimately ended up with him forgetting to pick it up?

Numbskull brute started cutting and cutting but when he came back he didn't bring any of it back with him!

I would go pick it up myself but I am busy with uh... stuff. So why don't you do it?

People around here respect working folk and you will get paid what the action is worth, bub.

Go pickup a few bundles.
80353.progress:
Can you believe it? He went back to cutting!

Please tell me you got a few back.
80353.completion:
Ah yes, that's absolutely great bub. Just toss them right there, here's the pay.

There's always work for you here if you need it.

80360.title: Power Taken, Power Given
80360.description:
The journey from our forests in the old world to our new home here in Kalimdor was not only hard on us, but also the loa that protected us on the journey. So far from the forests they have roamed for millennia, they are weakened in their presence here.

Far to the south, the Sandfury trolls of Zul'Farrak have maintained a connection with Kimbul despite their distance from the Gurubashi's jungles. Seek Kimbul's power and return it to me. I will use the power granted by the Sandfury to increase our own loa's presence and strength in these foreign lands.
80360.progress: Akil'darah has blessed the winds at your back with what strength she has.
80360.completion: It will take time for our loa to begin to feel as if this is their home, just as it will take time for us to accept it as ours. We will grow together and nurture their spirits while they safeguard our homes. Halazzi's cunning keep your wits, until then.

80366.title: The Hunter's Path
80366.description:
Hello, young ranger, you appear to be doing well!

Our people struggles but we must endure, we must become more able than we were before.

There is a ranger in Alah'Thalas called Damilara Sunsorrow, she is said to be able to bend beasts to her will, such a technique would be useful to you, see if you can learn it from her.
80366.completion: Greetings, ranger. Yes, perhaps it is time for you.

80369.title: A Warm Feeling
80369.description:
Ah, you have made your way back once more, <name>. That is simply splendid, for I may have another task for you.

Nestled far in the south lies a coven of supremely ferocious creatures known as Owlbeasts. The place of their dwelling, known as Owl Wing Thicket, is renowned for being the home of a particularly bizarre herb.

Might I trouble you to kindly gather me around twenty of these precious plants? The Owlbeasts should have them on their person as a light snack.
80369.completion: Ah, excellent. Give me but a moment to concoct a brew. Give it a taste.

80370.title: A Donation of Wool: Silvermoon Remnants
80370.progress:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Alah'thalas for your generous actions. Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Wool Cloth(60)
80370.completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!

80371.title: A Donation of Silk: Silvermoon Remnants
80371.progress:
As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low. Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community! If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Silk Cloth(60)
80371.completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!

80372.title: A Donation of Mageweave: Silvermoon Remnants
80372.progress:
Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks! By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal. Such generosity would not go unnoticed by the Alah'thalas, I assure you!

If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Mageweave Cloth(60)
80372.completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!

80373.title: A Donation of Runecloth: Silvermoon Remnants
80373.progress:
<name>, you've been a tremendous contributor to our cloth drive. As we work hard to replenish our reserves, one form of cloth remains critically low - runecloth. We are in absolutely dire need of it, and we hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past!

If you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare. We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there. Runecloth(60)
80373.completion:
Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.

With all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!

80374.title: Additional Runecloth: Silvermoon Remnants
80374.progress: Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it. Runecloth(20)
80374.completion: Greetings once again, <name>! Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them. For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of Alah'thalas.

80375.title: A Donation of Wool: Revantusk Tribe
80375.progress:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Amani'alor for your generous actions. Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Wool Cloth(60)
80375.completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!

80376.progress:
As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low. Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community! If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Silk Cloth(60)
80376.completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!

Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks! By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal. Such generosity would not go unnoticed by the Amani'Alor, I assure you!

If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now. Mageweave Cloth(60)
80377.completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, <name>!
