80378.progress:
<name>, you've been a tremendous contributor to our cloth drive. As we work hard to replenish our reserves, one form of cloth remains critically low - runecloth. We are in absolutely dire need of it, and we hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past!

If you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare. We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there. Runecloth(60)

Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.

With all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!

80379.title: Additional Runecloth: Revantusk Tribe
80379.progress: Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it. Runecloth(20)
80379.completion: Greetings once again, <name>! Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them. For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of Amani'alor.

80380.title: Lizzi's Competitor
80380.description:
I've got a whole party of people to feed, but one of my rivals cut me off from all of my meat suppliers! Whoever it is must be jealous of my deccadent, fall-off-the-bone ribs and beer-battered seafood supreme. With a name like mine, I have big boots to fill.

I'll make sure they regret crossing me by making the best barbeque anyone's ever tasted! What's in it for you? Well, I have a Saltcrabs family secret that I can impart to you. It'll help you turn any venue into a great place for a picnic. Round up all of the little crab, crocolisk, and stag families and tell them to say their goodbyes, then bring me their insides. The beer I need for basting can be bought from a few vendors that you'll find on your adventures. Get whatever is cheapest.

Hurry up, I gotta cook all of this before the party starts!
80380.progress: Time's a-tickin', bub. Can't waste what's left of it before this big palooza so I can surprise the culprit with my amazing spicy crab souffle. It's a cutthroat cooking competition out here that drives people to do these crazy things, <name>, but I'm always one step ahead.
80380.completion: You got the goods? Sweet! I'll get cookin', but first, I promised you the Saltcrabs formula for a perfect brunch, didn't I? Well first, you set down a blanket, then you put up an umbrella! That was worth the effort, now wasn't it? Thanks for the meats, <name>. I'm gonna knock the pants off these partygoers!

80381.title: Shellcoins
80381.description:
Everyone thinks I'm crazy, but I promise in like, 5 years, you'll all be regretting it! I know for a fact that these shells will be a huge part of the new economy even if the so-called “economists” don't believe me.

The shimmering shells along the ocean floor, I call them “Shellcoins”, are going to be the next big thing.

They all call me a fool for investing, but I'll be filthy rich when the market blows up while they'll be mining for my scraps.
80381.progress:
What are you waiting for? Get in now. Buy buy buy!

Hurry before the market value skyrockets!
80381.completion:
Excellent work. I'll give you a tour of the inside of my mansion when the Shellcoin value reaches 1000 gold.

In the meantime, take some old hand-me-downs. They look like they might fit you.

80382.title: VIP Invites
80382.description:
What would a beach party be without a couple of trade princes, huh? I need big names at this event or else it'll be a flop!

Put on your fanciest clothes and deliver these special invitations out to Trade Prince Gazlowe in Ratchet and Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.

If they come, then more will be sure to follow. More bodies at the beach equals more gold lining my pockets, see? I'll give you something real nice in return.
80382.progress: Hurry up or you'll cramp my style! I don't want these guys to think I left their invites for last.
80382.completion:
Sweet, my party's gonna rock! I can't wait to see what kind of clout these boys bring.

If they're really high rollers, they'll buy a whole bar's worth of booze.

Thanks again for your help. Why don't you join us on this beautiful beach front? Not looking like that, though. You've gotta have the right stitching to kick it with me. Take these and put them on.

80383.title: Sharks Are Friends, Not Food
80383.description:
Do you see that dorsal fin rising out of the water? That's a shark.

It appears to have come too close to the shoreline which is an anomaly for this species. I'm a marine biologist by trade and I've been watching that poor creature for a while now.

There could be a number of reasons that it's trapped here, but the goblins want to kill it like a stuck pig!

They think it's a threat to people in the water, but it's probably just scared and confused.

I can't let that happen. I need you to go into the water and shoo the shark away.
80383.progress: Did you know that sharks have skeletons made of cartilage and not bones?
80383.completion:
You did it! Now that shark can get back to its lifestyle as the apex predator in the sea instead of being strung up like a trophy which is what these goblins would have done to it.

I have a little memento for you as a reward. Take good care of it, okay?

80384.title: Pinch of Salt
80384.description:
Dese crabs, troublemakers dey are!

Cutting my nets with the claws, scaring all the fish away! Every time I chase them dey bury themselves to the sand, Lau'Tiki isn't as nimble as his younger years.

About time for some revenge, pesky shell-walkers will get what dey deserve for messin' with Lau'Tiki!

Hunt them, bring me their shells and I might let you in a little secret.
80384.progress: Hunt them, bring me their shells!
80384.completion:
Ahahahhah! Good job, mon! For my part of the deal...

<Lau'Tiki crack opens one of the shells and extracts something from it.>

Here's da secret, mon. This tiny pesky bastard might come in handy when ya tame it and feed it. Though never fully trust it, dey like nibbling on fingers.

80386.title: A Gizmo a Day...
80386.progress:
I never thought we'd have a fresh start, and not in my wildest dreams I'd think we'd do that under the Horde's flag, but what do you know, here we are.

We currently are a small group of goblins that ran away with only scraps and dust in our pockets, but slowly we will make a name for ourselves, and if you want, you can be part of that.

The Labor Union grows day by day, goblins come our way to find a new meaning in life under the Horde's gaze, but we lack both means and resources.

If you wish to be part of the Union's future bring me a handful of Whirring Bronze Gizmos whenever you can. You will eventually get paid. Whirring Bronze Gizmo(20)
80386.completion: Your help is appreciated, sugar, keep them coming!

80388.title: [DEPRECATED] Stay Awhile and Listen...
80388.description:
Hmm, another one? Very well.

You seek to prove yourself to your people, no? To rise above all others as the strongest, no? To leave behind a legacy of courage and heroism, rather than to fade from history as yet another wanderer of no consequence, no?

I have your attention, do I? I have just the offer for you, then. I will grant you the opportunity to become Immortal, should you prevail over death in your journey for glory.

However... If you die, you shall not return. Your soul shall be forever severed from your body.

This offer I extend to you only here and now. There will be no second chance should you refuse my deal.
80388.completion:
Well then, have you decided, <class>? Do you have what it takes to become Immortal? Once you start walking this path, you will not be able to abandon it. It will forever dominate your destiny. Only those who follow the same path will be of aid to you.

No mail will ever bring you good news. No auction will take your money.

Very well. Should you die, your soul will forever be mine. If you survive the trials ahead, we shall meet again one day.

80390.title: Letter to Mudsprocket
80390.description:
A group of former Venture Co. Goblins have joined the Horde.

Some of them chose to settle in Dustwallow Marsh in a town they now call Mudsprocket, while not yet forgiven for their past sins, the boss wants me to send whoever is willing to get some coin to deliver this letter to whoever is in charge.

No idea how the Undermine is gonna take this and frankly not my business to think of, anyway, you will find them in South Dustwallow Marsh, careful not to mistake the place for the Dragon's lair instead though.

Take care, kid.
80390.progress: Durotar Labor Union, has a nice ring to it, doesn't it?
80390.completion: What's this, a letter from Gazlowe?

80391.title: Crawling for Meat
80391.description:
Greetings! Your company is welcome. I am Inunquaq of Moa'ki Harbor. I find myself in this strange land after weeks of sailing.

My tale began when a Winter Tauren friend of mine known as Buniq visited my settlement in her canoe, she invited me to accompany her to the village of Taunka'le. But as I entered the canoe, a strong icy gust blew the rope out of Buniq's hands. Within moments a strong current had taken me out to the open sea!

Buniq had the oars so all I could do was to desperately cling to the canoe and hope for the best.

Eventually the current took me here to this warm land that looks nothing like my home. Listen friend, the canoe had some provisions but I have finished them days ago. Would you please collect some meat from these shelled creatures nearby?

We have similar creatures in the far north, but I am without the tools and the knowledge I need to try and approach them, as far as I can guess they are edible. If you do so, I will be forever in your debt.
80391.progress: Did you get the meat? I feel my strength wane...
80391.completion:
My hunger has finally been sated, and my belly feels overjoyed!

You can have these odd objects I found while scavenging for tools as well as my friendship and gratitude. Hopefully in time I can find my way back to my homeland.

Thank you so much friend. I have the strength and soon I will have the tools to hunt for myself now as I seek a way home, you need not worry for me anymore, may our paths unite again one day.

80392.title: Package to Quel'Danil
80392.description:
Excuse me, may I have your attention for a second?

My name is Lieren and you look like a seasoned traveler. I have a task for you if you do not mind helping me, I am quite busy with my own, I need a package taken to Quel'Danil east of here.

Just look for an Elf lodge there and take it to my sister. My sister has similar features to mine, but she is all of elvish ancestry.

I've attached your payment to the package, now what do you say pipsqueak, will you help me out?
80392.progress: Welcome to Quel'Danil, how may I be of assistance?
80392.completion:
A package for me? From my sister? thank you so much. Here is your payment as promised.

Actually there is one more thing I would like you to help me out with...

80393.title: Errand for Quel'Danil
80393.description:
I hope it is not too much to ask for, but you look like the strong type.

The people of Quel'Danil are my family and they've been at odds with the terrible Witherbark Trolls for a long time! I am asking you to reduce their numbers, I don't want to see any more suffering, we have all lost so much already.

Shandra'lor hosts sadistic trolls and their pet spiders, I would like you to focus on those.

Once the job is done please report to my adoptive mother Voldana. She is deeper inside the lodge!
80393.completion: You have my deepest gratitude, <class>, and of course I'll make sure to thank Loania, too. You must be curious why a human is among us. If you are interested, then I shall tell you...

80395.title: A Glittering Opportunity
80395.description:
Hey, <race>! In addition to the usual weapons in my stock, I have an opportunity for you.

While I was doing my run from Ratchet to the Crossroads, I saw a weird light on the mountain just south of Ratchet. There seems to be a ramp up just outside Ratchet. Some raptors call the thing home though, so be careful.

Now I don't know what it is, but you adventurin' types like to dive right in when it comes to dangerous situations, right? It could be some HUGE deal like a demon cult or whatever for all I know, and them doing nasty stuff to Ratchet would be very bad for MY business. Consider whatever spoils you find as payment.
80395.progress: Oh my, greetings! Who are you?
80395.completion:
Oh you're an adventurer that has come to investigate the lights aren't you? Don't worry, I was merely experimenting with a special matter transmitter and it is of no danger to anyone!

Fear not, my experiment will be of use to everyone once it succeeds! On the other hand, I have a task for you if you wish to keep this area safer!

80396.title: A Bloody Good Deed
80396.description:
I am Kheyna Spinpistol. Mechanist, medic and killer of bad things.

I am currently tracking a dangerous foe who threatens the lives of countless innocents. I might ask for your help in dealing with this later, but for now, I have another task for you and a generous reward if you do it well!

The nearby Kolkar tribe is preparing for a raid on the Crossroads. I know this because I've used one of my tools, and you could say I "sneaked" into their tent and heard their Khan ordering it. This can be avoided, however. You'll save many lives if you go down there and put an end to them all.

They can be found around the Oasis to the west. Once you're done, come back to me. If I am not here, simply touch the crystal again and I will know someone is waiting for me. Now get out there and KILL them all!
80396.completion:
Wonderful. I wonder what it felt like to have their blood splatter all over you, or what came into your mind as you heard them scream in pain and fall like the vermin they are.

I wish I could have been there to see it for myself, heh.

Nonetheless, know that thanks to your violent deeds many lives were saved. Now, of course I'll be sure to reward you… Hmm, let's see… Yes, this will be something you can either use or sell for compensation.

I'll make sure to tell others of your deeds. Hopefully we'll meet again, <name>.

80397.title: Sap Their Strength
80397.description:
Welcome, <class>. We don't see many adventurers up this way — and not without reason.

The greed of the Venture Company has tainted the land itself. Every ancient tree that they fell only adds to my troubles.

The powerful sap that once nourished the trees of this forest now congeals into those awful sap beasts. Their corrosive nature harms the delicate balance we've fought to maintain here.

Worse still, many have recently made their way to Stonetalon Peak itself! Their corrosive sap kills the herbs I need for cooking and simple potions.

<class>, venture forth and rid the Peak of these things. You'll find many just south of here, over the ridge that holds the old ruins. We've little enough use for coin up here, but perhaps a few potions might serve as payment?
80397.progress: Have you rid the mountaintop of those sap beasts? Rest here for a moment and recover your strength.
80397.completion: Thank you, <name>! With the Venture Company's activities unchecked, this surely isn't the end of those sap beasts, but for now the forest is quiet and already healing. Here, take a few of my potions in thanks for your hard work. They should help you travel swiftly in this mountainous terrain.

80398.title: A Pounding Brain
80398.description:
You find out that the Pounder's Mainframe is surprisingly intact. This could be valuable!

Take it to an expert of Gnomish Engineering who might be able to do something with it.
80398.progress: Hello there, <race>, are you here for one of my inventions?
80398.completion:
Is that an actual intact Pounder Mainframe?! Where did you get this?

The possibilities with this are endless! Tell you what, if you allow me to copy the data from this mainframe then I will help you build a Pounder of your own!

80399.title: Zalazane's Apprentice
80399.description:
Makasgar, my once faithful apprentice, has become arrogant and deserted me. He has fled north along the coast with a vast amount of dark mojo I had reserved for my future plans.

Perhaps we can make a deal if you and your minions retrieve this artifact along with his head. Bring me what rightfully belongs to me, and you shall receive what you seek in return.
80399.completion: Zalazane's mojo and his apprentice's head? A job well-done. Here, I've got a reward for you. Just pick which one you want.

80400.title: Re-assembler!
80400.description:
<The dwarf looks flustered as he mumbles under his breath.>

Blast 'em buggers all to pieces...

Oh, hallo there. Perfect timing, my friend. Why, I'd sure as hell like yer helping hand!

So, listen up, I've had me book finished recently and was about tae get some components I needed fer ma new invention. I left me camp fer a wee spell and whaddayaknow?! Bloody troggs came over and had a carousin' with me stuff!

Alas, me book got ripped to pieces and judging by what's left of it, all 25 pages of perfectly drawn patterns and schematics were lost.

All I care about now is me book pages returned and them mauchit troggs sufferin' in the process. They're numpties, same as kobolds, but just like kobolds they tend to run in packs — so be careful when ye find them!
80400.progress:
Wreckin' me camp, stealin' me belongings, eatin' me haggis and even settin' me camp ablaze are nowhere near as horrible a crime as stealin' me bonnie book!

Make 'em suffer worse than a gryphon with clipped wings!
80400.completion:
Oh, me bonnie, precious, darling book! What did those scunnered bampots dae to ye?

Thank ye, <class>, I'll never forget yer kindness.

I'll be sure to add a dedication to yer name once I put me book back together!

80401.title: To Build a Pounder
80401.description:
Unfortunately, building a Pounder isn't easy. I will supply most of the components, but I will need you to get me some special things. It is up to you how you go about acquiring them.

I need the following:

A thorium tuned servo for the chassis. I only know of one, and it's been locked up by those Scarlet fanatics. I think the armory is where they store objects they consider heretical. Go get it for me!

In addition to that, I also need a perfect core for the Pounder. The Dark Iron golems in the Blackrock Depths make a good source. Golem Lord Argelmach probably has one.

The last component I need is a high quality adamantite rod used for the endoskeleton. I believe Stratholme's forges used to make such rods in the past. I do not know the state of the city, but I believe the rods may still survive there.
80401.progress: Welcome back! How did it go? Did you get the items yet?
80401.completion:
That's all the components! Wonderful!

While you were gone, I've been busy engineering your Pounder. All that's left is to apply the components you've brought and to paint it.

I didn't do the paint job yet so you could pick a color!

80403.title: The Zeppelin Crash
80403.description:
Not long ago, a goblin zeppelin crashed to the east. A representative of the Steamwheedle Cartel passed through here a few days ago.

She was looking for information about the zeppelin's cargo and its pilot, Beezil, but none of us really got a good look at the crash. I doubt she'll be able to clean up after the wreck by herself, much less recover whatever cargo the vessel might have carried.

If you have time, you may want to check up on her out at Beezil's Wreck, due east of here, near the mountains.
80403.progress: How can I be sure that I can trust you?
80403.completion: I suppose I can use the help. There's not much here a <class> would be interested in, anyway.

80404.title: Delivery for Drazzit
80404.description:
Drazzit will expect to hear something from me soon, but I don't think the site is secure enough for me to leave.

If you have time, would you be willing to take some of the salvaged cargo down to him at Mudsprocket?
80404.completion:
<Drazzit accepts the cargo from you.>

I'm so hungry, I could eat a dragon! Thank goodness Moxie finally got some of that cargo down here. We've been reduced to playing dice against the ogre for whatever he's managed to kill on his hunting trips!

80405.title: Secure the Cargo!
80405.description:
This zeppelin was carrying six months' worth of supplies to us at Mudsprocket! Sure, they've been able to barter for some of what they need, but they won't hold out forever.

I've been sent out here to recover what I can of the cargo, but the wreckage is scattered all over the marsh in this area. I'm sure a lot of the cargo didn't survive the crash, but are you willing to help me recover what we can?
80405.progress:
<Moxie looks frantic with worry.>

Did the cargo survive? Did you find any of it?
80405.completion: Wow! You certainly found a lot more than I expected would be out there. I'm not sure how much Drazzit thought we were going to find out here, but he's going to have to be happy with this for now.

80407.title: A Letter From a Friend
80407.description:
Hey!

You're <name>, right? I received a letter from a certain Kheyna Spinpistol. She paid me handsomely to direct you to a crashed gnomish rocket car north west of town.

She said you'll know what to do when you find 'it' .
80407.completion:
Hello again, <name>! I see that Reas succeeded in her task.

Good, good! I have need of your aid again!

80408.title: A Slaughter for Brains
80408.description:
My search for my nemesis continues, but as that search continues, so too does the work that needs to be done. I have needs of brains! I am currently researching an amazingly innovative technology, but it needs to be perfected for all races.

I need more samples and I know exactly where to get them! Far south and slightly east of Gadgetzan you will find a set of Troll ruins known as the Eastmoon Ruins! There are Ogres there. Tear them apart violently! They're going to attack the water reserves of Tanaris and cause a lot of people to die from thirst.

Water is already expensive, but if the reserves are destroyed by those brutes, the price will skyrocket and most people won't be able to afford water. Let's avoid that. Kill them all. Once you have them, take the brains to Reas and then come back to the crystal.
80408.completion: You really got 12 brains?! Sick! Well, money is money.

80409.title: Return to Kheyna
80409.description: I will deal with these as instructed. You better go back to whoever sent you.
80409.completion:
The person you've been helping has been working to change history. Not only that, but the crystal you've been using is no simple invention, it is a time crystal, and it has been somehow corrupted and twisted!

I first took notice of this in when time was altered in the Barrens and I intended to observe, but now? I can't ignore this. I'll be taking this corrupt time crystal and I will find that gnome and take her into custody.

I will do my best to investigate this entire affair and I may ask for your help later. Do not work for her anymore or I'll have to punish you. Also I found this in a crate by the crystal, it was supposed to be your reward I guess. Normally I'd confiscate it, but I'll look the other way if you help me capture her the next time she shows up.

80410.title: A Timely Situation
80410.description:
Excuse me, <name>. I received a peculiar message from the Cenarion Circle recently, but it wasn't addressed to me, it was addressed to you.

<Rayne hands you a letter, as you open it, the letter only contains a few words and no signature: "It is time. Meet me inside the inn of Andorhal on the second floor.">
80410.progress: There you are, <name>! You're late! Or early. Well, it doesn't matter, at least you came.
80410.completion: Remember back in Tanaris when I told you I'd call for you when the time came? Well, that time has come. I've found her!

80411.title: An Infinite Hunt
80411.description: I have been hunting her for a while now, but she is extremely elusive! Every time we get close, she escapes. However, she intends to contact you again. This time we'll set a trap. Go to Seradane, avoid the Emerald Portal and proceed to the largest temple. You'll find another of her corrupted time crystals. Use it and summon her. Then I will appear and we will defeat her together!
80411.progress: There you are. I have been given much to ponder on.
80411.completion: It seems that this mysterious dragon seeks to corrupt the timeways. I have my disagreements with Kheyna over her disruptive actions, but I've put them aside now because of this greater threat. It seems that this dragon she was hunting has caused a major disruption at a specific point in time. She also mentioned a master so there may be more of them. I hope I can count on you when the time comes. For now, we will do our best to keep things stable as we figure out how to move ahead from here. Kheyna will cooperate with us under strict supervision. Her fate will be decided after this is dealt with. We have prepared this replica sword as your reward.

80604.title: A Journey Into The Caverns
80604.description:
Our enemy is no longer in this time, but I have reason to believe they are in the past. I will tell you more but not here, you never know who might be listening.

Travel to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

I have given you authorization to enter since you are involved in this matter.

Once you arrive talk to me again.
80604.progress: There you are... Try not to step into the time streams, and whatever you do never try to enter the hourglass.
80604.completion:
Do not mind the weirdness here too much, it's all timey wimey.

You'll get used to it... Maybe. Anyway. Thank you for coming and welcome to the Caverns of Time!

This is where the Bronze Dragonflight lives, and it is also where the time ways to different periods in history are.

The corridors that you can see here are ever changing and shifting.

From one moment to the next a corridor before you can be replaced with another.

Alas you can never truly experience the timeways with your limited perception of time.

But I digress, we have a job to do!

80605.title: The First Opening of The Dark Portal
80605.description:
Roughly seventeen years ago, Medivh the last guardian under the control of Sargeras opened the Dark Portal, and let the Orcish Horde into this world. We have detected a temporal anomaly in the area consistent with the same energy that Kheyna and Antnormi had.

Kheyna is all but certain that Antnormi is behind this, please enter the southern timeway and stop Antnormi before she damages history, I will oversee the situation from here. Before you doubt whether this is a bad thing, the Orcs were instrumental in defeating the Legion, I assure you, the outcome if they didn't arrive is catastrophic!
80605.progress: Please... You cannot let her win!
80605.completion:
<Kheyna stares somberly at the head, her ocular implants contracts for a moment>

Antnormi was like a sister to me once.

I wish this could have ended differently, but alas... We did what we had to.

For the time being I will remain here until Chromie figures out what to do with me. I was once a Bronze dragon after all, maybe I can be one again if we find a cure.

Remember when I had you collect brains for me? That work paid off, and I've made a version of my implant that can connect to your brain without needing to drill into your skull.

It's your reward for what you've done. Take it, it'll help you.

I also wish to introduce myself to you properly. My real name is Keridormi. I've never had many friends, so thank you for everything you've done for me.

Perhaps we will meet again in time. Stay safe!

80606.title: Revenge on Game Masters!
80606.description:
Have you ever seen one of those mysterious individuals that garb themselves in blue with hoods and robes, and travel through the land punishing those who make things unmerry for others?

Not many people have seen one, or know about them at all. For once they should be the ones to be punished!

It must be them who took my gloves, for who else could be responsible to make it disappear from my hands?!

I am not sure where you can find one, but should they appear, snowball them in the face for me and let them know it shall not be tolerated!
80606.progress: Did you find one of the mysterious masters of our world yet?
80606.completion:
You did it? Wonderous!

Maybe now they'll think twice before making my glove disappear.

Wait, they didn't take my glove?

Well, hopefully they don't take my other one now...

80700.title: A Particular Letter
80700.description:
I've been looking for you all around the city! Although I am more of an announcer than a mailman I was instructed to give this letter to you by well… I am not sure who he was.

The figure's face was covered and his voice didn't seem familiar at all. He said you will understand when you read it.

I am not one to pry, <name>, but be more careful, I wouldn't let the guards know I associate myself with those kinds of people.
80700.progress: Just take it off my hands before the guards think we're doing something shady.
80700.completion: Here's the letter, I hope I won't have to do this again.

80701.title: The Elusive SI:7
80701.description:
Burn this after you've read it.

<name>,

I dearly hope this letter finds you in good health, I wish I could've delivered the message in person but you must understand that we like to keep secrecy at hand.

I am not sure if you're aware of what our organisation does, or who we entirely are, but we have discovered valuable information and we might need your help.

In the envelope you will find a ring, keep it at hand while you come visit us, it will be the sign you've accepted our mission and that the letter was burnt.

Until we meet,
Mathias Shaw.
80701.progress: How can I help you, stranger?
80701.completion:
Ah, my ring.

It seems you've made it, apologies for the secrecy but we must be careful, even our walls have ears that do not belong to the organisation.

80702.title: Young and Foolish
80702.description:
My agents have reported that a Scarlet caravan has started moving through various towns.

From what we know they have already gone to Lakeshire, Darkshire, Menethil and Southshore.

My only assumption is that whoever took over the Crusade after the events that transpired the Scarlet Monastery, Hearthglen and Stratholme has realised they've been running short on men.

I want you to go and speak to the people of Lakeshire. The locals should have at least seen something.
80702.completion:
So we were right, this would've been valuable information if we didn't already receive another report.

Sorry about that, <name>. I will be needing your help once more.

80703.title: Thandol Span
80703.description:
Yeah bub that's all I know, now I don't say I deserve any kind of compensation for the information but it will highly be appreciated.

<Kixxle holds open his palm but you refuse to pay.>

Fine then, go on and follow the road to that bridge, Thandol Span or whatever, I hope those Scarlets get you for being such a prick!
80703.progress: The Scarlet Crusade must be put to an end.
80703.completion:
So this is all you could salvage from the idiots that willingly murdered our caravan, eh?

I’ll take him to the dungeon, good job.

80704.title: Are You True to Your Nature?
80704.description:
We've been trying to no avail to interrogate the young lad you brought back, <name>. He simply wouldn't talk, me and the other guards tried to persuade him as best as we could.

Considering you were there to put an end to their masquerade, I'd assume you'd have a better chance to draw some information out of him.

Credits given where credits are due, you did a great job putting piece to piece together and finding them.

Take whatever approach you'd like, just see it done.
80704.progress: The figure in front of you is displeased at your sight and is practically tearing you apart in their mind.
80704.completion:
You are at an impasse, not sure how to proceed. Given the circumstances you must make the best out of what you have. While contemplating the matter you take a wide look around the room, noticing that Stoutfist and the other guards left some means of approach to you. It's time for you to decide how to approach the interrogation of the prisoner.

The coffee mug on the table tells you it'd be best to persuade him. The iron maiden next to him gives you other ideas.

80705.title: The Means of Persuading
80705.description:
During your many adventures through Azeroth you have faced several perils and foes, unlike the man present before you.

You are more than sure he's not a wicked sort and chose to approach this lightly, staying true to your nature.

With a table full of choices you pick the best means of persuasion and are ready to begin.
80705.progress: The report seems incomplete, other than some basic information of the prisoner there's really nothing useful there.
80705.completion: Reaching for the quill and ink, you note the information you extracted from Vladeus thus finalizing the report.

80706.title: Seeking Justice or Vengeance?
80706.description:
You've met many foes on your several adventures through Azeroth, for the first time something in you clicked.

How many more scum do you have to beat, maim and kill so that this twisted world gets its damnable peace?

The Scarlet Crusade has been a personal thorn in your sides as well, maybe it's time to deliver some sort of justice or is it vengeance?

With a table full of tools that will aid you to obtain what you need, you are ready to embrace your demons.
80706.progress: The report seems incomplete, other than some basic information of the prisoner there's really nothing useful there.
80706.completion: Reaching for the quill and ink, you note the information you extracted from Vladeus thus finalizing the report.

80707.title: The Price Of Information
80707.description: You've extracted all the information you could get from Vladeus. Deciding you're done with him you let him rest and think about your next actions.

80708.title: Scarlet Aid
80708.description:
My boys made preparation for the prisoner to reach Stormwind. His fate will be decided there since he’s part of their jurisdiction.

You were of great help and I am sure you want to poke around this thing even further. I might have a lead for you, not sure how much it will help though.

Under the Cathedral District’s Chapel there’s a priest in red robes. The intel I got from Shaw’s men says that his name is Brother Crowley and was sent by the Scarlet Crusade inside the city as an ambassador of sorts.

His mission was to recruit the willing to fight in the name of the Light or whatever stupid lie these Scarlets are telling to themselves.

In any case, Crowley hasn’t been that active. We are not sure if he’s the one to recruit these blokes but it’s worth a try.
80708.completion:
Bold accusation, <race>, I almost feel offended.

I fear it was not me, things would’ve been simpler. I assume you got a name from your prisoner. Tell me what happened.

80709.title: Donning the Red Flag
80709.description:
Abbendis must be stopped and you will be one of the thorns in her side and how better should you do it if not from the inside?

While I hold no skill in the arts of the Arcane, a dear friend of mine who, just like me, would love to see her fall has provided me in the past with a few scrolls that could change one’s appearance.

I am more than happy to offer you one if you were to tell nobody of it. Let’s just say the scrolls were for something more meaningful, yet desperate times call for desperate measures.

Use this when close to Tyr’s Hand, claim to be one of the disciples of the caravan you destroyed and claim your team was slain by the ogres of Arathi.
80709.completion:
We’ve been expecting at least a handful of new recruits, not just one.

Explain yourself immediately.

80710.title: It’s All in Their Brains
80710.description:
Ready for your first assignment?

Your armor looks shabby and your blade dull but if you’re not able to pull up your own weight you’re not worth the trouble of the Light.

Travel the Plaguelands, slay any undead in your path and bring me their brains. Their brains are essential for something the High General has planned, simply do your job and ask no questions.

Go you fool, the Light waits for nobody, go on and claim your glorious purpose.
80710.progress: Don’t worry yourself with details, do as you were told.
80710.completion:
Perfect condition, if anything this rotten could be called something other than disgusting.

Blasted Scourge, I hope the High General is right.

Now onto your next task, recruit.

80711.title: Supplies We Need
80711.description:
Your next errand is to simply collect a few things here and there, nothing special.

You will find these while fighting Elementals and plants in some of the actual dangerous zones of the world, but I am more than sure you will succeed if you truly are chosen by the Light.

Bring me Savage Fronds and Core of the Elements, fifty of each, it will be a great help in what we wish to achieve.

When and if you return you will officially be a member and I will give you a map as to where to find the entrance for the secret training spot.

May the Light bless your poor soul. If you return we will embrace you as a sibling, if you do not we will not mourn for you even for a second.
80711.progress: It’s a simple task, kill and collect, what more do you want?
80711.completion:
Welcome back, brother and may the Light bless us both in the days to come.

Here’s your insignia and here’s the map for the entrance, the High General will be very pleased to have you.

For the Scarlet Crusade, for the Light and for Lordaeron!

80721.title: Grim News
80721.description:
Word has come to me of strange occurrences on the frontlines.

Some of our Queen's finest servants have gone missing. Too many, too swiftly and with conspicuous precision to be mere ill luck in warfare.

My Deathstalkers are preoccupied with far direr tasks, hence I would have you travel to Brill, the Sepulcher and Tarren Mill to collect the accounts of the local executors in their stead.

Return to me, and if I am pleased, I might just reward you.
80721.progress: I will empty your veins if you dare dawdle before me for one more fruitless instant.
80721.completion:
The fanatics of the Scarlet Crusade are behind this?

Here I thought such cunning to be bereaved of their agitable little brains.

80722.title: To Catch a Rat...
80722.description:
If we truly want to unravel the truth of this ploy, we will have to spur the Scarlets to play their cards into our hands.

For this purpose, I have pressed a Deathguard into your service. His name is Maverin, or Moverish — human names are a blight to my tongue.

You will find him in the graveyard near the path to the Monastery in the north. Have him play the bait, he is not a valuable asset, then slay the Scarlets and seize whatever you can find of this curious new weapon in their arsenal.

Do not disappoint me.
80722.progress:
You return already.

How is Meverius? Not too tarnished, I hope?
80722.completion:
I can smell the sweet stench of man-blood on you, <name>. Good, very good.

As for Deathguard Mavonius there, the Undertakers and Apothecaries can tend to him, and I expect that to be the last of your concerns.

80723.title: Trusted Apothecary
80723.description:
So this potion is the crux of the Scarlet schemes. Dull, crude and yet irritatingly potent.

I myself do not dabble in the low craft of alchemy. Fortunately, our Queen's Royal Apothecaries favor the art of pondering alembics and grinding grass.

Venture to the Apothecarium, find Apothecary Zwinker and show her what you have found. She is a creature of mine.

Go, be quick and be discreet.
80723.progress: Zwinker...Yes, I can see that Lord Varimathras sent you.
80723.completion:
My name is Zinge, <class>.

Show me what you've brought and I shall help you as I can, if such is my lord's command.

80724.title: Consulting an Expert
80724.description:
I did perform a few precursory tests on the substance you have with you. All I have been able to discern is that the potion contains Peacebloom and Ghost Hair.

But that cannot answer for the catatonic state it forces upon undead.

It is my hypothesis that this concoction has been tampered with some manner of higher spellcraft, and that is beyond my abilities to solve.

There is only one who can give us the answers we need. He dwells at the centre of Brightwater Lake, east of Brill.

Approach him with great reverence and measure your words accordingly.
80724.completion:
If your tale and the effects of this potion are true, you were right to come to me.

This is a weapon that should never lay in the hands of the Scarlet Crusade. As for what it is, you will have to indulge me momentarily.

80725.title: In Gunther’s Favor
80725.description:
I sometimes long for Dalaran and of the days I once lived as no more than a mere student of the arcane arts.

When the Scourge shackled me to their dominion, my old memories were the only tether that kept me from losing myself utterly.

I do not intend to burden you with my life's story, <name>, but I already know what this vial is and how it was made, yet I need you to do me a favor before I tell you. Think of it as an equivalent exchange.

Go to the decadent town of Ambermill: Behind its town hall I buried a locket and sealed it with magic.

I will give you a scroll that will erase its warding spell, retrieve the locket, and return it to me. Then we shall talk.
80725.completion:
You had to battle a mage for it?

I presume he failed to speak his name as you slew him, but that ought to be no concern of ours.

You fulfilled your end of the bargain, <name>, and it is now my turn to repay the debt.

80726.title: Soul and Alchemy
80726.description:
The potion brewed by the Scarlets that you retrieved is known as the Draught of Dormant Death, or Mortudiant as we scholars prefer.

It was first conceived during the Second War, in Dalaran, to aid in countering the unhallowed might of Gul'dan's death knights.

It can only be concocted with a specific alchemical implement commonly used in transmutation known as the Philosopher's Stone. Which, unfortunately, I neither possess nor know how to emulate.

For now, you should return to your masters in the Undercity with what you've learned. I will keep the potion and see whether I can learn anything else.
80726.progress:
My loyal <race> returns.

Go on, speak.
80726.completion:
Bah, draughts, potions and stones. Could there be anything more tedious?

At least that so-called 'lich' made himself useful. As did you.

You have pleased me once more.

80727.title: Dark Temper for a Dark Lady
80727.description:
I have prepared a report of our findings to be delivered to the Dark Lady.

She will little like what she shall read, and it would be a shame if her wrath were to be your end.

So kneel before her, appease her, serve her as loyally as you served me...but do not forget to whom you belong.
80727.progress: <Sylvanas takes the report you give her. She does not open it.>
80727.completion:
Do you think me a fool, <name>? Did you think I would be unaware of what occurs within my own realm, within my own throne room?

<Sylvanas shreds the report with her hands.>

80728.title: The Future Looks Grim
80728.description:
I know all of the draught that clouds the minds of my warriors, your collusion with my dreadlord and the deathguard you've squandered at his behest.

But perhaps you have grown fond of Varimathras. Would you like to be one of his playthings? One word and I will make sure you are his. Forever.

No? You yet value your soul? Pity.

Then you will do as I say and go to Tyr's Hand, in the Eastern Plaguelands. Fetch a Scarlet uniform from those zealous fools and bring it to Gunther. He will know the rest.

Go now, begone from my sight.
80728.progress:
Yes, the Banshee Queen forewarned me of your arrival. Do you have the uniform at hand?

It might make amends for the unfortunate feelings I hear you roused in her.
80728.completion: That will suffice. Lay it here for a moment. It will not take me long.

80729.title: A Different Shade of Red
80729.description:
As you may have divined, we contrive to infiltrate you into the ranks of the Scarlet Crusade.

Upon the uniform you've brought me I placed an illusion charm, as well as a few greater cloaking wards to keep the enchantment from easy detection.

All that is left is for you to introduce yourself as a novice to the recruiters in Tyr's Hand.

One such recruiter should be Mavel Brightwood.

I wish you luck, <name>. Have your wits about you and find out what you can of their meddlesome alchemists.
80729.completion: Ah, another recruit, what took you so long to get here?

80730.title: Caravan Meets Caravan
80730.description:
The SI:7 have means of communication that reach us quite fast and believe it or not they are very reliable.

Sparing you any further details you should know that a dwarven caravan that was meant to reach Aerie Peak never made it out of the Wetlands.

The caravan lays in ruins and you can only find the mutilated husks of what used to be dwarves.

Our agents already poked around the zone but failed to find anything, they are currently trying to localize these newly recruited Scarlet zealots.

I'm not very sure how much of a detective you believe yourself to be, but I ask you to take a second look, maybe they missed something.

If you find the recruits, keep in mind that we aren't sure what manner of persuasion the Scarlets used to brainwash them, spare as many as you can and take them to Menethil.
80730.progress: Now do you want to buy something or just bother me?
80730.completion:
Listen here pal, I am trying to make a living, so you either buy something or scram!

Of course unless you got something else to talk about but make it quick!

80735.title: An Uncommon Request
80735.description: Fulfill my request and I will teach you ancient, powerful knowledge.
80735.completion: You have done well. I will now teach you what I know to uphold our agreement.

80736.title: A Rare Request
80736.description:
You are not the only one who came here seeking forgotten knowledge. However, just like everyone else, it will not simply be given to you. Fulfill my request and I will teach you what I know.

You will need the help of a good alchemist, one whom I have taught my secrets.
80736.progress: What are you waiting for? Bring me 3 Refined Scales of Onyxia. Are you not eager for my knowledge?

80738.title: Recipe: Gurubashi Gumbo
80738.description:
The Gurubashi trolls have a unique recipe for gumbo that can boost the willpower of those that consume it. It is often eaten by their fiercest warriors before combat.

I have obtained such a recipe and am willing to trade it to those who prove themselves in the arena.

Bring me Tokens of Blood and you too may learn this recipe.
80738.completion: Endulge in the secret recipe of the Gurubashi with glee. You are as reknowned as their most savage fighters.

80739.title: Formula: Enchant Gloves - Major Strength
80739.description:
A fierce and quick bout of combat in the arena is often decided by the strength to overcome.

Such power can overcome those that are unprepared, or give you the last bit of desire to win in the heat of battle.

Such strength can be found in this enchantment once held by the Gurubashi trolls. For a price, it can also be yours.
80739.completion: Power now lies at your fingertips. Use this enchantment wisely, and you can overcome great obstacles.

80740.title: They Took Our Dragon!
80740.description:
<name>, the Lunar Festival needs you! During the celebration a sneaky satyr snuck in and stole our most special firework. It was a special kind of firework I managed to get from the Goblins of Booty Bay. He claims he managed to buy this off some traveling merchant that claimed he was from all the way to Pandaria.

Its beauty would cover the entire sky of Moonglade in the form of a dragon serpent. You must retrieve it! It was supposed to be our greatest surprise for this year's Lunar Event.

If the revelers are to be believed this satyr came at the behest of Lorgus Jett. A thievling cultist that hides in the Blackfathom Deeps. Retrieve my prize and I will offer you, yours!
80740.completion: Oh, it's you! And you got it back. Elune herself thanks you for your kindness. Here's a surprise for you.

80745.title: Illuminate the Moonlit Night
80745.description:
The Mid-Autumn Festival is upon us, a time to celebrate unity and joy under the moonlit sky. You’ve been chosen to take part in the ancient lantern-lighting ceremony, a tradition that fills the night with glowing blessings.

Head to the riverbank, place your lantern on the waters, and watch as it drifts, carrying your wishes for peace and prosperity. The spirits of the water will guide your light, spreading warmth and hope through the night.

Return once the lantern has set sail, and you'll be rewarded for your participation in this sacred event.
80745.completion:
The lanterns have drifted far, carrying your blessings to the world.

May the light you’ve set forth bring peace and joy to you and yours during this festival.

Take these mooncakes as a token of our gratitude.

80755.title: Training the Beast
80755.description:
Yes, yes, I understand why Liott sent you to me. Without that incantation, you would have had quite the struggle taming all but the most indiscriminate of beasts. Now you may tame living creatures the world over!

But you must know that is not enough. You must realize that the true power of the creatures you turn to your whims lies in bestowing them the talents you observe in the wild. It is not enough to simply sic a wild animal upon your foes.

If you wish to tap into the true potential of your pets, then speak to me once again. I will spare no detail in enlightening you in the ways of the beast master.
80755.completion:
I will now grant you the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Now, go. Gather your beasts and turn them to the cause of the Dark Lady.

140821.title: Strategic Strike
140821.description: Listen up, soldiers! Our scouts have identified one of the orcs' battlefield leaders. He is an extraordinarily bloodthirsty and cunning blademaster by the name of Axun. Take a company of men, and search for him. The sooner we eliminate this menace, the better our chances of holding the line. We must not let these savages advance further into human lands.
140821.progress: Clear your head of impure thoughts, <class>. We must trust the light to guide us to victory.
140821.completion: Well done! I was starting to think no one would take down that monster!
